tei:div.tei:p: 3:bye 0ditram̐ 1 ba0 tha 3 kyekye 3 030 0000 0 50shag03 7 3 ma07ma0 ri0 5 mam
༄༅/ rdzong gter rig 'jin kun bzang nyi ma'i zab gter gsung 'bum gyi dkar chag mkha' spyod badza da pa'i lam yig bzhugs/

༄༅/ na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki bh+yaḥ sirnya'i dwangs mchor 'dab stong chu skyes dbus/ /snang mtha'i sgyu 'phrul mtshan dpe'i khye'u chung sku/ /gsang chen snying po'i bstan pa'i shing rta che/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma ka ras skyongs/ /lo paṇa rje 'bangs slar yang 'jin rten khams/ /bsam bzhin mi yi srid pa bzungs ba'i tshul/ /bdud 'joms ging dang 'dzam ging dbang rgyal sogs/ /gte/ rten yab sras brgyud bar bcas la 'dud/ khrid byung zab gter chu bo bdun ldan gyi/ /'phrin las gdul bya'i zhing kun khyab zlodzad /pa'i/ /parto'i rgya/ tshab nus ldan gling ba yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu rges pa'i me tog stsol: gang gizab gter bgrang yas rgyu skar las/ /nyi zla zung dang tho rangs skar chen ltar/ /zhal bzhugs glegs bam 'bras chos nyer lnga'i grangs/ /gsal byed dkar chag bla ma'i bka' bzhin bri/ /shayang lang 11 dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ 'brog ban khye'u chung lo tsā sogs kyi sku gsung thugs kyi sprul ba'i zlos gar/ gter chen brgya dang rtsa brgyad/ gter phran stong dang rtsa gnyis/ yang gter bye ba

༄༅ / sa ya'i 'phrin las kyi bka' bab rig 'dzin nus ldan rdo rje'am yongs grags su rdzong gter kun bzang nyi ma mtshan snyan gyi dbyar rnga srid zhi'i bla na ldir ba de yi gter 'bum la zab gter chu bo bdun ldan zhes sa gter dang 'brel ba'i yang gter/ dag snang dang 'brel ba'i snyan rgyud/ dgongs gter dang 'brel ba'i rjes dran te chu bo drug dang / rgyal ba'i bka' srol slong ba'i bab so dang bdun ldan pa ni zab gter chu bo bdun ldan te khyon pod drug cu lhag bzhugs kyang bar lam dus kyi 'pho 'gyur drag po'i 'og glegs bam 'ga' zhig ni gtor brlags su shor song / da skabs 'bras chos nyer lnga'i grangs bzhugs pa'i thog mar/ga) pod la/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rig 'dus ma hā gu ru'i sgrub skor dang / snyan rgyud snying gi dum bu las: rig 'dzin rtsa sgrub/ rig 'dzin gdung sgrub/ rig 'dzin thugs sgrub dang / 'od gsal rig pa'i brda mdzod las: rjes rim 'gugs bstim rgyas gdab kyi rim pa bcas ldeb grangs 467) dang rgya nag gi e grangs ltar na shog ngo'i

934) bzhugs/gnyis pa/ kha) pod la/ gsol 'debs rnam gsum dang / snyan rgyud 2na po che'i sgron me las: don dam bla ma'i sgrub pa mi shigs don gyi snying po'i sgrub skor dang / dag snang pas sa rgyan sman gyibla ma'i sgrub skor/ zab gsang rdo dzosnying po las: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i sgrub pa/ gser chag snying po 'bru bdun las: bde mchog dkar po'i phyag rgya sogs ldeb grangs 194)dang rgya'i e grangs ltar 388) bzhugs/gsum pa/ ga) pod la/radadzadangs gter las bar chad lam sel/ zab gsang rdo dzosnying po las: rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i chos skor: gu ru phyag rgya zil gnon gyi sgrub pa/dag snang las: gu ru'i rnam thar gser gyi bum chung mkha' 'gro'i yi bstod/ pad+ma'i rnam thar dri med shel bum/ pad+ma'i rnam thar rin chen sgron me/ pad+ma'i rnam thar shel dkar

༄༅ / bum bzang / gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma'i don bsdus bdud rtsi'i snying po/ dam chos gsang ba yongs 'dus las: o rgyan gter 'byung rgyal po'i sgrub pa/ snyan rgyud rin po che'i mdzod las: 'od gsal bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'ja' lus mngon byed: mkha' 'gro'i gsang sgrub lam 'byer/ ma cig ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs sprin phung / dag snang las/ bsam lhun nyung bsdus/ sme brtsegs/ 'od gsal nyams kyi thol glu/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs ldeb grangs/ 267) dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na/ 534) bzhugs/bzhi pa/ nga) pod la/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i sgrub pa ldeb grangs 161) dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 322) bzhugs/lnga pa/ ca) pod la/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dpal chen rdo rje khro lod kyi hūm̐ sgrub thig le'i rgya can gyi sgrub pa ldeb 237) dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 474)

bsdo/ga'asdo/drug pa/ cha) pod la/ dam chos grol ba'i thig le las: zab tig yang snying 'dus pa'i rtsa gsum sgrub skor la ldeb grangs 211) dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 422)bsdo/ga44/bdun pa/ ja) pod la/ dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las: dbang chen rta khyung drag po'i sgrub par ldeb grangs 524) dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 104//bsdo/gas/brgyad pa/ nya) pod la/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen rta mgrin dmar po'i sgrub skor gyi snga dum la ldeb grangs 444) dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 88she

༄༅ / bzhugs/dgu pa/ ta) pod la/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen rta mgrin dmar po'i sgrub skor gyi phyi dum la ldeb grangs 48go dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 96du/bsdogab/tha / bcu pa/ tha) pod la/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can gyi sgrub skor la ldeb grangs 11// dang rgya'i e grangs ltar ba 23she bzhugs/bcu gartsig pa/ da) podal/ dam chos thugs kyi gter kha las: phur ba lha nag gi sgrub skor dang: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dpal chen 'byung 'dul gyi sgrub skor bcas ldeb grangs 211) dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 42// bzhugs/

bcu gnyis pa/ na) pod la/ dag snang yeshes kyi'akhor lo snyan rgyud rin po che'i mdzod las: bka' brgyad bder 'dus kyi sgrub skor bcas ldeb grangs 11shi dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 22// bzhugs/bcu gsum pa/ pa) pod la/ zab chos drimed klong yangs las: gu drag gnam lcags me 'bar/nyams snang blug le'i chos skor las: gu ru gtum drag rgyal po'i sgrub pa/ dam chos thugs kyi gter kha las: drag khros skor gsum gyi sgrub skor/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: 'jam dpal nag po na ga rak+ka'i sgrub skor bcas ldeb grangs 23zhe dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 47she zhugs/ ༄ bcu bzhipa/ pha) pod la/ drag sngags mi'adus spu gri'i 'od zer las/ rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog ngan sngags kyi rgyal po'i sgrub skor khyung nag gtad dkrugs bcas ldeb

༄༅ / grangs 556) dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 1112) bzhugs/bco lnga pa/ ba) pod la/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: thugs rje chen po dri med pad+ma dkar po'i sgrub skor la ldeb grangs 377) dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 754)bsdo/gas/bcu drug pa/ ma) pod la/ zab chos 'od gsal snying thig las: zhi khro ngan song dong sprugs kyi sgrub par ldeb grangs 135) dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 270)bsdo/gathab/bcu bdun pa/ tsa) pod la/ dag snang sgyu 'phrul rol ba las: dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub pa dang: dag snang las: mi 'khrugs pa'i mchod chog bcas ldeb grangs

158) dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 316) bzhugs/bco brgyad pa/ tsha) pod la/ dag snang las: sgrol dmar dbang gi rgyal mo'i sgrub pa/ zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig las: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub pa/ dag snang ye shes rol ba las: zhus lan gyi gab don rje btsun 'phags ma tā re'i phyi sgrub maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga bcas ldeb grangs 36// dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 72//ba(1garngan/bcu dgu pa/ dza) pod la/ zab chos mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: sgral ma nyer gcig gi sgrub pa ldeb grangs 35ste/ dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 70// bzhugs/nyi shu pa/ wa) pod la/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: ma cig khros ma nag mo'i sgrub pa gsang ba'i rgya can/ zab lam rdo rje phag mo'i chos skor las: smin byed dbang gi lhan

ra༅༅ / thabs bcas ldeb grangs 250)dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 50bye/bzhugs/nyer gcig pa/zha)pod la/dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las:bdud 'dul drag mo'i sgrub pa dang /dag snang las/las sbyor bcas ldeb grangs 24mi/dang rgya'i yis grangs ltar na 494)bsdo/gas/nyer gnyis pa/za)pod la/dag snang las:mkha' 'dza'i rtsa sgrub dang /snyan rgyud rin po che'i mdzod las:rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rtsa sgrub/dgongs gter las mkha' 'gro'i gsang dbang /dag snang las/zhi dbang drag po'i bsreg bluga'aphags ma ku ru kul+le'i sgrub skor/zab tig las:'phags ma dbyangs can lha mo'i sgom bzlas/dag snang las sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgom bzlas/dam chos sprul sku'isnying thig las:rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rtsa sgrub/'od gsal rig pa'i brda sgrom las:mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sgrub pa

sogs ldeb grangs 193) dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 386) bzhugs/nyer gsum pa/ 'a)pod la/ gsol 'debs rnam gsum dang / lha thabs/dam chos thugs kyigater kha las/ gu ru rdo rje khyung zhon gyi sgrub pa/bka' rgya gnad kyilde'u mig las: 'dzam gling skyes bu don 'grub rtsal gyi zab sgrub/ dag snang las: 'dzam gling skyes bu chen po'i gsol sgrub bcas ldeb grangs 51snye/ dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 1022) bzhugs/ nyer bzhipa/ ya)pod la/zab gsang rdo bsnying po las: dbang chen zil gnon rtsal gyi spros med don gyi myur lam bde stong 'ub chub/ chos nyid nam mkha'i glong mdzod las:dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub pa/ yang chag nam mkhali'od gsal las dzam dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i sgrub pa/chos nyid nam mkhaliklong mdzod las: dzam dkar

༄༅ / 'brug zhon lha lnga/ gza' nag dug sdong gi sgrub pa bcas ldeb 264) dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 528) bzhugs/nyer lnga pa/ e) podal/ dag snang las: bla sgrub ye shes thugs kyi snying po/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi rtsa sgrub/ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs char 'bebs/ snyan rgyud rin po che'i mdzod khang las: rig 'dzin bla ma mchod pa'i rim pa dngos grub rgya mtsho'i sprin phung / dag snang sgyu 'phrul rol pa las: dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byer/ rgyab chos bar do drug gi khrid yig/ snyan rgyud rin po che'i mdzod las: gu ru bi ma mi tra'i thugs bcud yid bzhin nor bu: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje'i zab sgrub rin po che'i za ma tog sogs bla sgrub skor gsum/ dag snang las bzhag thabs gnad kyi sgron me/ nam mkha' sgo 'byed mthong ba rang grol/ sri bzlog 'bar ba'i 'khor lo dang / rgya nag keg zlog rdo rje pha lam bcas ldeb grangs 347) dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na 694)

bsdo/gas/nyer drug pa/ tsa) pod la/ dag snang yi shesarol pa las: zangs mdog dpal ri'i mthong snang sku gsum zhing bkod zab mo dang / po ṭa la'i zhing bkod 'brel tshad sangs rgyas/ g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing bkod dri bral me long/ dag snang las: rdzogs pa chen po gnas lugs gcer mthong sogs zhal gdams sna tshogs kyi skor bcas ldeb grangs 311) dang rgya'i e grangs ltar na/ 622) bzhugs pa lags so/slar smras pa/ /e ma rgyal gsung chos mdzod kun/ /nye brgyud zab gter las byung ba'i/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i 'phrin las 'di/ /snyigs ma'i bstan 'gror lhag par sman/ /de phyir pad+ma'i rgyal tshab gang de yi/ /med byung zab gter tsin+ta ma ṇi'i dpya/ /sna tshogs skal bzang gdul bya'i bgo skal du/ /ngo mtshar nub med spar gyi 'phrul du btabs/ /de'i mthus

༄༅ / bstan 'jen skyes bu'i zhabs pad brtan/ /thugs bzhed ma lus gegs med myur 'grub cing / /rten 'dir 'brel thog gtsor byas mkha' mnyam 'gro//phyam gcig rnga yab dpal rir sangs rgyas shog/ khadag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dpal mgon bla ma dam pas rjes bzungs te/ /rgyal bstan nyi zla'i 'od dang mi 'bral bar/ /rnam mang 'gro la rtag tu sman par shog da rdzong gter ṛg 'dzen kun bzang nyi ma'i zab gter gyi dkar chag nyung bsdus mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i lam yig 'dir rje gang gi zab gter las deng skabasazhal bzhugs glegs bam rnams nas dbang chen rta mgrin dmar po'i sgrub skor nya) dang ta) pod gnyis pod gcig tu bsgrang bas 'bras chos nyer lnga'i grangs bzhin bsgrigs te shar rgyal ba dung dkar dgon gsang sngags smin grol gling gi mkhan ming ba pad+ma 'od gsal mtha' yas kyis rab rgyan lcags sbrul lo'i sa ga zla ba'i dus bzang la bris pa dge bas snyigs dus kyi rgud pa mtha' dag zhi zhing bde skyid rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston la longs spyod par gyur cig dge'o/ sarba maṅga le/
badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: sngon 'gro khog phub cha lag las rim nyi shu rtsa gcig phrin las kun 'khru1ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

bsarte na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ 41)yisgyusno raba'abyams rgyal ba sras bcas kyi phrin las gcig rdzogs 'gro ba'i mgon: rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru la: mthon mthing ral bas gtugs te 'dud:ma 'ongs las can skyes bu rnams gsang chen sgo 'dir zhugs 'dod tshe: mkho ba'i las rim nyi shu gcig: sngon 'gro khog phub rim pa 'di med mi rung bas sgog ltar zungs: sa ma yā dang po skyabs yul bskyed pa ni: āX rang mdun nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng: 'gro ba'i mgon po o rgyan pad+ma 'byung: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor: mkhyen brtse nus pas bdag cag la dgongs bsam: g.yas su rgyal ba shākya sing ge la bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong gis bskor: rgyab tu shes rab pha rol phyin ma la: gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis lam mer rdzogs: g.yon du 'phags pa byams pa mgon po la: byang sems dge 'dun rig 'dzin tshogs kyis bskor: mdun du yi dmagu ru drag po la: rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam 'khor gyis bskor: bar mtshams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rnams: nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin 'od kyi sku ru bzhugs: de dag gnas gsum 'od zer dpag med 'phros:

badz+ra zhi khro rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha: sbyan drangs dbyer med thugs rje chen po yis: bdag dang skal ldan rnams la gzigs par bsam: skyabs 'gro dang ni sems bskyed bya ba'o: gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: yi āhūṃ dus 'de nas bzung byang chub ma thob par: 'gro ba'i mgon po pad+ma 'byung gnas la: sgo gsum mos gus gdung shugs drag po yis: zhing rdul grangs mnyam chen pos phyag 'chal lo: hṝ na mo na ma ho: gsum pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: snye āhūṃ: stong gsum 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya ru: ngo mtshar bkod pa'i mchod sprin mtha' yas pa: zhen bral dag pa'i blo yis blangs nas su: rje btsun ma hā gu ru'i zhal du 'bul: tso( ma hā pañtsa puts+tsha ho: bzhi pa bshags pa bya ba ni: yin āhūṃ che ga gcod ma byin blangs dang mi tshang spyod: rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal smras: brnab sems gnod sems log par lta ba sogs: mi dge sdig pa'i las bgyis mthol lo bshags:badz+ra sa ma ya shudhe āḥ lnga ba rjes su yi ra bya ba ni: skyed āhūṃ: 37 skyes nyan rang byang sems rig 'dzin gyis: zag dang zag med dge ba sgrub pa la: dga' ba chen pos rjes su yi rang

ngo: yongs su grub pa'i lhag bsam rgyas 'debs so: hrī:bho dhi tsit+ta badz+ra spra ra ṇa dza: drug pa chos gabor bskor bar bskul ba ni:bla āX/: sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rig 'dzin tshogs: mnyam bzhag ngang gnas g.yo med mdzad pa la: 'gro khams dong nas sprugs par bya ba'i phyir: zab dang rgya che'i chos 'khor bskor du gsol: hrī: dharmā gar+bha tsakra sa ma ya ti hūṃ: bdun pa 'da' med gsol ba ni: 31 ā:hūṃ: zhing khams 'di'am gzhan na bzhugs pa yi: byang sems rig 'dzin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni: mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed pa thams cad kun: bskal pa ma stong bar du bzhugs gsol 'debs: hūṃ badz+ra sa ma yā tiṣ+ṭha lhan: brgyad pa bsngo ba'i rim pa ni snyen ā(spyi: 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum du:bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba kun bsdus te: 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bsngo bar bgyi: phyam gcig gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin par shog: dgu pa skyabs yul 'od zhu ni: trī: dad 51sa lcags kyus bskul te lha tshogs zhu: byams pa'i zhags pas bdag dang dbyer med bsre: dga' ba'i sgrog gis nyams rtogs yon tan bstims: btang snyoms dril bus

sa:tshu byang chub sems rdzogs gyur: smin cing grol nas ye shes lha sku yis: 'gro ba gang 'dul mdzad pa'i mthu stobs bsam: bcu ba dkar gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa ni:dkar skyems bā ling 'o phud bshams: bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa ni zlo sā bha was sbyangs: tram̐ las rin chen yangs pa'i snod nang du: skyed las gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur: 31 ā:྅: lan gsum: a ka ro yis brlabs: thugs rje chen po'i nga rgyal gyis: : hrīḥ sngon tshe sa/ rgyan pad+mas bka' bsgo ba'i: sa yi lha mo brtan ma chen mo dang: dbang chen sa bdag sa lha sa 'dzin rnams: gtsang sbyar gtor ma gser skyems mchod pa bzhes: khyad par bod kyi mgur lha bcu gsum dang: gangs dkar nyer gcig srid pa'i lha dgu dang: dbu gtsang ri bzhi mdo khams rgang drug gi: srung ma dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs rnams kyis: gtsang sbyar gtor ma gser skyems mchod pa bzhes: pha ri g.yas dang tshul ri g.yon la gnas:sra ba brag dang srib ri nags la gab: skye ba shing dang 'babs pa chu la rdzogs: na ba spang dang rgya lam skya mor chags: gnas 'di'i sa bdag klu gnyan gzhi bdag rnams:

gtsang sbyar gtor ma gser skyems mchod pa bzhes: gnod cing gdug pa'i bsam pa rab zhi nas: rtag tu dge ba'i sdong grogs rgya chen mdzod: bdag gis bla med byang chub mchog bsgrub cing: sems can rnams kyis don rab brtson pa la: khyod rnams ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par: rin chen gter gyi sa 'di stsol ba dang: gang bcol phrin las sgrubs shig sa ma yā: ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar phul: bcu gcig dmar gtor 'bul ba ni bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs rim pa la:yin swā bha was sbyangs:sbyo:las sreg chen yangs pa'i bye da nang du:tsas las gtor ma 'dod yon lnga ldan gyur: bla ādza/: lan gsumanam mkha' mjod kyis brlabs: pad+ma ka ra'i nga rgyal gyis shā jeḥ spyod tshe yin rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas mna' bor ba'i: dkar po lha dang rngams pa gshin rje'i tshogs: myur byed ma mo 'jigs byed gnod sbyin sde: stobs ldan btsan dang sgog bdag rgyal po dang: nag po bdud dang gtum po klu yi tshogs: drang sgong gza' dang 'gong po the'u rang sogs: bka' yi lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas: sha khrag dmar la dgyes pa'i sde tshogs rnams:

badz+ra 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen bsrung ba dang: rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis pa dang: legs tshogs yon tan gong nas gong 'phel zhing: nyer 'tshe'i bdud dang dam sri rdul du rlog: rin chen sa 'di bdag la rtsol ba dang: gang bcol phrin las sgrubs shig sa ma yā: ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs: phrin las gegs med yid bzhin 'grub: bcu gnyis bgegs gtor gtong ba ni: bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs rim pa la: yin swā bha was sbyangs: sbyo las rin chen yangs pa'i snod nang du: tre las glud gtor 'dod yon lnga ldan gter: gang la gang mkho ma tshang med pa'i sprin: ye shes bdud rtsi'i rol bar byin brlabs gyur: ma āhūṃ: lan gsum dang ni sam bha ra yi sngags: a ka ro yis byin gyis brlabs: dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i nga rgyal gyis: gzhung gi bka' bsgo gtong zhing 'di skad do: ྅ hrī glud gtor 'dod sku na lnga ldan 'di: bsngo zhing sbyin pa'i gnas gyur pa: byang chub sgrub la mi dga' zhing: lus sems sbyor ba ngan pa'i rigs: bdud sde dpung dang bcas pa rnams: ngoms shing tshim par gyur nas su: rnal 'byor

tshe la ma rku zhig rol mo'i sgra dbyangs ma 'phrog cig: sgrub pa'i dpal la ma rngams shig: bdud rtsi sman gyi bcud ma rku dpal gtor rtse la ma bru zhig: rak+ta'i ngad la ma 'jib cig: chos 'khor gnyan po ma gtor zhig: mkhon 'dzang 'khrug slong ma g.yo zhig: nad gdon grib yam ma slong bar glud kyi gtor ma 'di khyer la: rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mthar dengs slar yang rtesag par ma byed cig: sarba sha༄na gats+tsha phaṭa: hūṃ bzhi drag sngags thun gyis brab: gnad des bar chad g.yul las rgyal: bcu gsum bden brjod bya ba ni:na ma rego 'j-in grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: skyob pa dam pa'i chos rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: 'dren pa 'phags pa'i ge 'dun rnams kyi bden pa dang: bka' gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya bzlas brjod ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bden pa dang: lha las khyad par duregs 'dus ma hā gu 〈lisku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams kyi bden pa dang: sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan

badz+ra: brgyad: mchog gi rig 'dzin chen po brgyad: rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga:grub thob rig 'dzin brgyad cu: 'gro 'dul gyi gu ru drug: sprul pa'i gter ston rgya mtsho'i bka' bden pa dang: bden pa chen po de dag gi nus pa la brten nas: deng 'dir gsang sngags zab mo bskyed rdzogs kyis sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po:bgegs kyi gtso bo bi na ya ga:dug gsum gyi gdon: bgegs ring stong phrag brgyad cu:byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga:'phrog ma ma bu lnga brgya:srid pa chags pa'i 'dre dgu:gtsug lag khang gi gdon bcu: gnod sems 'chang ba'i dam sri: 'byung po kha yi dbugs 'phrog cing: khong pa'i nang gi srog gcod par byed pa'i tshogs thams cad glud kyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis dga' mgu yi rang nas tshims par gyis la sa yi phyogs 'dir ma gnas par byer cig:dnges shig:sarba bisnan gats+tsha gasne bcu bzhi bsrung gabar bsgom pa ni ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i steng thams cad phyag mtshan rnam lnga'i bla bre:'og thams cad rigs lnga'i sa gzhi:bar snang thams cad phyag mtshan rigs lnga'i gur khang sra

brtan gzhom gzhig dang bral ba:de'i phyi rol ā li dkar po g.yas su 'khor ba'i gur khang:kā lidamar po g.yon du 'khor ba'i gur khang:rdo rje'i me dpung 'bar ba'i gur khang:drag po'i rlung nag 'tshubs pa'i gur khang:rdo rje'i chu bo rba rlabs 'phyo ba'i gur khang:de yi dbus su yeshes kyirang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su bdag cag sgrub pa po rnams ye shes lha yi nga rgyal gyi gnas par gyur:bco lnga byin 'bebs snyan dbab ni:rang gi dadaya tsha gus gsang shugakhasaskragapo bskyinasarang chabs gcig:snying ga nas 'od dang 'od zer mu med pa 'phros:phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul:thams cad kyang sku phyag rgya:gsung yig 'bru:thugs phyag mtshan:yon tan phrin las thams cad 'ja' dang 'od phung gi rnam par byung nas bdag gnas sgrub pa'i rdzas yo byad rnams la thim pas gnas zhing khams:sgrub khang gzhal yas khang:sgrub pa po dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro:sgrub rdzas rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rol pa chen por byin gyis brlabs par bsam rol mo' sgra bcas byin chen 'bebs:

badz+ra tsu bcu drug dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni:rang gi snyeng ga nas 'od zer 'phros te: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa bde gshegs rigs lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs phyag na bum ba ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba'i snod bteg nas dbang bskur: bdud rtsi tshangs pa'i bu gar zhugs te lus gang: sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad dag par byas: rgyal ba rnams kyis rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur: 'khor 'das kyi spyi dpal chen por dbugs dbyung: khams gsum gyi 'khor ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings subasgral ba'i mthu byin nus pa dang ldan par bsam la: yin brnya kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: tī baju kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsahrī: swā rat+na ka ya a bhi ṣiñtsa tri: i pad+ma kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa i: hā garma kāya a bhi ṣiñtsa hā:slar yang rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sa bon tsho e tīgasarnams gnas lngar gsal ba la lha tshogs rnams thim ste mi shig mi 'gyur ba'i rgyas gdab par bsam:tson brnya dha ra sa ma yā s+t+waṃ teṣ+ṭha badz+raḥ e pad+ma dha ra sa ma yā s+t+waṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥtī badz+ra dha ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra traḥ de nas gnas gsum rdo rdze'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros te rab 'byams

rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs la bstim mo: bcu bdun bza' btung lam khyer ni: snyen ā〉〉 dzñā na pañtsa ra sa ya na a dṛ ta hū hrī: lan bdun brjod la byin gyis brlabs: shā trīḥ bdag lus sa rgyan gu ru pad+ma 'byung: gnas lngar thod phreng sde lnga yab yum rdzogs: rtsa khams ba spu thig le bye ba'i klong: rig 'dzin paṇa grub rje 'bangs rgya mtsho rdzogs:zhal ni dbang gi thab khung lce ni me: phyag gnyis dgang gzar sbyar nas bza' btung rnams: rje btsun pad+ma'i lha la bsreg blugs 'bul: tshogs rdzogs don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzod: gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa khā hi: bco brgyad sgrib sbyangs rgyun khyer ni rang gi lte ba'i a shad rlung gis btegs: ro rkyang lam brgyud thab rgya la thim pas: ye shes me dpung dmar ser 'bar bar gyur: rang gzhan 'gro ba'i las nyon sdig sgrib rnams: 'od nag rnam par bsdus te bud shing la: thim pas bag chags dri ma bsreg par bsam: gzurngo 'dzin las nyon sdig sgrib dz+wa la ram: 37 badz+ra sa twa hūṃ: a dṛ su:༷ pre du:sarba pā paṃ dz+wa la ram̐ khā hi: dmigs pas brjod nas thab shing 'bud sla bas don chen

gas/: 'grub par 'gyur sa ma yā bcu dgu rgyun gyi nyams len ni: rang nyid pad 'byunga.a tsar+ya gzhon mdzes: bcu drug mdangs ldan zod rnga dril bu brten rus rgyan rgyan rdzogs he ru ka yi chas: 'od lnga'i klong na snang stong gnyis med gsal: sku dbus ro rkyang kun dha dkar dmar mthing: 'khor lo lnga ldan thod phreng sde lngas mdzes: rtsa khams ba spu bye ba sa ya'i klong: phra rags ma nges ā dkar dri med phyur: gtum mo'i me 'bar gzung 'dzin rnam rtog bsreg: dbu ma'i nang du udakar nyer gcig brtsegs: 'od zer yar 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas mchod: mar 'phros 'gro drug 'khor ba'i gnas stong bsam: bum can rlud dang bsgrags nas ting 'dzin bsgom slar yang u rnamasa'od zhu snying gar 'dus: rig pa'i ngo bo ā:dkar bkrag 'bar ba: gangs kyi ri la nyin byed 'bum 'khyud ltar: bkrag mdangs gzi 'bar rang gsal rig pa 'i ngang brkyang nas tha mal rtogs pas bar mi gcod: nyin mchan bar med gang shar rig ngo bskyangs: nyams rtogs yon tan yar ngos zla ltar rgyas: 'gags med 'od gsal ngang la 'khyams klas 'gyur rgyun khyer rlung dang rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor bya ba'i rim pa'o: nyi shu dngos grub bskul ba ni:byin dbab spos dud rol mo 'brol: thal sbyar snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas: gsol ba gdab pa'i rim pa ni: hūṃ hrīX bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha: 'gro ba'i mgon po o rgyan

rin po che: thugs dam ma g.yel gzugs kyi skur bzhengs shig: rnga yab dpal ri pad+ma'i pho brang nas: rje 'bangs lo paṇa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bcas: thugs dam brtse bas ma 'dor rjes bzung 'tshal: gces pa'i bu ngu ma yis mi bzod ltar: bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i rtags tshad them pa dang: mos gus dad brgya'i nyi ma shar lags na: sngon gyi dam bca' ma g.yel myur du dgongs: sku ni gar bsgyur gsung dbyangs sngags sgra sgrogs: thugs ni mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzi 'od bcas: mngon sum byin thibs byung nas rdzas la thim:dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: rtags dang mtshan ma ston pa'i dus la bab: nyams rtogs yon tan bskyed pa'i dus la bab: mchog thun dngos grub ma hā sidhi hūṃ:lan gsum gyis bskul la:rtsa sngags 'jug tu kā ya sirnyi skyesaḥ wāk+ka sidhi āḥ tsit+ta sidhi hūḥ sarba sidhi hrī:brgya rtsa brjod la sman mchod 'bul:bro bshags bya zhing dag par bya:nyer gcig dngos grub len pa ni: hūṃ trīX sku la skyi 'chi bsgres rgud mi mnga' zhing: 'chi med rig 'dzin rdo rje tshe yi dbang: skal ldan bdag cag lus la rab bstsal nas: snang stong gnyis med ye shes sirnyi oṃ:

gas( khye hrīḥ gsung la 'gag dang sdud pa mi mnga' zhing: yan lag drug cu rdo rje gsung gi dbang: skal ldan bdag cag ngag la rab bstsal nas: gsal stong gnyis med chos sgo sid+dhi āḥ hūṃ hrīḥ thugs la nor dang 'khrul pa mi mnga' zhing: mi g.yo rang byung ye shes mchog gi dbang: skal ldan bdag cag yid la rab bstsal nas: rig stong gnyis med thugs mchog sid+dhi sa: hūṃ hrīḥ yon tan bsgres rgud dri ma mi mnga' zhing: ye shes chen po'i lo 'dab rgyas pa'i dbang: skal ldan bdag cag dpal la rab bstsal nas: dga' stong ye shes mthu stobs sirnyi trīḥ lha hrīḥ phrin las nye ring phyogs ris mi mnga' zhing: rmad byung thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dbang: skal ldan bdag cag sgo la rab bstsal nas: bde stong ye shes 'gro 'dul sidhi hā: hūṃ trīḥ ma hā gu ru'i byin rlabs nyi ma shar: su la ma shar sgrub mchog bdag la shar: thugs dgongs dbyer med rdzogs pa e ma ho: nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas pa a la la: paṇa tshob rgya masgo'i byin rlabs nyi ma shar: su la ma shar sgrub mtshog bdag la shar: brtul zhugs dngos grub 'grub pa

e ma ho: 'gro 'dul nus mthu thob pa a la la: dpa' bo mkha' 'dza'i byin rlabs nyi ma shar: su la ma shar sgrub mchog bdag la shar: bde stong nyams rtsal rgyas pathagom sa dga' bzhi'i ye shes rgyas pa a la la: rtsa gsum rgya mcho'i byin rlabs nyi ma shar: su la ma shar sgrub mchog bdag la shar: mthu stobs phun sum tshogs pa ye ma ho 'gro khams dngo sprugs nus pa a la la: gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni ka ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba ga gu ṇa ma hā su kha sidhi pha lacas āḥhūṃ trīḥ sgrub rdzas rnams gnas gsum du gtug cing dngos grub la rol bar bya'o:slar yang sngar lhar bkod nas bskang tshogs mchod bstod sbyin bsreg sogs bka' drin gtang rag rgya chen po bya'o: de ltar ldan pa'i rnal 'byor bsam pa 'grub: phyi nang gegs zhi nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas tshe bsod dpal 'phel don gnyis lhun gyis grub: the tshom med do rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' sa ma ya: yi ma ho rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yi: snying dang 'dra b.ligadams zab rmad byung ba rdo rje snying po'i chos sde bcu gsum sgo: grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad: da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thobs: gter bdag bzang phyir mdo khams tsa rir sbos: spu gri mched gsum dag la gter kha gtod: ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus

gas/rnya nga sprul grub pa'i gdung 'dzin gnubs kyi rigs:'brog ban dngos gyu'adus ldan rdo dze+egrags skyes bu de dang zab gsang 'di 'phrad 'gyur nyid las mi gzhan snying 'dra'i chos bdag lnga:rma ban sprul pa ku mud ma ṇi dang:cog ro klu rgyal ku mud dharmar grags:g.yu sgra'i sprul pa ku mud pra ṅge'i mchan:byere'osprul pa ku mud gar+bha'i ming: gnyag ban sprul pa ku mud sur+ya zhes:skyes bu de dag chos kyi bdag po ste:gdams bka' gtad pa'i rtsa ba dam pa yin las smon ldan pa'i skyes bu rnam pa brgyad:tshogs smon 'dzoms pa'i las kyis 'phrad par 'gyur:bstan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcu kun tu sgrogs:las ldan 'bum phrag rnga yab dpal rir 'god byin rlabs rno nus gzhan las khyad par 'phags bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal:dkon mod rgyal khams 'grims la ltos dang mthong:bka' gsang thub par srungs shigangesi nus ma skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya:las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog:sa ma yu:rgya rgya rgya:las rim nyi shu rtsa gcig pa phrin las kun 'grub rdzogs so:gter rgya:gtad rgya:tham rgya:zab rgya gsang rgya:gu h+ya:yin rgyan gye gleb dpan pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka':bdag 'dramakhar chen gzas bkod pa'o:brda thim:snyi:ces pa 'di'ang rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags pa'iskyes mchag pad+ma nor bus thabs shes rdor dril dbang lnga'i cod pan gser dngul g.yu byur rin po che'i rdzas sna tshogs dang bcas nas yang

yang bskul ba dang: chos bdag pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshos yang yang bzhed ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mdo khams bkra shis rdzong mdun nas mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/ bha wan tu:badz+ra: lha snang lta ba gyad sku ni: blo 'das ye shes zang thal gnyug ma'i gshis: ma bcos ye grol gu ru pad+ma 'byung: nyag gcig sku dang ye shes phrin las rdzogs: 'ub chub bde chen khyab brdal chos sku'i ngang: sgo badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sirnyi ྅: ye rdzogs ngo bo rig tsam grol dgongs pa zang thal don la gtad: bskur thob bral ba'i lha zhal mjal: rdzogs pa chen por e ma ho:sa ma yā:rgya rgya rgya: 'gro mgon li hi'i gar bsgyur me dri'i ngor: klong yangs sngags kyi brnye sur+yas bris sarba maṅga le: btsarnya brngan phog ñtsāḥ sman phud dkar gtor bsangs sbyangs spel hoḥ sngon tshe dngos grub sgrub pa'i dusaḥ ra sa ya na'i srung ma rtsa khas blangs mna' bor dam tshig canaḥ rtsi bcud lha mo bcu drug kyangaḥ rang rang bka' 'khor bran g.yog bcas: gsang chen gnas 'dir

pa(: spyan 'dren gshegasaḥ dam tshig las kyi dkyil 'khor 'diraḥ dngos kun bdud rtsi'i rnal 'byor la: phrin las sgrub pa'i grogs su bzhugasaḥ 'byung khams brtan g.yo'i dwangs ma bsdusaḥ a bri ta la gzi byin bskyedaḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad solaḥ brngan pa'i phud mchod bshos bu bzhesaḥ dngos grub sgrub pa'i srung ma mdzodaḥ ma pañtsi ma ha ri ni sa a mṛ ta ba lir+ha kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ lan bdun gyis phulaḥ 'dod gsol ni ho rtsi bcud 'byung ba'i lha mo bcu drug sprul pa g.yog dang bcas pa rnams kyisaḥ sman phud dkar bshos 'o skyems 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungasaḥ sems can la phan bde spelaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa la mthun rkyen sbyoraḥ 'gal rkyen solaḥ bdud rtsi sman gyi nus mthu bskyedaḥ che ba dang rtog pa brjodaḥ shing rtsi bcu gsum dang bla rten gtor ma la brten zhing dngos grub sgrub pa'i srung ma mdzod cigaḥ rol mo bya zhing me tog 'thoraḥ gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha mo rnams badz+ra rak+ta ho nyaḥ 7/ sman phud dkar bshos bsangs sbyangs spelaḥbye legs nyes gzegs pa'i mig stong ldanaḥ khams gsum dbang bsgyur

tshangs pa cheḥ bde legs dpal 'byor dbang phyug rgyalaḥ phyogs skyong zhing dang drang srong tshogasaḥ rang rang g.yog 'khor dpung dang bcasaḥ tha tshig bsgrags nas 'bod lags naḥrdzu 'phrul stobs kyis 'dir byon zhigaḥ sman phud 'o skyems dkar bshos 'bulaḥ sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bskangasaḥ 'gal 'khrul nongs pa bzod par gsolaḥ ra sa ya na spel zhing sgrubasaḥ nus mthu gzi brjid phun tshogs mdzodaḥ phyi nang bar chad rkyen bzlog cingaḥ nang gi dngos grub phyir ma gtongaḥ rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po stonaḥ dam la ma 'da' sa ma yuḥ sa ma hā dhe wa tsakyu shrī hūṃ sarba sa pa ri wā ra e di bha lirnyi kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ lan bdun gyis phul 'dod gsol ni ho lha yidabang po mig stong ldan pa dang tshangs pa chen po gzhon nu dbang phyug yab yum la sogs pa gtso 'khor sprul pa g.yog dang bcas pa rnams kyisaḥ sman phud dkar ngachogs 'o skyems dam pa 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungasaḥ sems can la phan bde spelaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa la mthun rkyen sbyoraḥ 'gal rkyen solaḥ bdud rtsi sman gyi nus mthu bskyedaḥ che ba dang

pa( rtog pa brjodaḥ shing rtsi bcu gsum dang bla rten gtor ma la brten zhing dngos grub sgrub pa'i srung ma mdzod cigaḥ sku rten ris su bris pa dang sgrub rdzas gtor ma la brten par bzhugs shing dngos grub sgrub pa'i srung ma mdzod cigaḥ rol mo bya zhing shis pa brjodaḥ ma hā de wa sarba sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ ra sa ya na sidhi 〉ཿ dkar bshos gtor skyems bsang sbyangs spel hrī slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gisaḥ rgya bal bod yul lha 'dre kunaḥ dam la ma btags gang yang medaḥ gzhug gnas dkar phyogs skyong ba rnamasaḥ bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i grogs la byonaḥ ra sa ya na'i nus mthu bskyedaḥ brngan mchod dkar bas/sa skyems phud bzhesaḥ sgrub la mel tshe rtag tu mdzod: glo bur lhag pa'i sde brgyad kunaḥ srog gcud tha tshig zab mo bsgragasaḥ pad+ma'i rjes 'jug bka' byung bzhinaḥ zhi zhing dge ba'i dam tshig longasaḥ yang dag nges pa'i lung 'dir nyonaḥ bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i grogs po mdzodaḥ phyi nang nyer 'tshe mtha' dag bzlogaḥ brngan mchod gtor ma ja chang skyemasaḥ bzhes la rtag par mel ces skyongasaḥ las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzodaḥ 31 sarba ma ka pā la e dam

bha lidha kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ lan bdun gyis phulaX 'dod gsol ni0 hoḥ dkar phyogs skyongs ba'i gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa khyed rnams kyisaḥ brngan mchod dkar skyems dam pa 'di bzhes laḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor zab mo dbu btsug nas mthar ma phyin gyi bar du phyi yi bar chad nang du mi gtong zhingaX nang gi dngos grub phyir mi yal bar ra sa ya na srung ba'i gnyer dam pa mdzod cigaḥ rol mo bya zhing me tog 'thoraX dharma pā la badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ 'di bzhin phrin las bskang gsol bya slar yang sgrub pa grol ba'i dus mchod gtor 'bul rjes bsdu rim niḥ ya mi sarba gahā'i gnad des phrin las lhun gyis grubaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsi rtags mtshan bcasaX ra sa ya na lhun gyis grubaḥdon gnyis 'byung ngo sa ma yaḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaX brda thim ༷ljaX bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i rgyud las btus nus ldan bdus pa rtsal gyis soX sarba maṅga le

badz+rarnya zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i gsol 'debs bde stong bum bzang bzhugs soḥgs/ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ byugrisposgaspyodachad dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus dpalaḥ dbyer med phrin las gcig bsdus skuḥ gdug pa 'dul mdzad he ru gaX mthu stobs rmad byung don la 'dudaḥ ma 'a/ngas las skal ldan pa yis dad mos gdung shugs drag po dang ldan pa'i ngang nas gsol 'debs 'diX dus drug brjod pas byin rlabs 'jugaX sa ma yāX cas ma he ma chags dri bral chos sku snang mtha' yasaḥ byams dang snying rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigasaḥ dbyer med bstan 'gro'i nyi ma pad+ma 'byung ༷ gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungasaḥ byin gyis rlobs sheg mkhyen brtse nus pas skyongasaḥ sin+tu dwangs mtshor pad+ma'i sbubs las 'khrungasaḥ dur khrod brgyad gshegs brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzadaḥ sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad zhes su gragasaḥ gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad solaḥ byin gyis rlobs shig nyams rtogs yon tan bskyedaḥ sgrub sde brgyad kyi gsang mdzod 1nga nas rdolaḥ gdul bya 'bum phrag

bde chen zhing la 'godaḥ mchog gi rig 'dzin chen po rnam brgyad laḥ gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad solaḥ byin gyis rlobs shig rig pa'i sgron me sboraḥ ngan song rigs drug sgo 'phar dbyings su 'drenaḥ ye shes drug gis gdul bya ma lus 'dulaḥ 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gcig gu ru drugaḥ gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad solaḥ byin gyis rlobs shig nyams rtogs yon tan bskyedaḥ rgya bal bod yul mun pa'i gling kun selaḥ gdul bya ma lus rnga yab dpal rir bkodaḥ zab mo gter gyi tshos skal 'gro la bzhagaḥgasol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad solaḥ byin gyis rlobs shig bde stong ye shes bskyedaḥ gdong dmar bod phrug spre'u'i tsha bo rnamasaḥ ma rig log pa'i 'khrul 'bor las bsgral teḥ chos kyi nyi ma'i 'od mdangs yongs la brdalaḥ gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad solaḥ byin gyis rlobs shig rtogs pa sang rdol mdzodaḥ ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis ༷ sku tshab lung ston gsung tshab gter du sbasaḥ thugs kyi dgongs pa dad ldan bu la bzhagaḥ gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad solaḥ byin gyis rlobs shig

'am: 'gro kun dpal rir drongasaḥ da lta gdong dmar srin po'i kha gnon mdzadaḥ rak+ka pho mo thams cad chos la bkodaḥ rgyun chad med par thugs rjes bod khams skyongasaḥ gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad solaḥ byin gyis rlobs shig gdul dka' 'dul bar mdzodaḥ kye ma0 deng sang snyigs ma'i rtsub 'gyur tu song skabasaX nad mug mtshon 'khrug 'jig rten rgud pas mnaraḥ skyabs med bu sdug dwa bu 'khyams po rnams ༷ ngan song 'khor ba'i duḥ khar dbang med 'khyamasaḥ mun pa'i gling du skal bzang re mchis naḥ thugs rjes yal bar ma dor rjes su zungasaḥ dam bca' ma ral gu ru rin po cheḥ nad mug dus 'khrug rgud pa mtha' dag solaḥ rgya 'dre me zhon 'byung po rlung zhon dngaḥ du ru ka yi 'tshubs ma bzlog tu gsolaḥ shi 'dre grong 'dres 'jig rten kha lo bsgyuraX baspu brid bdud kyi cho 'phrul zhi bar mdzodaḥ bstan 'gro'i bde legs yar ngo'i zla ltar spelaḥbasam pa'i don rnams lhun gyis grub pa dngaḥ gnas skabs mtha' thug chos kyis 'tsho bzhin tuḥ lus sems so sor zhig cing bral ma thagaḥ bde chen pad+ma 'od du skye bar re gaḥ

de ltar gsol ba btab pa na ༷ 'di dang phyi ma'i rkyen gegs zhi ༷ tshe bsod nyams rtogs yon tan rgyasaX don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa dang rnga yab dpal 3pad+ma 'od bde chen zhing du grol bar 'gyur 0 bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsalaḥ basmu ba med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ bdag 'drapad+masabha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyisaX snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag bcud grub pa'i dbang phyug khyod la gtad da lta spel ba'i dus ma yin rin chen brda theb sa ra dzuḥmado khams phyogs su dgongs rgya mdzodaX ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dusaX nga sprul nga dang dbyer med pa nusaldan dosdodang 'phrad nas brtan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel skal med lag tu bcud ma zagaḥ snying nor chos kyi bdag por spel 'gro don bsam yasatsasam nya sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya mahāguru'igasol 'debs bde stong bum bzang rdzogs so gter rgyaX gtad rgya rbas rgyaḥ zab rgya gsang rgya gu h+ya tso/rgyan gyislob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka'aḥbadag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'oḥ brda thim snyi0 ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag posprulapa'isku mtshag pad+ma nor bu'i thabs shes rdor dril bkra shis lha reg mi 'gyur mthing mdzes kyi cod pan dang bcas bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bonusaldanam rjes mkha' 'gro'i brda ris las dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/
gsagagato pa'i zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥrigs khrus ma hā gu ru'i zab sgrub dngos grub gter gyi bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ

badz+ra: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra yeḥ 43hāgro111tshi ma sas dre ma bral ba'i sku bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i dbyingasaX rang rig pad+ma lung gnas nyid0 bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchod bdag༄ 'dra pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyisaX shin tu zab / byedas kyi bcudaḥ med byung sgrub pa byed pa'i thabasaX byin rlabs dngos grub bang mdzod bstanaḥ sa ma yāXdeyang mi mdo dben sar phyin sde brgyad tshogs la sa bslang zhing dkar dmar skyems kyi mchod pas brngan0 bar chad bgegs tshogs bsgrad par byaḥ zung ba'i 'khor lo rim brgyad guraX gzhom med pha lam zab mo gtams0 deyang dkyil 'kheng mda' gang paX gru bzhi bzang drug ba byung gdabaḥ bum pa dri bzang chu yis bkang bhan+ta dza gad dkar mngar sbagaḥ sgrub gtor pad spungs mdzes pa dang sgog 'khor dar gyi lding gur canaḥ shel rdo me long sku gzugs bkodaḥ rnam lnga mdzes pa'i pu tsa bskoraḥ 'dod yon mchod pa rgya chen bya khrus dang gtsang sbra mnol bsang gtong rlung ro bsal zhing bum can bskyalaḥ 'bar 'dzag dga' stong lte sbyor sgomaḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rgya sdomaḥ de nas las la rnam par 'jugaḥ sa ma yuXkhyer ba dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum dang po las rim bcu yis bstan0 blo sems bag phab bde bar gnas dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni na 3 rang byung reg pa sku bzhi'i bdag nyid canaḥ 'pho 'gyur med pa bde chen gnyug

badz+ra ma'i gshisaḥ ye sangs rgyas pa gu ru pad+ma 'byungaḥ byang chub bar du skyabs kyi dam par 'dzinaḥ lan gsumaḥ gnyis pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed niḥ nyo mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba rnamasaḥ rang ngo ma shes 'khrul ba'i las rjes 'brangaḥ da ni rang rig rgyal sar ngal gso'i phyir 'bras bu'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed doḥlan gsumaḥ gsum pa tshogs bsags yan lag bdun pa niḥ na 33 sku dang ye shes bdag nyid bla ma laḥ sgo gsum mos blo'i dad pas phyag 'tshal loḥ snang srid 'dod yon kun bzang mchod pa 'bulaḥ mi dge sdig pa'i las kun mthol lo bshagasaḥ skyes bu gsum gyi dge la rjes yi rangaḥ gang 'dul theg pa'i chos 'khor bskor du gsolaḥ gdul bya'i skyabs mgon ma lus 'da' med bzhugs: dge tshogs gcig bsdus 'dza ra gsum dag par bsngoḥ phyam gcig kun bzang bla ma'i sa thob regagaḥ lan gsum bzhi ba maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i rim pa ni yin āḥ〉ཿ rin chen maṇ+ḍal gser g.yus brgyan pa 'diḥ bla ma sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku la 'bulaḥ rang lus maṇ+ḍal dbang pos mdzes pa 'diḥ bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la

'bulaḥ sems nyid maṇ+ḍal rig pa'i bkod mdzes paḥ bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la 'bulaḥ bdag sogs 'gro ba'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dngaḥ sku gsum mngon gyur gzhan don mthar phyin re gaḥ ྅ཿgu ru rat+na maskol pu tsa me ga sa mu tra spra ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥ(ཿ 'bru bzhis tshogs zhing 'od zhu byas la bstimaḥ lnga ba bgegs gtor gtong la mtshams bcad ni hūṃ hrīḥngar 'j-in las byung gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogasaḥ 'dod yon lnga ldan glud gtor 'di longs la: bde ba chen po'i gnas su dengs shig phaṭaḥ bar chad bgegs kyi g.yul las rnam par rgyalaḥ hūṃ hūṃ u tsa ta ya phaṭaḥ drug pa bsrung ba'i gabor lo bsgom pa niḥshā hūṃt+t+waṃḥ snang srid rnam dag dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngangaḥ bar chad gdon gyi rkyen las rnam par grolaḥ 'on kyang glo bur dug gsum 'khrul ba'i gdonaX rang grol ngang du 'god phyir srung 'khor gtamasaḥ spyoḥbadz+ramaṇ+ḍal dzñā na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa t+t+waṃḥ bdun pa brda sgo dbye phyag dam bca' niX spyo bder gshegs kun 'dus gtsug ma sku gsum lhaḥ ma rig sprib pa'i dri ma da dbye'oḥ rang byung pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshalaḥ sgog gi phyir yang mi gtong lha khyod sgrabaḥspyoḥmaṇ+ḍal pra

pa( we sha ya phaṭaḥ na mo na ma hoḥ dzñā na badz+ra tsit+ta shrī hūṃḥ brgyad pa byin chen dbab par bya ba niḥ / hrīḥ chos sku'i ston pa snang ba mtha' yas dngaḥ longs spyod rdzogs mdzad 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigasaḥ sbrul sku 'gro 'dul sa rgyan pad+ma 'byungaḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab du gsolaḥ hūṃ chen ka ra 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dngaḥ nā gardzu na pra bha hasti paḥ dha na se skṛ bī ma mi tra dngaḥ rospu gu h+ya shidzña ghar+bha rnamasaḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab du gsolaḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas blo ldan mchog sred rtsalaḥ nyi ma 'od zer seng ge sgra sgrogs dngaḥ bha wa dang pad+ma rgyal por gragasaḥ shākya seng ge rdo rje gro bo lodaḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab du gsolaḥ dga' rab rdo rje chos kyi 'byung gnas dngaḥ mkhas grub dbang phyug shrī seng ha dngaḥ o rgyan slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje sogasaḥ brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs rnams kunaḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab du gsolaḥ sa ra ha dang grub chen brgyad cu dngaḥ bi ro tsa na rje 'bangs nyi shu lngaḥ 'brog mi lo tsā chos kyi mig gcig sogasaḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen

dbab du gsolaḥ byin rlabs mchog stsol rtsa rgyud bla ma dngaḥ dngos grub kun 'byung yi dam zhi khro'i lhaḥ bde stong bskyed mdzad gnas gsum ḍak+ki dngaḥ bar chad kun sel chos skyong srung ma rnamasaḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab du gsolaḥ snang ba 'ja' dang 'od phung lam se lamaḥ rig 'dzin sku dang thig le shigs se shigaḥ byin rlabs dngos grub na bun thu lu lu: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun stsolaḥ bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad bsal ba dngaḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ tshod badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni sarba sa ma ya hrīng trīngaḥ pho pho ཿ a we sha ya a āḥ dgu pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs bya ba ni oṃ ā:hūṃ: dpag yas nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam pa yiḥ phyi nang gsang gsum kun bzang mchod pa'i sprinaḥ 'dod yon lha mo'i gar bsgyur dang bcas nas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa'i dbyid du stelaḥ ka ā:hūṃ ma hā sarba panyu 8 tsa dzñā na hṝ hūṃḥ badz+ra spa ra ṇa dzaḥ bcu pa bshags sbyang bya ba'i rim pa niX hoḥ rtsa gsum kun 'dus bla ma pad+ma 'byungaḥ mkhyen brtse nus pas bdag la dgongs su gsolaḥ lta sprod sgom pa ting

btsa/ 'dzin g.yel ba dngaḥ sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen nongs pa mthol lo bshagasaḥ ka badz+ra sa ma ya bhi shukhye āḥ gnad des phyi nang 'gal rkyen zhi ba dngaḥ don gnyis lhun grub 'byung ba'i gzhi ma'oḥ sbyor ba sngon 'gro'i rim pasnyiḥ las can skal ldan nyams su longasaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i nyams len bya ba laḥ las kyi rim pa nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bstanaḥ dang po ting nge 'dzin gyi khog phub niḥ rang bab shugs khrung ye shes rjen pa'i ngangaḥ u blo 'das dgongs pa chos sku de bzhin nyidaḥ gnyug ma rang gsal longs sku bde ba cheḥ 'pho med rang shar sprul sku rtsol ba medaḥ thabs shes dbyer med ting 'dzin mngon du byaḥ ka.ukahūṃ badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ti 〉ཿ gnyis pa zhing khams bskyed pa'i rim pa niḥ hrīḥ 'gag med rgyu yi sa bon yi ge lasaḥ eḥ spros bral chos dbyings ye shes khyab cing brdal: yeḥ las bya grub rang bzhin g.yo ba'i mtshan baṃḥlas dngas gsal rgya mtsho 'khyil zhing zlum: ram̐ḥspros sor rtog rang bzhin 'bar bas gtamasaḥ suḥlas rin chen sna lnga'i gzhi ma yangasaḥ ye shes lnga ldan rgya tshad phyogs lhung bralaḥ dri bzang sman gyi spang ri ngad pa 'thulaX ku mud sna tshogs mdog 'chang gcal du bkramaḥ yan lag

brgyad dang ldan pa'i rdzing bu mjesaḥ gser gyi bye ma g.yu yi ne'u seng dngaḥ rin chen ljon bzang dril g.yer chun 'phyang lasaḥ zab mo'i chos kyi sgra snyan di ri riḥ ri dwags mang pos rdo rje'i bro gar bsgyuraḥ bya rigs sna tshogs 'phur ldeng rtsed mo 'phrulaḥ 'ja' zer drwa ba mig mang ris su bkraḥ 'dod yon mchod pa'i lha mo'i spro bsdu 'khrugasaḥ ngo mtshar yid 'ong bkod pa lhun gyis grubaḥ de dbus t+t+waṃḥlas ri rab sra brtan brjidaḥ rin chen rnam pa lnga yis rab tu mdzesaḥ tshogs yul dpal dang dur khrod rnam par rdzogasaḥdag mnyam dpa' bo dpa' mo yum lnga'i dalaḥ rang gsal zhing khams rnam rtog dri ma bralaḥ s+t+waṃ dzña na eḥyiḥbaṃḥram̐ḥleḥbadz+ra spa ra ṇa phaṭaḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa 〉ཿ gsum pa gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i rim pa niḥtrīḥ rang byung rgyu yi sa bon gsal ba lasaḥ pho brang gzhi ma t+t+waṃḥlas byung ba yiḥ ye shes lnga ldan lhun grub gzhal yas khangaḥ shar phyogs shel la 'u phyogs be+eḍūr+ya nub phyogs ra ga byang phyogs in+t+ra'i mdogaḥ phyi dang nang med rang gsal rnod zer 'baraḥ rtsig pa 'dod snam pha khu drwa ba dngaḥ dra phyed mda' yab rin chen sna tshogs brgyanaḥ tshad

badz+ra: med sgo dang rta bab chos 'khor gdugasaḥ bum pa bre dang chos 'khor nyi zla'i togaḥ rgyan dang kha dog dbyibs mdzes ngo mtshar gnasaḥ rang byung lhun grub bsrung ba'i gur khang gtamasaḥ ye shes lnga yi me dpung phyogs bcur 'phroḥspyo rat+na maṇ+ḍal e dzñā na tsakra sarba sa ma ya 〉ཿ bzhi pa lha sku bskyed par bya ba ni ༷rta༄ rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas chen po'i dbusaḥ rin chen zur brgyad ma chags pad+ma dngaḥ thabs dang shes rab nyi zla gsal ba'i kharaḥ rig pashrīḥbab 'phro 'du'i gzi byin gyisaḥ bdag snang mi shigagu ru pad+ma 'byungaḥ dkar dmar gzi 'bar bcu drug lang tshos 'khyudaḥ gsang gos mthing nag dmar ser sham thabs mdzesaḥ chos gos gser mdog mazing gsal dar dpyangs 'phuraḥ pad zhwa kha 'bus rdo rje rgod sgros mdzesaḥ zhi 'dzum lang tsho chags pa'i rnam 'gyur bkraḥ phyag g.yas thod pa'i ṭā ru mkha' la 'khrolaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin rdzogasaḥ g.yon pas bhan+ta bdud rtsi dku la rtenaḥ skye 'chi med pa tshe yi dngos grub 'bebasaḥ lha lcam sbas tshul kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan khung rtenaḥ zhabs gnyis phyed skyil

sag lhum 'ja' khra mdzesaḥ ye shes lnga ldan 'ja' zer gur khang 'khrigasaḥ rigs kyi bdag po sangs rgyas snang mtha'abazhugasaḥ ma 'dres me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhinaḥsnang stong zung 'jug chen por lam mer gsalaḥ dngas gsal 'od sku'i gnas lngar thod phreng lngaḥ bde chen 'khor lo rig 'dzin rnam pa brgyadaḥ gcer bu he ru ka pa rus rgyan canaḥ cang dril 'khrol zhing rdo rje'i gar bsgyur brtseḥ longs spyod 'khor lor 'gro 'dul gu ru drugaḥ dkar ser dmar ljang mthing smug he ru gaḥ sna tshogs phyag rgyas rdo rje'i rol rtsed bsgyuraḥ chos kyi 'khor lor gu ru mtshan mchog brgyad sku mdog cha lugs ma nges brtul zhugs tshulaḥ phyag mtshan sna tshogs gar bsgyur thabs kyi skuḥ ma 'dres rang gsal chen por lam mer bzhugasaḥ sprul pa'i 'khor lor rje 'bangs nyi shu niḥ dkar la dmar mdog bcu drug lang tsho canaḥ sna tshogs e rag dar dpyangs rus rgyan sprasaḥ thor cog dbu sgra zar bu g.yon du 'phyangasaḥ snang stong gnyis med 'od lnga'i 1nga du bzhugasaḥ bde skyong 'khor lor bka' bab bu dgu niḥ he ru ka pa'i cha lugs mdzes pa'i sprasaḥ rang

'a:tshu rtags phyag mtshan stang stabs gar gyi rgyaḥ 'ja' lus 'od sku mtshan ma bral bar bskyedaḥ gzhan yang rtsa khams ba spu bye ba'i 1ngaḥ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus paḥ til gong phyur bzhin 'ub chub chen por sgomaḥ gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon yig 'bru lasaḥ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag med 'phroḥ rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus paḥ kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin spyan drangs nasaḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ lnga pa lha tshogs spyan 'dren bya ba ni hūṃ hrīX rngams brjed rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo nasaḥ 'gro ba'i mgon po o rgyan pad+ma 'byungaḥ rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'dza'i spro bsdu bcasaḥ gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gdung bas 'bod lags naḥthugs dam ma g.yel brtse ba chen po yisaḥ gshegs shing byon la dbang dang dngos grub stsolaḥ sgrub pa'i rkyen bzlog nyams rtogs yon tan bskyedaḥ tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ thugs dam ma g.yel badz+ra sa ma yuḥ oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru bīr+ya dha ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ drug pa bzhugs su gsol ba'i rim pa ni hrīḥ gdan gsum tshang pa rdo rje

yangs pa'i sangaḥ dbyings nas spyan drangs lha tshogs ro gcig bsreḥ gnyis med 'ub chub chu la chu bzhag bzhinaḥ du ma ro gcig brtan par bzhugs su gsolaḥ sgo badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ bdun pa phyag 'tshal bya ba'i rim pa ni na moḥ skye 'gags 'gyur med chos sku de bzhin nyid: lhun grub rang gsal 'gag med longs spyod rdzogasaḥ thugs rje rtsol med sprul sku pad+ma 'byungaḥ sku gsum dbyer med mchog la phyag 'tshal loḥ ka na mo na ma hoḥ brgyad pa phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba niḥkaka kakaka yon ma spang phyi yi mchod pa niḥ me tog bdug sbos mar me dri zhal rolaḥ yid 'ong lha mo'i spro bsdu dang bcas nasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i lha la 'bulaḥ dgyes bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba dngaḥ 'gro kun gdod ma'i rgyal sar grol bar regagaḥ ka badz+ra arnya pabye sogs shabha sarba pu tsa la kha ram̐ khā hiḥ dgu pa nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni āḥ nyon mongs ma spang nang gi mchod pa niḥ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogasaḥ 'dod yon lha mo'i gar bsgyur dang bcas nasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i lha la 'bulaḥ dgyes bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba dngaḥ 'gro kun gdod

ba:tshu ma'i rgyal sar grol bar shogaḥ bla badz+ra rū pa sogs dharmā dhartu sarba pu tsa khā hiḥ r+sā pa gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba niX 〉ཿ 'du 'bral med pa gsang ba'i mchod pa niḥ gho dhi tsit+ta byang chub sems kyi rgyunaḥ 'bar ba'i rang bzhin gnyis med bde rol rdzas: rmad byung rdo rje'i rig ma'i 'phrul rtsed bcasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i lha la 'bul dgyes bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba dngaḥ 'gro kun gdod ma'i rgyal sar grol bar shogaḥtso gho dzhai tset+ta dzñā na a haṃ lā phywa mā le gīrti nirti dhi wi sarba sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pañtsa pu tsa hoḥ bcu gcig bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul ba niḥhrīḥ rang byung gadzad nas rnam par dag pa yiḥ rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman chen poḥ rigs 'dus yab yum rdzas su byin rlabs nasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i lha la 'bulaḥ dgyes bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba dngaḥ 'gro kun gdod ma'i rgyal sar grol bar shogaḥ a sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta la kha ram khā hiḥ bcu gnyis rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba niXhrīḥ rten 'brel bcu gnyis gnas su dag pa lasaḥ gu h+ye mu la gsang ba'i dmar chen poḥ girti dmar mo'i rgyun bab rak+ta'i bcud

rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i lha la 'bulaḥ dgyes bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba dngaḥ 'gro kun gdod ma'i rgyal sar grol bar shogaḥ.a ma hā rak+ta la kha ram̐ khā hiḥ bcu gsumagator ma'i mchod 'byul ni smi bdechen rat+na 'bar ba'i gzhong pa phu ro brgya nus pa stong ldan bā lidhaḥ dza gad lha mo'i spro bsdu 'khrigs pa 'diḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i lha la 'bulaḥ dgyes bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba dngaḥ 'gro kun gdod ma'i rgyal sar grol bar shogaḥ.al ma hā bā lidha la kha ram khā hiḥ bcu bzhi sbyor dang sgrol ba'i mchod pa ni spyothabs dang 4༄ga rab sbyor las byung ba yiḥ gnyis med bde rol byang chub sems kyi bcud: blo ngan rtog pa bsgral ba'i sha khrag rusaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i lha la 'bul dgyes bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba dngaḥ 'gro kun gdod ma'i rgyal sar grol bar shogaḥyid ma hā sta na ga ṇa sarba pu tsa la kha ram̐ khā hiḥ bco lnga glu gar pro yi mchod pa ni sni glu gistong gsal bde ba chen po'i ngangaḥ gar ni don dam 'gyur med rtogs pa'i don: bro ni bar chad gdug pa 'dul ba'i broḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i lha la 'bulaḥ dgyes

ba:tshu bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba dngaḥ 'gro kun gdod ma'i rgyal sar grol bar shogaḥ oṃ dṛ ma hā dzñā na te ke phaṭa sarba pu tsa la kha ram̐ khā hiḥ r+sā drug 'dod yon ro mnyam mchod pa niḥ trīḥ bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgoḥ longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad niḥ dkyil 'khor la yang dkyil 'khor zimaḥ chos nyid la yang chos nyid rolaḥ.a ho ma hā su kha pu tsa hoḥ bcu bdun de bzhin nyid kyi mchod pa niḥ hrīḥ 'dza ra 'das chos rnams gdod nas rnam par dgaḥ ka dag zang thal spros bral sku gsum ngangaḥ mkha' la mkha' thim ji bzhin ye mchod rnamasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i lha la 'bulaḥ dgyes bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba dngaḥ 'gro kun gdod ma'i rgyal sar grol bar shogaḥ sa ma hā shuh+ye ta dzñā na badz+ra swā bha wa ad+ma ko3 nya: pu tsa hoḥ bco brgyad lha tshogs bstod pa'i rim pa niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi skuḥ bde chen longs spyod bla ma snang mtha' yasaḥpad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i skuḥ dbyer med pad 'byung sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ 'gyur med rig pa zang thal 'od kyi skuḥ 'gag med rang byung ye shes brjod bral

gsungaḥ 'khrul med smra bsam blo 'das gnyug ma'i thugasaḥ ma hā gu ru'i sku gsung thugs la bstodaḥ mngal gyis ma gos pad+ma'i sbubs las 'khrungasaḥ skye 'chi med pa tshe yi rig 'dzin 'grubaḥ dur khrod gnas gshegs brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzadaḥ sprul pa'i gu ru brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ sgrub sde brgyad kyi klong sgo gsal bar 'byedaḥ rgya bal bod yul chos kyi sgron me sbaraḥ bka' drin zla med 'gro ba yongs kyi mgonaḥ mid byung rig 'dzin brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ ngan song 'gro ba'i gnas ngan sbyong ba dngaḥ tshad med thugs rjes dmus long dbyings su sgrolaḥ byams dang snying rje'i bsil zer stong 'bar baḥ 'gro 'dul gu ru drug la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ bde stong thabs kyis dug lnga'i 'gro ba 'dulaḥ zhi dang khro tshul sbyor sgol ma nges paraḥ gang la gang 'dul brtul zhugs spyod pa skyongaḥ gu ru brgyad cu'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ gdong dmar bod phrug spre'u'i tsha bo rnamasaḥ yal bar mi 'dor thugs rje brtse bas skyongasaḥ mun pa'i 'phrul bsal chos kyi sgron me sbaraḥ rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ gzhan yang rig 'dzin bla ma'i

ba tshu dkyil 'khor duḥ dam tshig thugs rjes 'khod pa'i rtsa gsum lhaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung mar bcasaḥ dkyil 'khor yongs rjogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ bcu dgu bzod gsol bya ba'i rim pa niḥnyo dpang gyur skyabs mchog bla ma dgongs su gsolaḥ bka' bzhin ma sgrub mchod rdzas chung ba dngaḥ le lo g.yeng ba som nyi regar ba sogasaḥ nyams chags 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis paḥ snying nas bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsolaḥ yin badz+ra sa twa sa ma yāḥ sogs āḥ nyi shu 'dzab bskul bya ba'i rim pa niḥ hūṃ hrīX mi shig rang gsal bde chen dpal gyi riḥ tsit+ta pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nasaḥ rang byung rig pa o rgyan rdo rje 'changaḥ ston 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam gnad nas bskulaḥ ye shes gsang ba'i klong mdzod deng byes laḥ 'khrul med blo 'das ting 'dzin rab tu sboraḥ ye shes 'od zer 'bar ba'i lug rgyud kyisaḥ dbang dang dngos grub mchog gi chu rgyun stsolaḥ 'dzin med sku yi sprul pas stong khams khengasaḥ 'gag bral tshangs dbyangs na dā'i rgyang glu gyeraḥ 'khrul med thugs kyi 'od zer glog ltar 'khyugaḥ spros pas stong

gsum dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngangaḥ bsdus pas chos dbyings mkha' la lhun gyis grubaḥ ma gsal bar du yang dag don sgom naḥ 'grub pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po kunaḥring por mi thogs myur ba myur du stonaḥ thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yāḥ nyer gcig 'dzab bzlas bsnyen pa'i rim pa niX hūṃ hrīḥ rang nyid rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs ka dzas pad zla'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' niḥ he ru ka dpal ston gang skyil krung bzhugasaḥ mnyam bzhag 'chi med bhan+ta bdud rtsi brtenaḥ snang stong 'od sku 'ja' zer zlum 'khyil 1ngaḥdabang byin dngos grub mdzod du bzhugs par dmigasaḥ de yi thugs gar nyi steng gser rdo rjeḥ nas tsam dkyil du nyi zla'i ga'u rtsa rig pa hrīḥdamar spu yis bris tsam laḥ rtsa sngags gser gyi thag pa lta bus bskoraḥ bzlas pas sngags phreng 'aX ra ba'i 'od zer gyisaḥ bdag dang 'a17 ba sems can thams cad kyiḥ las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags ma lus paḥ ba mor nyi zer phog ltar sangs kyis dgaḥ ye shes 'od sku stong gsal 'dzin med gyuraḥ ces āḥhūṃḥbadz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūṃḥ thog mthar oṃ dang hūṃ bzhag cingaḥ bar na brgya phrag

—415 gser thag sbrelaḥ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bsnyen sngags yinaḥ bar ma chad par 'bru 'bum bzla mi tshig dag gis mtshams ma gcodaḥ ting 'dzin brtan po'i gnad ldan na phyi nang gsang ba'i 'grub rtags ཿngaX sa ma āḥ nyer gnyis skrub pa'i 'dzab bzlas niḥ / hrīḥ rang nyid rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs ka nasaḥ byin rlabs ye shes rlung gi zer byung ste: lte ba'i gtum mo a thung mes bskul nasaḥcher 'bar gnas lnga'i las nyon bag chags bsregasaḥ kun dha byang chub sems dang reg pa 'phrodaḥ bdud rtsi mu tig dkar po'i rgyun bab nasaḥ 'khor lo lngar brten rig 'dzin rgya mtsho mchod dgyes bskangs tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag pa dngaḥ bskur thob bral ba'i dbang bzhi a la la dga' ba bzhi yi 'od gsal nyams su myongaḥ ma bcos rang grol dkyil 'dzadar gsum gyi ngangaḥ ces āḥhūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃḥ thog mthara.oṃ dang hūṃ bzhag cing bar na bcu phrag gser thag sbrelaḥ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sgrub sngags yinaḥ bar ma chad par 'bru 'bum bzlasaḥ'aphro 'du dmigs pa'i rta la bskyonaḥ yengs med ting 'dzin brtan po yisaḥ bzlas pas rtags mtshan bzang po 'byung dbang dang dngos grub thob par 'gyuraḥ sa ma yāḥ nyer gsum las sbyor 'dzab bzlas niḥ ṭ+wāṃ tri rang nyid

rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs ka nasaḥ 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'phro 'du yisaḥ snang srid snod bcud 'byung lnga'i dpal yon kunaḥ bsdus te bdag thim gzi byin 'bar bar dmigasaḥ 'gro drug 'khor ba'i gnas stong dag pa'i dbyingasaḥ ma bcos rang grol dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngangaḥ lha tshogs kun kyang bung ba tshang zhig ltaraḥ sngags sgra'i sgra dbyangs stong gsum gang bar sgrogasaḥ thams cad dkyil 'khor gsum du rdzogs sangs rgyasaḥ sgo āḥhūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma yā dza sirnyi pha la hūm̐ āḥ thog mtharam dang āḥbazhag nasaḥ bar na nyer gnyis grong mdzes paḥ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i las sngags yinaḥ bar ma chad par 'bum ther bdun ting 'dzin gnad kyis gzer bsdams nas dag par bzlas pas rtags mtshan 'byung phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad selaḥ rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i dgong sa par grolaX sa ma āḥ nyer bzhi rtsa gnas lha'i bzlas paḥ hūṃ trīḥ sngags kyi phreng ba'i 'od zer mchod sprin niḥ lu gu rgyuda'aphros rtsa gnas ba spu'i klongaḥ bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnamasaḥ mchod cing bskul bas gzi 'od rab 'bar nasaḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i mthu stobs kun bsdus bstimaḥ bdag thim

badz+ra 'khor 'das spyi dpal chen por gyuraḥ ye rdzogs don gyi 'bras bu mngon du byaḥ sa āḥhūṃ bho dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhartu āḥ thog mthara.oṃ dang babazhag nasaX bar na bcu bzhi'i grangs mdzes paḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i srog sngags yinaḥ bar ma chad par 'bum phrag gsumaX ting 'dzin ldan pas bzlas pa yisaḥ dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub thobaḥ nyams rtogs yon tan sgo brgyad 'baraX dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyuraḥ the tsham med do sa ma yāḥ nyer lnga 'dod don gsol ba niḥhrīḥ dus gsum bde btagags 'dus zhal pad+ma 'byungaḥ mkhyen brtse nus pas bdag la dgongs su gsolaḥrtse gcig snying po'i nyams len gzhur la drangasaḥ yang dag don sgom bskyed rdzogs las gzhung bsringasaḥ chos brgyad bor la phyi ma dang du blangasaḥ dad mos drag pos yang yang khyed bsnyen naḥ ma hā gu ru'i thugs rje ma g.yel b.raḥ sgrub mchog bdag gi dpung dang skyabs su byonaḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dngaḥ nad mug mtshon 'khrug ming gi lhag mar gyuraḥ legs tshogs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel rgyas mdzodaḥ la klu mi yi zas nor longs spyod dngaḥ sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dod rgu'i gru char phobaḥ rten 'brel nyes pa'i

phyogs rnams zhi ba dngaḥ nyams rtogs yon tan rig pa'i nyi ma sboraḥ bar chad bdud kyi 'phrang kun sel ba dngaḥ tshe gcig yang dag snying pos rab 'tsho zhingaḥ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dga' ston spyodaḥ gdul bya 'bum phrag tshom bu dang bcas nas: rnga yab dpal ri'i gnas su lam sna drongasaḥ tse/ rgyan chen pos rjes bzung sprin grol nasaḥ 'gro khams dong sprugs nus pa'i dpal thob thegagaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ sarba ma hā gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni sidhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ de ltar bzlas pas dngos grub thobaḥ nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan 'baraḥ gdul bya mdzad phrin lang tsho rgyas phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad selaḥ kun bzang dgongs klong yangs par grolaḥ the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ dngos gzhi'i rim pa3nargyaḥ skal pa can gyis nyams su longs sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ nyarma//nyabyu/tsho gu khyaḥ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa niḥ las rim bco lnga dag gi bstanaḥ bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib rigasaḥ ma da na dang me sa dngaX zla rgyas zla phrum 'o chang zhoX zhun phye bdug pa snang ba sogasaX bsags la dum gcig mtshan ldan namaḥ rin chen snod du bsags byas teḥ dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni hūm̐ hrīḥ rang nyid yi dmalha yi thugs ka nasaḥ ram̐ḥyeḥdzaḥspros tshogs rdzas la phog tsheḥ ma dag dri ma'i tshogs rnams bsreg

badz+ra: gtor bkrusaḥ sa āḥhūṃ gis ye shes bdud rtsir gyuraḥ ha ho hrīḥyis zad med nam mkha'i mdzodaḥ kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin dpung dag pa yisaḥ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing rnams yongs khyab gyuraḥ dzaḥyiḥṇaḥ bla āḥ(ཿ ha ho hrīḥ badz+ra spra ra ṇa dzaḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren bya ba niḥ / hrīḥ rang snang mi shig dag pa mkha' spyod zhingaḥ lnga ldan zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo nasaḥ 31 rgyan pad 'byung yab yum ston 'khor dngaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'dza'i spro bsdu gar bsgyur bcasaḥ 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs su gsolaḥ sgrub pa po la dbang bzhi bskur ba dngaḥ bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad bsal ba dngaḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char ltar phobaḥ bla badz+ra sa ma yā dza dzaḥ gsum pa tshogs mchod 'bul ba niḥ sa āḥhūṃḥ 'dod yon bye nang bkod pa kun spungs nasaḥ sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rol par sbyang spel bsgyuraḥ bde stong ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'diḥ rje btsun ma hā gu ru'i tshogs la 'bulaḥ yin ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa la khā hiḥ bzhi pa bshags pa'i rim pa niḥ/ hrīḥ 'dredar tshogs 'dod yon kun bzang sprin chen poḥ ye shes lnga yi 'od zer

'phro ba 'diḥ gu ru pad+ma'i lha la mchod 'bul bsaḥ rtsa lhung dam tshig chags nyams ral ba nga gagasaḥ yin badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ lnga pa bsgral las bya ba niḥ rdzas la dmigs nas 'gugs bstim bya hūm̐ bh+yaḥ rje btsun pad 'byung rak+ka thod phreng rtsal: rngams brjid khros pa'i tshul gyi skur bzhengs laḥ ma rig log 'khrul snyigs ma'i dam sri rnamasaḥ stobs chen shes rab mtshon gyis rab bsgral nasaḥ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su badz+ra phaṭaḥ bla sarba ༄ ༅ mā ra ya phaṭa kha ram̐ khā hiḥ drug pa zhal bstab bya ba niX hūṃ hrīḥ gzung 'dze+en rū tra bsgral ba'i bam gyi tshogasaḥsha khrag bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i mchod sprin rnamasaḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du bstabasaḥ ye shes gsang ba'i 1nga du gnyis med rolaḥ bla sarba ru hra mā ra ya phaṭa kha ram̐ khā hiḥ de nas drangs ba len pa niḥ ho rin thang med pa legs 'ong chosaḥ gsang sngags mchog gi dam rdzas niḥ reg pas ngan song sgo gcod cingaḥ myong bas dngos grub thob par 'gyuraḥ de phyir dad spro ldan pa yisaḥ ro mnyam ngang spyod sid+dhi 〉ཿ ces brjod rdo rje rgyal po dngaḥ mched lcam kun gyis rol bar bya sa ma yā ces kyang pad+ma nor bu yisaḥ bzhed ngomadus ldan rdo rjes phul dge'o/

bsgotshu sarba maṅga le/ bdun pa lag ma 'bul ba niḥ ( hrīḥ sngon tshe sgo rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: grub pa'i rig 'dzin skyes mchog thams can kyiḥ spyan sngar khas blangs mna' bor dam bcas pa'iḥ dbang phyug nyer brgyad ma sring king ling rnamasaḥ 'dir byon 'dod yon lhag gtor mchod pa bzhesaḥ sgrub pa'i rkyen bzlog rnal 'byor bsam don spelaḥ bcol ba'i phrin las ma g.yel dam tshig canaḥ bla ma ma hrīng hrīng bā lirnyi la kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ brgyad pa bskul bar bya ba niḥ jeḥ rngams brjed rnga yab srin po'i pho brang nasaḥ u rgyan chen po yab yum sprul 'dza ra bcasaḥ thugs dam dbyings las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs laḥ mtha' dmag dus 'khrug rgud pa bsal ba dngaḥ bstan pa'i dgra sde thal bar brlag pa sogasaḥ rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ thugs dam ma g.yel badz+ra sa ma yāḥ dgu pa chad mdo gtong ba niḥ hūṃ bye sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po laḥ pad+ma dbang chen rta mchog he ru gsaḥ dpa' ba'i skad bton khros pa'i nga ro yisaḥ ma tram̐ ru tra bsgral nas 'dren pa'i tshe: dregs pa dam can rgya mtsho ma lus pasaḥ sangs rgyas

bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dmaḥ gtsug lag dge 'dun skyong bar ma chad dmaḥ bar chad dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dmaḥ dam rdzas gtor ma len par ma chad dmaḥrnal 'byor sgrub mchog bsrung bar ma chad dmaḥ sbyin bdag bar chad bzlog par ma chad dmaḥ sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ bstan pa'i ru hra bsgral ba'i brin las mdzodaḥ hūṃ bh+yoḥ de 'og bar gyi bskal ba bar ma laḥ mdangs ldan pad+ma las 'khrungs mtsho skyes rjesaḥ dur khrod brgyad gshegs brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzadaḥ gsang sngags bstan pa'i nyi ma yongs la brdalaḥ bka' nyan lha srin dregs pa sde brgyad kyisaḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dmaḥ gtsug lag dge 'dun skyong bar ma chad dmaḥ bar chad dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dmaḥ dam rdzas gtor ma len par ma chad dmaḥ rnal 'byer sgrub mchog bsrung bar ma chad dmaḥ sbyin bdag bar chad bzlog par ma chad dmaḥ sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ zab gsang phyogs bcur spel

ba:tshu ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥ/ stsode'ag bar gyebaskal ba phyi ma laḥ.o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyisaḥgadong dmar bod phrug chos la 'god pa'i tsheḥnagaphyogs gdug pa'i lha srin sde brgyad rnamasaḥdabang bsdus bran bkol sgog snying phul ba'i tsheḥ bod skyong lha srin dam can thams cad kyisaḥsangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar mchad dmaḥ gtsug lag dge 'dun skyong bar ma chad dmaḥ bar chad dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dmaḥ dam rdzas gtor ma len par ma chad dmaḥrnal 'byor sgrub mchogabasrung bar ma chad dmaḥsbyin bdag bar chad bzlog par ma chad dmaḥsngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥbod khamasachos bzhin spyod pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ/ khyerdode'og dus kyibaskal pa'i tha ma laḥbasam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag tuḥslob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis grub pa'i dbang phyug rje 'bangs nyer lnga laḥ zab gter rgya mtsho'i klong rgya bkrol ba'i tsheḥ gter gyi srung ma dam can rgya mtsho yisaḥzab gter bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam

gtsug lag dge 'dun skyong bar ma chad dmaḥ bar chad dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dmaḥ dam rdzas gtor ma len par ma chad dmaḥ rnal 'byor sgrub mchog bsrung bar ma chad dmaḥ sbyin bdag bar chad bzlog par ma chad dmaḥ sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ zab gter bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ hūṃ sbyoḥ de 'og lnga brgya'idus la bab pa'i tsheḥ rang snang zangs mdog dpal ri'i gnas mchog nasaḥ gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po pad 'byung gisaḥgrub pa'i dbang phyug 'brog ban lo tsā laḥ zab gsang rdor snying bstan pa yongs rdzogs gtadaḥ snyigs ma'i rgud pa gso phyir 'phrul ba'i tsheḥ dmar po lha dgu spu gri mched brgyad kyis ཿ zab gter bstan pa srung bar ma chad dmaḥ gtsug lag dge 'dun skyong bar ma chad dmaḥ bar chad dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dmaḥ dam rdzas gtor ma len par ma chad dmaḥ rnal 'byor sgrub mchog bsrung bar ma chad dmaḥ spyin bdag bar chad bzlog par ma chad dmaḥ sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: 'dod yon brgyan

badz+ra: pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ zab gter bstan pa phyogs bcur 'phel rgyas mdzodaḥhūṃ bye: da lta snyegs ma'i dus la bab pa'i tsheḥ snying dbus zangs mdog dpal ri'i gnas mchog nasaḥ rang byung rig pa pad+ma saṃ bha was: grub pa'i dbang phyug nus ldan rdo rje laḥ zhal gzigs lung bstan dgongs pa gtad pa'i tsheḥ rang rtsal bka' nyan dam can rgya mtsho yisaḥs nga rdo la zab gter srung bar ma chad dmaḥ gcug lag dge 'dun skyong bar ma chad dmaḥ bar chad dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dmaḥdam rdzas gtor ma len par ma chad dmaḥ rnal 'byor sgrub mchog bsrung bar ma chad dmaḥ sbyin bdag bar chad babye ga par ma chad dmaḥ bye na tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' b.raḥ 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ 'jig rten bde skyid ldan pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ bcu pa bstan ma skyong ba niḥhūṃ spyorgyal dbang pad+ma'i bka' dam la gnas pa'iḥ bod skyong bstan ma ya ma'i tshogs rnams kunaḥ lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan cha pu ru dza3 bran g.yog 'du ba sna tshogs nyi li liḥ sgrub pa

po la gdung shugs lam se lamaḥ ma thogs gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsolaḥ dam rdzas bshal chu'i mchod pa 'di bzhes laḥ mtha' mi dbus su 'byunge ba'i 'tshubs ma dang mi 'dod nad mug mtshon chas gzeng mo dngaḥ du ru ka yi rigs byed bco brgyad sogasaḥ mdor na gnod cing phung bar byed pa rnams mthu rtsal stobs kyis zhi zhing gzhom par mdzod rgud pa mtha' dag ming gi lhag mar gyuraḥ rdzogs ldan lang tsho dar ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥ bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ bcu gcig rta pro 'khrab pa ni hūṃ hrīḥgasang ba bla med don gyi dkyil 'khor duḥ bar chad dam sri 'dul ba'i rta mchog dpalaḥ thugs dam dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengasaḥ khru gsum sa 'og gshin rje'i lto ba rtsa ya ma dam sri brub po ma shor cigaḥ nam yang ldang bar ma byed s+t+waṃ bha yaḥ yid lam̐ḥ a leḥ hūṃ lam̐ḥ swā leḥ hā leḥ sto bha ya nanaḥ ma ra ya nanaḥ de nas dngos grub spyi ltar lenaḥmachod rtsing bstod pa rgyas par byaX bcu gnyis bzod gsol bya ba niḥ dzñā hrīX dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus 'dus pa'i dpalaḥ 'gro mgon pad 'byung 'khor bcas dgongs su gsolaḥ

ba tshu mchod rdzas ma tshang sgrub pa g.yel ba dngaḥ ting 'dzin bying rmugs 'thibs dang dam tshig nyamasaḥ 'gal 'khrul nongs pa thams cad mthol lo bshagasaḥklong yangs chen po'i ngang du bzod par bzhesaḥ tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ sa badz+ra sa ma ya bi shudhe ā ༷ yi ge brgya ba lan gsum gyisaḥ lhag chad kha bskangs bya ba'oX bcu gsum bsngo ba smon lam niX hoḥ 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum duḥ bsags dang bsags 'gyur bsags pa'i dge ba rnamasaḥ gcig tu bsdus te mar gyur 'gro la bsngoḥ phyam gcig kun bzang bla ma'i sa thob regagaḥ lan gsumaḥ bcu bzhi rtag chad mtha' bsal niḥ āX snang cha thabs su bskyed pa'i lha tshogs rnamasaḥ dmigs med blo 'das dbu ma chen por āḥslar yang rang gsal sgyu ma lta bu yisaḥ 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam rgyun du bya'oḥ a āḥ phaṭa phaṭaḥ bco lnga bkra shis bya ba niḥ na moḥ sku gsum chos dbyings nam mkha' laḥ bde stong chu 'dzin lhun rgyas nasaḥ dga' bzhi'i gru char 'bebs pa'i mthusaḥ 'gro dre'i ge sar zum pa phyeḥ rta bdun 'od kyis phyogs kun brdalaḥ rmongs pa'i mun pa mkha' ltar dgaḥ

gdul bya'i pad tshal rab rgyas shingaḥ phyogs kyi rkang drug 'du tshogs sminaḥ grags pa'i dbyar rnga phyogs bcur sgogasaḥ bkra shis 'od dkar nub med paḥ 'dzam gling kun khyab bkra shis shogaḥ nyin yang dpal 'bar da la laḥ mtshan yang bde spyod kyi li li rtag par chos 'khor 'u ru rtsa phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shogaḥ de ltar nyams su len pa yisaX skal bzang skyes bu thams can kyiḥ rgyud la phan bde'i lang tsho 'khrungaḥ nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyasaḥ tshe dang chos kyi bar chad sel: phyi nang rgud 'khrug rtsub 'gyur zhiḥ bde skyid lang tsho gsar du 'khrungaḥ bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen 'byungaḥ bar chad bdud kyi 'khor lo stongasaḥ legs pa'i 'bras bu smin par byedaḥ the tshom med do sa ma yāḥ byin rlabs rno nus gzhan las 'phagasaḥ bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal nges shes go bas lon par rigasaḥ yid ches myong bas thob par 'gyuraḥ dkon mod rgyal khams 'grims dang mthong rjes kyi rim pa3sargyaḥ las spron ldan pas nyams su longasaḥ tshe gcig sangs rgyas sa la reg ༷ ngo mtshar che ba'i gnas min namaḥ sa ma yuḥrgya rgya rgyaḥ gibla/3111 gu rgya0 e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha wasaḥ ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis shin tu zab pa yang snying sgog gi rgyudaX ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs tho le baḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i byin rlabs gzi me ba sgrub pa po la

zhes( dbang byin lam me baḥche ba'i yon tan bsgrangs las 'das pa'i bcudaḥsnying las phang yangakhye'u chung lo tsā dngaḥ mkhar chen mtsho rgyal rma ban rin mchog laḥyongs su gtad do da lta spel dus minaḥrin chen brda la thob cig sa ra bye0 mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya sdomasaḥm 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dusaḥ sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro la phan bde spelaḥchos bdagarmi ban ku mud ma ṇi yis ༷nyams su blang na phyi nang bar chad sel0nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mang du 'khrungaḥgadul bya bsam yas dpal gyi ri la 'godaX zab gter bstan pa phyogs bcur dar rgyas byedaḥ'abru ban dharma'i thugs la rab smin nasaḥbade skyid lang tsho brdal yang 'gro la 'domasaX zab gsang nyi ma phyogs bcur 'phel rgyas byedaX bar chad bdud 'dul 'brel thog dpal rir 'godaḥthugs bskyed rmad byung pad+ma 'od gsal snying chos kyi bka' bab zab gter 'dzin nus naX'abum phrag bcu gnyis 'gro ba ma lus paḥzangs mdog dpal gyi ri la mngon sangs rgyasaḥskal med lag tu chos bcud ma shor cigaXlas can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par regagaḥbaka' gsang thub par gyis shiganges nus maḥbastan pa'i bdud sde'i snying khrag gnam la gtor skal bzang las smon ldan pa'i 'du ba bskyedaḥdapon slob bde skyid ldan pa'i re 'bras smin:sa ma āX rgya rgya rgyaḥzab sgrub dngos grub gter gyi bul bzang zhes bya ba rdzogs soḥgater

rgya0 gtad rgyaḥ zab rgyaX sbas rgyaḥ gsang rgyaḥ gu h+ya o rgyan gyi sgob dponapad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka'aḥ bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'oX brda thim dziḥ ces pa 'di yang chos kyi bdag po dam pa sprul ba'i sku mchog pad+ma nor bus thabs shes kyi rdzas dang bkra shis pa'i lha regs ༷ mthing mdzes cod pan dang bcas nas zhal gsung rdo rje'i sgras yang yang bskul ba dngaḥ chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshos nan tan gyis bskul ba rnams rtags dang rten 'brel bzang po ru shes nas bri bar brtsams tsheḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gromang pos rdo rje'i bro gar dang bcas nas bskul ba'i mod la bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjesamakha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ legs so/ sarba maṅga le/

gtsa(: marga don kha nyi niḥ sa āḥhūṃḥ ka dag dri bral bde chen snang mtha' yasaḥ snying rje'i gter chen 'phags pa spyan ras gzigasaḥ 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig pad+ma ka ra laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hiḥ bdud 'dul gzhan snang zil gnon mtshan mchog brgyadaḥ 'khor ba dong sprugs 'gro 'dul gu ru drugaḥ dur khrod gnas brten rig 'dzin rnam brgyad laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hiḥ ye shes lnga gsang thod phreng sde lnga dngaḥ ma rung zil gnon rak+ka dbu 'bum rtsalaḥ 'gro 'dul thabs mkhas dbang po sde nyid laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hiḥ brtul zhugs dga' spyod grub dbang brgyad cu dngaḥ sgrub sde grub brtes snying gi bu chen dgu: mdo sngags bstan skyong lo paṇa brgya rtsa laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hiḥ mi brjed gzungs thob ye shes mtsho rgyal dngaḥ dbyings kyis rgyas 'debs lha lcam man+ta raḥ thugs byon jo mo snod ldan

rnam gsum laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hiḥ phrin las mtha' yas sprul pa'i gter ston dngaḥ mdzad pa rab rgyas bdud 'dul sde lnga sogasaḥ byin rlabs 'byung gnas rtsa rgyud bla ma laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsolaX ma hā pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hiḥsnang ba thabs mchog dpa' bo sde bzhi dngaḥ stong nyid gar dbang shes rab dpa' mo bzhiḥ las mdzad phrin myur ging dang lang ga laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hiḥ tha tshig gtsug 'dzin dam can rgya mtsho dngaḥ rnal 'byor grogs mo sngags bdag nges nus maḥ zab gsang gnyen skyongs spu gri mched gsum laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hiḥ g.ya' ri has po yang le shod la sogasaḥ phug gsum ljongs lnga gangs bzang nyi shu lngaraḥ brten bcas pho nya dam tshig sgog ldan laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hiḥ hūṃḥ lcoyidam tshog rdo rje pad+mo laḥrdo rje spyan gyi gsang bar〉ཿbsgom nasaḥ bla ma yab

badz+ra yum sbyor bas bdud rtsi'i rgyunaḥ mu tig dkar po dri med thig le'i bcudaḥ tsan dan smug po rma med pad+ma rtsa gnyis med bde sbyor bde ba'i mchog bstims paḥ sha lnga bdud rtsi sbyar ba'i bcud chen poḥ rdo rje'i phyag rgya dam tshig lcags kyu yisaḥ hūṃḥdang hūṃḥgis bsre sbyor la bstims nasaḥ reg myong bla med byang chub mchog thob pa'iḥdangos grub ma lus rigs ldan bu yis bye daḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ kā ya sirnyi skyesaḥ wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūṃḥ sarba sidhi hrīḥ 1 ma'i glu yis rig 'dzin bskulaḥ gar ma'i gar gyis nyams rtogs bslangaX brda las brda yi gsang bkrol nasaX mi smra kha med pad+ma'i rigasaḥ blang dor bral bar phab pa lags/'gyur med rgya mcho'i dpal du re/gnus ldan dza rje'i 'khrul nyams so/ sarba maṅga lam/badz+ra: bgrang phreng byin brlabs niX bla sarba dharma ga ga na āḥ stong pa'i ngang las bgrang preng rnams rig 'dzin paṇa grub dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams kyi rol bar gyur te kun kyang nyams bde ba chen po'i bro gar bsgyuraḥ phreng lung ye shes lnga'i gsang lam gyi drwa ba'i tshul du sbrel nas rtog pa bdud srin gyis bar mi chod par mchog thun dngos grub sdud

pa'i 'od zer gyis spro bsdu 'khrigs par bsamaḥ rten snying gis rab tu gnas par byas la me tog 'thor bzhin shis pa brjodaḥ 'di'ang sgrub pa'i cha lag dngaḥdzñā dza dgyes byer kun nyis so/ sarba maṅga lam̐/46 'dzab dgongs rdo rje'i rang sgra snyiḥ gigadza/ hūṃ hrī0 sku gsum mnyam rdzogs ye shes gsang ba'i srogaḥ mi 'gyur bdun ldan rdo rje phra ba'i bcudaḥ dbyangs gsal thabs shes go lar shar ba'i gsangaḥ dbang chen gsung gi rgyud bskul sa bonahrīḥ rdo rje las byed pho nya bcu gsum bcasaḥ mi 'gyur mi shig ting 'dzin phra mos brtenaḥbag chags 'byung ba'i dwangs snyigs zer gyis dbye: shes rab gsang ba gsum gyi srog tu tshudaḥ kun khyab rdo rje'i dgongs pa mngon du byaḥ bla ābadz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sirnyi hūṃḥ mi 'gyur dgongs pas gzer gdab bzhinaX bsnyen pa chu ba'i gzhung bzhin bzla sa ma yuḥ shā hrīḥ :༄gnas dbu ma mtha' bral nam mkha' laḥ 'dzadar 'das byed po sems nyid rig pa'i gsangaḥ thog regs mtshan 'dzin bral bar 'ja' 'khyag bzhinaḥ 'od zer skar phreng 'khyag pa'i spo bsnga yisaḥ gnyis snang dri ma'i mun khams dbyings su bshigaḥ bdud rtsi mu tig dkar po'i

ba tshu rgyun bab steḥ thog med las kyi yon tan mchog thob dmigasaḥ bzlas sngags gong bzhin gnad du dril nye bar bsnyen pa grogs su shesaḥ sa ma yuḥ / trīḥ miganas chos dbyings nam mkha' spros mtha' bralaḥ 'khrul snang 'khor ba'i rba glong der mnyam kyangaḥ rten 'byung zhing gi bkod pa sad byas nasaḥ lha sngags chos sku'i rol bar lam khyer mthusaḥ gnyis snang zhen 'dzin dri ma kun bcom nasaḥ bkod pa dpa' bo yab kyi gsang dang 'dresaḥ mi gnas mi shig rdo rje btsun mor dgaḥ sku gsum pad+ma'i dgongs slong byang chub steḥ 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzad pa mthar phyin dmigasaḥ sgrub sngags gsang ba bcu gnyis paḥ 'phro 'du'i gnad kyis bzla bar bya sa ma yā ༷ hūṃ hrīḥ kun khyab rdo rje ma hā gu ru yiḥ gsang gsum dril ba rdo rje'i glu gar bsgyuraḥ grangs tshom darkyele 'khor spros pa mtha' yas kyangaḥ gcig tu dril ba ye shes rdo rje'i gsangaḥ gnyis su mi gnas dbu ma chen po'idonaḥ a ti 'bras bu'i chos sgra gcig pu steḥ kun bzang spong nas gzugs sku mtha' yas pasaḥ med byung gu ru'i mdzad pa phrin las skoḥ yongs grub pad+ma 'od du byang chub dmigasaḥ ting 'dzin
