lu gu rgyud du spro bsdus pa dbugs kyi rtar bskyon nasaḥ sgrub pa chen po'i rtsa ba'i sngags nyi shu rtsa lnga srog gtar 'dzinaḥ sa ma yāḥ shā trīḥ ༷ bral rogal 〈debum pa bzang po nyidaḥ rin chen sgon me bltam pas gzi 'od bzhinaḥ 'bar ba'i 'od zer steng 'og phyogs bcur sprosaḥ 'jigs tshogs mi mthun dri ma kun bcom nasaḥ chos nyid zhi zhing chags pas ma gos pa'iḥ bde gshegs kun bzang dgongs pa mngon du byaḥ slar yang btso ma'i mdangs 'bar gzi 'od kyisaḥ 'khor 'das 'byung ba'i dngas bcud ma lus paḥ khab len rdo yis lcags khams sdud pa bzhinaḥ 'ub kyis dril la rig pa'i snying por bskyilaḥ mthu stobs nus pa'i gzi 'od rgyas par dmigasaḥ 'bar ba'i 'od zer dbang gi lcags kyu yisaḥ lha klu mi sogs tha dad bzung ba'i yulaḥ bgrangs dka' kun khyab nam mkha'i mthar mnyam pa'iḥ bla srog yid bskul zas nor 'o/ngas spyod gteraḥ byā dang g.yang gi dngos grub ma lus paḥ sib kyis bsdus la mnga' dbang thob par dmigasaḥ drag cing tsha la rtsub pa'i phrin las skoḥ sbyor dang sgrol ba'i thabs tshul ma nges pa gang la gang 'dul gnyen po mtha' yas paḥ bdud

btsa/ dpung zil gnon bgegs dpung rtsad nas bcadaḥphyi nang gsang dgra dam sri nyul le'i tshogasaḥming tsam med par drag po mngon spyod kyiḥbrin las shugs 0〈rgyung cardon dang ldan par dmigasaḥlas bzhi'i phrin las 'grub pa'i sngagasaḥrdo rje'i gzhung las gsal ltar byaḥdamigs pa las kyi pho nya sbran don kun 'grub par the tshom medaḥs ma yāḥtha ṭhaḥrgyaḥsku gsum bla ma pad 'byung dngaḥrnam dbyer ma mchis 'dud 'dul nasaḥman ngag snying gi pad+mor bstims ༷don dang ldan snyam ngo mtshar ba'iḥbarda mdzodargya mche'i ming gis bskulaḥrin chen shog skyar bkod pa niXlas kyi pho nyas marnyasaḥbazhengs bsgrub dge ba'i bsod nams kyis 'gro khams dong sprugs nus par shogaḥkhrag 'thung bdud 'dul 'dus pa rtsal gyis so/sarba maṅga lam̐ḥ

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru la brten pa'iḥ smon lam rnam dag bdud rtsi'i thigs pa bzhugs soḥgs/ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ spo 0)skyo/tshe rgyal ba'i dbang po o rgyan pad+ma 'byungaḥ gang 'dul sprul pa'i rnam grangs bsam mi khyabaḥ dbyer med gcig bsdus gu ru rin po cheḥ mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchodaḥ ma 'ongs skal bzang las can pho mo rnamasaḥ gsang ba rmad byung sgo 'dir zhugs pa'i tsheḥ smon lam rnam dag bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'diḥ dus kun ma brjed nyams len rtsa ba mdzodaḥ sa ma yāX 6) ma therteḥ'adi nas nyi ma lto nub mtshams shed na: rnga yab gling zhes rak+ka srin po'i yulaḥ rgyal ba rnams kyis byin rlabs mdzad pa'i gnasaḥ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar regagaḥganas mchog de yi chags tshul tsit+ta'i dbyibasaḥ rtsa ba gdengs can 'jog po'i thod du bcingaḥ sded par lus med mkha' 'dza'i tshogs 'khor bskoraḥ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shogaḥ rtse mo tshangs pa'i 'jag rten snyegs pa 'draḥ dri bzang 'ja' 'od bsil chab rtag tu 'bebs nyin mtshan bar med 'od gsal 'khor lo'i ngangaḥ zangs

mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar thog: rngams brjid 'jigs rung srin po'i tshogs rnams kyangaḥ gu ru thod phreng sde lnga la 'dud cingaḥ gsang chen chos kyi sgron me rab tu sbaraḥzangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shog: lhun grub pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang niḥ phyi nang rab gsal rin chen lnga las grubaḥ khru chad sgo khyud rta bab bang rim mdzesaḥ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar re gaḥ phyi nang dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mchod sprin stobasaḥ rgyal chen sde bzhis phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub ཿ king dang laṅka rnams kyis rtsed 'jo byedaḥ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar re/ga: lhun grub gzhal yas khang dbus rat+na'i khri: ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi stengaḥ bde gshegs 'dus zhal gu ru pad+ma bzhugasaḥ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar re gaḥ zhi 'dzum dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur bsam mi khyabaḥ dar dang rat+na gsang bam chos gos klubasaḥ dmar smug sham thabs pad+ma'i mnyen zhu mdzesaḥ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar re/gaḥ phyag g.yas thod pa'i ṭā ru nam mkhar 'khrolaḥ g.yon pas bde stong thod bum dku la brtenaḥ stangs stabs gar bsgyur

gtsasdo rgyal po rol stabs bzhugasaḥzangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shogaḥye shes 'ad lnga'i 'du 'phro skar ltar 'khrigasaḥthugs rje'i byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i sbrang char 'bebasaḥdapa' bo mkha' 'gros mchod bstod rtag tu 'gyedaḥzangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar re gaḥgayas kyi gral na rgya bal paṇa grub 'tshogasaḥgayon ngos 'phags bod rje 'bangs lo paṇa bzhugasaḥbashad sgrub gsang sngags chos kyi sgron me sbaraḥzangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar re gaḥsprul pami gter steX rgya mtsho'i spro bsdu 'gyedaḥthugs rje rgyun chad med par bod la gzigasaḥskyid pa'i nyi ma dam chos spel ba'i gzhiḥzangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shogaḥgu runi spyan gyi 'od zer bye ba brgyasaḥmi mjed 'dul mdzad pad 'byung sprul pa 'gyedaḥ'ajig rten zhing khams gdul bya bye brag 'drenaḥzangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar re gaḥsku dang phyag las 'od zer bye ba dungaḥre re bzhin du 'dren mdzad sprul pa 'gyedaḥngan song 'khor ba'i btson khang gshom mdzad pa'iḥzangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shogaḥde steng zhing khams

rnam par dag pa dzasgyu 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugasaḥ thugs rje'i zer gyis 'gro khams dong nas sprugasaḥ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar re/gaX yang thog ma chags pad+ma 'od kyi zhingaḥ bde chen mgon po chos sku snang mtha' yasaḥ thugs rje'i rlabs kyis 'gro rnams 'dren par mdzadaḥ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar regagaḥ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gzhal yas mdzes pa'i dbusaḥ gu ru mtshan brgyad ston 'dza ra tshom bu bcasaḥ ngo mtshar dag pa'i bkod pa phun sum tshogasaḥ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skyebar shogaḥ pho rgyud dpa' bos bro 'khrub sha ra raḥ mo rgyud dpa' mos glu len kyu ru rtsa mkha' 'gros gsang ba'i brda skad di ri riḥ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shogaḥ chos skyong sde brgyad las byed khyugs se khyug thod rnga rol mo'i sgra dbyangs 'u ru rtsa phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dpungs se dpungaḥ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shogaḥ bdag dang bdag la 'brel ba'i skye bo kunaḥ log lam 'khrul ba'i dbang du mi 'gyur bar: sdom pa gsum gyi bslab bya mthar phyin nasaḥ zangs mdog

ba:tshu dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shogaḥ nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tsheḥ kun mkhyen mgon po'i pho nya mkhar chen gzasaḥ mngon sum lag pa'i mdzub mo nas drangs teḥ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar re gaḥ slar yang gdangs kyi 'khor ba ma stong b.raḥ dbyings las ma g.yos sprul pa sna tshogs kyisaḥ 'gro khams dong sprugs dpal gyi rir bkod nasaX ngo mtshar mdzad pa rmad byung mthar phyin re/gaḥ de ltar smon pas 'bras bu chud mi za byin rlabs khyad par 'phags pa'i rno so yodaḥ pad+ma bdag gi snying bcud gdams pa spro nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dngaḥ 'phrad nas bstan 'dza'i don chen 'byung gyur cigaX bka' gsang thub par srung shig nges nus ma skal med lag tu ma shor dam tshig canaḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaX smon lam rnam dag bdud rtsi'i thigs pa rdzogs so0 gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgyaḥ zab rgyaḥ gsang rgyaḥ gu hraḥ u rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'oḥ brda thimaḥdziḥ ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag popad+ma nor bus yang yang bskur ngoraḥ bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

'a:: zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru yiḥ don bstod thugs dam gnad bskul byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥbatsan na 37 gu ru padha ka ra yeḥ ྅skormi/dīsgo mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer stong 'bar zhingaX rgyal kun phrin las gcig rdzogs garaḥ o rgyan pad+ma ka ra la mthon mthing ral bas btud de 'dudaḥ bdag 'dra pad+ma saṃ bha wasaX ma 'ongs las ldan dga' ba'i chal0 o rgyan pad+ma ka ra yiX sgrub sde rmad byung zab mo bstanaḥ dad mos brtson pa drag po yisaX nyams su len par bskul bgyi'o0 sa ma yāḥde yang den bstod bya ba la gu ru'i yon tan dran pa yis dad dang mos gus spro shugs bskyedaḥ snyan pa'i dbyangs dang rol mo'i sgrasaḥ dus drug 'di nyid brjod par byaḥ hūṃ hrīḥ ye sangs rgyas pa snang ba mtha' yas skuḥ ma chags pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs 'dzin zhingaḥ 'chi ba med pa rdo rje tshe yi lhaḥ 'gags med 'od mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ byams dang snying rje'i bsil zer 'od stong gisaḥ dmus long 'gro ba'i nyon mongs tsha gdung 'jomasaḥ rigs drug 'khor ba'i gnas rnams stong mdzad pa'iḥ dri med pad+ma dkar por phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ mi mjed 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya rtsa gang 'dul

sprul pa'i 'gro don bsam yas kyisaḥ dad ldan gdul bya'i lo tog smin mdzad pa'iḥ gu ru pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ nyon mongs dug lngas gzir ba'i 'gro ba rnamasaḥ ye shes lnga yi lam la drangs byed cingaḥ sku dang zhing khams mngon snang smin grol mdzadaḥ dpa' bo thod phreng sde lngar phyag 'tshal bstodaḥmadangs ldan dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling duḥ rgyu rkyen las 'das brdzus skyes mchog gi skuḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mchod bstod gus 'dud byedaḥ mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥkhams gsum dbang sdud rgyal po'i tshul 'dzin zhingaḥ chos kyi 'khor los ma rig mun pa bsalaḥ dbul phongs rgud sel nor ster re skong dpalaḥ pad+ma rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ'og min gnas dang rgya mtsho'i 'gram la sogasaḥ dag pa'i zhing nas rang snang ston pa yisaḥ gsang sngags phyi nang zab mo'i don ngo spradaḥ blo ldan mchog sred sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ a su ra sogs dag pa'i gnas mchog tuḥ shāka thub dpa' bo'i nye gnas kun dga' yisaḥ rjes bzung 'dul khrims srung zhing don kun mkhyenaḥ sde snod ma lus bstan pa'i mdzod chen gtadaX

bsgo(rnya gu ru shākya seng ger phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ brtul zhugs mdzad pa'i dur khrod gnas kun nyulaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gror chos kyi 'khor lo bskoraḥ bdud rtsi bam ro sgrub pa'i dngos grub brtesaḥ nyi ma 'od zer sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje gdan dang gling gsum bstan pa'i mdzodaḥ snub 'dod phra men mu stegs sbyor ngan 'khrugaḥ 'joms byed drag po'i mthu yis thal bar rlogaḥ seng ge sgra sgrogs sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ za hor yul chedags bsam mi khyab pa yiḥ gdul bya ma lus thar ba'i lam la bkodaḥ rdzu 'phrul grub pa'i rtags mtshan mngon snang ba'iḥ pad+ma saṃ bha'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ stag tshang seng ge bsam 'grub ke'u tshang duḥ bdud dang dam sri bon rnams drung 'byin cingaḥganas chen gangs brag gter gyis gang bar mdzadaḥ rdo rje gro lod sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ smon ma ga bdud dang dam sri sgrol mdzad cingaḥ zab gsang chos kyi nyi ma yongs la brdalaḥ mthu stobs rmad byung he ru ka dpal niḥ gtum drag rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rgya mtsho'i gling gi 'ja' 'od bsil khyim nasaḥ gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma yi

brda glu yisaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos kyis smin par mdzadaḥ khyad 'phags rig 'dzin sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ brag phug chen po ma ra ti ka rtsardo rje'i tshe bsgrubs tshe dpag med mgon byonaḥ 'chi med a yu'i dbang gis smin grol mdzadaḥ bsgres bral gu ru rje la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥrgya gar yul ljongs byang chub ring mo rtsa zag med thams cad mkhyen pa'i ting 'dzin gyisaḥ lha klu mi la gsang sngags chos 'khor bskoraḥ gu ru zhi ba nyid la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥtshogs brgyad rnam dag brtul zhugs spyod pa yisaḥ 'gro 'dul gu ru bsam mi khyab par 'phrulaḥ gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min zhing la 'godaḥ sprul ba'i rig 'dzin brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ ma rig 'khor ba'i'adam rdzab 'thug po dza3rmongs 'khrul dug lngas myos pa'i 'gro ba rnamasaḥ sbyor dang sgrol ba'i lam la drangs nas dgrolaḥ rnam 'phrul grub chen brgyad cur phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ las nyon 'thib pa'ibag chags btson khang duḥ tsha grang bkres skom zug rngus mnar ba rnamasaḥ bde chen dbyings la 'god par mdzad pa yiḥ 'gro 'dul gu ru drug la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥgadong dmar

badz+ra bod khams spre'u'i tsha bo rnamasaḥ rnam dag dkar po'i lam la 'god mdzad cingaḥ gsang chen nyi ma yongs su rab sbar ba'iḥ gu ru rin po che la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ ma rung rak+ka srin po'i yul gling kunaḥ dam pa'i chos kyi snang bas khyab par byasaḥ kheng sems gdug pa'i blo ngan drungs 'byin pa'iḥ rak+ka thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ bsam bzhin 'phags pa'i zlos gar bsgyur ba yiḥ ye shes spyan ldan gangs can bstan pa'i gzhiḥ rig 'jin chen po las can bu dgu sogasaḥ rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lngar phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ snyigs ma'i nad mchen dmag 'khrug rgud pa gzhomaḥ bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs ba yisaḥ phan bde'i lang tsho 'byung ba'i gzhir gyur paḥsprul pa'i gter ston rnams la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥgazhan yang reg 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor duḥ dam tshig thugs rjes 'khod pa'i rtsa ba gsumaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging dang rig 'dzin tshogasaḥ rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi skuḥ bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rjeḥ pad sdong las 'khrung bla ma

sprul pa'i skuḥ dbyer med rdo rje'i klong la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ bye ba phrag brgya'i bla ma yi dam lhaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang chub semasaḥ 'ub chub spro bsdus mnga' bdag bstan pa'i gzhiḥ mnyam nyid rgyal ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ sku ni mi 'gyur mtshan bzang dpe byad rdzogasaḥ gsung ni mi 'gags zab mo'i chos sgo 'byedaḥ thugs ni mi g.yo bsam brjod 'dzin pa bralaḥ rgyal kun thugs kyi sras por phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ de ltar rje btsun gu ru rin po che'iḥ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las ma lus paḥ rgyud la blang nas dad mos drag po yisaḥ bstod cing gsol ba btab pas bdag sogs rnamasaḥ thugs rjes ma dor rjes su bzung du gsolaḥ 'jig rten rgud pa mtha' dag bsal ba dngaḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad nyer 'tshe gzhomasaḥ nam zhig srid pa'i rgong rgya ral ma thag: rnga yab dpal ri bde chen bkod pa'i zhing: lhun grub bde ba chen pos gzhal yas suḥ 'gro ba'i mgon po pad+ma ka ra'i drungaḥ mi 'bral tshom bu gcig tu sangs rgyas re gaḥ de ltar brjod pas byin rlabs 'dugaḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad selaḥ nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan

—414 'baraḥthe tshom med do sa ma yāḥ.e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma sa bha ngasaXm 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yisaḥsnying da 'dra ba'i man ngag zab pa'i bcudaḥrtsa gsum rgyal ba'i byin rlabs rdzogs pa 'di0 grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung lo tsā dngaX yi shes mtsho rgyal rma ban rin chen mchog ཿcog ro klu rgyal be+e ro ca na laḥyongs su gtad do da lta spel dus minaḥrin chen brda la thob cig sa ra bye:mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya sdomasaḥm 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dusaḥng sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dngaḥ'aphrad nas las can ches bdag rnam pa gsumaḥlas can lnga la legs par spel gyur naḥbastan dang 'gro ba'ibade skyid nyi ma rgyasaḥgadul bya 'bum phrag dpal gyi ri la grolaḥgatan la phab pa 'i dus tshegs bskal pa khyiḥzab gsang sgrub pa'i sgo 'dzug sa pho stagaḥskal med lag tu gdams bcud ma zag cigaḥlas can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par regagaḥzab gsang thub par srung shig nges nus maḥs ma yāḥrgya rgya rgyaḥdon bstod thugs dam gnad bskul rdzogs soḥgater rgya gtad rgyaḥsbas rgyaḥzab rgya ༷gsang rgya 0gu h+ya yi rgyan gyi ste/ba dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka'0 bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bked pa'o brda thimaḥ snyiḥces pa 'di'ang chos bdag pad+ma ner bus thabs shes rdor dril dang bcas te bskul ba dngaḥchos bdag pad+ma chos 'phel gyis yang yang bskul ngoranus ldan rdo rjes phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga waṃ/

btsanazab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i chos steḥ bstan srung ngas nus chen mo'i zab sgrub phroṃn las lhun grub zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥgs/: na ma gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ sgo ga(bye zlo smo rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas kyi phrin las gcig bsdus 'gro ba'i mgonaḥ o rgyan pad+ma thod phreng rtsal mi 'bral spyi bo'i rgyan du mchodaḥ bdag 'dra pad+ma so bha was ma 'ongs las ldan sgrub pa po'iḥ phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i phyiraḥ drung ma sgrub pa'i thabs mchog bstanaḥ sa ma yāḥshing skyorngo dur khrerdo lha mo zhes: e ka dza ṭi'i las mkhan ma brten na snying nye dkor rnams bsrungaḥ 'khor ba'i thabs la rten rdzas bsagasaḥ 'bral med 'grogs thabs bla rda sgrubaḥ mchod thabs dam rdzas bsags par byaḥ de dag 'bring po'i las ltar shesaḥ nal thod dam ni sa'i phor nangaḥ dmar gtor zur gsum phra la mnyenaḥ rang 'dra bzhi dang bshos nag bzhiḥ gtor chung brgyad dang theb kyu dngaX bā ling dag gis mdzes par dngaḥ phyi nang nyer spyod mchod pas bskoraḥ ra lug rta bong sha khrag brgyanaḥ skyems dang 'o chol bsang dud spro rol mo'i sgra sgrogs dbyangs snyan pos bye rang mdun me rlung dud sprin 'khrigs pa'i slongaḥ bstan srung ma mo gnod sbyin mdzes ldan maḥ gsang sngags bka' yi bstan pa 'dzin mdzad dpalaḥ sku

mdog dmar nag chags 'dzum bzod par dka'aḥ phyag g.yas spu gri g.yon pas tsit+ta bsnamasaḥ dar dkar lu'u rin chen rgyan gyis sprasaḥ zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur rnam 'phrul ya ma zungaḥ rat+na'i sgog zhu rdo rje'i dam rtags spudaḥ de yi phyi rim srid pa'i lcam sring brgyadaḥ shar du nyid las mi gzhan nges nus maḥ dmar mo dur khrod chas rdzogs khro 'dzum sgegaḥ dar nag go bgos lcags kyu me long bsnams: lho phyogs nor srung klu mo sku mdog seraḥ rat+na'i rgyan rdzogs sku smad sbrul du 'khyilaḥ phyag mtshan lcags kyu phur bus dgra bgegs sgrolaḥ nub phyogs rdzas srung gnod sbyin chen mo mthingaḥ gcer bu gar bsgyur mi lpags g.yang gzhis brgyanaḥ lcags kyu bum 'dzin sgrub la gdung sems cheḥ byang phyogs zas srung 'dre mo mthu rtsal canaḥ ljang nag gcer bu sbrul dang thod phreng brgyanaḥ ro lang zhon cing khram shing lcags phur gdengs kun kyang rngams 'jigs srin mo khros pa'i nyamasaḥ ral pa dmar ser mdud pa rdo rjes mdzesaḥ dkor nor zas dang rdzas la lhag par mosaḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i pho nyar bskyedaḥshar lto ming po mi ring che brjid

btsaX niḥ phyag gnyis sbrul zhags nad kyi skyal ba bsnamasaḥ nag po stag gi lpags pas mdzes par brgyanaḥ lho nub ming po bswe yi mdung dmar canaḥ dmar sgrug khrab rmog 'khor gsum rgyan cha rdzogasaḥ mgyogs byed me glog 'khyil ba'i glong na 'gyingaḥ nub byang ming po shan pa ra mgo nagaḥ dgra sta zhags pa thogs shing rngams pa'i skuḥgacer bu sbrul gyi thul bas rnam par mjesaḥ byang shar ming po bdud po zu ra skyesaḥ sngo nag kha ṭ+wāṃ phur ba gdengs thabs phyaraḥ rta nag la bcibs ber khrab mdzes par brgyanaḥkun kyang 'jigs byed rak+ka srin po'i tshulaḥ me glog na bun dud sprin 'khrigs sang bskyedaḥ de yi phyi rim dur khrod brgyad srung maḥ ro lang nag mo rdo rje drag rtsal dngaḥ ka li nag mo lag ring chen mo dngaḥ sha za nag mo byi to ta ma nagaḥ las byed nag mo nag po rab 'jigs maḥ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan rdzogs nu pad rgyasaḥ rat+na pad+ma sbrul chun mgo phreng sprasaḥ gar bsgyur lcags kyu nad skyal phyag na bsnamasaḥ rnam rol ma nges gtso mo'i cho 'phrul steḥ ye shes me dang dud sprin 'khrigs sang bskyedaḥ kun gyi thugs srog rdo rje'i sa

bon lasaḥ 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs bstimaḥ kyiḥ nyi ma byang shar mtshams kyi pha ki nasaḥ dur khrod chen po gsang chen rol ba'i klongaḥ dug mtsho khol zhing byang brag ldem pa nasaḥ lha mo mdzes ldan chen mo gshegs su gsolaḥ dkor rnams srung zhing gtsug lag khang gi bdagaḥ srid pa'i lcam sring brgyad po gshegs su gsolaḥ'abar ba dur khrod brgyad kyi pho brang nasaḥ mched bzhi'i sprul pa brgyad po gshegs su gsolaḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i phyiraḥ dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsolaḥ dam ldan rnal 'byor rig 'dzin sgrub pa po'iḥ lhang lhang 'bod do ma g.yel tser tser byonaḥ o dzñā na ḍāk+ki ni ra li pra ma ya dzaḥdza si li ma ni dzaX zhes brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bzlas tshe mngon sum 'du 'ong ngoX skabs su gtor ma 'bul ba laḥ gtor rdzas bshams phral 'gugs gzhug bsgrangasaḥrnam pa dgra bgegs sha khrag laX ngo bo bde stong bdud rtsi bsamaḥhūṃ hrīḥ 'jig rten srid pa gsum gyi mnga' bdag moḥ zhing dang gtsug lag khang gi gnyer srung baḥ zas nor longs spyod dkor la lhag par gdungaḥ rin chen gter gyi srung ma rdzu 'phrul canaḥ nor

btsa/ bdag dbang gi lha mo nges nus maḥ mchod sbyin gtor ma rin chen brdar ba'i skyemasaḥ dgra dgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag bdud rtsi 'disaḥmanyes pa bskang ngo sgrub la brtse bas dgongasaḥ bos so dkor gyi bdag mo snyan ma sraḥ g.yab po dkor bdag chen mo spyan ma rtulaḥdo nub snga ma'i gtang rag bdag gis 'bulaḥdo nub phyi ma'i zhu skyems bdag gis 'bulaḥ grogs mor 'bod do ma g.yel da tshur byonaḥ mdza' mor brten no ma thogs dam la 'dusaḥ dkor la rngams pa'i dgra bgegs don snying gisaḥ zhing skyong dur khrod lha mo'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ klu mo nor snyegs gnod sbyin chen mo bskangasaḥ 'dre 'bod nag mo dkor srung rgyal mo bskangasaḥ ming po las mdzad sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskangaḥ brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes laḥrnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ 'o chol dkar mngar bsres pa phug ron gyi dang rus 'thor zhingaX yin dzñā na ḍā/mini ra li pra ma ya pu tsa bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ lan bdun gyis gtor ma cha shas bstabasaḥde nas mched bzhi'i sprul pa brgyad brngan pa'i gtor ma 'bul ba niḥ bye dur ༷ da rngams brjid 10la ba'i

gnas brgyad nasaḥbaka' nyan nges nus mched brgyad dam la 'dusaḥdakor 'phrog dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dam rdzas kyisaḥlas byed mkha' 'a1 ma brgyad dgyes pa bskangasaḥsgrub la gdung zhing rnal 'byor pa la byamasaḥnor srang gang gi phyir 'brang dgra sgog gcodaḥrtsa phyag gang gi rjes gcod ltas ngan 'gyedaḥ khyod la bdag gi bstan gzhi zhing khang dkoraḥyongs su gnyer ro sems med 'byung ba bzhi'iḥ gnod pa srung na gzugs can dgra bo dngaḥ gzugs med bgegs kyi 'tshe ba smos ci dgosaḥ gnas rten bsrung la yon gyi bdag po kyisaḥsangs rgyas bstan srungs dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstodaḥrdo rje theg pa'i rang lugs dar rgyas mdzodaḥ khyad parazab gsang rdo dzasnying po'i chosaḥphyogs bcu kun tu dar zhing rgyas par mdzodaḥ bstan la smad cing 'khu ba'i dgra bdud bgegasaḥ bstan pa'i srung ma khyod kyi zas skal gtadaḥ lo zlar ma bzhag da lta nyid du sgrolaḥ mthu dang nus pa stobs rtsal ma zhan cigaḥ rdo dze+ephag lnga/ pad+ma 'byung gnas kyiḥ bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po dran gyis laḥ ma g.yel las 'di myur du grub par mdzodaḥ bdag cag

badz+ra 'khor bcas ma rig dbang gyur nasaḥ khyod kyi thugs dang 'gal ba'i las bgyis paḥ gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol bshags bzod par bgyiḥ nad yams dal kha rdul brlog mkhon 'khrug bsgyuraḥ bar chad gegs zhi tshe dpal lang tsho rgyasaḥ lha mi'i 'du ba rab rgyas rdzogs ldan gyiḥ lang tsho gsar bas sa gsum kun khyab nasaḥ bkra shis phun sum tshogs spyod phrin las mdzodaḥ ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs: phrin las rnam bzhi gegs med 'grubaḥ sa ma yāḥdamigs pas dgra bgegs la bskul naḥ sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma deḥdagra bo de nyid dngos su gsalaḥ 'gugs gzhug bden brdar grub nas slaraḥ drag bskul zab mo rngams pas sgogasaḥ mjug tu 'di nyid sbyar bar byaḥ je ma g.yel dam la dgongs shig nges nus maḥ ma bul phrin las sgrub mdzad lcam dral brgyadaḥ ma zhan dgra bgegs sgol cig re ti brgyadaḥ brngan pa'i sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ bdag la sdang zhing dam la 'khu ba yiḥ bar chad byed pa'i dam sri pho mo laḥ than dang ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogs stonaḥ tshe srog spar chod ming tsam med par mdzodaḥ thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yāḥ sa dzñā na 1lkoni ra li pra

ma ya dzaḥ dza si li ma na dzaḥ 'ur 'uraḥ rgyug rgyugaḥ preng prengaḥ shag shagaḥ tshal tshalaḥ thog thogaḥ yer yeraḥ chom chomaḥ zungs zungaḥ than gyi mig 'phrul cig ༷ snrakhriḥ.a mu ga'i tshe 11ga bye da la thegagaḥ brgya rtsa brjod la gtor ma dgra phyogs su mchodaX thal mo rdeb dmod pa bor ral pa bsigasaḥ gnad des dgra dpung pha lam yin kyang rdul du rlog par 'gyuraX rang nyid dam tshig dang ldan pa ni gal che'o bsad rtags sogs byung tshe bskang gsol brgya stong khri 'bum sogs bya ba dngaX 'khrugs bskang sogs gzabaX rtag tu mkhon 'dzing dang thab gzhob mdze yug ro grib la 'dzemaX rang 'dod phug bcug gi blo yis drag las mi bya ba gnad dam pa'o e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yisaḥ snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag zab bcud skor grub palidabang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thobaX mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya mdzodaX ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga spruladapa' po nus ldan rdo rje dngaX 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spelaḥ las canatshas bdag skyesamatshag rnam pa lngaḥ bka' bab rig 'dzin rnam pa brgyad dag laḥ bstan na zab gter chos kyi sgon me sbaraḥ gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min zhing la bkod byin rlabs rno nus yon tan khyad par 'phags gtan la phab pa'i dus tshig shing pho khyiḥ sgrub pa'i sgo 'dzug sa pho stag gi dus

btsa(: gnad smin grub na bde legs snang ba rgyas bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal dkon mod rgyal khams 'grims la ltos dang mthong skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgyaXlas can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shogaḥm g.yel rtag tu srungs shig jes nus maḥsama.āḥrgya rgya rgya:srung ma'i zab sgrub brin las lhun grub rdzogs soḥgater rgyaḥgatad rgyaḥsbas rgyaXzab rgya gsang rgya gu rgyaḥs rgyan gyi sgob dbon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka'aX bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o brda thimaX snyiX ces pa 'di'ang rdo rje'i lung zin dam pa sku skyes pad+ma nor bus thabs shes rdor dril dang dbang lnga'i cod pan bkra shis lha reg gser dngul rin po che'i rdzas sna tshogs dang bcas nas bskul ba dngaḥchos bdag rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dam pa pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshos sgrub pa'i me tog dang bcas nas yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mdo khams tsa ri'i gnas kyi mdun ngos bsil ldan bde ba'i dben khrod nas skyid pa'i nyams dang bkra shis pa'i snang ba du mas bskul nas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ rig 'dzin bla ma'i sgrub pa'i bstan srung sha za nges nus ma'i gsol mchod dgra bgegs rdul brlag zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥbatsa( na ces gu 〈co pad+ma ka ra yeḥ sgra'igiganya〈rgo da ma 'ongs dam ldan skyes bu yisaḥ zab gsang nyams su len pa laḥ bar chad sel zhing brin las rnamasaḥ gegs med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phyiraḥsrung ma bsgrub cing gsol mchod brtsonaḥ de yang dmar gtor bā ling spungasaḥ rin chen brdar bas ja chang skyemasaḥ bzang drug dkar gsum dmar gsum rnamasaḥ bsres pa'i 'o phud gtsang ma nyidaḥ phug ron dang ru gyis mchod cingaḥsngags dang phyag rgyasasbyangs spel bsgyuraḥ de nas rang nyid yi dam pa'iḥ nga rgyal ldan pas srung ma nyidaḥ mdun du gsal la mchod gsol niḥ hūṃ bh+yoḥ bsil ba'i tshal gyi gnas mchog dam pa dngaḥ bden bral mun pa can gyi dur khrod nasaḥ dkor gyi bdag mo rdo rje nges nus maḥ sgob dpon chen po pad+ma'i bka' dam bzhinaḥ sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsolaḥ bla rdo srog 'ashesar rten la brtan par bzhugasaḥ phrin las lhun gyis grub phyir gus phyag 'tshalaḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar mnga' gsol loḥ dgyes mchod nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod

yon lngaḥ sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol byang chub semasaḥ thod pa ltag sprod bshugs glu rol mo'i sgraḥ rin chen brdar ba'i ja chang skyems phud dngaḥ 'dod yon longs spyod ma tshang med pa'i gteraḥ mig 'phrul lta bu'i bkod pa bsam yas kyisaḥ bstan srung nges nus chen mo gsol zhing mchodaḥ dur khrod mkha' 'gro mched brgyad gsol zhing mchodaḥ las byed sha za spun gsum gsol zhing mchodaḥ rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i grogs mo gsol zhing mchodaḥ zab gsang bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gsol zhing mchodaḥ dam ldan skyes bu'i srung ma gsol zhing mchod: sdig byed shan pa'i gshed ma gsol zhing mchodaḥ dkor gyi bdag mo chen mo gsol zhing mchodaḥ khyed rnams gsol zhing mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyisaḥrnal 'byor bdag gi 'jigs tshogs zhi ba dngaḥ tshe bsod 'byor rgyas mos bzhi dbang du bsdusaḥ log par 'dren pa'i bdud bgegs dam sri sgrolaḥ tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i 11gas 31 mchosadaḥ bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs phrin las gang bcol gegs med 'grubaḥ phyi nang bar chad g.yul ngo gzhomaḥ bde skyid lang tsho spel bar

btsa(4 byedaX bdag 'dra pad+ma saṃ bha was gdams pa snying dang 'dra ba'i skoraX nusaldan rdo rje'i dpal du bzhagaḥ ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i 'tshubs slong du rgud gso skyes mchog de dang ni zab gsang 'di nyid 'phrad gyur cigaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya srung ma'i gsol mchod dgra bgegs rdul brlag rdzogs soX gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgyaḥ zab rgyaḥ gsang rgyaḥ gu h+yaX o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma so bha wa'i bka'aḥ bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'oḥ brda zimaḥsnyiḥ ces pa 'di'ang chos bdag pad+ma nor bu dang chos bdag pad+ma tshos 'phel rgya mtsho gnyis kyi bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje'i mkha' 'dza'i gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra tsu zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i bstan srungaḥ sha za nges nus chen ma'i 'khrugs bskang 'khu ldog tshar gcod bzhugs soḥbadz+ra na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ / derga tsu ) dus gsum rgyal bani brin las gcig bsdus dpa laḥ 'gro ba'i mgon po rgyan zad phreng rtsalaX rnam dbyer ma mchis rtsa gsum rgya mtsho la 'du 'bral mtshan ma bral bas phyag 'tshal loḥ ma 'ongs las ldan sgrub pa'i sgor zhugs cing: srung ma bsnyen sgrub las la brtson pa'i tsheḥ 'khu ldog byung na 'di nyid med thabs medaḥ sha khrag gtor ma ja chang phud bshams shingaḥ bsang gsur dud spro rol mo'i sgra sbir zhing snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad gyer bar byaḥ ma stso gsang sngags rdo rje snying po'i bstan srung mchogaḥ ma mo sha za nges nus gtso 'khor bcasaḥ ma thogs myur du spyan 'dren gshegs su gsolaḥ bla rdo srog gi 'khor lor dgyes par bzhugasaḥ zab gsang bstan pa bsrung phyir gus phyag 'tshalaḥ dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa dpag yas 'bulaḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa bskang zhing bshagasaḥ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag dmar mchod 'bulaḥ ma mo mkha' 'dza'i 'khrugs pa bskang zhing bshagasaḥ nga chang

'o phud mngar gsum mchod pa 'bulaḥ ma mo mkha' 'dza'i 'khrugs pa bskang zhing bshagasaḥ rin chen brdar bas bā ling mchod pa 'bulaḥ ma mo mkha' 'dza'i 'khrugs pa bskang zhing bshagasaḥ sman thod shing thog sna tshogs spungs ba yisaḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i 'khrugs pa bskang zhing bshagasaḥ sil snyan rnga dung sba gling mchod pa 'bulaḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i 'khrugs pa bskang zhing bshagasaḥ rba dkar tshigs gsum mda' dar dung shwa 'bulaḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i 'khrugs pa bskang zhing bshagasaḥ g.yu byang mig med ra pa ṇi 'bulaḥm mo mkha' 'gro'i 'khrugs pa bskang zhing bshagasaḥ mdos dang srog 'khor bla rdo dar tshon 'bulaḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i 'khrugs pa bskang zhing bshagasaḥ khyod nyid dga' na gdod ma'i rgyal sar sbyoraḥ khros na srid pa gsum gyi legs nyes stonaḥ sgrub pa po la lus dang grib bzhin 'grogasaḥ gsang sngags bstan pa rin chen srog ltar bsrungaḥ rnal 'byor rtsa phyag gang gi rjes gcod cingaḥ than dang ltas ngan dug gi kha phru 'gyedaḥ bre bor gang gi nas phyir dgra srog gcodaḥ dkor la lhag par mos pa'i dam tshig canaḥ 'dod

bsgotshu yon mchod pas dga' mgu yi rang nasaḥ bstan pa'i dgra sde thal bar brlag pa dngaḥ rnal 'byor dam la ma 'da' da tshur byonaḥ 'khu ldog khro 'khrugs ru nga phrag dog spangasaḥ zhi zhing byams pa'i sems dang ldan gyis laḥ rnal 'byor bcol ba'i don rnams grub par mdzodaḥ bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma āḥ ci nus brjod la gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegasaḥ gang bcol phrin las rab 'byams gegs med 'grub ma mo mkha' 'gro'i 'khu ldog 'khrugs pa byangaḥ lus dang grib bzhin dbyer med 'grogs par 'gyuraḥ skal med lag tu gdams bcud ma zegs cigaḥlas can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ mkha' 'gro'i 'khrugs bskang 'khru ldog tshar gcod rdzogs soX gter rgya gtad rgyaḥ sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgyaḥ gu rgyaX yo rgyan gyi sgob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka'aḥbadag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'oḥ brda thim snyiḥ ces pa 'di'ang chos bdag pad+ma nor bu dang dharma ku mud kyi bzhed ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bzhus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam̐/

ba:tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru la brten pa'i: bshags pa dag gsal shel gyi me long zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥgs/: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ sgimiṭ+wāto rab 'byamasargyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa'iḥ ye shes dbyings sku skal ldan 'gro ba'i mgonaḥ dad ldan gdul bya'i lo tog smin mdzad pa'iḥ mtsho skyes rdo rje'i gsang gsum dbyings la 'dud bdag 'dra snyed rgyan rdo rje gshog rgod ngasaḥ ma 'ongs las can gsang sngags sgor zhugs nasaḥ dam tshig nyams chags sbyang ba'i thabs mchog tuX bshags pa dag gsal shel gyi me long bstan de yang gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba yisaḥ mdun mkhar skyabs yul gsal gdab spyan snga ruḥ gus pas phyag 'tshal snyan pa'i bshags tshig brjodaḥ nyon mongs blo bral yid kyang gnong 'gyod ngang yis ma ste rang mdun nam mkhar 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i 1ngaḥ skyabs kun yongs 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma niḥ gu ru rin po che yi rnam par gsalaḥ sku la rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams dngaḥ lo paṇa rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i spro bsdus niḥ mtsho la gza' skar bkra ba ji bzhin gsalaḥ hoX dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus 'dus pa'i gteraḥ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la phyag 'tshalaḥ brgyud pa dgu

ldan gcig rdzogs 'gro ba'i mgonaḥ gu ru rin po tshel gus phyag 'tshalaḥ nyon mongs gti mug 'khrul ba gnas dag phyiraḥ bud+dhā thod phreng rtsal la gus phyag 'tshalaḥ nyon mongs zhe sdang rtog pa gnas dag phyiraḥ rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la gus phyag 'tshalaḥ nyon mongs nga rgyal rtog pa gnas dag phyiraḥ rat+na thod phreng rtsal la gus phyag 'tshalaḥ nyon mongs 'dod chags rba rlabs gnas dag phyiraḥ pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la gus phyag 'tshalaḥ nyon mongs phrag dog 'gyu ba gnas dag phyiraḥ karma thod phreng rtsal la gus phyag 'tshalaḥ tsha grang sdang ba'i 'khrul 'khor gnas dag phyiraḥ gu ༄ rnam par gnon la gus phyag 'tshalaḥ bkres skom 'jur bcing gnas su dag pa'i phyiraḥ gu ru bde chen stsol la gus phyag 'tshal: blun rmongs 'thibs myos gnas su dag pa'i phyiraḥ gu ru ye shes snying por gus phyag 'tshalaḥ 'thab rtsod kheng sems gnas su dag pa'i phyiraḥ gu ru mnyam pa nyid la gus phyag 'tshalaḥsdug sngal chu gnyer gnas su dag pa'i phyiraḥ gu ru pad+malisku la gus phyag 'tshalaḥ kheng sems le lo gnas su dag pa'i phyiraḥ gu ru gser thub 'dzin la gus phyag 'tshalaḥ

gtsasdo: tshogs brgyad rtog pa gnas su dag pa'i phyiraḥ gu ru mtshan mchog brgyad la gus phyag 'tshalaḥ kun rtog brgyad cu gnas su dag pa'i phyir: grub brnyes brgyad cu'i sku la gus phyag 'tshalaḥ yul brgyad rtog pa gnas su dag pa'i phyiraḥ sprul pa'i rig 'jin brgyad la gus phyag 'tshalaḥ dug gsum 'khrul 'khor gnas su dag pa'i phyiraḥ rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga la gus phyag 'tshalaḥ 'khrul snang ma lus gzhi ru gnas dag phyiraḥ zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis la gus phyag 'tshalaḥ 'khrul rtog lnga bcu gnas su dag pa'i phyiraḥ khrag 'thung khro bo'i tshogs la gus phyag 'tshalaḥ rten 'brel 'byung ldog dbyings su dag pa'i phyiraḥ gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gus phyag 'tshalaḥ bar chad bdud sde dbyings su dag pa'i phyiraḥ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gus phyag 'tshalaḥ hoḥ bde gshegs yongs rdzogs mkhyen brtse nus pas dgongasaḥ bdag ni ma rig zhabrul ba'i dbang gyur teḥ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig niḥ nyi shu rtsa bdun dam sdom nyams pa bshagasaḥ spyad par bya ba'i dam tshig rnam pa lngaḥ sbyor sgrol dang du ma blang mthol lo bshagasaḥ

shes par bya ba'i dam tshig rnam pa lngaḥ rigs lnga yab yum dang du ma blangs bshagasaḥ sgrub par bya ba'i dam tshig rnam pa lngaḥ rigs dang dkyil 'khor ma rtog mthol lo bshagasaḥmi spang ba yi dam tshig rnam pa lngaḥ nyon mongs rang khar spyod pa mthol lo bshagasaḥ dang du len bya'i dam tshig rnam pa lngaḥ dam rdzas gtsang sme bltas pa mthol lo bshagasaḥ phyi gsang bzhi dang bar gsang rnam pa bzhiḥ gsang 'os gnyer gtad ral ba mthol lo bshagasaḥ rgyud grol dbang bskur de nyid ston pa yiḥ bla mar mos gus chung ba mthol lo bshagasaX bla ma lha dang dkyil 'khor gcig pa yiḥ grogs la brtse gdung chung ba mthol lo bshagasaḥ rtsa ba'i sngags dang rkyen sngags las sngags sogasaḥ dang du ma blang ral ba mthol lo bshagasaḥ dam tshig las dang chos dang phyag rgya cheḥ rnam dag chen pos ma spyod mthol lo bshags: rmad byung gnyug ma bde gshegs klong mdzod nyidaḥ ma rtogs 'khrul bar 'phyan pa mthol lo bshagasaḥ 'khor bcas chos rnams stong pa'i rang bzhin laḥ dngos zhen bden 'dzin 'thas pa mthol lo bshags bsnyen cing sgrub la dkyil 'khor

bsnye gsum ldan ngangaḥ ma rtog ting 'dzin g.yel ba mthol lo bshagasaḥ nya stong tshes bcu dus chen drug po laḥ tshogs dang gtor ma rgyun chag mthol lo bshagasaḥle lo bsog 'jog ser sna'i rgyu rkyen gyisaḥ sgrub g.yel mchod gtor chung ba mthol lo bshagasaḥ dngas ma'i lha dgyes snyigs mas mkha' 'gro brnganaḥ ma ldan phud lhag nyams pa mthol lo bshagasaḥ dag mnyams zhen bral gtsang mas mchod dgos kyangaḥ spyang gi kha tshar shor ba mthol lo bshags: snod bcud dag mnyam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor laḥ ma dag log par bzung ba mthol lo bshagasaḥ chos nyid rnam dag skyon dang bral ba laḥ bzang ngan re dogs bltas pa mthol lo bshags: lhun grub rang gsal bde ba chen po'i dbyingasaḥ mngon du ma gyur 'khrul ba mthol lo bshagasaḥ dam tshig med gcig phyal ba lhun grub rnamasaḥ bka' ltar ma sgrub ral ba mthol lo bshagasaḥ gzhan yang tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nasaḥ mi shes ma rig 'khrul ba'i las dbang gisaḥ sor byang sngags kyi sdom pa dam tshig lasaḥ 'gal 'das nor 'khrul zhig ral chag nyams kunaḥ mi

gsang mi zed gnong 'gyod drag po yisaḥ rig 'dzin bla ma'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshagasaḥ mtha' med 'khor ba'i las bsags dag tshang 'byangaḥ phyin chad sgog la bab kyang mi dge sdomaḥ rje btsun byas rgyan thugs rjes bdag bzung nas: sgrib bral kun tu 'od kyi sa thob re gaḥ shes badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yi ge brgya ba dag par bzla rdos bzhi'i bskang ba skabs 'dir bya bar rigs de nas yan lag bzhi pa'i rim pa ni0 hoḥ nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa' sogasaḥ so so'i skye bo ma lus thams cad kyisaḥ rnam dkar dge ba'i las rnams sgrub pa laḥ snying nas dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngoḥ srid gsum 'khor ba dbyings su ma stong paraḥ rang snang ston pa bsam mi khyab pa yisaḥ gang la gang 'dul zab pa'i sgo phyes nasaḥ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad du gsolaḥ zhing khams 'di 'am gzhan na bzhugs pa yiḥ rig 'dzin bla ma skyes bu dam pa rnams: mya ngan mi 'da' yun du rab bzhugs nasaḥ gang la gang 'dul mdzad pa mthar phyin re gaḥ 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsag pa'i dge ba rnamasaḥ gcig tu bsdus te ma gyur 'gro la bsngoḥ phyam gcig gdod

ba tshu ma'i ye gzhi chen po'i klongaḥ kun tu bzang po'i rgyal sa zin par shogaḥ bdag dang bdag la 'brel thog sems can kunaḥ rang rig ye shes dgongs pa mngon gyur nasaḥ gzhon nu bum sku'i gtan srid zin pa dngaḥ gang 'dul sprul bas 'gro khams dong sprugs re gaḥ de ltar mos gus tshad med pasaḥ bla ma bsgom pa'i spyan snga rtsa rnam dag bshags pa byed pa'i miḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyuraḥ 'di dang phyi ma'i nyes sgrib byang ༷ che bsod nyams rtogs yon tan rgyasaḥ the tshom med do sa ma yā e maḥ rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma sa bha wa'iḥ ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yisaḥ snying gi yang tig rdo rje snying po'i chosaḥ tshe gcig rdzogs sang sa rgyas pa'i man ngag mchog2 grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung lo tsā dngaḥ ye shes mtsho rgyal rma ban rin chen mchogaḥ 'bru ban dharma be+e ro g.yu sgra snyingaḥ gnyag pa dzñā na gnubs ban brte dngaḥ ye shes dbyings rnams smon lam mthu btsan pasaḥ skal ldan khyed cag dag la gtad par bgyiḥ da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thobaḥ mdo khams rtse sgo da gsham du dgongs rgya mdzod ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjesaḥ zab gsang rin chen gdams pa 'di 'phrad 'gyuraḥ mi lo bcu la gsang ba'i rgyas 'debs cingaḥ de nas nad mtshon rgud pa 'khrug pa'i tsheḥ chos bdag rma ban ku mud ma ḍi laX spel na rang gzhan
don gnyis lhun gyis grubaḥ las smon mthu btsan dharma ku mud laX bstan na 'gro ba'i don chen 'byung bar 'gyuraḥ dam ldan sngags 'changabe ro pad+ma'iming

da:: zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i dkyil 'khor duḥ rdzas bzhi'i bskang ba 'bul ba'i rim pa byin rlabs gnad bsdu zab mo bzhugs soḥgatsa/: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ rdo( 14114 nga ma 'ongs dad dam ldan pa yisaḥ ma hā gu ru'i dkyil 'bar du ga ṇa tsakra 'bul ba laḥ las mdzad rdo rje pho nya yiḥ rdzas bzhi btegs la 'dud rgya yis ༷da la'i drung du bstabs par byaḥ de nas rnal 'byar dam pa yisaX snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad doḥ oṃ ār+yāḥ gsang chen gnyis ldan mchog gi dkyil 'khor duḥ rigs kun yongs 'dusagu ru rin po che'iḥ sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bskang ba'i phyiraḥ dbyings rig 'gyur ba med pa'i rkong bu 6 lhun grub ye shes sgon me bltams te 'bulaḥ dum gcig ka pā la ru bskyil ba yiḥ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bulaḥ chags bral ghirti dmar po'i gsang ba'i bcudaḥ rten 'brel rnam dag rak+ta'i dgyes mchod 'bulaḥ gtor gzhong rat+na

'bar ba'i gzhong pa dzas ro ldan 'dod yon bā ling mchod pa 'bulaḥ thabs shes dbyer med dza gad bsgreng ba yangaḥ bde skyong dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul lags naḥ a la la ste 11 mtshar chen 17sa bzhesaḥ ces brjod dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bskangasaḥ gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dgaḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sel nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyasaḥ bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal basmu med rgyal ba'i gtan tshig yinaḥ bdag gi thugs bcud zab pa'i skor mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs tho le baX sgog las phang yang phyi rabs kyi0 las ldan bu la phan 'dogs phyiraX rin chen brdar bkod gter rgyas gtams snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dusaḥ nga sprul nus ldan rdo rje dngaḥ 'phrad nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde spelaḥ rtags dang rten 'brel yongs su dgeḥ skal med lag tu ma shor cigaḥ thub par srung shig nges nus ma0 sa ma yā rgya rgya rgyaḥ rdzas bskang byin rlabs gnad bsdus zab mo rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgyaX zab rgyaḥ gsang rgya gu khyaX.o rgyan gyislob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o brda thimaXsnyiX ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtsho dang ༷ chos bdag pad+ma nor bu'i yang yang bzhed ngor bdag 'dra nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

btsa' zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru yiḥ tshogs mchod bsdus pa bsod nams 'byung gnas bzhugs soḥbasgo/ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ skaspyoskojus ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yisaḥ ma hā gu ru'i dkyil 'khor duḥ bsags sbyang spel ba'i thabs mchog tu ga ṇa tsakra 'bul thabs bstanaX sa ma yuX de yang bza' bca' btung ba'i rigasaḥ ci 'byor kā pa la ru bsagasaḥ bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas su nam mkha' mdzod du dmigs byas teḥ rol mo sna tshogs sgra sbir laX snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad doḥ ces āḥhūṃḥmatshan ldan bhan+ta yangs pa'i snod kyi nangaḥ tshogs rdzas 'dod yon ye shes rol ba'i rgyanaḥ sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rnam par 'khyil ba niḥ mchod pa'i lha mo'i gar bsgyur dang bcas nasaḥrigs 'dus ma hā gu ru dgyes pa'i phyiraḥ gtso 'khor sprul bar bcas la gus pas 'bulaḥ rtsa gsum rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang: sdom dang dam tshig nyams pa bshags par bgyiḥ bstan pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba dngaḥ sha khrag bdud rtsi'i rol ba bzhes su gsolaḥ las mdzad pho nyas lhag gtor mchod pa bzhesaḥ rnal 'byor

bdag cag phrin las lhun shā1ba cingaḥ 31gas rje gas sgrib dag sangs rgyas sa lnga ba thegagaḥ ces pa dmigs 'dun dag pa yis brgya stong khri 'bum ci 'grub bskyar gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyuraḥ sa ma yuX yinam rgyal bsladabang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ༷ ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis snying phyung lag mazil bkram pa'i gdams zab mchog grub palidabang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thobaḥ mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya mdzodaX ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dusaḥ nga sprul dpa' mnus ldan rdo rjes dngaḥ 'phrad nas las can chos bdag rnams la spelaḥ bstan pa'i rgud pa gso pa'i rten 'brel cheḥ skal med lag tu ma shoranges nus maX dam ldan snying gi bu dang 'phrad par re gaḥ sa ma yāX rgya rgya rgyaḥ tshogs mchod bsdus pa bsod nams 'byung gnas rdzogs soḥ gter rgyaḥ gtad rgyaḥ sbas rgya: zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya0 o rgyan )slob dpon pad+ma so bha wa'i bka'aḥ bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'oḥ brda thimaXsnyiḥ ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtsho dngapad+ma nor bu gnyis kyi bzhed ngor bdag 'dra dus mtha'i gter ming tsam 'dzin panus ldan rdo rjes dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam̐/

btsa/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru la brten pa'i bskang ba pad+ma rgyas pa'i chun 'phyang zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥgs/ na 3 gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ sgosgaridzā/:| dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyiḥ ye shes rdo rje gsang gsum rdzogs pa'i gteraḥ 'gro ba yongs kyiskyobs mchog pad+ma 'byungaX mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchodaḥ bdag 'dra rgyal dbang pad+ma saṃ bha wasaḥ ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yisaḥ zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i chos sde lasaḥ shin tu zab pa bla ma'i thugs sgrub bstanaḥ sa ma yāḥ de yi cha lag bskang ba bsdus pa ni phyi nang gsang ba'i yo byad kun bsags teḥ bsags sbyangs spel gsum byin rlabs rgya chen byaḥ snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad gyer bar byaḥ ( hrīḥ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa'i 27 brang nasaḥrgyal ba dgongs rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ ma 'dres rang gsal 'gag med sa le baḥ rig 'dze+en brda rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangaḥ bka' lung lhag chad med par ston mdzad pa'iḥ gang zag snyan rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangaḥ gter rigs bco brgyad zab mo'i sgo 'phar 'byedaḥ re/ga ser tshig brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskangaḥ ka

dag skyemed spros bral pho brang nasaḥ gdod ma'i mgon po yab yum thugs dam bskangaḥ ma chags pad+ma 'bar ba'i pho brang nasaḥ 'chi med snang mtha' yab yum thugs dam bskangaḥrnga yab zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo nasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i thugs dam bskangaḥ rak+ka srin po chos la 'god mdzad pa'iḥ budha dbu 'bum rtsal gyi thugs dam bskangaḥ ye shes rnam lngas 'gro ba 'dul mdzad pa'iḥ gu ru thod phreng sde lnga'i thugs dam bskangaḥ sgrub sde dgu yi 1nga chen sgo 'byed pa'iḥ mchog sprul rig 'dzin brgyad kyi thugs dam bskangaX ma rig 'gro drug 'khor ba kha lo bsgyuraḥ rnam 'dren gu ru drug gi thugs dam bskangasaḥdur khrod brgyad gshadags brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzadaḥ sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad thugs dam bskangasaḥ gdul bya ma lus thabs mang lam gyis 'dulaḥ rnam rol grub chen brgyad cu'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ dad ldan gdul bya'i lo tog smin mdzad pa'iḥ rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ zab gsang chos kyimadzod chen 'chang ba yi: grub mchog khye'u chung lo tsā'i thugs dam bskangaḥ gter rigs bco brgyad zab mo'i sgo

ga ṇa tsakra sman gtor rakaḥ sbyor sgrol byang chub sems dang dza gad skyemasaḥ rdo rje'i phyag rgya glu gar dbyangs dang bcasaḥ pi wang gling bu cha lang rol mo'i sgraḥ mchog chen mchog phran mtshan ldan za le 'briḥ shel sgong lug dang tsa ra mkha' lding 'phuraḥ dar gdugs ba dan 'phan dang rgyal mtshan dngaḥ bla bre lda ldi drwa ba drwa phyed sogasaḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin mtha' yas pasaḥ khyad par rmad byung yo byad ting 'dzin dgaḥ nam mkha'i khams gang kun bzang sprin dpung gisaḥ rig 'jin bla malilha tshogs thugs dam bskangasaḥdangos po chos nyid yangs pa'i klong du bskangasaḥ snang ba ye shes chen po'i slong du bskangasaḥ gsal ba shes rab 'bar ba'i klong du bskangasaḥ sdug bsngal ka dag chos nyid ngang du bskangasaḥ kun rdzob don dam dbyer med klong du bskangasaḥ bskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzin dag pas bskangasaḥ 'khor gsum yongs dag chos dbyings lhug paratsos de ltar phul bas tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib dag sku gnyis mngon du 'gyuraḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad selaḥ nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel rgyas 'gyuraḥ the tshom med do sa ma yāḥ.a maḥ rgyal bamidabang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse

bsgo( ba chen po yisaḥ shin tu zab pa rde/ rje snying po yi: rmad byung rig 'dzin bla ma'i chos bcud skoraḥ snying las phang yang khye'u chung khyod la gtadaḥ da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thob mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya mdzodaḥ ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dusaḥ nga sprul dpa' bonas ldan rdo jes dngaḥ 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spelaḥ skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgyaḥ las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad gyur cig0 zab gsang thub par srungs shiganges nus maX sa ma yuX rgya rgya rgyaḥbaskang ba pad+ma rgyas pa'i chun 'phyang rdzogs soḥ gter rgyaḥ gtad rgyaḥ sbas rgyaḥ zab rgyaḥ gsang rgyaḥ gu h+yaḥ.e rgyan gye sla1 dmed pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka'aḥ bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'oḥ brda thimaḥsnyiḥ ces pa 'di'ang chos bdagapad+ma nor bus bskul ngor bdag 'drasas ldan rdo rjese mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam̐/(ཿ tshogs bsdus niḥ hrīḥ dri med ye shes gzigs pa'i mtsho skyes rje: sgyu 'phrul rol pa bde stong tshogs kyis bskangasaḥ rlung sems dbu mar tshud te rtogs pa rgyasaḥ rig stong pad+ma rgyal po'i sa thob de gaḥ bsod nams rgya mtsho rdzogs phyir sur+yas bris/ sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rjesnyeng po lasaḥ rigs 'dus ma nyagu ru laḥ brten pa'i gter srung bskang ba phrin las lhun grub zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥgs/ na mo gu dzag pad+ma kā ra yeḥ sgogisgocoshā8/ rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas kyiḥ brin las gcig rdzogs pad+ma 'byung dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i spro bsdu bcasaḥ mi 'bral dngas mi'i ze'u 'brur mchodaḥ ma 'ongs las skal ldan pa rnamasaḥ gsang ba'i sgo 'dir zhugs pa'i tsheḥ tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyiraḥ ga ṇa tsakra'i thabs la brtsonaḥ sa ma yāḥ de yi cha lag zab mo niḥ 'bul bskang bshags bsgral bstabs pa'i rjesaḥsnyan pa'i dbyangs dang rol mo'i sgrasaḥ bskang ba 'di nyid gyer bar byaḥ trī bh+yoḥ 'og min gnas dang mkha' spyod gsang ba'i yulaḥ dur khrod brgyad dang he ru ka yi gnasaḥ dbyings dang sa spyod dag la dbang bsgyur ba'iḥ rgyud mgon legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag po dngaḥ phyag bzhi phyag drugaber nag ma ning nagaḥ gur zhal seng gdong yab yum trak+kad sogasaḥ pho rgyud mgon po'i sde tshogs thams cad dngaḥ 'bum phrag rgyud kyi bdag mo e ka tsaḥ dpal ldan lha modamag zor rgyal mo dngaḥ tshe ring mched lnga rdo rje g.yu yi sgronaḥ dur khrod lha mo sha za kha mo
