btsa( ltag sprod rnga sgras thugs dam bskangaḥ mi rkang sba dkar gling bus thugs dam bskangaḥ brda dang bshug pa gar gyis thugs dam bskangaḥ 'dod yon rgyan gyi mchod pas thugs dam bskangaḥ bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs kyis thugs dam bskangaḥ dza chang rak+ta phud kyis thugs dam bskangaḥ dkar dmar sman gyi mchod pas thugs dam bskangaḥ dar zab reg bya'i tshogs kyis thugs dam bskangaḥ rnal 'byor lta spyod dag pas thugs dam bskangaḥ thugs dam bskang la dgyes pa chen po yisaḥ sgrub pa po yi mthun rkyen legs tshogs spelaḥ 'gal rkyen dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlogaḥ rnal 'byer bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ ces brjod gter skyems gtsang sar gshegs: phrin las gegs med yid bzhin 'grub0 phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad selaḥ tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag dngos grub thob the tshom med do sa ma yāX e maḥ rgyal dbang o rgyan pad+ma saṃ bha wa'iḥ ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yiḥ snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag zab ba'i bcud rmad byung rdo rje snying po'i chos sde rnams grub pas dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtadaḥ da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thobaX mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya mdzod

ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes dang 'phrad nas snyigs ma'i rgud pa gso byed cingaḥ las can 'bum phrag tsit+ta dpal rir 'godaX skyes mchog gsum gyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel las ldan rnam lnga 'dud cing zhabs tog sgrubasaX phan bde'i nyi ma gsar du 'khrungs par 'gyuraX the tshom med do rdo rje rgyal po'i bka'aḥ bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsalaX dkon mod rgyal khams 'grims la ltos dang mthongaḥ dam nyams lag tu gdams ngag ma zeg cigaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ gnam phud gter srung bskang ba phrin las lhun grub rdzogs soḥ

bsgo/ mchod bsdus(1ཿ gotsu/ kho a mṛ ta yi pho brang laḥ las kyi rdo rje'i 'dud rgya yis ༷ phyi nang mchod pa btegs byas teḥrdo rje glu yis 'bul ba niḥhrīḥ kun khyab reg pa ye shes sgyu 'phrul rtsalaḥ tshogs yul gnas dag rdo rje lha mo yisaḥ gzung 'dzin spros bral 'od gsal mchod pa'i sprinaḥ dbyings las bton te ye shes dbyings su 'bulaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i a mṛ taḥ rigs lnga yab yum gsang bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ.a pa nepo pe nu su ra toḥ ti pu pa ra muḥ sarba ta tha ga ta sid+dhi huḥ sa ma ye ta muḥ sarba ma ha su kha sid+dhi 〉ཿbla bṛ badz+ra ra ga dh+wa pe bhuḥ.a bṛ badz+ra ra ga pur+sha puḥyi/ bṛ badz+ra ra ga a lo ke hrīḥyi/ bṛ badz+ra rā ga ghan+dhe ghanaḥ.a bṛ badz+ra rā ga ru pa oṃḥ.a bṛ badz+ra rā ga shabha 〉ཿa bṛbadz+ra rā ga ra sa (ཿ tso bṛ badz+ra ra ga spasne hrīḥ.a bṛ badz+ra ra ga la phya hūm̐.a bṛ badz+ra rā ga ma l+ya (ཿa sh-i badz+ra ra ga girti hrīḥm bṛ badz+ra rā ga nirti āḥ sa shrī badz+ra ra ga pañtsa a dṛ ta hoḥ tho shrī badz+ra ra ga ma hā rak+ta heḥ tho bṛ badz+ra ra ga ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta nyaḥ tho shrī badz+ra rā ga ma tram̐ ru tra pra bhan tsakra pra we sha ya phaṭa kha ram̐ khā hiḥ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'iḥ mchod pa bla na med pa yi

dngos kun bla ma'i dal du mchodaḥ skyes dang skyes lan ting 'dzin gzer ༷ gnad brten dngos grub bde blag snyedaḥ sa ma yāX rdo rje'i glu bstod 'bul ba niḥ hūṃ trīḥ 'a17 ba'i mun sel nyi ma 'od po cheḥ khams gsum dbang sdud rgyal po zil gnon ldanaḥ lta dman dpa' skongs theg mchog snying po'i mdzodaḥ bla ma rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ mngal gyis ma gos pad+ma'i sbub las byonaḥrus rigs las 'das rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skuḥ skye 'chi mi mnga' tshe dbang rig 'dzin mchogaḥ kun 'dus thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ sku ni mi 'gyur 'od gsal zang thal skuḥ gsung ni mi 'gags rang byung ye shes gsungaḥ thugs ni mi g.yo smra bsam brjod bral klongaḥ rigs 'dus pad+ma rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ che ba'i yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyamaḥ mdzad pa'i phrin las rgyun chad mi mnga' baḥ mi mjed phrag brgya'i skyabs gcig rdo rje 'changaḥ gu ru gangs can mtsho la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ bla ma'i gsang gsum ye shes sgyu 'phrul lasaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i gzi byin phebaḥ myong grol sngags kyi lta dgongs zab mo yisaḥ grangs tshom dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i sprin

btsa( la bstodaḥ rol mo sna tshogs sgra yis bstodaḥ hrīḥpad+ma ta krid ta ha he (ཿ pañtsa a dṛ ta badz+ra e gu sha dzaḥ bdun nam nyer gcig brjod bar byaḥ gu ru ṛn po che'i lha tshogs thams cad rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu ba lasaḥ rigs lnga yab yum kyi rang bzhin dngos kun bdud rtsir 'khyil te dkar dmar mthing ga'i mdangs dang ldan par bsamaḥpad+ma dzñā na mu tra bho dhi tsit+ta sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya tswaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas rdo rje thal mo sbyar la smon lam ni 0trīḥ dpa' bo dpa' mo rdo rje rnal 'byor rnamasaḥ yang gsang dkyil 'khor gsang ba gsum gyi klongaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir sgrub pa'i mched dang lcamaḥ rigs 'dzin bla ma pad+ma'i zhabs drung duḥ mi 'bral tshom bur 'tshogs pa'i rten 'brel yodaḥ skye dang srid pa'i bag chags 'dam rdzab skemasaḥ las dang nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i rgyun dag nasaḥ rdo rje'i lta dgongs rlabs la kun dril nasaḥ 31 rgyan mkha' spyod gsang lam mngon gyur teḥtheg mchog snying po'i bshad sgrub mthar phyin nasaḥ sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i rten 'brel yodaḥ hrīḥ tshe rabs kun tu o rgyan rgyal tshab dngaḥ 'bral med dga' ston theg

mchog la spyod nasaḥ sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nasaḥ lo paṇa rig 'dzin gral dbus byang chub regagaḥ mtha' rten dge bsngo smon lam gdab ༷ des ni nyams rtogs 'phel rgyas 'gyuraḥ sa ma yā ༷ rgya rgya rgyaḥ gu h+ya brda thim snyi chos nyid klong rdolanusaldan pas dag par phab pa mang ga lam̐/ dge'o/ bkra shis dpal 'phel sa gsum yongs 'geng shog /

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ rig 'dzin bla ma sgrub pa'i cha lagaḥ bum pa sgrub pa'i cho ga byin rlabs bcud chen bzhugs soḥgs/ ma no gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ jakarnani(11 ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo rnamasaḥ yang gsang lam la zhugs 'dod tsheḥ dang po smin byed dbang 'dod galaḥ de yi cha lag bum pa gnyisaḥ sgrub chog byin rlabs bcud chen bstanaḥ sa ma yāḥ de yang dri bzang chu yis byugaḥ gu gul ngad can dud pas bdugaḥ yungs dkar rdo rje'i thun gyis brabaḥ bkra shis khye'u bcu drug mas blang ba'i rgyun 'babs chu yis dgangasaḥ bzang drug bdud rtsi chos sman btab ku sha'i chun po'i khri la 'khodaḥ kha rgyan gzungs thag mgul chings dmar rnam lnga nyer spyod pu tsa bkramaḥ las kyi bum pa g.yon phyogs dgodaḥ bhan+ta dza gad g.yas ngos bshamasaḥ sgrub gtor la sogs nyer mkho 'a chasaX gzhung las byung ltar legs par bkodaḥ khyad par ga ṇa tsakra niḥ med du mi rung rgya chen bsagasaḥ de nas bdag bskyed las gzhung bsrangaḥ mdun bskyed bum pa bskyed bzlas niḥ yis sā bha wa rbedugs 8)bye3nyaḥbum pa mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las: lhun grub ye shes gzhal yas chen po niḥ sgo gru rta babs bang rim 'byud 'khor mdzes de dbus dzaḥlas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'khyilaḥ

rang byung pad+ma'i sdong po mdzes 'dzum rgyasaḥ ze'u 'bru dmar ser nya gang zla ba'i stengaḥtrīḥyig 'phros 'dus yongs gyurapad+ma 'byungaḥ dkar dmar mdangs ldan bcu drug lang tshos 'khyudaḥ gsang gos mthing shams chos gos sham thabs mdzesaḥ phyag g.yas bcu drug ltag sprod ṭā ru bsnamasaḥ g.yon pas bhan+ta bdud rtsi lte bar brten gru mo g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum 'changaḥ pad+ma'i 'od zhwa dar sna sgro yis brgyanaḥ rgyal po rol stabs rngams brjid gzi 'od 'baraḥ ye shes 'od lnga'i 'ja' gur 'khrigs 1nga bzhugs spyo bor sprul pa'i rig 'dzin chen po brgyadaḥ mgrin par brgyud pa drug ldan gu ru rdzogasaḥ thugs gar dpal chen gu ru mtshan mchog brgyadaḥ ste bar rje 'bangs lo paṇa nyi shu lngaḥ gsang bar grub chen brgyad cu gsal bar rdzogasaḥ ma 'dres 'od sku 'ja' yi rang bzhin canaḥ rgyan dang cha lugs phyag mtshan ma nges par ཿ he ru ka pa brtul zhugs rol pa'i tshulaḥ snang stong ye shes sgyu ma'i phung por gsalaḥ king dang lang ka dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogasaḥ bshug glu brda skad gar bsgyur khrigs se khrigaḥ sna tshogs mchod sprin dar gdugs ba dan

bas/ 'phuraḥ ngo mtshar bkod pa yid 'ong lhun gyis grubaḥ kun gyi gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus paḥ kha ba bu yug 'chubs bzhin spyan drangs gyuraḥ de nas spyan 'dren bya ba niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ bde chen rngams brjed rnga yab dpal gyi ri ༷ pho brang pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nasaḥ rje btsunabla rgyan yab yum ston 'khor bcasaḥ gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen dbab du gsolaḥ 37 badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ de nas bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal niX hrīḥ ye shes lha tshogs dbyings nas spyan drangs baḥ dam tshig rten gyi lha la brtan par bzhugasaḥ sgo gsum mos gus gdung shugs drag po yisaḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal loḥ skyed dzñā na sa ma ya stoḥ na mo na ma hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba niḥhrīḥ dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam 'phrul mchod pa'i sprinaḥ dpag yas nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam pa niḥ rdo rje lha mo'i gar bsgyur dang bcas nasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i lha la 'bulaḥ sa ma hā pañtsa phuts+tsha khā hiḥ de nas bstod pa bya ba ni0 hūm̐ hrīḥ ma chags pad+ma'i sdong po'i rtser 'khrungs shingaḥ ya mtshan rmad byung 'gro 'dul mtshan brgyad

gragasaḥ rgya bal bod yul gdul bya smin grol mdzadaḥ bka' drin mnyam med rje la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ de nas 'dzab bskul bya ba niḥ rang srog sngags kyi 'od zer mchod pa'i tshul du 'phrosaḥ bum pa'i lha tshogs rnams la phog ste thugs rgyud bskul thugs rje byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thams cad bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du bab nas bum pa gang bar dmigs la: bzlas pa bya mthar mchod cing bstod la badz+ra sum̐ḥgyis ye shes pa'i lha tshogs rnams 'od du zhu 31 āḥ( gis dam tshig gi bdud rtsi'i rnam par gyur te mer gyis gang bar dmigasaḥ ces pas bzhu btul bya'oḥ gnyis pa las bum sgrub pa niḥ 31 swā bha wa sogs 8)bye3nyaḥ las kyi bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyuraḥ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus suḥ pad zla'i gdan la nyuX yongs su gyur pa las khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin dmar gsal g.yas thod dbyug dang g.yon bhan+ta bdud rtsi brten paḥ khro gtum bzod par dka' ba dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs paḥ ye shes me 'bar ba'i dbus su 'gying ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phrosaḥ dbyings

gtsa/ nas ye shes pa spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bstimaḥ thugs ga'i (ཿla sngags kyis bskor ba las bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin can babs te bum pa gang bar dmigs laḥ sa badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bzlaḥ slar rnam lngas mchod la bstod pa niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ spyan ras gzigs dbang stong gsal ye shes skuḥgadug pa 'dul phyir khro rgyal rngams pa'i skuḥ gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs ye shes rol ba'i lhaḥ rta mgrin dbang gi sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ bum pa'i lha rnams 'od du zhu nas bum pa la thim pas bag chags dag byed kyi bdud rtsir gyuraḥ ces pas bzhu bsal bya'oḥgasum pa bhan+ta sgrub pa niḥ ( hrīḥ bhan+ta ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang duḥ dza gad rnam par 'khyil ba'i dbus su hrīḥlas gu ru a tsār+ya yum bde chen rgyal mo dang 'khril sbyor rol baḥ dga' bzhi'i stong pa'i 'od gsal rab tu 'bar nasaḥ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa sbyor mtshams nas babs te bhan+ta mer gyis gang bar dmigasaḥ 31 badz+ra ma hā a tsār+ya bho dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha a dṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ brgya rtsa brjod laḥ lha 'od du zhu

ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyis bhan+ta gang bar dmigasaḥ de nas rig pa'i me tog doraḥ dbang bzhi blang la thugs yid bsreḥ gnad des bdag nyid las rung zhing slob ma rjes su 'dzin nus 'gyuraḥ sa ma yā yi maX rgyal ba'i dbang ba.o rgyan pad+ma ngasaḥ ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yisaḥ thugs kyi yang bcud rdo rje snying po'i chos ༷ grub pa'i dbang phyugakhye'u chung khyod la gtad ༷ da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thob mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya bstimaḥ ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dusaḥ nga spruladapa'aponus ldan rdo rje dngaḥ 'phrad nas bstan 'gror phan bde spel gyur cigaḥ bka' gsang thub par srungs shigangasanus maḥ skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya0 las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shogaḥ sa ma yāX rgya rgya rgyaḥbumapa'itshag byin rlabs bcud chen rdzogs soḥ gter rgya gtad rgyaḥ sbas rgyaḥ zab rgya gsang rgya tsanargyan rgyas slob dbaka pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka'aḥ bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'oḥ gu rgyaḥsnyiḥ ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag popad+magor bu'ibazhed ngor bdag 'dragusaldan dorjes mdo khams tsa ri'i gnas mdun nas dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥrigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i chos sde lasaḥlas bzhi'i bsreg blugs zab mo phrin las lhun grub zhes bya ba bzhugs so/badz+ra na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ paṃsmab sdus/ gdod nas rnam dag chos sku spros pa bral:lhun grub 'gags med mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i garaḥdabyings ye zung 'jugs ru pad+ma rgyal mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo' rgyan du mchodaḥm 'ongs las can skal bzang skyes bu rnamasaḥyang gsang sgrub pa'i lam la zhugs pa'i tsheḥmatha' rten kha bskang las bzhi lhun grub phyiraḥbasreg blugs zab mo'i thabs la brtson par byaXs ma yāḥde yang thab stegs gru bzhi gru gang dpagaḥthab rgya pad+ma 'dab brgyad phyogs mdog byaḥnye bar gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga mdzasaḥkha khyer 'khor lo kha pad rin po che0 mchu ni pad+ma mchu rgyab ral gri bri 'od skor rdor phreng me ri pa tra dang zla phyed rdo rjes mdzas pa'i rnam 'gyur byaḥ'abru yi tshom bu lha grangs rdzogs par byaḥlas bzhi'i shing gis hom yang rang gzhung ltaraXdapal 'bar me dar rlung g.yab bkod par byaḥlogs su stegs khar bsreg rdzas gzhung bzhin bshamasaḥrang nyid yi dam lha yi las gzhung bsrangs bsnyen pa gsol mchod bskang tshogs rgyas par gtongaḥlas chu sgrub cing rig pa'i me tog dor0 rnal 'byor pa rnams he ru'i chas su zhugs dang po bsreg rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa niḥces

ār+yāḥ thabs dang shes rab sbyor las byung ba yiḥ bsreg rdzas phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i sprinaḥ ngo bo bde stong myong grol bdud rtsi laḥ rnam pa 'dod yon lnga ldan rol bar dmigasaḥ bla āno/ཿ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsumaḥ sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabasaḥ gnyis pa me sbar bya ba'i rim pa niḥ/ trīḥ me yi nge nge sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas me yi rang bzhin 'phags ma gos dkar moḥ me yi las ni gzung 'dzin mtshan rtog bsreg me la ye shes lha yis gzi byin phobaḥyin asne ye dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ḥ gsum pa thab khang bskyed pa'i rim pa niḥyin su bha wa sogs ste thab mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid lasaḥ zhi rgyas dbang drag lhun gyis grub pa'i thabaḥ dkar ser dmar ljang me 'od 'khyil zhing zlumaḥ de dbus rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas khang: gru bzhi sgo bzhi tshad dang mtshan nyid rdzogasaḥ phyi gsal nang gsal bar med zang thal 1ngaḥ rin chen pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla'i stengaḥhrīḥbab 'phro 'dus sku ngas su gyur pa lasaḥ mdun bskyed rje btsun gu ru rin po cheḥ —1gispyoX gzhung bzhin lha bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag 'tshalaḥ bzhi pa byon skyems 'bul ba'i rim pa niḥyin ādo/ཿ snang ba

bsnye bde stong yangs pa'i snod nang duḥ zag med byang chub sems kyi bcud kyis gtamasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i lha la 'bulaḥ dgyes bzhes mchog dang thun mong dngos grub (6paḥ rtsa sngags mthar pañtsa a dṛ ta khā hiḥ nyer gcig dag gis phul la dgyes pa bskangasaX gzhung bzhin bye nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs gtong lnga pa zhi ba til gyis mchod pa niḥ /ཿdhīḥ'agro drug las nyon sgrib pa sbyang pa dngaḥ rnal 'byor dam tshig nyams chags sor tshud phyiraḥ 'bru mchog snying po til gyi mchod pa 'bulaḥ ma rig dri kun dag pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥrtsa sngags mtharaḥ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hāḥ brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyal bar byaḥ drug pa 'dod gsol gdab pa'i rim pa niḥ heḥ rje btsun thugs rje'i dbang phyug rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul bas byin rlabs la brten nasaḥ bdag cag rnal 'byer ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags 'gal 'khrul nyes ltung thams cad dag pa dngaḥ sems can thams cad kyi las nyon sdig sgrib ma rig dri ma mtha' dag byang zhing sor chud pa'i

phrin las mdzod cigaḥ bdun pa rgyas pa yam shing mar khu ni hūṃ sni rnal 'byor bdag cag sgrub mchog 'khor bcas kyiḥ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byer rgyas pa'i phyiraḥ ye shes bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod pa 'bulaḥ 'dod rgu lhun grub rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ a prota khā tīḥ bho dhi dhik+ta sā hāḥ brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyal bar bya brgyad pa 'dod gsol gdab pa'i rim pa niX sto dzabatsun thugs rjelidabang phyug rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la zhal zas sreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i byin rlabs la brten nasaḥ bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad zla ba yar ngos bzhin du gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cigaḥ dgu pa dbang gi rdzas rnams 'bul ba ni ༷ hūṃ trīḥ rnal 'dresar bdag cag phrin las lhun grub cingaḥ khams gsum srid gsum dbang du sdud pa'i phyiraḥ 'thu mchog ye shes snying po'i mchod pa 'bulaḥ 'dod rgu dbang du gyur ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥ rtsa sngags mthar oṃ badz+ra sesasaṃ bha bye puṣ+ṭa be ga bi dza ye grusma ba la āḥyu ṣe pra ti ha ta gha gru

gas/ ni sarba pā paṃ da ha na ye swā hāḥ brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar bar byaḥ bcu pa 'dod don gsol ba'i rim pa niḥ r+sā rje btsun thugs rje'i dbang phyug rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la zhal zas sreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i byin rlabs la brten nasaḥ bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i mthun rkyen zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i phya g.yang thams cad dbang du sdud pa'i phrin las mdzod cigaḥ bcu gcig drag po'i bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni0 hūṃ hrīḥ gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas phyir sngags byang buḥ zhing bcu tshang ba'i sha khrag drod dbugs 'bulaḥ nus mthu phun sum tshogs phyir yungs dkar stobasaḥ drag po'i phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzodaḥ rtsa sngags mthar0 gargod byed dug lnga dug gsum las byung ba'i log par lta ba rnams mā ra ya phaṭa khā hi khā hiḥ brgya stong khri 'bum sogs bskyar bar byaḥ bcu gnyis 'dod don gsol gdab rim pa niḥhe rje btsun thugs rje'i dbang phyug rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la zhal zas sreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i byin rlabs la brten nasaḥ bdag cag rnal

'byor bsgrub pa po'i dam la 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs zhing bcu tshang ba'i bdud bgegs rgyal bsen dam sri 'byung po thams cad mngon spyod drag po'i sgo nas tshar chod la ming tsam yang mi gnas par rdul du brlag pa dngaḥ gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: bcu gsum rdzas rnams kun 'bul rim pa niḥ hūṃ trīḥ brdal khyab rin chen yangs pa'i sgod nang duḥ dam rdzas 'dod yon lnga ldan phung pos gtamasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i lha la 'bulaḥ dgyes bzhes tshogs rdzogs don gnyis lhun grub mdzodaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ sarba puts+tsha kha kha khā hi khā hiX shidzña puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭaḥ las bzhi lhun gyis grub par gyur cigaḥ 'di ni ci ltar 'tshams pa'i grangs bzhin bzlaX dmigs pa'i lde kha bsgyur ba'i phrin las kunaḥ rtsol med yid bzhin 'grub par the tshom medaḥ de nas gzhung bzhin bstod pa rgyas par bya bskang tshogs gsol mchod byed kyang skabs 'dir rungaX bcu bzhi gshegs skyems 'bul ba'i rim pa ni rnam lnga nyer spyod 'dod yon pu tsa 'bul hūṃ trī0 thabs dang shes rab lto sbyor las 'dzag pa'iḥ bdud rtsi a dṛ ta yi chu rgyun gyisaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i dgyes pa bskangasaḥ phrin las lhun

—4(4 grub gtang rag mchod pa'oḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ a mṛ ta khā hiḥ nyer gcig dag gis yongs su phul bar byaḥ de nas bstod bsdus gang rung legs par gtongaḥ bco lnga dngos grub blang ba'i rim pa niX ma.āḥhūṃḥ sku gsum lhun grub bde chen bde ba'i bcudaḥ dbang bzhi'i dngos grub rdzogs pa gsang gsum gteraḥ deng 'dir sgrub mchog bdag la stsal du gsolaḥ bskyed sgom chud mi za ba ngo mtshar cheḥ 'bras bu dus su smin pa a la laḥ dbang dang dngos grub stsal ba e ma hoḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ bcu drug bzod gsol bya ba'i rim pa niX hūṃ hrīḥ ma 'byor pa dang nyams sgrib ser snas sbagaḥ rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chags kunaḥ rab gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis bshags bgyi'oḥ mi sgrib tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsolaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya shukhye āḥ yig brgya gsum bzlas pas lhag chad bskangasaḥ bcu bdun bsdu rim bya ba 'di ltar roḥ aḥ snang cha thabs su shar ba'i dkyil 'khor loḥshes rab stong nyid spros mtha' bral ba'i ngangaḥ med byung rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' klong duḥ 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid du brdal bar bzhagaḥ a āḥ ye shes pa chos kyi dbyings su

bsduḥ phuṭa phuṭaḥ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar bsdu'oḥ bco brgyad bsngo ba smon lam gdab pa niX ho 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum duḥ bsags pa'i dge rtsa thams cad gcig bsdus nasaḥ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas thob phyir 'gro la bsngoḥ phyams gcig gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin par re gaḥ lan gsumaX bcu dgu bkra shis bya ba'i rim pa niX na mo ma chags pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po lasaḥ dad ldan gdul bya'i re skong sbrang char 'bebasaḥ gnyis med bde ba chen por sgrol mdzad pa'iḥ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis shogaḥ mkhyen brtse'i 'od stong zer gyi spyan yangs posaḥ ris med ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la brdalaḥ las ldan ma lus 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrolaḥ longs sku nam mkha' rgyal po'i bkra shis re gaḥ mdangs ldan mtsho gling pad sdong rtse las 'khrungasaḥ ya mtshan rmad byung grub pa'i rtags mtshan brnyesaḥ dad ldan bod kyi skyabs gcig bka' drin canaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i bkra shis shogaḥ thos pa tsam gyis ngan 'dza'i g.yang las skyobasaḥ dran pas 'dod rgu'i mchog stsol dpag bsam shingaḥ bsgrub pas rang snang dag pa'i zhing la grolaḥ yang zab rdo rje snying

btsa/: po'i bkra shis re/gaḥ mkha' la bkra shis nyi zla skar tshogs bkraḥ bar snang bkra shis lto sprin sbrang char 'bebasaḥ sa gzhir bkra shis rtsi bcud lo thog sminaḥyangs pa'i rgyal khams bde ba'i bkra shis de gaḥ de ltar shis brjod bsngo spron mthar rgyas byaḥ tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub phrin las rnam bzhi'i las gang 'dod pa de 'bad med re skongs sngags kyi khyad chos yinaḥ sa ma yāḥ tso maḥ rgyal ba'i dbang po o rgyan pad+ma ngasaḥ ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yisaḥ snying gi ya tig bcud byung gdams zab 'di:grub pa'idabang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtadaḥ da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thobaX mdo khams rtse shod gshams du dgongs rgya mdzodaḥ ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dusaX nga spruladapa' bo nus ldan rdo rdodangaḥ 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spelaḥ gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min zhing la 'god chos bdag rnams kyis bstan pa'i ba dan bsgrengasaḥ dad ldan rnams kyis rang rig lhug par mthongaḥ skye 'gro re 'gar smin grol gru gzing thebaḥ bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsalaX dkon mod rgyal khams 'grims la ltos dang mthongaḥ bka' gsang thub par srung shigarngasanus maḥ snod med lag tu ma shor a tham rgyaḥ las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shogaX sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaX las bzhi'i bsreg blugs phrin las lhun grub rdzogs soḥ gter rgya

gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgyaḥ gsang rgyaX gu h+ya yo rgyan gyi slob dathonapad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka'aX bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'oḥ brda thimaḥsnyi ces pa 'di'ang chos gyi bdag po dam pa rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags pa'i skyes mchog pad+manor bus thabs shes rdor dril mthing mdzes cod paṇa bkra shis lha reg sogs kyi skyes bcas yang yang bskul ba dngaḥ chos bdag pad+ma chos 'phelargyal mtshos yang yang bzhed ngoraḥ bdag 'dra dpa' 4nus ldan rdo rjes gser shod rnga rol stag rtse'i mdun zur rje btsun thugs rje'i gnas kyi mdun ngos pad+ma bde ba'i dga' tshal thang gi yang ljongs nas nyams dga' dang spro shes pa bde ba'i ngang nas mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ legs so/ sarba maṅga lam̐/

'a tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥbatsaX na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ phonarte /jeX dad dang mos gus gdung shugs drag pos yisaḥ dus chen tshes bcur bskang tshogs rgya chen gtongaX gu ru yid kyi dran zhing dang ba'i blosaḥ rnam thar gsol 'debs snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis gyer0 gces pa'i bu ngus ma yis mi bzod ltar: rnga yab dpal gyi ri nas byin rlabs 'gyur e ma hoX bde chen zhing du chos sku snang mtha' yasaḥ ri bo ta lar 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: rnga yab gling dbus o rgyan rin po cheraḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥ rgyal kun gcig bsdus ma hā gu ru rjeḥ nyam thag snyigs ma'i 'gro ba bdag cag gisaḥ dad mos drag pos gsol ba 'debs lags naḥ thugs dam ma g.yel rjes su bzung du gsolaḥ dbang chen sprel lo sprel zla'i tshes bcu'i nyinaḥmadangs ldan dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling duḥ ya mtshan rmad byung mtsho skyes rdo rjer gragasaḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsalaḥ khyang gi zla ba'i tshes bcur au ṭi ya'iḥ

rgyal srid bzung zhing khams gsum bde la bkodaḥ srid gsum zil gnon pad+ma rgyal por gragasaX gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥ stag gazla ba'i tshes bcur rgyal srid spangasaḥ bsil ba'i tshal gshegs brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzadaḥ tan gaṇa mthar phyin shan+ta rak+ṣir gragasaḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥ yos zla'i tshes bcur a su ra la byonaḥ kun dga' bo brten rab tu byung tshul mdzadaḥ 'dul 'dzin mkhan po shākya seng ger gragasaḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥ'abrug gi zla ba'i tshes bcur za hor byenaḥ gson bsregs mdzad kyang me dpung mtsho ru bsgyuraḥ 'bum phrag smin mdzad pad+ma saṃ bhar gragasaḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥ sbrul zla'i tshes bcur bse sgom spug po phyesaḥ phra men mu stegs sde tshogs drung nas 'byinaḥ bdud 'dul seng ge sgra sgogs zhes su gragasaḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥ rta zla'i tshes bcur lhun grub brtsegs la byenaḥ dur khrod lha 'drer gsang sngags chos 'khor bskoraḥ 'gro 'dul nyi ma 'od zer zhes su gragasaḥ

bsgotshu gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥ lug zlaliches bcur rdo rje gdan la byonaḥ mdo sngags bstan pa'i sgron me rab tu sbaraḥ bka' drin zla med blo ldan mchog sred gragasaḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥ gyizla'i ches bcur bal po'i yul du byonaḥ rgyal khams chos bkod zab gter sta gon mdzadaḥ mthu stobs rmad byung gtum drag rgyal por grags gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥbya zlali sa bcur rgya nag yul grur byonaḥ kun rdzob rtsis kyis rgyal khams bde la bkodaḥ mtshan ni blo gsal mañdzu bṛ gragasaḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥkhyizlalitshes bcur bod yul mun pa bsalaḥ bsam yas lhun grub chos kyi sgron me sbaraḥ zab gsang gter bkod 'gro mgon pad+mar gragasaḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥ phag gizla b.litshes bcur lha 'dre btulaḥ sgrub gnas byin brlabs rje 'bangs smin grol bkodaḥ lnga brgya'i dpal sder rdo rje khro lod gragasaḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaju rngams pa'ingar

rje gas tshes bcu la bab tshe sde brgyad dbang bsdus lha 'dre mi gsum laḥ zhal gdams snying byang gtad pa'i thod phreng rtsalaḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsol bdestong gar gyitshes bcu la bab tsheḥ lus med mkha' 'dza'i tshogs rjer mnga' dbang bsgyuraḥ dga' bzhi'i 'byung gnas a tsār+ya zhes gragasaḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥ rol pa chen po'otshes bcu la bab tsheḥ sgrub mchog stong phrag byin rlabs zab gter sbasaḥ snyigs ma'i skyabs mgon pad+ma bde rol gragasaḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥsteru ka yitshes bcu la bab tsheḥ gdong dmar srin tshogs gsang sngags chos la bkodaḥ rak+ka rgyal po dbu 'bum rtsal zhes grags gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥmanyam brdal dga' b.litshes bcu la bab tsheḥ dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi da lar bzhugasaḥ 'phags bod rig 'dzin tshogs la chos 'khor bskoraḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥtshogs sman las 'dzams dus kyi tshes bcu laḥ dad ldan sprul ba'i spyan sngar dngos byon zhingaḥ pha nor

ba:tshu mchog ster gdul bya smin grol 'godaḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥ thos pas bde stong dga' bzhi'i ye shes bskyedaḥ mthong bas ma rig mun pa dbyings su selaḥ dran pas dgongs rgyud byin rlabs char ltar 'bebasaḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥ da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i 'tshubs slong 'diraḥ mtha' mi dbus sdibs mtshon chas gzengs pa langasaḥ nad yam mu ges kha lo bsgyur rkyen gyisaḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥ sde brgyad lha 'dres sbyor ba cho 'phrul rtsubaḥ du ru ka yi rigs byed bco brgyad 'khrugaḥ rang gi rang la yid mi ches pa'i dusaḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥ phyi ru bdud dang dam sri'i 'tshubs ma langaḥ nang du nyon mongs dug lnga'i bslu brid stonaḥ rgyad pa sna tshogs bsal ba'i dus la babaḥ gsol 'debs bu la byin rlabs dngos grub stsolaḥ 'di bzung ci srid byang chub snying po'i b.raḥ skad cig 'bral ba med par rjes bzung nasaḥ byin rlabs dgongs pa'i ye shes yon tan kunaḥ da lta nyid du bdag rgyud la 'phos teḥ ma dag

'khrul pa'i 'dzin zhen rang sar dgaḥ sku gsum ye shes dgongs pa'i sa zin nasaḥ rdzogs ldan gsal ba'i lang tshos mdzes gyur cigaḥ bdag la bzang ngan las kyis 'brel ba yiḥ skye 'gro yongs kyi ma rig sgrib tshogs bcomaḥ 'jig rten 'di snang dbyings su zhig ma thag: rnga yab dpal gyi ri la phyin pa dngaḥ pha gcig pad+ma kā ra'i zhal mthong zhingaḥ ston 'aX ra dgongs pa dbyer med sangs rgyas shingaḥ da byung sprul pas 'gro khams dong sprugs re gaḥ de ltar bzlas pas phyi nang bar chad selaḥ nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gong 'phel rgyasaX the tshom med do rdo rje rgyal po'i bka'aX bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsalaḥ byin rlabs bcud rdzogs gdams pa zab mo 'di grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtadaX da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thobaX mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs pra mdzodaX ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dngaḥ 'phrad nas sku skyes dam pa rnam gsum dngaḥ chos kyi bdag po skyes mchog rnam brgyad la 'doms nas gsang chen bstan pa phyogs bcur sgrogasaḥ gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min zhing la 'godaX snyigs ma'i ru 'dzing dus kyi rgud pa gso ༷ zab bcud thub par srungs shig nges nus maḥ skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgyaḥ las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shogaḥ sa

—6(tshu ma yā0 rgya rgya rgyaḥ gu rgya gsol 'debs byin rlabs char 'bebs rdzogs so0 gter rgyaḥ gtad rgyaḥ sbas rgyaḥ zab rgyaḥ gsang rgyaḥrme rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka'aḥ bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o brda zim ces pa 'di 'ang chos kyi bdag popad+ma nor bus gser dngul rin po che'i rdzas dang bcas nas bskul ngor/ bdag 'dragus ldan rdo rjes mdo khams tsa ri'i gnas mdun nas dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'iḥ thugs dam dgongs ba'i gnad bskul zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥgasaX na mo gu ru padha ka ra yeḥ 〉〉thu /t+tacho sa rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa'iX ye shes rdo rje mkhyen brtse'i gzi 'bar baḥ mtsho skyes rdo rje 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig pu mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchodaḥ bdag 'dra rgyal dbang pad+ma saṃ bha wa'iḥ ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yisaḥ rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs kyi sgrub pa niḥ yang zab snying gi dwangs ma lta bu bstan sa ma yāḥde yi cha lag thugs dam gnad bskul niḥdri zhim spos dud thod rnga'i sgra sbir zhing snyan pa'i dbyangs gyer mos gus tshad med pasaḥ dus drug nyams su len pa gnad du cheḥ( hrīḥ 'di nas zhe nub rak+ka srin yul dbus: rngams brjid thod mkhar zhing g.yang rgyal mtshan klongaḥ tsit+ta mgo phreng mig gi bsgril 'phyang brgyanaḥ thod pa'i kha bad nyi zla'i sang skar mjesaḥ khyad zhag zha la 'ur mo'i gzer gyis gtams bye gsal nang gsal dri bral dag pa'i sangaḥ rab 'jigs srin po'i tshogs rnams 'dud cing 'khrigasaḥ de dbus byol song gtso brgyad kyis btegs pa'iḥ rin chen khri rkang pad+ma nyi zla'i

kharaḥgadug pa tshar gcod rak+ka thod phreng bzhugasaḥrnal 'byor bdag gis gdung bas 'bod lags naḥsnyigs ma'i rgud pa bzlog phyir thugs dam bskulaḥdug lnga'i gdon 'dul srid gsum 'gran zla bral thabs mkhas lcags kyus 'gro rnams bde la 'godaḥdapa' bo gar dbang thod phreng sdolnga po bstan pa'i ru tra 'dul phyir thugs dam bskulaḥyul brgyad rang grol gsang ba'i gnas mchog nasaḥbartul zhugs thabs kyis gang 'dul mdzad pa skyongaḥsprul pa'i skye mchogagu ru mtshan brgyad poḥbadud dang dam sri 'dul phyir thugs dam bskulaḥtshogs brgyad rang grol gsang ba'i gnas mchog nasaḥlas can smin mdzad bstan dang 'gro ba'i mgonaḥmed du byung ba'i rig 'jin rnam pa brgyadaḥsnyigs ma'i bstan dgra bzlog phyir thugs dam bskulaḥnyon drug 'khrul ba rnam dag pho brang nasaḥgadug pa kun 'dul 'khor ba dbyings su sgolaḥ'agro khams dong sprugs rnam 'dren gu ru drug 0smon log dam sri 'dul phyir thugs dam bskulaḥsbyor sgrol brtul zhugs mthar phyin pho brang nasaḥthabs dang shes rab 'brel ba'i mthus drangs nasaḥ'agro

badz+ra rnams bder 'god grub dbang brgyad cu dzaḥ dus mtha'i 'gong nag 'dul phyir thugs dam bsgulaḥ rang gsal ye shes dag pa'i pho brang nasaḥ gang 'dul grub rtags rdzu 'phrul mnga' brtes shingaḥ 'gro 'dren pho nya bsam mi khyab par 'gyedaḥ rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga'i thugs dam bskulaḥ tsit+ta zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo nasaḥ 'gro ba 'dul mdzad gangs can bstan 'dza'i mgonaḥ o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas niḥ ma rung nad mtshon bzlog phyir thugs dam bskulaḥ bskul lo 'gro mgon o rgyan rin po cheḥ dbyings nas bzhengs shig rdo rje thod phreng rtsalaḥ bar chad rdul rlog rdo rje khro bo lodaḥ bdud dang dam sri 'dul ba'i dus la babaḥ rgya 'dre me zhon 'dul ba'i dus la babaḥ'abyung po rlung zhon 'dul ba'i dus la babaḥ dus 'khrug mtshon cha 'dul ba'i dus la babaḥ rā tsa bse mo 'dul ba'i dus la babaḥ nad yam dug slong 'dul ba'i dus la babaḥbyad phur rbod gtong 'dul ba'i dus la babaḥ bskal pa'i g.yo 'khrugs bzlog pa'i dus la babaḥ bdag cag snyigs ma'i dmu rgod 'gro ba rnamasaḥ thugs rjes yal bar ma dor

gu ru rjeḥ bstan pa nyams dma' chos byed mgo 'phang rdul: sdig can dpon dang khrel med rkun po rnamasaḥ lang la shor nas rin chen snying po bcomaḥ sgrub pa'i sgo gtor dmag jag mtshon las 'gyedaḥ skyed pa'i nyi ma nub ri'i phyogs la nye: mtha' mi dbus su sdud pa'i la nye tshangaḥ bdud dang dam sri'i las la kun g.yeng nasaḥ ngan song duḥkha'i dpal bskyed so nam sgrubaḥ kyi ma kye spyod a rgyan rin po cheḥ snyigs ma'i rgyal bstan 'di la ma gzigs samaḥ o rgyan thugs rje'i dgongs pa'i bzod nus samaḥ skyabs med da phrug bdag cag 'dor ram ci: nyon mongs gdung sel thugs rje'i char skems samaḥ 'khor ba'i mtsho sgol gru bo stor ram ci: mun sel ye shes sgron me nub song ngamaḥ thugs bskyed dam bca' nyams par ma gyur ramaḥ dgra yi kha dar bgegs kyi 'tshubs ma langasaḥ mtha' mi kla kle'i dbang du nub la nye: 'gro rnams bzod med dmyal ba'i rang bzhin canaḥchos byed bu yi tshe sgog dam la glagasaḥ bkra mi shis pa'i nyer 'tshe ma ldang naḥ skyabs mgon khyed la 'o dod ci'i phyir 'bodaḥ gdung bas gsol tshig chud mi za ba rtsa thugs rje

bas/: nye ring bral ba'i sku mchog gisaḥ che ba'i yon tan stobs rtsal dpa' bskyed laḥ snyigs ma'i rgud pa ma lus bcom pa dngaḥ tshos kyi sgron mes sa gsum yongs khyab cingaḥ rdzogs ldan lang tsho dar ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥ 'gro rnams dpal gyi ri la lam sna drongasaḥ thugs dam ma g.yel badz+ra sa ma yāḥ ces brjod phud skyems gtsang sar gshegasaḥ thugs dam gnad bskul dmigs bsal bzhin : grub na bar chad g.yul ngo zhiḥ bde legs myu gu smin 'gyur roḥ the tshom med do sa ma yāḥ e maX rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha wasaḥ snying byung lag mthil bkram pa'i gdams zab 'di: grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen brda la chugasaḥ mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya mdzodaḥ ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus: grub pa'i dbang phyuganus ldan rdo rje dngaḥ'aphrad nas chos bdag skyes bu bdun la spelaḥ bstan pa dar rgyas las ldan 'bum phrag grolaḥ bar chad g.yul 'joms bde skyid lang tsho rgyasaḥ gdams bcud thub par srungs shiganges nus ma skal med lag tu ma de|ra a tham rgyaXlas can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shogaḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥthugs dam gnad bskul rdzogs soḥ gter rgyaḥ gtad rgyaḥ sbas rgyaḥ zab rgyaḥ gsang rgyaḥ gu h+yaḥtso rgyan gyi sleb dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka'aḥ bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas
bkod pa'oḥ brda thimaḥ ces pa 'di'ang chos bdagapad+ma nor bu'i bzhed ngoranus ldan rdo rjes dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ gu ru zhi ba'i sgrub skor dang 'brel ba'i mtshan don khā hi bzhugs soḥ gas/ na mo gu ru pad+mā ka ra yeḥ las ldan sgrub la zhugs pa'i tsheX dkyil 'bar lha tshogs dgyes pa'i phyiraḥmatshan don khā nyisbyar spro naḥsnyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad doX yin āḥshāḥ skye med chos sku dun bzang yab yum de mchod do sa āḥhūṃḥ 'gag med zlum 'khyil rdo rje 'chang chen de mchod do snyed āḥhūṃḥ chags med rdul bral snang ba mtha' yas de mchod do snyed āḥ(ཿskyabs rje gter chen nam mkha' rgya mtsho de mchod dophaṭa āḥhūṃḥ rdo rje'i sgras bskul thod phreng sde lnga de mchod do0( āḥhūṃḥ 'dzam gling yongs kyi skyabs mgon pad 'byung de mchod do 6) āḥhūṃḥ tshogs brgyad rang grol gu ru mtshan brgyad de mchod docas āḥ(ཿ sgrub sde'i 'byung gnas rig 'dzin rnam brgyad de mchod docas u(ཿ 'gro drug gnas stong gu ru sde drug de mchod do oṃ āḥ& ma 'dres yongs grags 'phrul mtshan nyi shu de mtshod dochas āḥhūṃ mi mjed 'dul mdzad pad 'byung bye ba phrag brgya de mchod do oṃ āhūṃḥ thugs sras

bka' bab snying gi bu dgu de mchod do ma/ ā(ཿ 'dzam gling mun sel rje 'bangs nyer lnga de mchod do oṃ ā ༷hūṃḥ brtul zhugs rol mdzad paṇa grub rgya mtsho de mchod do 30 ā ༷hūṃX phan bde 'byung gnas ye shes mtsho rgyal de mchod do oṃ āḥhūṃḥ chos kyi mig ldan 'drog mi lo tsā de mchod do oṃ āḥhūṃḥ brgyud pa dgu ldan rig 'dzin rgya mtsho de mchod do oṃ āḥhūṃḥdrin chen mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma de mchod do oṃ āḥhūṃḥ dngos grub gter mdzod yi dam rgya mtsho de mchod do oṃ āḥhūṃḥ dga' bzhi'i 'byung gnas ḍāk+ki ma tshogs de mchod do skye/ āḥ(ཿ legs nyes ltong 'dzin dam can rgya mtsho de mchod do oṃ āḥhūṃḥ dgos 'dod 'byung gnas nor lha gter bdag de mcho de do oṃ āḥ(ཿ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud mnyes shing tshim nas sgrub pa po la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsolaḥ sirnyi pha la a la la hoḥ zhes bdud rtsi myong bas dngos grub thob par 'gyuraḥ rten 'brel che phyir rdo rje'i lce yis bskulaḥnub pa mi mnga' gaṅga'i rgyun bzang dpalaḥ ku mud tshal khyab mdangs 'bar nor bu'i dbyigaḥ ring min nye ba'i brda thabs kyis bslang nasaX rol ba'i rdo rje'i blo mtsho dbang med g.yo o rgyan bla ma'i phrin las 'grub phyir smonaX mi 'dra
—8rdo dbang med tshig 'chor thad rdol 'di/dad ldan smon sems zhes byas yi ger bkod/sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra them yig med pa'i skor rin chen shog skya:dhiḥ zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ rig 'jin bla ma 'dus pa'i sgrub sdeḥ bdud rtse sman gyi khog phub gzhan phan thugs rje'i nyi ma zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ

ba:tshu na mo gu ru pad+mā ka ra yeḥ margagazhugatshasag662bsgos/ rmad byung dur khrod brgyad gshegs brtul zhugs mdzadaḥ sgrub sde dgu yi dngos grub pha phog thobaḥ sangs rgyas gnyis pa rdo rje gshog rgod rtsalaḥ mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du rolaḥ bdud rtsi yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas mchogaḥ dpal chen yongs rdzogs mi shig thig le'i skuḥ dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter chen thugs rje'i smanaḥ che ba'i che mchog snying gi ga'u rolaḥ bye nang gsang ba mchog gi dur khrod duḥ ya mtshan rmad byung a mṛ dngos grub brnyesaḥ / gar ro langs ku ku rā tsa sogs: grub chen rig 'dzin rnams la gus pas 'dudaX bdag 'dra o rgyan pad+ma saṃ bha wasaḥ ma 'ongs las ldan skal bzang pho mo laḥphan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas gcig gyur paḥ bdud rtsi a bṛ ta yi gsang mdzod bstanaḥ sa ma āḥ de yang khyad par chen po lnga ldan galaḥ dang po gnas kyi khyad par bstan pa niḥ rgyal ba gong ma'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i saḥ rig 'dzin rnams kyis sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gnasaḥ rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po brnyes pa yiḥ gnas mchog nyams dga' mi

btsan med dben pa'i saḥ g.ya' gangs mtsho ljongs dur khrod chen po rtsa nyams dga' dwangs spro rgyu 'grul glags tshol dbenaḥ ljon shing na ba ku mud rab rgyas tshalaḥ bsrung bzhi tshang zhing sa 'dabs phyag rgya bsnolaḥ nyi zla 'char snga nub phyi g.yas su bskoraḥ rgyun 'bab mdun 'dud mjug ma ma sgo ra baḥ yon tan de tshang ba yi gnas brten naḥ mchog thun gang sgrub yid la bsam bzhin 'byungaḥ gnyis pa dus kyi khyad par bstan pa niḥ ra ba bzhi'am dus chen rnam pa gsumaḥ bsil drod khod snyoms yar tshes bzang po ni: spen snar 'phrod 'dzom grub sbyor chen po laḥ 'bog g.yos sgrub pa'i sbyor ba phun tshogs suḥ bkra shis dge mtshan ldan pa'i yon tan 'byungaḥ gsum pa rdzas kyi khyad par bstan pa niḥ yid bzhin gter ldan rdo rje'i ka pā laḥ mdog dkar dum gcig phyi nang gsal sgrib bralaḥ 1ma 'khyil 'am ni rdo rje'i dbyibs lta buḥ rin chen phra mdzes gser dngul gzhong pa lagasaḥ shon shing ra ba ma 'thor 'bras bu spudaḥ lo 'dab phyi ru ma shor nang du sdudaḥ sgog gi ka ba 'jam la skyon ma zhugasaḥ dngos grub rgyun lam 'jam

bde rtsub reg bralaḥ skyon brgyad 'joms pa'i dngos grub sgo gcig har: glang chen mche skung 'ju thag rten phur rnamasaḥ ma nyams phun tshogs pra ltas bzang po canaḥ rdo rje'i rigs kyi 'bru sman ku mudhaḥ kha dog dkar zhing zhi byed yon tan ldanaḥ rtsa ba'i rigs dbyibs ni 'draḥ rtsa ba byang sems mi sha rang bsgol gyisaḥ phyur bur bkang la sel ma zhugs pa galaḥ 'dod 'byung bum bzang rat+na'i ka pā laḥ gser mdog brjid ldan a ru ra yi dbyibasaḥ yang na dpa' bo'i thod pa ji lta bu: gru bzhi logs 'bur gser thag lta bus mdzesaḥ rat+na'i dbyibs kyi phra dang yi ge bkraḥ bsam 'phel lha ba'i zam pa ma chad paḥ yon tan rten byed skyon 'joms gong ltar roḥ dum bu gsum pa lha klu mi'i nor buḥdangos grub pra ltas brtags la thabs kyis btsalaḥ rin chen rigs kyi 'bru sman ku mud taḥ gser gyi mdog can rin chen rdo yi rigasaḥ nor bu'i dbyibs can a par skyur gsum bsagasaḥ sha chen dngas ma klad pa khyi yi shaḥ mig zlum rigs kyi sha khrag cung zad bsreḥ sel dang mi gtsang skyon lnga ma zhugs galaḥ ma chags bde bskyed pad+ma'i ka pā laḥ

btsan mdog snum zangs 'od 'bar zhing pad+ma'i dbyibasaḥ ku mud 'dab 'bras ldan pa'i phra yis mdzesaḥ dum bu bzhi'am lnga ste ge sar mtshonaḥ shing 'bras thog bu zhub la byur bur gangaḥ srin dong ro rul 'dam khung skyon ma zhugasaḥ rang phyogs wa ba rgyas shing gzhan du dbenaḥ pad+ma'i rigs kyi 'bru sman ku mud taḥ bsil ldan tsan dan byu ru zangs rdo dmaraḥ ro tshwa lan tshwa ge sar la sogs pa'iḥ dbyibs ni pad+ma'i dbyibs can dza ti sogasaḥ khyad par pad+ma mtshal chen me bya'i shaḥ chags pa ma dag 'jur po'i dri bral gnadaḥ las rnams mthar phyin garma'i ka pā laḥ phra gare/nga smug snum ral gri rgyal mtshan mngonaḥ mu tig phreng ming phra mdzes haḥyig spudaḥ dum bu gnyis pa 'am ni bcu gsum ldanaḥ shing 'bras rags la rgyas shing dbus su gugaḥ nad kyis gtsen pa'i mdog tu ma bsgyur galaḥ las lam phrin las dngos grub sgo gsum ldanaḥ gser mtsho g.yu mdza ma skol sla bas bkangaḥ nyi zla'i phra ldan ya mtshan rmad du byungaḥ las rab rigs kyi 'bru sman ku mud taḥ ar nag ga bur gser me ku sha sogasaḥ ral gri'i dbyibs can tsan dan

seng ldeng ngo med mi rung ba dri chu glang po'i shaḥ rdzas 'jab blang dri mas ma gos galaḥ dngos grub kun 'byung 'khor lo'i ka pā laḥ 1ma 'khyil 'od 'bar sngo la dwangs pa'oḥ dum thu bzhi'am drug pa 'khor lo'i rtsibasaḥ yon tan rdo rje'i rang bzhin yar ldan rdzogasaḥ de bzhin rigs can 'bru sman ku mud taḥ kha dog dri ro khyad 'phags ji snyed bsagasaḥd byibs ni 'khor lo'i rnam pa can rnams soḥ ta la'i lo ma la sogs lo yi rigasaḥ khyad 'phags dri chen ba glang sha yis byuraḥ skyon lnga bral ba'i yon tan ldan pas bkangaḥ sha yi spyang kuku shud zer mo dngaḥ so rag mdzo dril bong bu rta rkyang dngaḥ stag gzig 'phar spyang bse dri can dor laḥ dri yi spyang ku sgog rigs shing kun dngaḥ byi rug pa dang rtsa yi gla bu byugaḥ shu dag nag po la sogs dri ngad canaḥ phyogs gcig bsgyur bas nyung bsre mang mi byaḥ me tog spyang ku ri sha spru ma dngaḥ sran ma'i me tog la sogs shes par byaḥ nus pa'i spyang ku bong nga'i rigs rnams dngaḥ thar nu dur byed re'u lcags la sogs paḥ mang du mi bya nus pa mi lags soḥ ro yi spyang ku gzhob tsha tig ta'i rigasaḥ pi ling pho ril sga skya

bsgo/ srub ka baḥ hong len rtsa mkhris khur mong tsi dra gaḥ ṣa zhing tsha ba lan tsha'i rigs rnams kunaḥ mang du mi gtong skyon gyis 'khri ba 'byungaḥ mdog gi spyang ku spangs rgyan rgya snag dngaḥ mtshur rigs sngo sman ljang gu'i rigs byed nyungaḥ mdog 'don kha gur mang bas gser 'od 'charaḥ tsan dan rgya skag shas che spug 'od 'baraḥ yon tan dri ro nus ldan phun sum tshogasaḥ nye bar 'os pa'i shing rtsi chang gson maḥ dri bral sgye'u rigs lnga'i phyag rtags canaḥ chag gas phug ral bral ba'i rin chen sgromaḥ nye bar mkho ba'i rten rdzas ma lus paḥ mthong rgyud zhal shes bzhin tu bsag par byaḥ bzhi ba sgrub pa po yi khyad par niḥ ston pa mdzod ldan chu bo bzhi yis spudaḥ dbang dang dngos grub sgrub pa'i drod rtags canaḥ gsang sngags las la mkhas shing sbyor sgrol thebaḥ 'khor ni khong khro g.yo rgyu kha gsag medaḥ phu dud dad mos che zhing byams brtse ldanaḥ mig ser med cing snying rus sdug sran cheḥ dam gtsang thugs mthun khrims la gnas pa'oḥ lnga ba ma/ byad bkod pa'i khyad par niḥ bsam gtan tsher ma zhi ba'i 'bol stan 'jamaḥ khong khro zug rngu

skyobs phyir rgyu 'grul bsdamasaḥ dug lnga'i baspu brid zhi phyir dam rgya bcadaḥ gnyes ngan g.yul rgyal dran shes bag yod brtenaḥ thabs shes ya ma bral ba'i rdor dril dngaḥ gzhan snang zil gyis gnon pa'i rnga bo cheḥ thams cad chos sgrar sad pa'i sil snyan dngaḥpho rgyud dpa' bo 'bod pa'i ṭā ma rtsamo rgyud dpa' mo 'bod pa'i g.yer zhub 'phanaḥrdo rje'i pho nya sbran pa'i dar nag dngaḥ ma tshogs las la 'bod pa'i rkang gling zungaḥ bkra shis mi nub rgyang grags skad po cheḥ rdo rje glu ma'i gar bsgyur gling bu zungaḥ bdud 'dul sngags kyi rgyud bskul dung dang dmaraḥ tshangs pa'i gsung snyan sgrogs pa'i ting ting shagaḥrdo rje'i tha tshig bsgo ba'i bzed phor dngaḥ dam tshig gnad la dbab pa'i nang mchod smanaḥ ma rung rū tra brlag pa'i sgrol phur dngaḥ mi gtsang nyes skyon sbyang ba'i las byed bumaḥ dngos grub mtshan ma brtes pa'i da la chas dbang bzhi lhun rdzogs bum sogs mdzes par spro:phyi nang 'dzin pa dag phyir rgyan bkod bkramaḥ tshogs gnyis bre kha bkang phyir mchod sprin spro: 'tsho ba bza' btung sdig dang ma 'dres bsags: rkyen bzlog sman dang sgo srung pho

gtsa/ nya 'bodaḥ dam sri mnan zhing nyul le bsgrad chog byaḥ sgrub phrin lhun grub las bzhi'i bsreg blugs byaḥ lha bsang mnol bsang lha khrus grib khrus bskyaraḥbasags sbyangs spel ba'i las la rnam par brtsonaḥ dam skong dong sprugs mdzad pa'i dam ldan gcigaḥ sgrub pa'i rkyen bzlog sngags pa nus ldan gcigaḥ 'dza phan grin las 'gyed pa'i bla ma gcigaḥ sbyin pa rnam bzhi gtong ba'i khrims ldan gcigaX las kyi kha bskang thabs su rnam par bsagasaḥ yon tan phun sum tshogs pa ya mtshan cheḥ sa ma yuḥkhyad par lnga ldan gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa'oḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ de nas las la 'jug pa niḥ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes dang gsumaḥ dang po spyor ba'i las la yangaḥ rnam grangs bco lnga'i sgo nas bstanaḥ dang po sa gzhi brtag pa laḥ ra ba 'bring po tha chung bzhi: lto 'phye nyal tshul mtshan ma brtag: lto ba las ni dngos grub zhu: rang byung da la'i gzhi ma byaḥ pho nya yul gzhi thams cad laḥ 'dod don dngos grub zhu ba niḥ dkar gtor rnam lngas brgyan pa laḥ dar tshon bal tshon shug rtsis mdzesaḥ sngags drug phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabasaḥ snyan pa'i

dbyangs bcas 'di skad doḥ e ma hoḥ ngo mtshar rmad byung bkra shis phun tshogs kyiḥ dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub cing bzhengs ba laḥ dngos grub chen po mi 'gyur g.yung drung ltaraḥnub pa med pa gang ga'i rgyun bzang bzhinaḥ 'gag med yongs su stsol bar bya ba'i phyiraḥ sa bdag lto 'phye sa tshon bdag po lngaḥ sa gzhi skyong mdzad yul gzhi dkar phyogs skyongaḥ'akhor bcas 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i mchod gtor bzhesaḥ ru nga phrag dog 'khu ldog mi byed paraḥ dbang chen lto gter rin chen sna lnga'i bcudaḥ yo drang thig gis phyes la legs par stsolaḥ rat+na e rda bā ling ta khā hiḥ lan gsum brjod la gtor skyems mchodaḥ 'dod pa'i don smon sa gzhi btsalaḥ sa ma yuḥ gnyis pa sa yi lha mo laḥ rin chen gzhi ma bslang ba niḥ gtor skyems bsham zhing byin gyis brlabasaḥ bdag bskyed mchod bstod grub pa'i rjesaḥ gnas yid du 'ong zhing bkra shis pa la dbang chen bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin sa yi lha mo byon par bsam laḥ hūṃ hrīḥ bkra shis mi 'gyur srid pa 'degs pa'i gzhiḥ dgos 'byung rin chen gser gyi sa khams laḥ mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i bstan ma

bsgo/ chen mo niḥ tha tshig bzhin du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsolaḥ bhu mi pa tai sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūṃ hrīḥ bcom ldan shāka thub pad+ma saṃ bha wa'iḥ bstan pa gnyan la dgyes shing so kha bsrungaḥ legs nyes stangs 'dzin dbang chen sa yi bdagaḥ lha mo bstan ma mchog la phyag 'tshal loḥ na re na ma hoḥ mjes paliku mud dri zhim bdug pa sbosaḥ dbang gi sgron me bde ba'i dri chab dngaḥ ro ldan zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo rnamasaḥ dbang chen sa yi lha mo dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ a ma hā pañtsa pu dza hoḥhūṃ hrīḥ bstan pa'i dbu bstod skye 'gro yongs kyi mgonaḥ dam ldan sgrub la dngos grub char chen 'bebasaḥ bde legs dpal bskyed ma la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dgyes bskang phyiraḥ bkra shis rdzas rtags 'dod yon lnga ldan pa'iḥ kun bzang mchod pa 'bul lo dgyes brtses bzhesaḥ dkyil 'khor sa gzhi bdag la stsol ba dngaḥ sgrub pa'i 'bras bu dus su smin par mdzodaḥ bla bhu mi pa tai sarba rat+na e de bā ling ta khā hiḥ lan bdun gyis phul la dgyes pa bskangasaḥ de nas tha tshig bsgrags pa laḥ hūṃ

hrīḥ rgyal ba shākya seng ge yisaḥ bstan pa rin chen gnyer byang gtadaḥ sgrub pa'i grogs su bsgo ba byedaḥ tha tshig dus la da bab poḥ las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzodaḥ ces se gol gyi sgras bskul te lha mos zhal 'dzum brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas nasaḥ rnal 'byor sgrub pa po khyed kyis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin du dkyil 'khor kyi sa gzhi phul zhing phrin las sgrub po zhes khas blangs shing phyag byas nas sa la thim par bsam laḥ me tog 'thor zhing rol mo 'khrolaḥ gnad kyis gegs med yid bzhin 'grubaḥ sa ma yuḥgasum pa sa gzhi brlabs pa niḥ dri bzang ba byung chu gtsang nyidaḥ slob dpon srin mdzub kyis blangs teḥ/ sngi bkra shes gzhim phun sum tshogs pa yangaḥ yon tan ldan phyir ba byung rnam pa lngaḥ tshul khrims dag phyir dri bzang spos chu yisaḥ nyes skyon dri ma dag phyir chag chag gdabaḥ bla sarba se shwa dha na ya sa sa le le badz+ra marnyal sbyoḥ da la gsum bskor chag chag gdabaḥ gnad des yon tan phun tshogs 'gyuraḥ sa ma yāḥ bzhi pa rdo rjer bslabs pa niḥ slob dpon dpa' bo'i 'gros stabs kyisaḥ / hrīḥ bdag nyid dpal chen yongs

btsasdo 'dus he ru ga'iḥ mig gnyis maḥdang ṭaḥlas byung ba yisaḥ nyi zla gnyis las me yi tshwa tshwa 'phrosaḥ bar chad 'byung po rdul du brlag pa dngaḥ dus mtha'i me dang rtsa sbur 'phrad pa bzhinaḥ sor rtog ye shes chen por ram̐ ram̐ phaṭaḥ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃḥbadz+ra dz+wa la mar+bhal ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod thun gyis brabaḥ da la lan gsum bskor bar byaḥ sa ma yuḥ lnga pa stong nyid rol pa ༄ཿ sa gzhi mtshan 'dzin sbyangs ba niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ gdos por bzung ba'i mtshan ma thams cad kunaḥ ye shes chos sku thig le nyag gcig steḥ stong par brdal te nyag gcig dgongs pa skyongaḥ dbying phyug yum gyi ngo bocas ma hoḥ oṃ ma hā shun+ya ta sogs ko3nyaḥ dmigs pa med pa'i sa bzung zhingaḥ stong pa nyid kyi dgongs rgyas btabaḥ sa ma yāḥdrug pa sa bzung bsrung ba niḥrdo rje'i gar dang stang stabs bsgyuraḥ khro phur bkram la 'di skad doḥ ( (ཿ gu gul dud spro bar chad bgegs tshogs bsgradaḥ rak+ta byug pas stobs dang gzi mdangs bstedaḥ yungs dkar khro bo'i phyag mdas nyes tshogs bsalaḥ phyogs bcu'i gdon 'dul dpa' bo'i stobs su bzhengasaḥ

garma duṣ+ṭa phaṭaḥrak+ta ha ha hūṃḥ sarba bisnan mā ra ya phaṭaḥ slob dpon sngags kyi chas su zhugasaḥ tho chen phur ba thogs nas suḥ / (ཿ khro chen hūṃ shar sgra 'byin masaḥ lha gdon pho mo zil gnon mdzodaḥ sa badz+ra kro ta hūṃ ka ra hūṃḥ lha gdon pho mo gardza gardza gī li ki la ya sarba du ca hūṃ phaṭaḥ phur pa shar stod gdon la 'debasaḥ hūṃ hūṃḥ khro chen rnal rgyal mda' snyems masaḥ dri za pho mo zil gnon mdzodaḥ sa badz+ra kro ta bi dza ya (ཿ dri za pho mo ha na ha na gī li ki la ya sarba du ca hūṃ phaṭaḥ phur pa shar gyi gdon la gdabaḥ hūṃ hūṃḥ khro chen dbyug sngon sder mo yisaḥ drang sgong pho mo zil gnon mdzodaḥ sa badz+ra kro ta ni lan+tan tra 〉ཿ me lha pho mo da ha da ha gī li ki la ya sarba du ca hūṃ phaṭaḥ phur ba shar lho'i gdon la gdabaḥ hūṃ (ཿ khro chen gshin rje dur bdag masaḥ yi dwags pho mo zil gnon mdzodaḥ a badz+ra kro ta ya man+ta ka hūṃḥ gshin rje pho mo pa tsa pa tsa gī li ki la ya sarba duṣ+ṭa hūṃ phaṭaḥphur pa lto yi gdon la gdabaḥ hūṃ hūṃḥ khro chen mi g.yo gtun khung masaḥ laṅka pho mo zil gnon mdzod3 rja badz+ra kro ta ar+ya a tsa la hūṃḥ srin po pho mo bhasmyo bhasmyo gī li ki la ya sarba

bsgo/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnam grangs niḥ sum cu rtsa lnga dag gis bstanaḥ dang po shar gyi tho 'dzug niḥrnam lnga nyer spyod bkod pa rnamasaḥ bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa niḥ hūṃ bisnan ta kri ta phaṭaḥ ma sā bha wa sogs shud+dhi3nyaḥ mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid lasaḥ t+t+waṃḥlas rin chen snod nang duḥ kakakaka phyi nang gsang gsum gyiḥ mchod sprin nam mkha'i khams gang gyuraḥ nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum dngaḥ a ka ro yis 'dzad med spelaḥ de nas tho byang bskyed pa niḥ skye ma hā shun+ya — sogasako3nyaḥtho byang mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid lasaḥ rang byung shel gyi gzhal med gru bzhi paḥsgo khyud mtshan rdzogs rgya khyon yangs pa'i dbusaḥbaiḥlas byung ba'i rgyal chen yul 'khor srungaḥ dkar gsal rab brjid pi waṃ bsgyur thabs 'dzinaḥ dung rmog dung khrab dar dpyangs swag lham mdzesaḥ 'ja' sprin 'od 'khyug 'jigs tshogs zil gyis gnonaḥ dri za bye ba 'bum sde'i 'khor gyis bskoraḥ dam tshig 'od kyis bskul te ye shes bstimaḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa niḥ kyeḥ phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki naḥ nyi ma shar

phyogs pha gi nasaḥ dri za'i rgyal po yul 'khor srungaḥ 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsolaḥ rang bzhin gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyangaḥ dam tshig rten dang gnyis med bzhugs: phrin las bsgrub phyir phyag 'tshal loḥ skyed dhi ṭa raṣ+ṭa ye sa pa ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥbadz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ na mo na ma hūṃḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba niḥhūṃḥ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog sposaḥ mar me dri chab zhal zas rolaḥ 'dod yon mchod pa bsam mi khyabaḥ sku gsung thugs la dgyes par 'bulaḥ bla ma hā pañtsa pu tsa hoḥ 6) dzhaiṭa raṣ+ṭa ye sa pa ri wa ra e de ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ lan bdun gyis phul phrin bcol niḥ hoḥ rgyal chen 'khor bcas dgongs su gsolaḥ bdag gi sgrub pa zab mo 'diḥ dbu nas mthar ma phyin bar duX phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad bzlogaḥ dngos grub sgrub pa'i srung ma mdzodaḥ rten la brtan par bzhugs su gsolaḥ bzhugs nas phrin las thogs med sgrubasaḥ dam la ma 'da' sa ma āḥ o dhi ṭa raṣ+ṭa ye sa pa ri wa ra sa ma ya rak+ta rak+taḥ o su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hāḥ me tog 'thor zhing rab tu gnasaḥ de nas shis pa brjod pa niḥ

badz+ra hoḥ shar nas bkra shis don gyi lhaḥ mi 'gyur rdo rje sems dpa' yiḥ 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i bkra shis gangaḥ deng 'dir bde legs stsal du gsolaḥ ces brjod dri za la sogs pa'iḥ shar phyogs rkyen snang ma lus zhiḥ sa ma yāḥ gnyis pa lto yi tho byang niḥ mchod rdzas byin brlabs gong ltar laḥ bskyed chog dngos ni 'di lta steḥ sa ma hā shukhye sogs tho byang mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid lasaḥ rang byung be+eḍūr+ya yi gzhal med khang: gru bzhi sgo rgyan mtshan rdzogs yangs pa'i dbusaḥ be+eḥlas byung ba'i rgyal chen 'phags skyes poḥ sngo nag khro gtum ral gri phyed byung mdzadaḥ mgo rmog lcags khrab dar dpyangs sug lham brjidaḥ me rlung rab 'khrigs gdon tshogs zil gyis gnonaḥ khrul bum gshin rje bye ba 'bum sdes bskoraḥ dam tshig 'od kyis bskul te ye shes bstimaḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: kyeḥ phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi naḥ nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi nasaḥgrul baṃ rgyal po 'phags skyes poḥ 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsolaḥ rang bzhin gnas nas gshegs nas kyangaḥ bskyed pa'i lha dang gnyis med bzhugs: phrin las sgrub

phyir phyag 'tshal loḥ 3 be+e ru ta ka ye sa pa ri badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha na mo na ma de nas mchod pa 'bul ba niḥhūṃ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog sogs dgyes par 'bulaḥ.oṃ ma hā pañtsa oṃ be+e ru ta ka ye sogs hiḥ lan bdun gyis phul phrin bcol ba niḥ ho rgyal chen 'khor bcas dgongs su sogs ma āḥ 37 be+e ru ta ka ye sa sogasarak+taḥ ka su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra me tog 'thor zhing rab tu gnasaḥ de nas shis pa brjod pa niḥ ho lto nas bkra shis don gyi lhaḥ 'dod 'byung rin chen 'byung ldan gyiḥ 'byor drug rgyas pa'i bkra shis gangaḥ deng 'dir bde legs stsal du gsolaḥ ces brjod grul bum la sogs pa'i: lho yi skyen snang bar tu zhiḥ sa ma yāḥ gsum pa nub kyi tho byang niḥ mchod gtor byin brlabs gong ltar laḥ bskyed chog dngos ni 'di lta steḥs ma hā shun+ya sogs tho byang mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid lasaḥ rang byung pad+ma rā ga'i gzhal med khang:gru bzhi sgo rgyan mtshan rdzogs yangs pa'i dbusaḥ biḥlas byung ba'i rgyal chen spyan mi bzangaḥ dmar gsal sgeg bzhad mchod rten sbrul zhags 'dzinaḥ zangs rmog zangs khrab dar

badz+ralho dpyangs sag s+t+waṃ mdzesaḥ dud sprin 'khrigs klong log 'dren zil gyis gnonaḥ klu dbang bye ba 'bum sde'i 'khor gyis bskoraḥ dam tshig 'od kyis bskul te ye shes bstimaḥ de nas spyan 'dren bya ba niḥ kyi phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi naḥ nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi nasaḥ klu dbang rgyal po spyan mi bzangaḥ 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsolaḥ rang bzhin gnas nas gshegs nas kyangaḥ dam tshig rten dang gnyis med bzhugs: phrin las sgrub phyir gus phyag 'tshalaḥ snyen be+eru bha k+ta ye sogs na ma hūṃḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba niḥ hūṃX mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog sogs 'bulaḥ bla ma hā pañtsa oṃ be+e ru bha k+ṣa ye sogs hiḥ lan bdun gyis phul phrin bcol niḥ ho rgyal chen 'khor bcas dgongs su sogs ma yāḥ o miru bha k+ta ye sogs rak+taḥ sa su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra me tog 'thor zhing rab tu gnasaḥ de nas shis pa brjod pa niḥ stonub nas bkra shis don gyi lhaḥ chags bral 'od zer mtha' yas pa'iḥ khams gsum dbang sdud bkra shis paḥ deng 'dir bde legs stsal du gsolaḥ ces brjod klu dbang la

sogs pa'iḥ nub phyogs rkyen snang ma lus zhiḥ sa ma yuḥbazhipa byang gotho byang niḥ mchod gtor byin rlabs gong ltar laḥ bskyed par bya ba 'di lta steḥbla ma hā shun+ya sogasatho byang mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid lasaḥ rang byung gser gyi gzhal med gru bzhi paḥ sgo khyud rgyan rdzogs 'od 'bar yangs pa'i nangaḥ bi las byung ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos srasaḥbatso bsregs mdangs 'bar rgyal mtshan ne'u le bsnamasaḥ g.yu rmog g.yu khrab dar ljang sag s+t+waṃ brjedaḥ me rlung sprin dbus log 'dren dpa' bskong zhingaḥ gnod sbyin bye ba 'bum sde'i 'khor gyis bskor dam tshig 'od kyis bskul te ye shes bstimaḥ de nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni: kyeḥ phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi naḥ nyi ma byang phyogs pha gi nasaḥganod sbyin rgyal po rnam thos srasaḥ 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsolaḥ rang bzhin gnas nas gshegs nas kyangaḥ dam tshig rten dang gnyis med bzhugs: phrin las sgrub phyir phyag 'tshal loḥ 37 be+e shra ma ṇa ye sa sogs na ma 〉ཿ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba niḥ shāḥ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog sogs pu tsa hoḥsgo pi ma ṇa ye sa pa ri

btsan sogs hiḥ lan bdun gyis phul phrin bcol niḥnyo rgyal chen 'khor bcas dgongs su sogs ma yāḥ oṃ be+e shra ma ṇa ye sogs rak+ta rak+taḥ a su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra me tog 'thor zhing rab tu gnasaḥ de nas shis pa brjod pa niX hoḥ byang nas bkra shis don gyi lhaḥ rtsal rdzogs don yod grub pa yiḥ drag po mthar phyin phrin las gangaḥ deng 'dir bde legs stsal du gsolaḥ ces brjod gnod sbyin la sogs pa'iḥ byang phyogs rkyen snang zhi bar 'gyuraḥ sa ma yuḥ lnga pa phyi yi sgo srung niḥ mchod gtor byin gyis brlabs pa laḥ bsangs sbyangs grub nas 'di skad doḥ sa las rin chen snod nang duḥ kakakaka mchod sprin zad med gyuraḥ oṃlas bhan+ta yangs pa sa holas gtor ma phun tshogs gyuraḥ sa āḥhūṃ dang ha ho hrīḥ nam mkha' mdzod sngags a ka rosaḥ sbyangs spel bsgyur la byin gyis brlabasaḥ de nas rten bskyed 'di ltar roḥ oṃ ma hā shun+ya sogasako3nyaḥ mdun gyi tho byang mi dmigs stong par gyuraḥ de yi ngang las me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbusaḥ (ཿlas khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po niḥ sngo nag khro gtum 'jigs rung bzod

par dka'aḥ gar gyi nyams rdzogs thod dbyug bhan+ta bsnamasaḥ dur khrod chas rdzogs gyad kyi 'dor stabs bsgradaḥ bdud bgegs dam sri pho mo zil gyis gnonaḥ sku las khro chung nyi rdul bzhin du spro: thugs srog 'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs bstimaḥ de nas spyan 'dren bya ba niḥ hūṃ ༷ rang bzhin rnam dag gzhal yas nasaḥ khro rgyal ya man+ta ka niḥ 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsolaḥ rten la brtan par bzhugs par 'tshalaḥ dngos grub stsol phyir phyag 'tshal loḥ snyed badz+ra 17 ta ya man+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ na mo na ma (ཿ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ rnam dag phyi nang gsang mchod sprinaḥ kun bzang rol pa chen po dngaḥ brjid ldan dpal gyi gtor chen poḥ phrin las sgrub phyir 'bul gyis bzhesaḥ glu ma hā pañtsa pu tsa hoḥ snyed ya man+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra e dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ lan bdun gyis phul phrin bcol niḥ he gzhal yas chen po'i sgo bsrung ba'iḥ khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po dgongasaḥ bdag gi sgrub pa zab mo 'diḥ dbu nas mthar ma phyin par srungasaḥ bar du gcod pa'i bgegs tshogs sgolaḥ

gtsa/ dngos grub phyi ru mi g.yel zhingaḥ dam sri nang du mi tshud pa'iḥ rdo rje bsrung ba'i ra gur dkrigasaḥ dus la bab po sa ma yāḥ oṃ ya man+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya rak+ṣa rak+taḥ ma su pratiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hāḥ me tog 'thor zhing rab tu gnasaḥ de nas shis pa brjod pa niḥhoḥrdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byedaḥ ha ha'i gad rgyang hi hi sgogasaḥmi shig rdo rje'i bkra shis gangaḥ deng 'dir bde legs rtsal du gsolaḥ ces brjod gshin rje sde brgyad sogasaḥ ma rung gdon rnams zhi bar 'gyuraḥ sa ma yuḥ drug pa dam sri mnan pa laḥ liṅga dbang tshang rta rmig btsud: brub khung nang du bkod par byaḥ de nas e bskyed rim pa niḥ e dzaX mdun du gru gsum las kyi btson khang rgya che la gting zab pa'i nang du tritshopas sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dam sri 'byung po thams cad nyam thag pa'i gzugs can du gyuraḥ na moḥ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal 'o/ཿmchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum rig 'dzin rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dngaḥ bden gnyis baspu ba med pa'i nus stobs kyisaḥ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'tshe

zhing sems can la gnod cing rgol baḥ khyad par du sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gnod byed dam sri 'byung po thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la myur du khug cigatri ā gar+sha ya dzaḥ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ gsum bdun dgu sogs gang skabs brjodaḥ de nas 'gugs 'ching sdom myos niḥdṛḥtriḥbadz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ ru tra pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ pad+ma bhan+ta sbo ṭa baṃḥ karma ghaṣ+ṭi a we sha ya a āḥ de nas nyes pa bsgrags pa niḥ dzaḥ phung dre nag po las ngan 'disaḥ rdo rje sgob dpon sku la bsdosaḥ gsang ba'i 'du sgo gnyan po bkagaḥ mched lcam bar la mkhon 'dzings slongaḥ dge ba bcu po khyad du bsadaḥ mi dge bcu po dang du blangasaḥ mtshams med lnga yi 'bras bu sminaḥ 'di la bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshangaḥ thugs rje thabs kyis ma btul naḥ rgyal bstan rin chen 'jig la nyertsa las ngan thar ba'i dus med pasaḥ da lta nyid du mngon spyod kyiḥ dus la bab po sa ma yuḥ de nas phur gdab bya ba niḥ dzaḥ rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcodaḥ mtshon chen 'bar ba ki la yaḥ snying rje chen po'i brtul zhugs kyisaḥ dam sri'i snying la mā ra yaḥ bla badz+ra kro ta gī li ki

bsgo/ la ya sarba dū tra sha hūṃ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ zhes phur ba dam sri'i snying gar gdab pas dran pa nyams nas brgyal bar bsam laḥ dza dzaḥ sa 'og taing 'jen las bskyed sgromaḥ lcags khang sgo med gru gsum nangaḥ dam sri 'byung po kun tshud nasaḥ 'phar ldang 'gul bskyod mi nus paraḥ ye shes lnga yi bro rgyas gdabaḥ khro bo khro mo'i gar gyis bcomaḥ ma hā bha la'i stobs kyis mnanaḥ ma āḥ( swā hāḥ stum bha ya nanaḥrgyal ba byams pa'i bstan pa ma byung bar du dam sri rnams 'phar ldang g.yo 'gul mi nus bar bsam moḥ sa chu me rlung rgya yis gdabaḥ ban dang bon gyi phyag rgyas btabaḥ las kyi shul mi mngon par byaḥ gnad des sgrub pa'i skyen gegs zhiḥ gtor ma cha gsum spyi ltar gtongaḥsgrub pa'i 'bras bu gegs med 'grubaḥ sa ma yāḥ bdun pa nang sgo bsrung ba niḥ mchod gtor byin rlabs gong ltar laḥ rten bskyed bya ba'i rim pa niḥ.a ma hā shu n+ya sogasako3nyaḥ mdun gyi tho byang mi dmigs stong par gyuraḥ de yi ngang las ye shes me sang duḥ gyilas khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil ba niḥ ljang sngon zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba

gtsigasaḥ spyan gsum rab bsgrad smar smin me ltar 'baraḥ rdo rje rgya gram bsdig mdzub phyag rgya mdzadaḥ dur khrod chas rdzogs gar dgu'i nyams dang ldanaḥ bdud bgegs dam sri 'byung po zil gyis gnonaḥ khro chung las byed pho mo sprin ltar gtibasaḥ thugs srog 'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs bstimaḥ de nas spyan 'dren bya ba niḥ hūṃḥ gsang chen mori 'bar ba nasaḥ khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil ba niḥ 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsolaḥ rten la brtan par rab bzhugs nasaḥ dngos grub stsol phyir phyag 'tshal loḥ bla badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kur+bha li sa pa ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ na mo na ma hūṃḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba niḥ / hrīḥ rnam dag phyi nang gsang gsum gyiḥ mchod sprin kun bzang rol ba dngaḥ 'dod 'byung dpal gyi gtor chen po: phrin las grub phyir 'bul gyis bzhesaḥ au ma hā pañtsa pu tsa hoX o badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kusnyo li sa pa ri wa ra e dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ lan bdun gyis phul phrin bcol niḥ hoḥ dkyil 'khor nang gi sgo srung baḥ khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dgongasaḥ bdag gi bsnyen sgrub zab mo 'diḥ

gtsa/ dbu nas mthar ma phyin par srungasaḥ dus drug nyul zhing 'khor ba'i bgegasaḥ chos kyi dbyings su bsgral ba dngaḥ mchog thun dngos grub ma lus paḥ gegs med myur du stsal du gsolaḥ thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yuḥ skyid badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya rak+ta rak+taḥ bla su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hāḥ me tog 'thor zhing rab tu gnasaḥ de nas shis pa brjod pa niḥ hoḥ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shingaḥ bgegs rnams 'joms shing dngos grub stsolaḥ rdo rje bdud 'dul bkra shis gangaḥ deng 'dir bde legs stsal du gsolaḥ ces brjod dam sri 'byung po yiḥ bar chad rkyen snang zhi bar 'gyuraḥ sa ma āḥ brgyad pa ma tram̐ bsgral ba laḥ gzhi la lcags snod yangs pa'i dbusaḥm tram̐ liṅka dbang tshang baḥ skang lag lcags kyi gzer bus btabaḥ sgra gzengs gshog bskyang tshul du byaḥ de nas e bskyed bya ba niḥ rta mchog rol ba'i nga rgyal gyisaḥ e dzaḥmadun du lcags khang gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang duḥ dzaḥtriḥyongs su gyur pa lasaḥ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam la bar du gcod pa'i bdud ma tram̐ rū tra thams cad mgo 'phang

dma' la dpa' rtsal zhum pa'i rang bzhin can du bskyed doḥ de nas bden pa brdar ba niḥ ral spri thog shing phur ba 'drilaḥ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad phyag rgya yisaḥ na moḥ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal 'o/ཿ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dngaḥ dbang chen gsung mchog rol ba'i bden pa dngaḥ khro rgyal h+ya k+ṣ-i wa'i bden pa dngaḥ pad+ma gzi ldan chen mo'i bden pa dngaḥ bka' nyan byi la pu shud gdong pa can gyi bden pa dang: zil gnon khro rgyal yab yum bcu drug gi bden pa dngaḥ pho nya dmus long bcu drug gi bden pa dngaḥbaka' nyan khyi spyang bcu drug gi bden pa dngaḥ sprul pa me 'brug rlung 'brug drwa ba ste/ga 'gyu ma rnams kyi bden pa dngaḥ pad+ma gsung /rilha dzadzags sprul pa yang sprul phyag brnyan dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dngaḥ bden pa chen po de dag gi mthu dang nus pa la brten nasaḥ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'tshe zhing sems can gyi bde skyid bcom par byed pa'i bdud ma tram̐ ru tra thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la myur du khug cigaḥdṛḥtre+eḥ.a ༷r+sha ya dzaḥ dzaḥshā baṃ hoḥ bdun dgu nyer gcig la sogs brjodaḥ de nas 'gugs 'ching

ras phur pa rū tra'i snying gar btab pas tsit+ta phyung ste bdag he ru ka la bstabs par bsamaḥ dpal chen king ka ra nus stobs 'bar bas shes rab ral gri'i rno ngar la drangs nas rū tra'i phung khams dum bur gtubs par bsam laḥ sa (ཿ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' yiḥ sku gsung thugs las 'gyed pa'i srasaX las mdzad dpal chen k+ko raḥrū tra'i phung khams dum bur gtubasaḥ hūṃ hūṃX rū tra'i zhe sdang rtsad gcod phyiraḥ lag g.yas phrol zhig mā ra yaḥ nga rgyal drung nas 'byin pa'i phyiraḥ lag g.yon phyungs shig mā ra yaḥ'adod chags rgya mtsho skems pa'i phyiraḥ rkang g.yon chod cig mā ra yaḥ phrag dog rlung 'tshubs gtor ba'i phyiraḥ rkang g.yas 'byin zhig mā ra yaḥ gti mug mun pa bsal ba'i byiraḥ mgo bo phrol zhig mā ra yaḥ rū tra'i skye rgyud drung 'byin byeraḥ mtshan ma phyung shig mā ra yaḥ 'khor ba ru log gting 'byin phyiraḥ zo khog phrol cig mā ra maḥ ma rig gzhi la bsgral ba'i phyiraḥ nang khrol 'byin zhig mā ra yaX tshogs dag phyir du rdzas brgyad bkodaḥ yul brgyad grol phyir dur khrod bsgrunaḥ gsang chen he ru ka dpal gyiḥ bkod pa rmad

bas/ byungathasgo ma hoḥ hūṃ (ཿ lag g.yas dur khrod bsil ba'i tshalaḥ lag pa g.yon pa sku la rdzogasaḥ rkang g.yas pad+ma brtsegs pa dngaḥ rkang g.yon dur khrod lang ka brtsegasaḥ zo khog dur khrod bde chen brdalaḥ mgo bo dur khrod gsang chen rolaḥ nang khrol dur khrod he chen brdalaḥ mtshan ma dur khrod 'jig rten brtsegasaḥ brag shing me rlung sprin mtsho dngaḥ rig 'dzin grub thob lha dbang dngaḥ phyogs skyong me lha zhing skyong dngaḥ rlung lha phra men lce spyang kluḥ brgyad brgyad bkod pa phun sum tshogasaḥ gsang chen rang byung he ru'i gnasaḥ ya mtshan rmad du byung ba steḥ bde legs dpal gyi 'byung gnas sharaḥ rū tra maṇ+ḍal hūṃḥ badz+ra spa ra ṇa phaṭaḥ se ha ra ṇa 〉ཿ ces ma nor legs par bkodaḥ khro bcu'i bsrung phur rnams kyang bkramaḥ gnad des sgrub pa mthar phyin zhingaḥ rtags mtshan mngon sum brtes bar 'gyuraḥ sa ma yuḥ dgu pa dur dzadad byin 'bebs niḥ sha chen dud btang zhun me sbaraḥ rol mo sna tshogs sgra sbir zhing: snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad doḥ hūṃ hūṃḥ byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnasaḥ shar phyogs dur khrod bsil ba'i tshalaḥ

mchod rten rang byung bde byed brtsegasaḥ rū tra'i snying dang stobs bzang roḥ ma mo ko ri bhan dmar 'dzinaḥ shing chen nya yi sdong po seraḥ zhing skyong gnam 'phro glang gi mgoḥ phyogs skyong brgya byin mig stong ldanaḥ mtsho nang klu rgyal mtha' yas dkar: sprin dkar 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs spro: rig 'dzin grub thoba3 ka raḥ slob dponapad+ma bdebyed 'baraḥ'akhor bcas 'dir gshegs byin phob cig a/ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni sarba hring hring āḥ hūṃ byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas: lto phyogs dur khrod sku la rdzogasaḥ mchod rten chen po rin chen brtsegasaḥ rū tra'i mgo dang 'chi bdag roḥ tso ri ser mo mda' gzhu 'gengasaḥ shing chen tsun+ta sngo la rgyasaḥ zhing skyong 'tsho byed ma he'i gdongaḥ phyogs skyong mthing nag thod dbyug 'dzinaḥ gser mtsho'i 1nga na 'jog po seraḥ 'dod 'byung sprin ser rab tu sdudaḥ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshos gnyen dngaX rig 'dzin chen po ro la nga dgyesaḥ 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs byin phob cigaḥ yi badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni sarba 〉ཿ byen chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnasaḥ nub phyogs dur khrod pad+ma brtsegasaḥ mchod

btsan rten rang byung bde rgyas dkaraḥ rū tra'i ba su stobs ldan roḥ pra mo chu srin rgyal mtshan 'dzinaḥ shing chen a bha a li gaḥ zhing skyong rol byed chu srin gdongaḥphyogs skyong chu lha sbrul zhags 'dzinaḥ mtsho nang klu rgyal dung skyong dkar: sprin chen 'jigs byed rab tu g.yoḥ rig 'dzin chen po klu grub snyingaḥ slob dpon tshangs rigs khyung zhon dmaraḥ 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs byin phob cigaḥ yi badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni sarba hūṃḥ byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnasaḥ byang phyogs dur khrod lang ka brtsegasaḥmachod rten rang byung dpe yi rjongaḥ rū tra'i mtshan ma khyab mjug roḥ be+e ta zhing dbyug bhan dmar 'dzinaḥ shing chen a su ta na ljangaḥ zhing skyong dud kha rta gdong canaḥ phyogs skyong gnod sbyin be con 'dzinaḥ mtsho nang klu rgyal stobs rgyu ljangaḥ myos sprin 'bar ba 'thor bur spro: slob dpon bram ze pra bha haḥ rig 'dzin ṭosbyi brtul zhugs ldanaḥ 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs byin phob cigaḥ slo badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki hūṃḥ byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnasaḥ shar lho dur khrod bde chen brdalaḥ mchod rten ko shan da la laḥ rū tra'i

lag g.yas dbang phyug roḥ puṣ+ka chen mo byis rgyu 'drenaḥ shing chen ne+e kro ta na rgyasaḥ zhing skyong 'byung po ra gdong seraḥ phyogs skyong me lha drang srong dgeḥ mtsho nang klu rgyal pad chen sngo: sprin chen sdud byed rab tu 'tshubasaḥ rig 'dzin dha na saṃ sgri taḥ slob dpon so khya dī wa dkaraḥ 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs byin phob cig ༷ o badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni sarba hūṃX byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas: lto nub dur khrod gsang chen rolaḥ rang byung mchod rten ka ni gaḥ rū tra'i lag g.yon stogs bdag roḥ karma rdo rje bhan dmar dkrugasaḥ shing chen bzhi khri gsang chen rolaḥ zhing skyong sprul pa mi gdong sngoḥ phyogs skyong srin po chung mar bcasaḥ mtsho nang klu chen pad+ma smug: sprin dpung gha na ser khra 'khyilaḥslob dpon bi ma mi tra dngaḥ rig 'dzin gar bsgyur ro langs zhonaḥ 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs byin phob cigaḥ o badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni sarba hūṃḥ byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnasaḥ nub byang dur khrod he chen brdalaḥ mchod rten bde rgyas ma hā bhaḥ rū tra'i rkang g.yon dzhai gi roḥ tsan+ta ser mo rgyu ma 'drenaḥ shing chen dag tsa ljang 'od 'baraḥ zhing

gtsa/ skyong lho 'phyang sha ba'i mgoḥ phyogs skyong rlung lha dud kha'i mgoḥ mtsho nang klu rgyal rigs ldan ljang sprin chen 'dod yon char ba 'bebasaḥ slob dpon raspru gu rgya dngaḥ rig 'dzin pad+ma ku lang nagaḥ 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs byin phob cigaḥ yi badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni sarba hūṃX byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnasaḥ byang shar dur khrod 'jin rten brtsegasaḥ mchod rten rang byung shing kun seraḥ dū tra'i rkang g.yas smin drug roḥ sme sha mthing nag bam ro zaḥ shing chen da la 'od 'bar dmaraḥ zhing skyong dregs pa lce spyang gdongaḥ phyogs skyong dbang ldan rtse gsum 'dzinaḥ mtsho nang klu rgyal ba su dkar: sprin 'khrigs nya chen nag po brjedaḥ slob dpon shan+ta ghar+bha dngaḥ rig 'dzin rdo rje gdong 'khrugs rtsalaḥ 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs byin phob cigaḥ bla badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni sarba (ཿ byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnasaḥ sgrub pa las kyi dkyil 'khor 'diraḥ gsang chen o rgyan he ru'i zhingaḥ dur khrod brgyad kyi bkod pa (3 byin chen rnams kyis byin phob cigaḥ dbang chen rnams kyis dbang bskur cigaḥ rtags dang mtshan ma

bstan pa dngaḥ marnyal brgyad ldan dngos grub stsolaḥ sgro badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni sarba tring hring āḥ ces brjod rol mo'i sgra dang bcasaḥ byin chen nan du dbab par byaḥ gnad des sgrub la bde drod 'baraḥ dngos grub gang ga'i rgyun bzhin sdudaḥ sa ma yāḥ bcu pa dkyil 'khor rgyan bkod niḥ rdo rje rgyal pos sbos ring thogasaḥ rgyal theb bum pa gsang yum gyisaḥ bhan+ta bdud rtsi btegs pa dngaḥ brda spyor bu gnyis yo byad bsnamasaḥ ging ka mched gnyis rdzas kun 'dzinaḥ 1 ma rgyang grags spun bzhi dngaḥ rdo rje gdong 'khrugs sna drangs nasaḥ da la lan gsum bskor ba steḥ rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas teḥ / hrīḥ bde gshegs gsang mdzad ye shes nyi ma sharaḥ ma rig dri ma sgrib tshogs dbyings su bsalaḥ 'gro phan phrin las mi nub 'od stong bkraḥ las smon mthu btsan gang zhu bde mchog ldanaḥ ( trīḥ 'og min chos dbyings rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' ldeng khri gong ma chos sku'i dkyil 'khor cheḥ mi g.yo mi shig bde 1nga yangs par 'khyilaḥ phyogs ris med pa bkra shis lha'i gzhal yasaḥ bde skyong bum bzang byang sems bcud kyis gtamasaḥ dri

gtsa/ bral ka nas dag pa dpe yi rdzasaḥmatshan ma tshig bral kun zlum a dar+shaḥsgrub dang dkyil 'khor yongs 'dus gsang rdzogs gteraḥzla phrom nyi zla kha sbyor bkra shis rdzasaḥzla rgyas smin gyi sgrom bus khams rnams gsoḥtshe rten pad 'khyil tshe rdzas nor bu spungasaḥtshe gtor zlum 'khyil tshe 'brang zla phyed gzugasaḥtshe sgrub mthar phyin mdzes pa'i da la bzhiḥbasod nams grub brgyad gter spel thod rdzas lngaḥsku gsung thugs yon phrin las rtags kyi rdzasaḥmi nub dad ldan gdul bya'i dpal du spro:hūṃ hrīḥrang gsal thabs mchog dpa' bo'i thugs 1nga duḥ'agags med bde mnyam rol pa chen po'i dalaḥzheng khri bar ma longs sku'i dkyil 'khor steḥbyin rlabs char 'bebs pad spungs nor bus mdzesaḥdangos grub dpal sdud rdo rjes rab brgyan gteraḥbade stong dga' sbar ḍāk+ki gsang rten dngaḥnor lha'i bang mdzod chos skyong rten rdzogs dngaḥyid bzhin gter ldan 'dod 'byung bsam 'phel dngaḥm chags dri bral las rnams lhun rdzogs dalaḥchos dbyings mi shig 'khor lo'i ka pā laḥsku gsung thugs yon phrin las

bcud kyis bkangaḥ lha dang ḍak+ki dpa' bo dpa' mo 'khrigasaḥ pañtsa stong sbyar rtsa ba brgyad dang ldanaḥ 'dod 'byung gtor ma lha mo'i spro bsdu byedaḥ gīrti'i mkha' gsang las bab rak+ta phyuraḥ ma 'gags bkod pa rang gsal bde ba cheḥ mnyam nyid bde bkod gdul bya'i dpal du sharaḥ hūṃ hrīḥ thugs rje ye mnyam kha sbyor bdun ldan dalaḥ cir yang 'char la gnyis su ma grub pa'iḥ ye shes zang thal rigs lnga yab yum dalaḥ med byung gsang gsum bsgrub pa'i dpal du sharaḥ kun rtog gnas dag ma rig mun sel ba'iḥ ye shes snang ba'i sgron me brgya rtsa brgyadaḥ mi nub tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho rdzogs pa'i phyiraḥ me sa ga ṇa tsakra ma da naḥ bkrag gsal mjes ldan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis mdzesaḥ phyi nang gsang sgeg 'dod yon lha mo niḥ brgya rtsa re re'i gar bsgyur mchod sprin 1ཿ dza gad a mṛ brgya rtsa bhan+t+rar brtenaḥ ba ling brjed ldan rak+ta brgya rtsa sogasaḥ bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid sna bdun dngaḥ zhen med rang grol 'dod yon bkod pa rnamasaḥ dbyings las bskrun te ye shes rol ba ruḥ khams gsum yongs rdzogs ma bcos sku gsum rdzogasaḥ o rgyan he

gas/ tsu ru'i zhing bkod phun sum tshogasaḥ spyo rat+na maltol badz+ra spra ra ṇa phaṭaḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa 〉ཿ ces brjod legs par bkram par byaḥ yo 'khyog bral dang bral ba gcesaḥ gnad des sku gsum zhing bkod steḥ dngos grub zab mo dus su sminaḥ sa ma yuḥ bcu gcig rgyan rnams bkram pa niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ skye med dbyings las ma 'gags rol pa cheḥsku gsum lhun grub yid bzhin rat+na'i dalaḥ sgrub mchog rnal 'byor yongs la rnam par sharaḥ mdzad pa phrin las rgya mtshom ma ho : hrīḥ mnyam brdal byang chub sems kyi bla bre laḥ mi nub phrin las dra ba dra phyed 'phyangaḥ bgegs bdud 'chi bdag pha rol g.yul bzlog phyiraḥ phyogs las rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan mdzes pa bzhiḥ 'gyur med thugs rje byams dga' btang snyoms bzhiX yon tan rab spud dar gyi 'phan yab bzhiḥ phyogs ris bral ba sku gsum ye shes lnga'iḥ brda don rtags rdzogs dar sna'i 'phur ma canaḥ tshad med 'gro 'dul phyin drug stobs ldan rtagasaḥ dar gyi chun 'phyang rus pa'i rgyan cha mdzesaḥ 'dod yon zhen med rang grol rol ba'i phyiraḥ dpa' bo dpa' mo ging dang pho nya 'khrigasaḥ

gzhan snang zil gnon dug gsum gdon 'dul rtagasaḥstag gzigs sham thabs 'od 'bar rab tu klubasaḥrdzu 'phrul thogs med bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i rtagasaḥrdo rje'i rkang pa mi 'gyur bzhi la brtenaḥskye ba rnam bzhi dbyings su bcom pa'i brdaraḥmadzes pa'i ral gri bzhi yis legs par brgyanaḥrigs lnga'i 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i phyiraḥ'od 'bar mda' dar bzhi yis mngon par bstodaḥ bdud dpung zil gnon 'khor 'das mnyam rol brdaraḥ rab rngams lcags phur bzhi yis rnam par brtenaḥ phyi nang zang thal 'od gsal nyag gcig dalaḥ rab mdzes dngas gsal me long bzhi yi mtshanaḥ 'khor 'das lto sbyor bde klong nyag gcig brdaraḥ'od 'bar yol ba dar gyi 'phur ma canaḥ'akhor los bsgyur rgyal srid zhi dbang sdud rtagasaḥ rat+na'i tog mdzes dri ma kun dang bralaḥ dam ye ro gcig ye nas lhun grub phyiraḥrdo rje gzungs thag lu gu rgyud du 'brelaḥ dam can pho nya 'du 'bral med pa'i rtagasaḥtshangs chen mched gnyis bdud rtsi 'bral med 'grogasaḥ thams cad ma 'gags kun bzang rgyan rol pa'iḥ phyi nang gsang mchod dngos

btsan 'dzin dag par sharaḥ ye shes gcig la rnam rol mtha' yas paḥ bde gshegs sku gsum bkod pa ngo mtshar gnas: sgyu 'phrul bde mchog rdo rje'i gsang lam steḥ ma 'gags bzhin du 'dzin med so ma skyongasaḥ gang shar rang grol don la mnyam par bzhagaḥ sa āḥ(ཿ dzñā na sa mā ti badz+ra spa ra ṇa phaṭaḥ se ha ra ṇa 〉ཿ ces brjod sbyan gyi bye brag kunaḥ rnam par bkram nas yid 'ong byaḥ de nas sgrub pa cher brtson naḥ don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyuraḥ sa ma yuḥ bcu gnyis rdol dril byin brlabs niḥ sa ma hā badz+ra hūṃḥ hrīḥ mtshan rtog mi dmigs rdo rje btsun mo'i sangaḥ thabs mchog rdo rje ye shes kun gyi gsangaḥ yar gyi rwa lnga thabs mchog dpa' bo yabaḥ mar lnga bde stong shes rab yum gyi mkha'aḥ yas pad sems dpa' ma'i pad sems ma'i dal: lte ba kun zlum byang chub sems kyi dbyingasaḥ mnyam gnas mnyam par sgrol ba'i brtul zhugs kyisaḥbade gshegs thugs kyi rdo rje mngon du byaḥ phyar gzir gdengs thabs phyag rgya gar bsgyur gyisaḥ 'khor ba ru bzlog chos sku nyag gcig ngangaḥ ma badz+ra tsit+ta ma hā su kha hūṃḥ lan

gsum brjod la rdo rje niḥ thugs gar brten zhing gdengs thabs byaḥ upra dzñā dzñā na hūṃḥ gnyis rtog dra ba mi gnas dbu mar brdalaḥ bde stong ma 'gags shes rab dril bu'i gzugasaḥ sku lngas 'gro don mdzad pa'i rwa lnga dngaḥ rgyu brgyad pa dang sbyor ba'i pad 'dab brgyadaḥ nges pa lnga ldan 'og min rnam snang zhalaḥ chos gzugs 'du 'bral med pa'i mgul gsang dngaḥ pho brang zlum po chos kyi 'khor lo'i dalaḥ 'khor 'das mnyam rol dra ba dra phyed dngaḥ mi 'gyur spros bral rdo rje'i phreng bas brtenaḥ thabs chen dpa' bo'i rdzas kyis tshangs dbyings bskulaḥ ma rig mal dub 'gro ba'i gnyid dkrogs shingaḥ thig le nyag gcig bde sang yangs par bskyilaḥ thabs shes zung 'jug ma hā mu hā'i lamaḥzung 'jug rdo rje'i rgyal srid mngon du byaḥhrīḥmu ku ta la dzñā na dhartu āX lan gsum dkrol zhing dkur brten byaḥ.a ghaskyedharma haṃ āḥ ces brjod 'khyud rgya bya'oḥ sa ma yuḥ de nas ḍa ru byin brlabs niḥ hūṃḥye k+ṣa sa ma yā pho ཿ thod rnga dmigs med stong pa'i ngang nyid lasaḥ bcu drug ltag sprod khro ཿstsi sum̐ḥk+ṣeḥsgrogasaX las byed dpa' bo dpa' mo sprin ltar sdudaḥ
