bsdu kun bzang yab yum gnyis med dgongs mnyam sbyoraḥ rjes chags bde ba'i chos sgras khams gsum khyabaḥ grags stong 'gags med rdo rje bla ma'i gsungaḥrgyud /zlol dug lnga'i 'khrul 'khor 'joms gyur cigaḥ ( badz+ra tsit+ta maḥ badz+ra sa marnya bha tra āX e a ra li bha ṣa bhi pa sa ma ya hring hring phe po dza dzaḥ de nas rnga chen byin brlabs niḥskye/ kro ta bṛ dzñā na hūm̐ : rnga chen mi dmigs de bzhin nyid dbyings lasaḥ dpal chen khro rgyal yongs 'dus dkyil 'khor bdagaḥ che mchog yab yum snyoms zhugs rol pa lasaḥdrag po'i gad rgyang nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sbiraḥ ma rig rū tra'i glad pa 'gems shing brlagaḥ ha he hūm̐ phaṭa rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs kyisaḥ 'khrul rtog gnyis snang rgyu ba dbu mar bcomaḥ.oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā bṛ he ru ka hūṃ phaṭaḥ sa ma ya tswaḥ tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥ de nas rol mo byin brlabs niḥ ha pra dzñā shabha ri ti hūṃ ཿ mtshan 'dzin rtog pa bcom ste stong dbyings lasaḥ rol mo sil snyan kun bzang ro mnyam dalaḥ rnam kun yongs grub phrin las rgya mtsho'i gteraḥ dag grol rol ba dpa' bo don yod grubaḥ 'ub chub bde sang dam tshig sgrol ma steḥ

gnyis med bde sbyor chos nyid stong pa'i sgraḥ mthar phyin lhun rdzogs harta tshangs dbyangs gruḥ rgyal ba dgyes bskyed 'khor ba chos skur gzhigaḥ mnyam gnas mnyam rdzogs bde klong yangs par sgraḥ 'gags med gang 'dul gdul bya'i dpal du sharaḥha pra dzñā dh+rikaḥ ྅ badz+ra ra ti s+t+waṃ shabha tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥ de nas dung gling byin brlabs niḥtrīḥ chos kun chos nyid rol ba'i rten 'brel gyiḥ rdo rje glu ma bcu drug gar bsgyur rtseḥ zung 'jug gar gyis rgyal kun thugs gsang bskulaḥ ro mnyam 'byug ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'iḥ 'gyur khug ldem pa'i rtsal ldan zung 'jug gisaḥ dpa' bo yab bskul shes rab dbyings dang bsreḥ bskul ma tshangs chen rgyang grags skad po chesaḥ bkra shis lha rgyal bdud pham tshogs lnga bskulaḥ bde byed sgrogs ma sdong po brgya ba'i skadaḥ pho nya bskul 'bod dam can las la sbranaḥ mchog chen ngar ma'i 'bod gling zung 'jug gisaḥ dpa' bo sde lnga dbyings kyi yum drug 'bodaX gsang ba'i phywa sgra las byed bskul ba'i badzaḥ chos sgras stong gsum khyab pa'i mkhar rnga dngaX ye shes gsang ba'i brda glu ting ting shagaḥ ma tshogs las la 'bod pa'i

gas/: rje'u chung dngaḥdam tshig gnyan po sgrogs pa'i phag rdob paḥdabang phyug ma sring 'bod pa'i g.yer phreng dngaḥdam can laṅka bskul ba'i rnga gshang paḥthams cad kun bzang chos sku'i ngang las byungaḥ'agags med grags stong rgyang glu bsam mi khyabaḥlha tshogs chos sku dbyings las gzugs skur bskulaḥpho nya dam can rang dbang med par 'bodaḥmi mjed zhing kun chos sgras khyab cing sgrolaḥm rig log 'khrul sgra skad ru bzlog nasaḥnges pa lnga ldan nyid du rgyas btab pa'iḥgasang chen spyod pa ya mtshan khyad par 'phagasaḥs badz+ra shabha wi ni waṃ se su ṭaṃ bṛ ma hā spra ra ṇa dzaḥces brjod rol mo yongs rdzogs brlabasaḥde nas bsang chu byin brlabs niḥ.e be+eghan ta krita/ phaṭaḥbardal khyab chos dbyings smra bsam brjod bral lasaḥbasang chu'i rang bzhin hūṃḥlas bgegs mthar byedaḥljang nag rgya gram sdigs mdzub mdzad pa yiḥsku las 'od 'phros rgyal kun byin brlabs bstimaḥrdo rje phra rab rdul gyi char bab nasaḥ'abyung po dam sri nyul le thams cad kyisaḥmathong ngam thos sam dran nam reg tsal gyisaḥlus ngag yid gsum

bsregs gtubs brlag byed gyuraḥ hūṃ bisnan ta krita a mṛ ta hūṃ phaṭaḥ brjod la bsangasaḥ su bha was stong par sbyangasaḥ mchod rdzas midamigs sna tshogs chos sku'i ngangaḥ de las lhun grub rang gsal ye shes rdzasaḥ t+t+waṃḥlas rat+na'i snod mchog yangs pa ྅3 oṃ las phyi mchod nyer spyod rnam pa bdunaḥ rgyu gtsang bkod legs 'od 'khyug dri kun bralaḥ āḥlas nang mchod 'dod yon rnam pa lngaḥ 'dzin zhen rnam dag ye shes ro mnyam gteraḥ hūṃ ཿlas gsang mchod sman gtor rak+ta rnamasaḥ 'dod yon lha mo dang bcas gar bsgyur spro: sdilas yang gsang sbyor sgrol ro mnyam sogasaḥ kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam paḥ dbyings las bton te rtsa gsum dbyings su 'bulaḥ 'khor ba dong sprugs bar du 'dzad med spelaḥ 6/ badz+ra spa ra ṇa dzaḥ ces dang spel sngags gang 'os bskyaraḥ gnad des tshogs gnyis bre kha gangaḥ de nas spos byung bya ba laḥ ( hrīḥ tsan dan a gar pi la spos dkar sogasaḥ dri zhim ngad ldan bdug pa spos kyi rigasaḥ 'byung ba mer bsregs dud pa mkha' khyab sboḥ ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i byin gyis brlabasaḥ bag chags dri

btsa( bral ye shes gzi 'od kyisaḥ rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus dgyes bskang zhingaḥ sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen nyer 'tshe zhi ba dngaḥ mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs kun dag gyur cigaḥ saṃ le seng nge ye swā hāḥ.e badz+ra dhu pe pra tits+tsha pu tsa me ga sa mu tra spra ra ṇa sa ma yehūṃ ཿ ces brjod dri bzang phyogs kun spro: byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bar bar 'gyuraḥ de nas snyan gsan dbab pa laḥ mos gus gdung ba drag po yisaḥrang ge snyeng ga nas 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros teḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskulaḥ thugs rje byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thams cad kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin 'ja' 'od thig le'i rnam par bdag mdun sgrub pa'i rdzas la sib sib thim par bsamaḥkhyad par du rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nasaḥ.e rgyan chen po khyad 'phags rig 'dzin phyag rgya zil gnon rtsal dngaḥ sprul pa'i thod phreng sde lngaḥ gu ru mtshan mchog rnam brgyadaḥ sprul ba'i rig 'dzin chen po brgyad dngaḥ 'gro 'dul gyi gu ru sde drugaḥ rgya gar gyi grub chen brgyad cuḥ bod kyi rje 'bangs nyer lngaḥ lo

paṇa brgya dang rtsa brgyad dang zab gter mdzod 'dzin gyi rig 'dzin rgya mtshoḥ lha lcam man+ta ra ba dang ye shes mtsho rgyal la sogs pa'i thugs byon gyi jo mo rnams dngaḥ dpa' bo dpa' mo ging dang laṅka pho rgyud mo rgyud bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskulaḥ kun kyang sku mjes pa'i gar bsgyur khrig khrigaḥ gsung tshangs pa'i brda glu 'ur 'uraḥ thugs brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur lhag lhagaḥ gar rdo rje'i bro brdung thags thagaḥ brda bshud glu mang po tir tiraḥ dpal yon tan 'ja' 'od thig leḥ stobs phrin las bstod dbyangs sangs sangaḥ sman bdud rtsi'i rtogs brjod waṃ 4ཿ 'ja' 'od lnga'i mos 'dun lam lamaḥ gdangs 'gags med sprin ltar 'thibs nasaḥ bdag mdun sgrub rdzas dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa la thim pas snang srid dag mnyam myong grol bdud rtsi rig 'dzin paṇa grub 'dod yon ro mnyam lhun grub gzhal med bkod pa rab rdzogs chen por dag smin rdzogs par bsam la byin dbab soḥ yang rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul te sman srung rdo rje'i pho nya rnams rang bzhin gar bzhugs gyi gnas

bas/ nasaḥ sngon gyi bka' tha tshig dran nas gzugs skur bzhengs te sgrub pa'i rdzas la kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin byon nasaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir bsgyur nas pañtsa a dṛ ta 'dzin spel bsrung ba'i las byed par bsam la byin dbab par bya'oḥ de nas bde drod me ltar 'baraḥ rtags mtshan yon tan khyad 'phags 'byungaḥ de nas dur khrod byin chen laḥ gnad dbab 'di nyid gces par zungasaḥ bdag nyid dpal chen brtul zhugs rol ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phrosaḥ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa gsang chen dur khrod gnas nas grub pa'i rig 'dzin chen po brgyad dngaḥphyogs skyong dbang phyug chung ma dang bcas paḥzhing skyong klu brgyad phra men pho moḥrten dang brten par bcas pa rnams la phog nas rdo rje gsang ba'i tha tshig gis bskul te rang byung lhun grub bkod pa'i dal dang gnyis su med par 'dresaḥ gsang mchog sngags kyi phun tshogs bkod pa rmad du byung ba'i da la steḥ dbang dang dngos grub 'byung ba'i bang mdzodaḥ gsang gsum rdo rje sad pa'i brda dbangaḥ ye shes zang thal 'char ba'i nyi zlaḥ tshogs brgyad dbyings su grol ba'i

rten 'byungaḥ yul snang mtshan 'dzin grol ba'i dag dbyingasaḥ ro mnyam bde ba chen po'i da la nyid du dag smin rdzogs par bsam la byin chen dbab soḥ de nas gnad bsdu bya ba laḥ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃḥ nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs gtso 'khor sprul ba dpung dang bcas pa thams cad bdag mdun sgrub pa'i rdzas yo byad rnams la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur te smin cing grol bar bsam laḥ dza dza tswaḥ ces pa'i gnad kyis thugs rgyud bskulaḥ nyams rtogs gong 'phel rtags mtshan 'byungaḥ sa ma yāḥ bcu gsum rig 'dzin byin 'bebs niḥ rol mo snyan pa'i sgra dang bcasaḥ sbyar spos sna tshogs dud pa btangaḥ dar dang ba dan lhab lhub phyaraḥ mos gus gdung shugs tshad med pasaḥ hūṃḥ byin chen ngo mtshar khyad par 'phags pa'i gnasaḥ sin+dha rgya mtsho rol ba'i mtsho gling duḥ ya mtshan rmad byung pad sdong rtse las 'khrungasaḥ sgob dpon chen po mcho skyes rdo rjer gragasaḥ dgyes sde gar dbang klu mo 'od 'phro maḥ ma tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcasaḥ gnas 'dir spran 'dren byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ spron lam las ldan isbyo sto dhi yisaḥ dad pas spran drangs

bsgo/ rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangasaḥslob dpon mtshan ni ra dza zor cog canaḥdagyes bskyed ḍak+ki 'od 'chang lha mor grags:grub pa'i rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis bskoraḥsgrub mchog bdag gi gdung bas 'bod lags kyisaḥganas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥthabs kyis bskul te rgyal srid ring du boraḥbasil ba'i tshal gshegs brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzadaḥtan ghan sbyor sgrol dgongs pas gdul bya skyongaḥdapa' bo mkha' 'gror chos kyi 'khor lo bskoraḥslob dpon mtshan ni shan+ta rak+ṣi taḥdagyes bskyed ma mo rma bya'i mgrin bzang canaḥdapal 'byor yon tan ldan pa'i 'khor gyis bskoraḥsgrub mchog bdag gi gdung bas 'bod lags kyisaḥganas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥrang bzhin ma nges gnas rnams thams cad duḥmi dang mi min rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i drungaḥrnal dbab mi brjed gzungs kyi ting 'dzin gyisaḥrig pa'i gnas lnga kun la mkhas dbang brnyesaḥslob dpon chen po dbang po'i sde zhes gragasaḥdagyes bskyed gar dbang bde chen phra bkod gragasaḥm nges gdul bya dag pa'i

'khor gyis bskoraḥ sgrub mchog bdag gi gdung bas 'bod lags kyisaḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ bya skyibs tshal dang rgya gar dur khrod duḥ rig 'dzin grub thob mang po'i spyan snga rtsa yo ga rnam gsum chos la sbyang mthar sonaḥ slob dpon mtshan ni blo ldan mchog sred rtsal ༷ dgyes bskyed ḍak+ki pad+ma'i thod rgyan canaḥ dad ldan yongs la chos kyi char ba 'bebasaḥ sgrub mchog bdag gi gdung bas 'bod lags kyisaḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ a su ra yi brag phug chen po dzas shāka thub nyer gnas 'phags pa kun dga' boḥ rab brten rgyu 'bras chos kyi sgo 'dogs bcadaḥ drang sgong nyi ma'i gung la rab tu byungaḥ sa yi lha mo brtan mas chos gos phulaḥ slob dpon mtshan ni shākya 'od zer gragasaḥ dgyes bskyed shākya dṛ 'od lam maḥ byang sems rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis bskoraḥ sgrub mchog bdag gi gdung bas 'bod lags kyisaḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ za hor rgyal khams 'dul bar dgongs pa'i tsheḥ ya mtshan rmad byung mer bsregs chu ru bsgyuraḥ lha lcam dpon g.yog

badz+ra smin grol lam la bkodaḥbaka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i 'khor lo bskoraḥslob dpon mtshan nipad+ma so bha waḥ dgyes bskyed ḍāk+ki me tog man+ta raḥrje 'bangs las ldan nyer lnga'i 'khor gyis bskoraḥsgrub mchog bdag gi gdung bas 'bod lags kyisaḥganas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ'atshemed rdo rjer dgongs pa gtad pa'i tsheḥmakha' 'gro sde bzhi'i gar gyis gdan drangs nasaḥbrag phug ma ra ti ga'i dben gnas suḥrdo rje'i tshe sgrub 'od dpag med mgon gyisaḥtshe yi bum pa yab yum spyi bor bzhagaḥbaskal pa grub nas 'jig rten ma stong paraḥskye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i dbang chen bskuraḥsems rtags lus shar bsgres rgud mi mnga' b.raḥslob dpon mtshan ni che dbang reg 'aram̐n rtsalaḥbagyes bskyed ḍāk+ki gu h+ya dzñā nar grags:grub pa'i rig 'dzin mang po'i 'khor gyis bskoraḥsgrub mchog bdag gi gdung bas 'bod lags kyis0 gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥtso rgyan yul khams gdul bar dgongs pa'i tsheḥ.u pa ta sogs bdud blon thams cad kyisaḥgason bsregs mdzad kyang 'byung

khams mtsho ru bsgyuraḥ in+t+ra bhi dhi dpon g.yog lnga brgya poḥ tshom bu 'bum bcas phyag rgya chen por sbyoraḥ slob dpon mtshan ni pad+ma rgyal po dngaḥ dgyes bskyed mtshan ni rat+na'i phreng ba canaḥ dad ldan gdul bya rig 'dzin 'khor gyis bskoraḥ sgrub mchog bdag gi gdung bas 'bod lags kyisaḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsol: lhun grub brtsegs dang pad+ma brtsegs la sogasaḥ rang byung mchod rten drung du rgyab brten nasaḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro tshos kyi 'khor lo bskoraḥ bdud rtsi bam ro sgrub pa'i dngos grub brtesaḥslob dpon mtshan ni nyi ma 'od zer bzhadaḥ dgyes bskyed ḍāk+ki nyi 'od 'bar ma gragasaḥ gdul bya yongs la pha ma bzhin brtse mdzadaḥ sgrub mchog bdag gi gdung bas 'bod lags kyisaḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥrdo rje gdan dang zangs gling gser gling giḥ phra men mu stegs bstan pa bsnubs pa'i tsheḥ mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul bse sgrom gtad sel phulaḥ bsgrub pas ngan sngags bdag po thog gis bsgralaḥ mu stegs ston pa lnga brgya'i rtsod pa bzlogaḥ rgyal po klu yi khyab 0〈cog thabs kyis bsgralaḥ rā dza

btsa( zangs kyi dregs pa 'khor bcas brtulaḥnam mkha'i shugs can dkar po'i chos la bkodaḥsangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i so nam rgyasaḥsgob dpon mtshan ni seng ge sgra sgogs rtsalaḥmakha' 'gro'i ming ni bdud 'dul 'od ldan maḥlas ldan gdul bya mang po'i 'khor gyis bskoraḥsgrub mchog bdag gi gdung bas 'bod lags kyisaḥganas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥrang byung gsang ba'i dur khrod chen po nasadage slong kun dga' smon lam spyan sngar phyinaḥphyi nang gsang ba'i dbang rnams rje gas par zhusaḥstag tshang seng ge bsam 'grub ke'u tshang du:dregs pa tshar gcod gzhan snang zil gyis gnonaḥganas chen gangs brag thams cad byin gyis brlabasaḥsnyigs ma'i skyabs mgon rdo rje bde rol rtsalaḥslob dpon mtshan nigu ru khro bo lodaḥdagyes bskyed mon gyi bu mo khye 'dren maḥlas ldan au ṭis bsngags pa'i pho nyas bskoraḥsgrub mchog bdag gi gdung bas 'bod lags kyisaḥganas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥrgya gar zhing sa rnga thub can gyi yulaḥdabang du sdud phyir brtul zhugs spyod

pa mdzadaḥ hū chen ka ra smin grol yang dag mdzadaḥ slob dpon mtshan ni so khya dhe war gragasaḥ mkha' 'gro'i ming ni ka la sirnyi zhesaḥ sbyor sgrol bde rol gdul bya mang pos bskoraḥ sgrub mchog bdag gi gdung bas 'bod lags kyisaḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ bal yul yang le re da kyi brag phug tuḥ phyag rgya chen po dngos grub mtshan ma brtesaḥ slob dpon mtshan ni rdo rje sgod phreng rtsalaḥ dgyes bskyed ḍāk+ki shākya de war gragasaḥ bar chad bdud btul zab gter chos 'khor bskoraḥ sgrub mchog bdag gi gdung bas 'bod lags kyisaḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ bod kyi gangs chen bzhi la sgrub pa mdzadaḥ bsam yas lhun grub rgya chos bod du drangasaḥ phug gsum ljong lnga gsang chen nyi shu lngaḥ byin brlabs rtags mtshan phyag zhabs sku rjes bzhagaḥ rje 'bangs lo paṇa brgya rtsa smin grol mdzadaḥ slob dpon mtshan ni pad+ma 'byung gnas gragasaḥ dgyes bskyed gzungs ma ye shes mtsho rgyal dngaḥ snying gi bu dgu rje 'bangs grogs lnga sogasaḥ las ldan bsam mi khyab pa'i 'khor gyis bskoraḥ sgrub mchog bdag gi

bsgo/ gdung bas 'bod lags kyisaḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ da lta gdong dmar srin po'i kha gnon mdzadaḥ rak+ka pho mo thams cad chos la bkodaḥ lus med o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon byedaḥ bde stong dga' bzhi'i gru char rtag tu 'bebasaḥ dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi da la rtsa 'phags bod lo paṇa rnams la chos 'khor bskoraḥ sku dngos sprul pas bod khams rjes su 'dzinaḥ thugs rje rgyun chad med pa'i phrin las canaḥ bka' drin zla med 'gro mgon chos kyi rjeḥ slob dpon mtshan ni raka thod phreng rtsalaḥ dgyes bskyed ḍāk+ki mkha' 'gro sde lngar gragasaḥ rak+ta rig 'dzin mang po' 'khor gyis bskoraḥ sgrub mchog bdag gi gdung bas 'bod lags kyisaḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ sa āḥhūṃ badz+ra gu ru thod phreng rtsal hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta king ka ra sarba sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ e a ra li hring hring pho pho ཿrol mo sna tshogs sgra bcas teḥ byin chen nan du dbab par byaḥ gnad des nyams rtogs yon tan 'charaḥ dngos grub char ltar 'bebs par 'gyuraḥ sa ma yāḥ bcu bzhi brgyud

ldan rig 'dzin gyiḥ byin chen 'bebs pa'i rim pa laḥ mos gus gdung shugs tshad med pasaḥ snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad doḥshā hūṃshāḥ 'gro b.limagon po o rgyan chos kyi rjeḥ bka' drin mnyam med pad+ma thod phreng rtsalaḥ mi mjed bye ba phrag brgya'i mgon gcig phuḥ mos gus dad pas yang yang bskul lags naḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ o rgyan dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling duḥ 'ja' zer 'od stong 'khrigs pa'i gur khang nasaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la chos 'khor bskoraḥ thugs nyid zhi zhing dgongs pa ma 'dres sharaḥ bla med bla ma gu ru zhi ba nyidaḥ mos gus dad brgyas yang yang bskul lags naḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥlta stangs mdzad pas khams gsum dbang du bsdudaḥ stangs stabs mdzad pas sde brgyad dam la btagasaḥ zhal 'a byem mdzad pas mkha' 'a11 sprin ltar gtibasaḥ dgyes brtse gzigs pas gdul bya smin grol byedaḥ rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis lta log zil gyis gnonaḥ bka' drin bsam mi khyab pa'ipad+ma 'byungaḥ mos gus dad brgyas yang yang bskul lags naḥ gnas 'dir byon

gtsa/ la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ mos gus ldan la thugs rje'i nyi ma sharaḥ dad ldan pho mor dngos grub char ltar 'bebasaḥ rgyad pa gso phyir phrin las spro bsdu 'gyedaḥ khyad 'phags rig 'dzin phyag rgya zil gnon nyidaḥ mos gus dad brgyas yang yang bskul lags naḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ thugs mchog yang dag rol mdzad hūm̐ ka raḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje mañdzu mi tra'i garaḥ rta mchog dngos snang na gardzu na dngaḥ phrin las phur ba mngon gyur pra bha haḥ mos gus dad brgyas yang yang bskul lags naḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ ma mo bde rol dha na saṃ kri taḥ rig 'dzin slob dpon dri med bshes gnyen zhabs: dregs pa 'dul mdzad rosbu gu h+ya dngaḥ drag sngags mthu thob shidzha ghar+bha raḥ mos gus dad brgyas yang yang bskul lags naḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ dga' rab rdo rje chos kyi 'byung gnas dngaḥ rdzogs chen ston pa rig 'dzin bṛ seng: sgyu 'phrul sgo 'byed sangs rgyas gsang ba dngaḥ bstan pa'i 'byung gnas paṇa chen nyi shu lngaḥ mos gus dad brgyas yang

yang bskul lags naḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ chos kyi lhun po be+e ro tsā na dngaḥ bstan pa'i gzhi ma khri sgong lde'u btsan dngaḥ rdzu 'phrul mthu thob nam mkha'i snying po dngaḥ drags sngags dbang phyug sangs rgyas ye shes rnamasaḥ mos gus dad brgyas yang yang bskul lags naḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ ri brag zang thal dpal gyi rdo rje dngaḥ dzña na ku mas bdud rtsi thog med 'byinaḥ sra brtan brag gsol rma thog rin chen dngaḥ gzhan snang zil gnon dran nam lha dpal zungaḥ mos gus dad brgyas yang yang bskul lags naḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsol:grub brnyes gzungs ma ye shes mtsho rgyal dngaḥ ro langs gser bsgyur rgyal ba'i blo gros zhabasaḥ nyer gcig yi ge'i lde mig legs sbyin nyi: rgya chos bod drangs ska cog zhing gsum dngaḥ sngags ston phur thogs rdo rje bdud 'joms rnamasaḥ mos gus dad brgyas yang yang bskul lags naḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ chos kyi mig ldan khye'u chung ye shes bloḥ smon lam mthu btsan rba mi khri gzher dngaḥ sde brgyad bran

btsa(4 'khor dpal gyi ye shes sogasaḥ sprul ba'i rje 'bangs lo paṇa brgya rtsa yangaḥ mos gus dad brgyas yang yang bskul lags naḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥzab gter mdzod 'dzin grum gyi mkhar nag paḥm rung tshar gcod bdud 'dul rdo rje dngaḥmakhyen gnyis gzi 'bar dpa' bo rol pa rtsalaḥdagongs pa klong rdol bdud 'joms rdo rje rnamasaḥ mos gus dad brgyas yang yang bskul lags naḥganas 'dir byen la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ'agro ba'i mgon po dri med klong yangs dngaḥbargyud pa'i bla ma byin rlabs 'byung gnas mdzodaḥrtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin gsum ldan dpalaḥthugs rje'i gter chen ma lus thams cad kunaḥmos gus dad brgyas yang yang bskul lags naḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥrtsa rgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs rnams kunaḥ mjes 'dzum thor cog dbu sgra ldems se ldemaḥdar dpyangs cod paṇa sna tshogs pu ru rtsa rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo loḥdril g.yer sgra snyan mang po si li liḥ sna tshogs rdo rje'i gar bsgyur khrigs se khrigaḥ dpa' bo mkha'

'gros brda skad di ri riḥ ging dang dpa' bos bshug glu kyu ru ༄sa dar gdugs ba dan mda' dar lhabs se lhabaḥ shā phaṭa brda skad sna tshogs sangs se sangaḥ bdag dang skal ldan sgrub pa po rnams laḥ shenas 'dir thugs rjes dgongs te gshegs su gsolaḥ nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan bskyed pa dngaḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ glu badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ e a ra li hring hring pho pho ཿ mos gus gdung shugs tshad med pasaḥ byin chen nan du dbab par byaḥ sa ma āḥbaco lnga sman srung byin 'bebs laḥ spos dkar tsan dan dkar po dngaḥ ka ko la yi dud pa bdugaḥ rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcasaḥ shā shāḥ byen chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnasaḥ 'og min gsang ba'i gnas mchog tuX dngos grub mchog gi bcud 'dzin paḥ sman srung rdo rje'i pho nya baḥ dam tshig can rnams skad cig gisaḥ sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsolaḥ a mṛ ta la byin phob cigaḥ grub rtags mtshan ma bzang po stonaḥ thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yāḥsum cu rtsa gsum lha yul nasaḥ tshangs pa mi mjed bdag

btsan po dngaḥ dbang po mig stong bkra ba yangaḥ sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsolaḥ a mṛ ta la byin phob cig:grub rtags mtshan ma bzang po stonaḥthugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yāḥ khams gsum grong khyer sum brtsegs nasaḥ dbang phyug ma hā de wa dngaḥ lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po dngaḥ dbang sdud 'dod pa'i rgyal po rnamasaḥsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsolaḥ a mṛ ta la byin phob cigaḥgrub rtags mtshan ma bzang po rtonaḥ thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yāḥmathing gsal 'od klong rol pa nasaḥsangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro maḥgasang ba'i mtshan btags tsan ti gaḥsprul pa bsam yas dpung dang bcasaḥsngon gyi tha tshig ma g.yel b.raḥganas 'dir spyan 'dren byin phob cigaḥ bdud rtsi dud pa'i ngad la byonaḥ rol mo snyan pa'i sgra la gsonaḥrnal 'byor gdung ba'i tshig la dgongasaḥ a dṛ skyems phud rab bzhes la:grub rtags mtshan ma bzang po stonaḥthugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yuḥdakar gsal bde klong rol ba nasaḥrdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro maḥ gsang ba'i mtshan gsol nil num maḥ gar bsgyur rdo rje'i

dpung dang bcasaḥ sngon gyi tha tshig ma g.yel b.raḥ gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin phob cigaḥ dar ston g.yab mo'i sna la byonaḥ kun bzang mchod sprin gtibs la byon ༷ dri bzang bsang gi ngad la byonaḥ rol mo snyan pa'i sgra la gsonaḥ rnal 'byor gdung ba'i tshig la dgongasaḥ a dṛ skyems phud rab bzhes la grub rtags mtshan ma bzang po stonaḥ thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yāḥser gsal brjed ldan rol ba nasaḥ rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro maḥ gsang ba'i mtshan gsol gar tri bamaḥ rat+na rigs kyi 'khor 'bangs bcasaḥsngon gyi tha tshig ma g.yel b.raḥ gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin phob cigaḥ lha rdzas mchod sprin gtibs la lha sngags ting 'dzin ldan la byonaḥ dri zhim bsang dud ngad la byonaḥrol mo snyan pa'i sgra la gsonaḥ rnal 'byor gdung ba'i tshig la dgongasaḥ a mṛ skyems phud rab bzhes la: grub rtags mtshan ma bzang po stonaḥ thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yāḥdamar gsal chags bral rol ba nasaḥ pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro maḥ gsang ba'i mtshan gsol gu h+ya k+ṣeḥ ma chags pad+ma'i 'khor dang bcasaḥ sngon gyi tha tshig ma g.yel b.raḥ

gas/ gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin phob cigaḥ pad+ma mtshal chen skyems la byonaḥ ku mud sna tshogs spungs la byonaḥ lha shing dud pa'i ngad la byonaḥrol mo snyan pa'i sgra la gsonaḥrnal 'byor gdung ba'i tshig la dgongasaḥ a dṛ skyems phud rab bzhes la:grub rtags mtshan ma bzang po stonaḥthugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yuḥljang gsal bde mnyam rol ba nasaḥlas rab rigs kyi mkha' 'gro maḥgasang ba'i mtshan gsol tri ga bamaḥlas rnams rab rdzogs 'khor dang bcasaḥsngon gyi tha tshig ma g.yel b.raḥganas 'dir spyan 'dren byin phob cigaḥ a dṛ stong sbyor bsgrub la byonaḥ dza gad dpa' bo'i skyems la byonaḥ lha rdzas bsang gi ngad la byonaḥrol mo snyan pa'i sgra la gsonaḥrnal 'byor gdung ba'i tshig la dgongasaḥ a mṛ skyems phud rab bzhes la:grub rtags mtshan ma bzang po stonaḥ thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yāḥrdo rje'i tha chig bsgrags pa naḥ ma g.yel ma 'phang rig 'dzin tshogasaḥ ma g.yel ma 'phang ḍāk+ki'i tshogasaḥ ma g.yel ma 'phang dpa' bo'i tshogasaḥ ma g.yel ma 'phang dpa' mo'i tshogasaḥ ma g.yel ma 'phang king gi tshogasaḥ

dam bsgrags gnad nas bskul 'a/ gsonaḥspyo na tsho dpal chen he ru gaḥ dbang chen rta phag zhal sbyor nasaḥ gsang sngags sgrub chen myong 17la brtsamasaḥ lha klu mi gsum zag mas khyabaḥ de tshe khas blangs dam bcas pa'iX sman srung gsang ba'i pho nya rnamasaḥ sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegasaX brngan rdzas dza gad 'di bzhes laḥ rtags mtshan bzang po bstan du gsolaḥ bar du rig 'ardzan hūṃ ka rasaḥ mchod rten pad spungs brtsegs pa ga yang dag thugs mchog rol pa yiḥ bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa mdzadaḥ de tshe khas blangs dam bcas pa'iḥ sman srung gsang ba'i pho nya rnamasaḥ sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegasaḥ brngan rdzas dza gad 'di bzhes laḥ rtags mtshan bzang po bstan du gsolaḥdi'og sur+ya rasmiyisaḥ mchod rten bde chen brtsegs pa rtsa 'jam dpal bde dgyes rol pa yiḥ bdud rtsi bam ro'i sgrub pa mdzadaḥ de tshe khas blangs dam bcas pa'iḥ sman srung gsang ba'i pho nya rnasamaḥ sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegasaḥ brngan rdzas dza gad 'di bzhes laḥ rtags mtshan bzang po bstan du gsolaḥ do'og yar lung shel brag

bsgo/ tuḥ gu ru rje 'bangs grogs lnga yisaḥ 'chi med ā yu'i gsang mdzod phyesaḥ bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa mdzadaḥ de tshe khas blangs dam bcas pa'iḥ sman srung gsang ba'i pho nya rnamasaḥ sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegasaḥ brngan rdzas dza gad 'di bzhes laḥ rtags mtshan bzang po bstan du gsolaḥde 'og bkra shis zla phug tuḥsnying gi bu dgu grogs gsum bcasaḥ rol pa chen po'i dal zhal phyesaḥ bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa mdzadaḥ de tshe khas blangs dam bcas pa'iḥ sman srung gsang ba'i pho nya rnamasaḥsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegasaḥ brngan rdzas dza gad 'di bzhes laḥ rtags mtshan bzang po bstan du gsolaḥ tha ma bla rgyan chen po dngaḥ lo paṇa sum cu rtsa gcig gisaḥ khra 'brug gsang ba'i yang dben duḥ bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho yiḥ bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa mdzadaḥ de tshe khas blangs dam bcas pha'iḥ sman srung gsang ba'i pho nya rnasamaḥ sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegasaḥ brngan rdzas dza gad 'di bzhes laḥ rtags mtshan bzang po bstan du gsolaḥkhyed rnams mthu stobs byin rlabs kyisaḥ deng

gi dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'diraḥ myong grol ye shes bdud rtsi rtsa dam rdzas byin gyis brlabs du gsolaḥ rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rtsa sgrub mchog byin gyis brlabs du gsolaḥ bkod pa rab rdzogs dkyil 'khor duḥ da la byin gyis brlabs du gsolaḥ rang byung lhun grub gzhal med duḥ khang pa byin gyis brlabs du gsolaḥ 'og min gsang ba'i gnas mchog tuḥ sgrub rdzas byin gyis brlabs du gsol: grub pa'i rtags mtshan bzang po kunaḥ da lta nyid du rtsal du gsolaḥ sa dzña na dha ka dha ki ni bir+ya bi ha ri ni sa sarba sa ma ya hring hring dza dzaḥ a we sha ya a āḥ dus drug bya zhing byin chen dbabaḥ a dṛ ta la gzi mdangs bskyedaḥ sta gon lha tshogs 'od zhu byaḥ sgrub pa'i dal dang gnyis med bsreḥs ma yuḥ bcu drug rdo rje'i bstong ring niḥ gar skor phyag rgya rol mo bcasaḥ hūṃ hrīḥ rdo rje nam mkha' 'pho 'gyur mtshan ma bralaḥ rdo rje chags pa ye shes bzhi lto sbyoraḥ rdo rje 'pho 'gyur bral bar rgya yis gdabaḥ rdo rje 'degs byed chen por phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje'i rtsig pa rat+na lnga yis mdzesaḥ rdo rje mi shig las bzhi'i dbyibs dang ldanaḥ rdo rje thog

gtsa( med nyi zla'i sang skar haraḥ rdo rje mdzes pa'i dal la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje'i 'dod snam wa mo'i spro bsdu mdzadaḥ rdo rje rab 'bar pha gu gser 'od 'baraḥrdo rje mdzes 'khyil dra ba dra phyed 'phyangaḥ rdo rje dpal 'khyud shar bu mda' yab mdzesaḥ rdo rje rab mdzes ri dwags chos 'khor gdugasaḥ rdo rje gdal khyab bla bre 'phan yab spudaḥrdo rje 'gyur med 'ur mo'i gzer chen gdabaḥ rdo rje bde ba'i klong la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje rab rgyal bsrung ba'i 'khor los gtamasaḥ rdo rje chags bral phyi nang 'od zer 'baraḥ rdo rje gzhi rgyan bkod pa phu sum tshogasaḥ rdo rje'i gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje rat+na'i khri rkang zur brgyad paḥ rdo rjes 'khor ba'i sgo gnon byol song brgyadaḥrdo rje thabs shes zung 'jug zla nyi mdzesaḥ rdo rje'i gdan khri yangs par phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje phag mo'i gar bsgyur bye kri maḥ rdo rje'i sdang mig sder tshogs bdud bzhir bsgradaḥrdo rje 'od zer dra ba'i ri mo canaḥ rdo rje'i pho nya chen mor phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje gar dbang dpal ldan pad+ma skyesaḥ rdo rje zhi mdzad gad rgyang khro la rngamasaḥ rdo rje'i dbu zhal nyi shu

rtsa gcig poḥ rdo rje'i sa rnams kun dang mnyam par sbyoraḥ rdo rje'i khro tshul nyer gcig phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis phyag rnams gdengasaḥ rdo rje'i rigs 'chang gu ru bzhi bcu gnyisaḥ rdo rje dgyes bskyed yum dang mnyam par sbyoraḥ rdo rje bde gshegs bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje'i gar gyi rol rtsed dbu 'bum dngaḥ rdo rje las bsgyur 'phrul phyag 'bum phrag gisaḥ rdo rje las skyes bdun lnga nyer lnga sogasaḥ rdo rje dkyil 'khor 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje'i sku la 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro 'khrilaḥ rdo rje'i go khrab dur khrod dpal chas brgyanaḥrdo rje byang chub sems kyi spro bsdu mdzadaḥrdo rje las kyi sems dpar phyag 'tshal bstodaḥrdo rje thugs kyi ga'ur pad zla'i stengaḥrdo rje rig 'dzin gu ru zhi ba nyidaḥ rdo rje bhan+ta ḍā ru dkrol brten 'changaḥ rdo rje zhi mdzad he ru ka par bstodaḥ rdo rje zil gnon zhabs 'bum gyad stabs bsgradaḥ rdo rje 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i rtseraḥ rdo rje mi mjed bye ba phrag brgya'i togaḥ rdo rje rig 'dzin rgya mtsho bsnams la bstodaḥ rdo rje lcags kyu rno ba'i gzi 'od kyisaḥ rdo rje 'od mtha' yas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyiḥ

btsarnya rdo rje gzi 'od sku gsung thugs yon bcudaḥrdo rje bdud rtsi 'bebs la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥrdo rje zhing rdul grangs mnyam rgyal ba'i dalaḥrdo rje mi shig gsang ba gsum gyi sprinaḥrdo rje ye rdzogs gnyug ma'i ngo bor lhugaḥrdo rje sems kyi gsang bar phyag 'tshal bstodaḥrdo rje grub pa chen pa'i sa bzung zhingaḥrdo rje las kyi gar bsgyur phan bde spelaḥrdo rje chags thog gnyis 'dzin mdud pa grolaḥrdo rje'i gdung 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥrdo rje'idakyil 'khor gnyan po 'di bzhengs nasaḥrdo rje gsum gyi dgongs pa'i gsang srog 'dzinaḥrdo rje 'da' med don la mnyam bzhag nasaḥrdo rje'i mdzad pas 'gro khams dong sprugs shogaḥces brjod rdo rje'i phyag rgya dngaḥbasgrags nas bstod par bya ba'oḥs ma yāḥbacu bdun bdud rtsi phye sgrub laḥbhan+ta lnga yi nang du bkodaḥmatshams su rak+ta dmar chen dngaḥdza gad snying khu ldan pa dngaḥsel med dam rdzas byin ldan dngaḥtsan+dan gur gum gsang ba'i chuḥ'akhru brgya'i mar gyi nying khu dngaḥ'abras dkar ram bu se 'bru'i phyeḥrgyun 'babs chu gtsang ga bur ldanaḥbazang drug la sogs sman

drus bskoraḥ rnam lnga nyer spyod mdzes par bkramaḥ shin tu yid 'ong byas nas suḥ bskyed chog dngos ni 'di lta steḥ 1 ka timan ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūṃ: lhun grub zhing bkodaphun sum zogs pa'i dalaX lnga ldan zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor sharaḥ dri bral mtshan ma mi dmigs gzhal med khangaḥ sgo gru rta babs chos 0shesar gdugs tog sogasaḥ bkod pa phun zogs 'dod yon lha mo 'khrigasaḥ de dbus ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i stengaḥ zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin niḥ hrīlig yongs gyur o rgyan thod phreng rtsalaḥ dkar dmar padangs ldan bcu drug lang tshos 'khrudaḥ he ru ka pa rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzesaḥ phyag g.yas dngul dkar rdo rje rtse dgu paḥ g.yon pas bde skyong bhan+ta bdud rtsir bsreḥ mdzes mdzum gzi 'bar dbu sgra thor cog bcingaḥ thod skam dbu rgyan dar sna'i cod paṇa 'phuraḥ nyi zla snyan cha dar gyi dpyangs pa mdzesaḥ gsang ba'i yum mchog mtsho rgyal 'khril sbyor rolaḥ 'ja' 'od lnga'i klong rgyal po rol stabs bzhugasaḥ spyi bor ge sar 'bum brdal nyi zla'i kharaḥ rigs kyi bdag po gu ru zhi ba nyidaḥ lha lcam me tog mas ra bar sbyoraḥ rdo

ba tshu rje pad+mor bsre sbyor bdud rtsi'i rgyunaḥ nub med sgrub mchog rnams kyi dpal du stsalaḥ snang srid 'dzin bral 'od kyi sku ru gsalaḥ rtsa ba'i lha mchog o rgyan thod phreng giḥ bde chen 'khor lo las spros 'od mthing rtseraḥ chos dbyings mi 'gyur budha thod breng rtsalaḥ mthing gsal gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug sprasaḥ rdo rje gar gyis sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror sbyoraḥ byang chub sems kyi 'phro 'du 'gags med mdzadaX longs spyod 'khor lo las spros 'od dmar rtseraḥ ma chags dri bral pad+ma thod breng rtsalaḥ dmar gsal ku mu ta yi chun 'phyang 'phuraḥ zag med bde rol pad+ma mkha' 'gror sbyoraḥ aḥdangaḥnyaḥgi brdas bskul a bṛ spro: chos kyi 'khor lo las spros 'od dkar rtseraḥ mi shig bde mchog badz+ra thod phreng rtsalaḥ gangs la nyi rgyas 'od 'khyug rat+nas brgyanaḥ stobs chen mkha' rol rdo rje mkha' 'gror sbyoraḥ me yis bzhos pa'i bdud rtsi 'dzad med bskyilaḥ sprul pa'i 'khor lo las spros 'od ser rtseraḥ yon tan dpal mchog rat+na thod phreng rtsalaḥ btso bsregs brdar ba'i mdangs 'bar dar dpyangs klubasaḥ mi nub dpal spud rin chen mkha'

'gror sbyoraḥ bde bas bskul te dpa' bo'i bdud rtsir zhu: bde skyong 'dor lo las spros 'od ljang rtseraḥ bya ba mthar phyinakarma thod phreng rtsalaḥ in+t+ra'i mdangs 'bar nor bu'i do shal spudaḥ 'khor 'das bde klong las kyi mkha' 'gror spyoraḥ 'bar dang 'dzag pa lte spyor byang sems zhu: dpa' bo yab rnams bhan+ta bskyil rol 'bebasaḥ dbang phyug yum rnams yab kyi mgul nas 'khyudaḥ grangs spro ba la rang 'dra 'bum 'bum 'gyedaḥ skye med thig ler dzña na ku ma dkaraḥrdo rje'i gar bsgyur bhan+ta bdud rtsi btegasaḥ dbyings kyi yum chen gshin rje'i las byed 'khrilaḥ rtsa khams ba spur sku mchog lha tshogs rdzogasaḥ dza lan+ta ra'i dpa' bo ḍāk+ki maḥ nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin 'dud cing mchod bstod byedaḥ'agags med 'od 1nga rgyal ba mchog dbyings dmaraḥ dbang gi bum pa zag med sman gyis bkangaḥ bde mchog mchog rol pad+ma ḍāk+ki 'khrigasaḥ sku dbyings dbang chen gsung gi lha tshogs rdzogasaḥ lam pa ga'i yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'khrigasaḥ kun kyang sbyor sgol thabs kyi bkod pa ngomasaḥ mi shig ga'uranam mkhalisnying po mthingaḥ gter bum 'chi

ba tshu med tshe yi bcud kyis bkangaḥrang grol bde chen rgyal por snyoms par zhugasaḥthugs mchog yang dag rol ba'i lha tshogs rdzogasaḥkañtsi ga'i yul dha ka ḍāk+ki 'khrigasaḥlha tshogs mchod bstod bdud rtsi'i char sprin sdudaḥdapal spungs thig leratshangs pa lhalimitogaḥdakar dmar mdangs ldan las kyi phyag rgyar sbyoraḥrtsibs stong ldan pa gdul bya'i dpal du ngomasaḥche mchog yon tan lha tshogs sku dbyings rdzogasaḥtri sha ku na'i dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogasaḥbagrangs bral 'dud sbyar a dṛ rtogs pa sbyoraḥlas rdzogs thig leradza rje bdud 'joms sgrugaḥbhan+ta lcags phur gdengs thabs tshul du brtenaḥsku dbyings phur pa phrin las lha tshogs rdzogasaḥbartul zhugs gar gyis dbang phyug lha mor sbyoraḥsirnyi ya na'i dpa' bo dpa' mo 'gyedaḥsbyor dang sgrol ba la dgyes bdud rtsi 1ཿbrten byed thig le g.yas paradapal yeshesaḥdamar nag gcer bu bam ro bdud rtsir bsgyuraḥsku dbyings ma mo rbod gtong lha rnams rdzogasaḥmachim gyi lha mo seng ge mu khar 'khrilaḥm la wa brgyad dpa' bo ḍāk+ki 'khrigasaḥkun kyang rdor pad bsre zhing bdud rtsi

bskrunaḥ bsgyur byed thig le g.yon parakhye'u chung rtsalaḥ mdzes 'dzum dpal 'byud ye shes mi mor 'khrilaḥ sku dbyings rig 'dzin slob dpon gar bsgyur spro: ko sa ka ling las byed pho nya 'khrigasaḥ gsang nan a dṛ ta yi dngos grub 'bebasaḥ 'dzin byed thig leradapal gyi seng ge mthingaḥ tsit+ta ko ro tsa na bdud rtsir bsgyuraḥ sku dbyings 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs rdzogasaḥ dbyings kyi ma lnga gar gyis 'khril sbyor rolaḥ ma ro raṣ+ṭar las mdzad pho mo 'tshogasaḥ ro mnyam ye shes bdud rtsi'i char chen stsolaḥ sdud byed thig ler be+e ro tsa na dkaraḥ gzhan snang zil gnon rdo rje bhan+ta 'dzinaḥ sku dbyings dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs 'gyedaḥ rdo rje mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i dbying sa sbyor bsreḥ pul+li ra ma hi mal las byed 'phroḥ kun kyang dgyes brtses bdud rtsi phyur bur spro:gzhan yang rtsa khams thig le phra mo'i 1ngaḥ lo paṇa bcu drug he ru ka pa'i nyamasaḥ dgyes bskyed shes rab ḍak+ki snyoms zhugs mdzadaḥ gnas yul dur khrod he ru'i las byed 'khrigasaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsi'i rol bar sbyang spel bsgyuraḥreg 'dze+en yab rnams rus rgyan dar dpyangs

btsaX 'phuraḥdabang phyug yum rnams bde stong dga' bzhir dgyesaḥdapa' bo yab rnams bdud rtsi spro la dgyesaḥdapa' mo yum rnams zag med bskyil la gnasaḥking chen pho mos gsang ba'i bde drod 'dzinaḥlaṅka rnams kyis mi mthun 'byung po bsgradaḥpho nya rnams kyis mchod sprin mtha' yas stobaḥḍāk+ki mang pos bdud rtsi'i rtogs brjod 'uraḥgasang 'dus ma ya bde mchog kye rdo rjeḥdus 'khor 'jigs byed rgyud sde rab 'byams lhaḥrig 'dzin rnams kyi sku la ma 'dres shar ༷rtsal rdzogs bcu gsum phran lnga zung la sogasaḥbaka' 'dus dgongs 'dus rgyud 'dus 'khor lo rdzogasaḥdakyil 'khor spro ba rang 'dra bye ba 'gyedaḥkun kyang ma 'dres bdud rtsi'i char chen 'bebasaḥphyogs mtshams steng 'og 'od zer brgyad cu sprosaḥde dag rtse mor 'ja' 'od thig le'i klongaḥs ra ha pa ṭom bhi lu hi sogs:grub chen brgyad cu rang rang yum dang sbyoraḥrgyud sde rgya mtsho'i tshom bu lhun gyis grubaḥre re las spros 'od zer bye phrag rtseraḥmi mjed 'dul mdzad grub chen re re bzhugasaḥkun kyang brtul zhugs he ru ka pa'i chasaḥrdo rje bhan+ta

bsnams shing mdzes 'dzum 'baraḥ yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nasaḥ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum mu med 'phrosaḥ 'khor 'das nyi zla 'byung bzhi'i dwangs bcud dngaḥ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin ma lus paḥ bsdus te zag med a mṛ dkar dmar 'khyilaḥ pho rgyud dpa' bos bro gar khrigs se khrigaḥ mo rgyud dpa' mos glu len kyu ru rtsa ging chen rnams kyis bshud glu di ri riḥ laṅka'i tshogs kyis thod rnga hro lo loḥ rig 'dzin rnams kyis brda chos 'u ru rtsa rdo rje glu mas glu len sangs se sangaḥ sgeg tshogs yid skyes mchod sprin phyu ru dzas dar gdugs ba dan mda' dar lhabs se lhabaḥ shub chen dril bu'i sgra snyan si li liḥ tshom bu spro ba bsam mi khyab pa'i dalaḥ nam mkha' rab 'byams khyon dang mnyam pa yiḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir bsgyur te myong grol gteraḥ ngo mtshar rmad byung rab 'byams zhing bkod gsalaḥ gzhan yang mgron thabs lta bu'i lha tshogs niḥ sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam dngaḥ dpa' po mkha' 'gro nyi rdul 'khrigs ltar rdzogasaḥ kun gyi gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon lasaḥ 'od 'phros ye shes pa

btsa( rnams thugs rgyud bskulaḥ kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin spyan drangs nasaḥ bskyed pa'i lha dang gnyis su med par bstimaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza steḥ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa rnamasaḥ gzhung ltar grub rjes bstod pa bya ba niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ rdo rje mi shig yon tan bdun ldan garaḥ rdo rje chos kyi 'byung gnas bstan pa'i gzhiḥrdo rje'i rwa gur gdul bya'i bsil khang cheḥ rdo rje he ru ka dpal dbyings la bstodaḥ rdo rje'i rigs la ma chags pad+ma'i yumaḥ rdo rje gsang ba brdas bskul a haṃ bsreḥ rdo rje phyogs ris mi dmigs bde mnyam klongaḥ rdo rje'i sku grub ḍak+ki'i rje mor bstodaḥ rdo rje cir yang thogs med mkha' la bsgyuraḥ rdo rje bskyed yum pad+ma'i sbubs las 'khrungasaḥ rdo rje'i gar bsgyur lha lcam man+ta raḥ rdo rje pad 'byung yab yum klong la bstodaḥ rdo rje bde gshegs yon tan pad+ma lasaḥ rdo rje rigs kun 'dus zhal thogs pa medaḥ rdo rje bdud 'joms gdul bya'i gsos sman mchogaḥ rdo rje thod phreng sde lngar phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje dbyings las thabs tshogs bsam mi khyabaḥ rdo rje'i lus la rdo rje'i ba sbu sproX rdo rje sgeg bzhad

cir yang thogs pa medaḥ rdo rje grangs kyi yon tan rdzogs la bstodaḥ rdo rje nam mkha' gsang gsum 'byung gnas kyiḥ rdo rje 'od zer dngas ma'i dpal dgu sogasaḥ rdo rje dkyil 'khor rgya mche'i spro bsdu cheḥrdo rje las mdzad rje 'bangs nyer lngar bstodaḥrdo rje gsang chen rol pa gnas yul dngaḥrdo rje mnyam nyid dur khrod he ru yiḥrdo rje'i bkod pa sku lus gcig la rdzogasaḥ rdo rje dkyil 'khor ba gor phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje las mdzad 'od zer mtha' yas rtseraḥ rdo rje grub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad cu lasaḥ rdo rje'i spro bsdu bye brag brgya la sogasaḥrdo rje'i tshom bu bsam yas klong la bstodaḥ rdo rje dpa' mi zhum pa chags thogs bralaḥrdo rje rkang gnyis gtso mchog bde bar gshegasaḥ rdo rje mi shig phyogs ris mtshan ma bralaḥ rdo rje bde gshegs gdung la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ rdo rje grub pa myong grol a dṛ mchogaḥ rdo rje gsang ba gsum du mthar phyin pa'iḥ rdo rje las rnams rdzogs shing 'gro khams 'dulaḥ rdo rje phan bde'i 'byung gnas nyid la bstodaḥ rdo rje'i gdung 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gisaḥ rdo rje pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor rab bzhengs shingaḥ rdo rje'i rigs

btsanyu 'dzin las smon rnam par dgaḥ rdo rje'i mdzad pas 'gro khams dong sprugs shogaḥ ces brjod phyag rgya gar bsgyur bcasaḥ dkyil 'khor lha la bstod par byaḥs ma yuḥ bzlas pa sngags kyi 'khrul 'khor niḥ bdag nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas gu ru zhi bar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer mchod pa'i tshul can dpag tu med pa sprosaḥ rtsa ba'i lhag ru a tsar+ya'i sku gsung thugs la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bulaḥ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer 'phrosaḥ dpa' bo thod phreng sde lnga'i thugs rgyud bskulaḥ kun kyang snyoms zhugs mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams dang sku las byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par bab pas pho brang mtshan rdzogs chen po phyur bur gang nas 'khor ba dong sprugs chen po'i mdzad pa grub par bsam laḥ sa badz+ra ma hā gu ru a tsar+ya budha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma garma thod phreng rtsal sarba sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya hring hringaḥ rat+na pañtsa a mṛ ta ra sa ya na pañtsa sid+dhi hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ 'dzab dbyangs 'od zer spro bsdu bcasaḥ zhag bdun bar du dbab bstim bskyaraḥ skabs skabs nyul le mnan

bsgrad dngaḥ snga dro sman srung byin chen dbabaḥ nyin gong lha tshogs thugs dam bskulaḥ dgong mor rig 'dzin byin dbab byaḥ sman srung pho nya mchod gsol bstodaX gnad des sgrub rdzas 'od 'khyug cingaḥ dri bzang 'azibs pa'i drod rtags 'byungaḥ sa ma yāḥ de nas sgrub pa'i bzlas dmigs niḥ rang githugs ka nas 'od zer mchod pa'i tshul can dpag tu med pa 'phrosaḥ mdun bskyed gu ru a tsar+ya thod phreng sde lnga rigs kyi bdag po dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskulaḥ bde stong mnyam sbyor chen po'i dgongs pa la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub sems kyis 'od zer gyi dkyil 'khor spro ba bka' bab bu dgu yab yum sgrub sde dgu dang rtsal rdzogs bcu gsum bde gsang kye 'jigs ma ya dus 'khor bka' rnams 'dus pa la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskulaḥ kun kyang snyoms 'jug mdzad pas sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phrosaḥrab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la mnyes mchod 'bulaḥ thugs rje'i byin rlabs gzi brjid dngos grub thams cad bsdus te bstimasaḥ ngan song gsum

gtsar+sha dang 'gro khams rgya mtsho dong nas sprugs te rig 'dzin lha dang lha mo'i rol par btsan sa zinaḥ tshe bsod dpal yon 'byung ba'i dngas bcud thams cad bsdus te bstimasaḥ myong grol ye shes kyi rang bzhin rgyal kun thugs kyi gsang ba rdzogs par bsam laḥ ces badz+ra ma hā gu ru hrī ma nyariḥniḥsaḥr tsa hri ya tsit+ta sarba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya hring hring pho pho ཿ pañtsa a mṛ ta tshoḥjuḥsgihrīḥ.āḥhūṃḥlīḥdhīḥbye:haṃX ra sa ya na sarba sirnyi pha la hūm̐ āḥ 'dzab dbyangs byas la smra bcad duḥ dmigs pas 'od zer spro bsdu byedaḥ yengs med bdun phrag bar du bzlaX skabs su dur khrod byin 'bebs dngaḥ phra men rak+ṣar 'bod bskul sbranaḥ bdud rtsi sman gyi che ba brjodaḥ des ni bde drod me ltar 'baraḥ nyams dga' dang spro skyo ba medaḥ dri bzang 'thul zhing dag snang 'charaḥ lha mi'i 'du ba rgyas par 'gyuraḥ sa ma yāḥ de nas las sbyor dmigs pa niḥ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phrosaḥ mdun bskyed gu ru rin po che a tsar+ya'i thugs rgyud bskulaḥ de yi tsan+d+ra byang chub sems kyi 'od zer mu tig dri ma bral ba'i rnam par zhal nas byung ste yum gyi

zhal du zhugasaḥ sku yi dbyings brgyudaḥ yum gyi pad+mo nas yab kyi rdo rje'i sbubs su zhugasaḥ zag med thugs rje'i rol rtsal gdul bya'i dpal du shar bar bsamaḥ slar yang yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phrosaḥ grangs tshom dkyil 'khor du spros pa'i lha tshogs rnams la phog pas kun kyang thugs rjes gdul bya la dgongs nas rjes chags kyi sbyor ba'i thabs des bskul nasaḥ dpa' bo yab rnams kyi tsan+d+ra thabs chen zla ba thig le dkar po'i rnam par zhu zhing dpa' bo'i zhal nas yum gyi zhal du zhugasaḥsku yi dbyings bde ba chen por brgyudaḥ yum gyi pad+mo dri med bde klong nas yab kyi rdo rje nor bu 'dod 'byung gi sbubs su zhugasaḥ zag med thugs rje'i gsos sman dam pa gdul bya'i dpal du shar nasaḥ gang 'dul mdzad pa rgya mtshos 'gro khams dong nas sprugs par bsam laḥ cod badz+ra ma hā gu ru a tsar+ya hrīḥm haḥriḥniḥsaḥr tsa hrīḥya tsit+ta hring hring dzaḥsarba pañtsa ra sa ya na a ra pa tsa ma ta hri da ye pañtsa sidhi a ral+li hring tringaḥ sum̐ ya ral+li po pho ཿ sarba sidhi a we sha ya sbyo sbyoḥ smra bcad ting 'dzin ldan pa yisaḥ 'dzab rgyun dbyangs kyi

gas/: sgras bskul nasaḥ bdun phrag bar bzla spro bsdu 'gyedaḥ skabs su sman gyi mchod pa dngaḥ pho nya'i gsol bskang grangs ldan bskyaraḥ rdo rje bstod ring dag par bsgrangasaḥ de tshe byin rlabs nyi ma 'charaḥ dngos grub bdud rtsi'i char chen 'bebasaḥ rtags mtshan ma nges bsam mi khyabaḥ dngos nyams rmi lam dag tu 'charaḥ ya mtshan ltas bzang the tshom medaḥ sa ma yāḥbaco brgyad rak+ta gnad dbab laḥ las kyi rdo rjes rak+ta phyaraḥ rdo rje rgyal pos dar nag g.yabaḥ rgyal theb nyid kyis phur gdab byaḥ king ka ra yis gu gul spro: rol mo sna tshogs sgra sbir zhing: rngams pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad doḥhūṃ shāḥ gu gul byen bskyed gdug pa 'dul ba'i rdzasaḥ rak+ta khrag gi rba 1nga rten 'brel rgyuḥnyon mongs chags pa chen po'i rang bzhin rdzasaḥ dpal chen rtags kyi phyag rgyas ma rig bcomaḥ nyon 'khrul dū tra rdo rje'i stobs kyis bsreḥ dpa' bo dgyes bskyed mchog gi rdzas su brlabasaḥ khro rgyal la bstabs 'khor ba ru bzlog byedaḥ dbang phyug ma sring brtan mas phrin las sgrubasaḥ pho nya las la bskul bas tha tshig dranaḥ phra men dam la gdung zhing

sngags bstan spelaḥ rdo rje gsang ba'i lha rnams dgyes par bskulaḥ dpal chen gī la ya yi rtags su sbrengasaḥbla badz+ra gī lo ki la a bhe tsar+ya'i dus la bab pa'oḥ brnag pa de kho na 'oḥ khams gsum ru bzlog rak+tar dbab bskyil zhigaḥm badz+ra ko ri haḥ ha he rak+ta phaṭaḥyi/ badz+ra tso ri haḥ ha he rak+ta phaṭaḥ.a badz+ra pra mo haḥ ha he rak+ta phaṭaḥ.e badz+ra be ta li haḥ ha he rak+ta phaṭaḥbla badz+ra puṣ+ka si haḥ ha he rak+ta phaṭaḥ.e badz+ra gasma ri haḥ ha he rak+ta phaṭaḥtso badz+ra tsan+ta li haḥ ha he rak+ta phaṭaḥ.a badz+ra sme sha ni haḥ ha he rak+ta phaṭaḥ.e badz+ra sedhamu kha heḥ ha he rak+ta phaṭaḥ yin badz+ra be+e kri mu kha heḥ ha he rak+ta phaṭaḥyi/ badz+ra sri la mu kha heḥ ha he rak+ta phaṭaḥ.a badz+ra shwa na mu kha heḥ ha he rak+ta phaṭaḥyin badz+ra kri ta mu kha heḥ ha he rak+ta phaṭaḥ yid badz+ra shaṅka mu kha heḥ ha he rak+ta phaṭaḥ yin badz+ra kha kha mu kha heḥ ha he rak+ta phaṭaḥyin badz+ra hu lu mi kha heḥ ha he rak+ta phaṭaḥ bye shwa ra sarba sa ma ya heḥ ha he rak+ta phaṭaḥ ces pa'i skabs su rak+ta nyidaḥ las kyi rdo rje'i phyar ba dngaḥ rdo rje rgyal pos tha tshig sbranaḥ rgyal theb nyid kyis bsgral 'dren byaḥ 'khor ba ru bzlog dmigs 'dun dngaḥ gdug pa 'dul

ba tshu ba'i gad rgyang byaḥs ma yāḥbacu dgu bdud rtsi'i rtogs brjod niḥlas kyi rdo rjes bdud rtsi mchodaḥkaing ka ra yis spos dud spro:kun gyi thal sbyar mos gus dngaḥldan pa'i ngang nas 'di skad doḥ37 āḥhūṃ ༷mtshan ldan bhan+ta kā pa la yi nangaḥbla ma yab yum snyoms zhugs bdud rtsi'i rgyunaḥmu tig dkar po dri med thig le mchogaḥtsan dan spug po rma med pad+ma'i mdangasaḥganyis med bde rol bde ba'i mchog las 'byungaḥm chags skyon gyis ma gos byang chub semasaḥ'agyur med ye shes gsang ba kun gyi srogaḥdri chen rnam dag be+e ro tsa nar gnasaḥme sa chen po yon tan rin chen 'byungaḥm chags pad+ma'i ze 'bru snang mtha' yasaḥkun+dha byang chub sems nyid rdo rje semasaḥdri chu dag byed las rdzogs don yod grubaḥrgyud lnga'i 'gro la gnas pa'i bdud rtsi kunaḥdam tshig rten mchog rigs lnga yab yum dalaḥdangos kun bdud rtsir 'dres pa ya mtshan cheḥmatshan ma sna tshogs mtshan med dbyings su 'dresaḥgacig tu dpa' bo dgyes bskyed chen po laḥganyis su med pa rdo rje btsun mo'i dbyingasaḥrang bzhin skye 'chi gnyis med tshe yi

rdzasaḥ byed las gnyis snang ma rig dri ma bcomaḥ bdud rtsi'i don ni gnyis med mnyam pa nyidaḥ thugs rjes 'khrul rtog nyon mongs dug lnga zhiḥ phud kyis rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras bcas bskangasaḥ gzegs las rig 'dzin paṇa sdo/ba rgya mtsho mchodaḥ gsang nan thabs kyis bde mchog yab yum bskulaḥ 11na mongs 'bo gas las bslang zhing bde nyams 17laḥmadzad phrin gdul bya'i dpal shar myong grol gteraḥ kun bzang yab yum gnyis med dgongs mnyam steḥ padha ka ra'i gsang gsum lhum zhugs dbangaḥ dad ldan gdul bya'i ze'u 'bru'i gsos sman 'diḥ dus gsum rgyal ba yongs kyis bsngags par 'osaḥ bcu drug lha mo'i rdo rje'i gar bsgyur rolaḥ bde mchog bde klong rdo rje'i dgongs brag 'dzinaḥ.oṃ ra sa ya na a dṛ ta bṛ ha hi hūm̐ ཿ ces brjod las kyi rdo rje yisaḥ gzegs ma phyogs rnams kun nas sgrengasaḥ lha la bstabs shing rdzas dang bsreḥ de tshe 'od 'khyug dri bzang 'thulaḥ sman gyi ngad pa rab tu 'thibasaḥ me mar rang 'bar gtor ma zhu: rtags mtshan bsam mi khyab pa 'byungaḥ sa ma yuḥ nyi shu bdud rtsi sman mchod niḥ snyan pa'i dbyangs

ba tshu bcas 'di skad doḥ sa āhūṃḥ dug lnga sman bsgyur dza gad dpa' bo'i skyemasaḥ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar pañtsa a mṛ taḥ sha lnga bdud rtsi dwangs mar dbab pa'i smanaḥrtsa gsum rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes bskyed sharaḥ pañtsa a pro ta hūm̐ hrīḥthaḥskyemed chos sku 'od zer mtha' yas dngaḥ ma 'gags thugs rje'i gter mdzod nam mkha' rgyalaḥ rtsol bral pad+ma las 'khrungs mtsho skyes rjeraḥsman mchod 'bul 'a mchog thun dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram khā hiḥdur khrod brgyad gshadags grub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyadaḥ da byung mdzad pas gu ru mtshan brgyad gragasaḥ 'khor ba dong sprugs gu ru sde drug laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram khā hiḥ brtul zhugs rol ba'igrub dbang brgyad cu dngaḥ thabs mkhas rgyal po gu ru nyi shu lngaḥ gzhan snang zil gnon pad+ma drag po laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram khā hiḥ gangs can gsal mdzad mkhan slob chos rgyal dngaḥ bstan pa gsal byed rje 'bangs nyi shu lngaḥ zab gter 'byung gnas khye'u

chung lo tsā laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hiḥ gu ru'ithugs byon me tog man+ta raḥ ka la sirnyi shākya de wa dngaḥ bkra shis khye 'dren ye shes mtsho rgyal laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram khā hiḥkhrum gyimakhar nag he pa chos 'byung gnasaḥ bdud 'dul rdo rje dpa' bo rol pa rtsalaḥ bdud 'joms gling pa dri med sang yangs laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram khā hiḥ gzhan phan thugs rje'i nyi ma yongs la brdal: phrin las 'od dkar nub med bstan pa'i sgogaḥ 'gro ba'i mgon po rtsa rgyud bla ma laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram khā hiḥ bka' rnams 'dus pa tshom bu nyi shu lngaḥ dpal chen yongs rdzogs pho brang lang tshe dgu: mdo sgyu sems phyogs dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram khā hiḥ rtsa b.lilha rdzogs dgongs pa 'dus pa dngaḥ bdud dpung zil gnon badz+ra ku ma raḥ dngos

btsan grub char 'bebs zla gsang kye 'jigs laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram khā hiḥ cir yang 'char ba dus kyi 'khor lo dngaḥ dbang phyug dam pa ma hā ma ya sogasaḥ yi dam rgyud sde rgya mche'i dkyil 'khor laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram khā hiḥ gsor 'das bdeklong 'ub chub wa ra hiḥ ma rgyud bdud 'dul seng ha ḍāk+ki maḥ khros ma nag mo ku ru kul+le laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsolaḥm hā sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram khā hiḥdabyings kyi dbang phyug rdo rje rnal 'byor maḥ cir yang bsgyur ba'i bdag med chen mor gragasaḥ gar gyi mnga' bdag bde sbyor mu kha leḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram khā hiḥ chos nyid mkha' la thugs rje'i shugs kyis 'groḥ bde mnyam rol ba rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro maḥ dag pa dbyings gsum skyong ba'i ḍāk+ki laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram khā hiḥ pho rgyud che btsan ma hā ka la dngaḥ drang

srong yongasakyi dbang phyug ra hu laḥ ma mo yongs kyi gtso mchog e ka dzaḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram khā hiḥ bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin sha za nges nus maḥ skyes ging gtso bo badz+ra sa dhu bamaḥ mgyogs ma chen mo dbang phyug nyer brgyad laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsolaX ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram khā hiḥ mi mjed bdag po tshangs pa lha yi gtsoḥ mig stong ldan pa dbang po tha tshig srungaḥ sman 'dzin gsang ba'i lha mo mched lnga laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram khā hiḥ pad spungs brtsegs pa dur khrod bde chen brdalaḥ yang le re/da dang khra 'brug shel brag sogasaḥ sgrub gnas gnyan po'i sman srung thams cad laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram khā hiḥ bdud rtsi'i gzegs mas 'khor 'das rgyas theb mthusaḥ sde brgyad gdug rtsub zhi zhing dam la gnasaḥ lha srin bgegs rigs byang chub sems dang ldanaḥ rigs drug sems can las snang sdug bsngal sbyangasaḥ byang chub chos

btsan sku'i bde klong ngang la 'byilaḥmanyam nyid bdud rtsi'i dgongs pa e ma hoX ces brjod rtsa gsum lha tshogs bskangasaḥnyams rtogs yon tan mkha' ltar rgyasaḥtshe dpal 'byor ba lang tsho daraḥkhams dang bkrag 'bar lus sogs bdeḥyon tan bsam yas dus su 'byungaḥs ma yāḥnyer gcig sman srung gsol mchod laḥgator skyems byin gyis rlabs pa niḥgator snod bhan+ta gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du gtor ma dgra bgegs gnod byed dngos su gsalaḥn moḥmachog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i nus stobs kyis gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cigaḥlan gsum gyis bkug par byas laḥdzaḥ〉 baṃ hoḥdabyings nas mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char bab pas sha khrag rus gsum khrol bur gtubs te nam mkha'i gtos dang mnyam par bsam laḥs su bha was sbyangs laḥsde/nga pa'i ngang las ye ram̐ kau las rlung me thod sgyed kyi khar āḥlas ka pā la stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gtso bor gyur ba'i bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib 'bru sman

rat+na gos dar la sogs pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyuraḥ sa āḥ(ཿ lan gsumaḥ gtor skyems 'dod yon gyi bkod pa rnams ngo bo bde stong ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la dngos po dgra bgegs kyi sha rus khrag gsum rnam pa 'dod yon phun sum tshogs par gyuraḥ ha ho hrīḥ rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer glog 'khyug pa ltar 'phros pas rang bzhin gar bzhugs kyi gnas nas mkha' 'gro nges nus ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pas sngon gyi bka' tha tshig dran nas byon par bsam moḥ nges nus chen mo'i sgrub gsal bskyaraḥ skabs su 'dod gsol gdab pa laḥ hoḥ zhing skyong dur khrod kyi lha moḥ sha za 'bum gyi gtso mchogaḥ dgra snying drod mo la dgyes paḥ rnal 'byer ba'i dam la gdung baḥ chos 'bor gtsug lag sgrub gnas kyi srung maḥ dkor dang zhing khang la mel rtse byed paḥ dam ldan gyi srung maḥ dam nyams kyi gshed du bzhengs pa sha za nges nus ma sprul 'khor bka' sdod dang bcas pas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes laḥ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungasaḥ sems can la bde skyid spelaḥ rnal 'byor

btsa/ ba'i sku tshe bsringasaḥ sgrub pa'i drod tshad nyulaḥ ci re dang ci smon pa'i las thams cad zogs pa med par myur du 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod cigaḥ ces brjod phud bshar bā ling spungasaḥ gsol mchod 'khrugs bskang grangs ldan bsogs: de nas dkar skyems bsham byas teḥ bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa niḥ 31 sā bha was sbyangs byas laḥ (ཿlas rin chen yangs pa'i snod nang duḥ gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsir gyuraḥ bla a ka ros spel bsgyur byas laḥ ( hrīḥ khams gsum srid pa'i mnga' bdag poḥ dbang phyug ma hā de wa dngaḥ 'dod pa'i rgyal po tshogs kyi bdagaḥ tshangs pa mi mjed bdag po dngaḥ dbang po mig stong legs nyes gzigasaḥ 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon nasaḥ 'dod yon mchod gtor skyems bzhes laḥ bdud rtsi sman gyi srung ma mdzodaḥ bar chad dam sri'i 'tshe ba bzlogaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir bsgyur nus pa'iḥ las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzodaḥ ci 'grub brjod la 'dod gsol niḥ ho rdo rje gsang ba'i tha tshig can dbang phyug ma hā de waḥ dbang sdud 'dod pa'i rgyal poḥ lha chen

zogs kyi bdag poḥ tshangs pa mi mjed mnga' bdagaḥ dbang po mig stong ldan pa rnams sprul 'khor dang bcas pas mchod sbyin gyi gtor skyems 'di bzhes laḥ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pasrungasaḥ 'jig rten khams la bde legs bskyedaḥ 'khor 'das kyi dpal yon dang 'byung lnga'i dngas bcud ma lus pa bsdusaḥ sgrub rdzas la drod tshad bskyedaḥ rtags mtshan mi 'gyangs bar stonaḥ pañtsa sid+dhi a khaṃ gi las thogs pa med par stsol ba'i phrin las mdzod cigaḥ ces brjod phud skyems gtsang sar mchodaḥ de nas sman bshos rnam lnga da ngaḥ 'o phud bshams la bsangs sbyangs niḥ tho swā bhawas sbyangs laḥ trī hrīḥ'og min gnas dngahe ru'i zhingaḥ dur khrod brgyad srung pho nya baḥ rigs 'chang lha mo mched lnga dngaḥn pa' bo dpa' mo bsam mi khyabaḥ mdzes pa sku yi gar dang bcasaḥ sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsolaḥ pañtsa sirnyi grub phyir bzhugasaḥ dngos grub stsol slad gus phyag 2tshalaḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dngaḥ bdud rtsi sman phud bsangs dud sprinaḥ dar tshon dkar mngar skyems phud rnamasaḥ gus pas 'bul lo dgyes par bzhesaḥ sku gsung

gas/rnya thugs yon phrin las bskangasaḥ ting 'dzin ma gsal 'byor tshogs chungaḥ ser sna nyon mongs dri ma kunaḥ snying nas bshags so tshangs par stsolaḥ gdung dbyangs rol mo'i sgra yis bstodaḥ rnam bzhi'i las rnams 'grub pa dngaḥ khyad par bdud rtsi sgrub pa laḥ bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rnams thulaḥ rtags mtshan ma g.yel myur du stsolaḥ tha tshig dus bab sa ma yuḥ skabs su 'dod gsol gdab pa niḥ he: gsang chen mkha' 'dzad sgyu ma bde mchog ye shes kyi rnam par shar baḥ sgrub pa'i drod nyul zhing legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin par byed pa'i bdud rtsi sman gyi srung ma dam tshig sgog gi mnga' dbang mo sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro tsadh+ri gaḥ rdo rje'i rigs 'changanail num maḥ rin chen dpal 'bebs gar tri bamaḥ pad+ma'i gsang mchog gu h+ya k+ṣ-iḥ las rab ḍāk+ki ṭaṃ ka beḥ rang rang g.yog 'khor dpung dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes laḥ sgrub mchog brtse bas skyongs shing drod tshad mi g.yel bar stsol ba dngaḥ dngos kun zag med bdud rtsi'i rol bar dag smin rdzogs pa dngaḥ tshe gcig 'od skur grol ba

sogs las rab 'byams gang bcol ba'i don thams cad thogs med yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las rgya chen po mdzod cigaḥ ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegasaḥ'adod don phrin las bcol ba niḥ kyiḥ dus gsum rgyal kun spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byungaḥ gang gis bka' dam gnyan la bzhag pa yiḥ pho rgyud mo rgyud bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogasaḥ'adir gshegs mchod gtor rgya chen rab bzhes laḥ sangs rgyas bstan srungs dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstodaḥ dge 'dun sde spel bshad sgrub bstan pa skyongasaḥ nad mug mtshon 'khrug ming gi lhag mar thulaX 'jigs dang sdug bsngal nyes tshogs zhi zhing stongaḥ legs yon tshe dpal 'byer drug nyams rtogs bskyedaḥ khams gsum srid gsum mos bzhi dbang du bsdusaḥ bstan la 'khu ba'i mtha' mi kla 1 dngaḥ dam log slob ma spyang ku rgyab ser dngaḥ khrel med rkun po zhing bcu tshang ba'i steḥ ming tsam med par thal ba rdul du rlogaḥ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcasaḥ kun bzang gzhi 1nga mngon par byang chub paraḥ 'bral med bsrung skyob bsam don chos dang sbyoraḥ don gnyis

brdezhu gegs med 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yuḥ ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs: phrin las gang bcol gegs med 'grubaḥ slar yang bshags pa bya ba niḥ ho rgyal bstan srung ba'i pho nya dam can dgongasaḥ bdag rmongs blo yis thugs 'gal las bgyis paḥ gnong shing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis bshags bgyi'o: sgrib med dag tshangs dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ yi ge brgya pas bzod par gsolaḥ don gnyis gegs med 'grub par 'gyuraḥ sa ma yuḥ nyer gnyis rlon sgrub bya ba laḥ rang nyid brja thod phreng giḥ bskyed rim ting 'dzin ldan pa yisaḥ phyag rgya rdo rje rtse lngar bsamaḥ gsang 'dzin sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror gsolaḥ rdo dkyil pad+ma'i snod du dmigasaḥ rol mo snyan pa'i sgra bcas nasaḥ hūṃḥ bdag ni thabs mchog bud+dha thod phreng rtsalaḥ bde gshegs bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis phrin las 'gyedaḥ thugs mchog mi 'gyur yang dag lha tshogs rdzogasaḥ kun dha byang chub sems kyi 'od zer 1ཿ gsang 'dzin sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro maḥ bud+dhā'i dpa' bo dpa' mo 'bum 'bum

'byedaḥ bde sbyor bde rol pad+mo klong yangs 'byilaḥ tsit+ta thugs kyi rdo rje'i mnyes pa bskangasaḥ yab yum zung 'jug bde mchog rol ba yisaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsi'i rol bar bsre zhing bsgyuraX dpa' bo yab lnga'i bde mchog rdo rje dngaḥ dbang phyug yum lnga'i hūṃ ༷gyi gsang ba dngaḥ gnyis med mnyam sbyor sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bcudaḥ rgyud lnga'i 'gro sgol myong grol a dṛ brtsamaḥ rten 'brel bslu ba med pas rgyas gdab poḥ sa brnya sgod phreng rtsal bud+dha mu tra e nyaḥ sarba hūm̐ ཿhūṃḥ sarba dzaḥlīḥ sarba swā pheḥ sarba eḥt+t+waṃḥ sarba nya〉ཿ panyu 5/ ru ya na phye ma bye ma sirnyi hūṃ ཿ ces brjod las rdor btags snod brtenaḥrdo rje rgyal pos zhub tu brdungaḥ king ka ra yis bgegs tshogs bsgradaḥ rgyal theb nyid kyis mthun rkyen spyoraḥd la'i shar du bya ba'oḥ dngos grub dri ma med pa 'byungaḥ sa ma yāḥ de nas las kyi rdo rje yisaḥ phyur bum snod mchog 'dud rgyas btegasaḥ king ka ra yis sang ras bkramasaḥrdo rje rgyal pos sman bye blugs ཿ dpa' bo chen pos dngul rdo phulaḥ rgyal theb nyid kyis kha sgrog bsdamasaḥ kun kyang dgyes rol phun tshogs pasaḥ (ཿ bdag ni thabs mchog rat+na

ba tshu thod phreng rtsalaḥ yon tan rtsal rdzogs bcu gsum spro bsdu 'gyedaḥ sku mchog 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs rdzogasaḥ mi nub bde stong bdud rtsi mkha' khyab spro: bde bskyed rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro maḥ rat+na dpa' bo dpa' mo 'bum 'bum 'gyedaḥ mnyam gnas mnyam par rol ba'i brdas bskul teḥ rat+na yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po dngaḥ chags mchog pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur mnyam sbyor mthusaḥ mi shig dbyings las bdegashegs sras 'khor bcasaḥ ye shes rdo rje zag med myong grol gteraḥdangos kun a mṛ shar ba rten 'brel cheḥ phrin las 'gro ba'i dpal duthasamahoḥ 37 rat+na thod phreng rtsal rat+na mu tra dzñā na sidhi (ཿ tho trī tri triḥ.āḥ spyosde4spyohūṃḥ ra sa ya na phye ma phye ma a we sha ya a we sha ya rat+na na ma (ཿ ces pas bum snod legs par bkangaḥ dwa la'i lho nas bya ba'oḥ sa ma yuX de nas las kyi rdo rje yisaḥ lha reg dang bcas thal mo sbyaraḥdapa' bo chen pos phyur bum nyidaḥ bkan la rdeb cing bsgrub par byaḥ pho nya yongs kyis rol mo sbiraḥ snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad doḥ/ trīḥ bdag nithabs mchog pad+ma

thod phreng rtsalaḥ bye ba phrag brgya'i rig 'dzin 'du 'phro 'gyedaḥ dbang chen gsung mchog rol ba'i lha tshogs rdzogasaḥ chags bral bde ba'i 'od zer phyogs kun spro: dgyes bskyedagar dbang pad+ma ḍāsko steḥ zhen bral dha ka ḍāk+ki 'bum 'bum 'gyed: lhun mnyam bde dbyings rol bas brdas bskul nasaḥ mi g.yo dbang gi rdo rje 'od 'bar baḥ pad+ma rgya bde 1nga yangs dam par rolaḥ spros pas rgyal kun gsang rdzogs dbang byin bsdusaḥ mi shig thig le kun 'khyil bum par zlumaḥ zad med zag bral rdo rje tshe yi rdzasaḥ myong grol gdul bya'i dpal du e ma hoḥ 37 pad+ma thod phreng rtsal pad+ma mu tra spra ra ṇa phaṭaḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa /rtsa rmi hū tri tīḥ.āḥ spyomāṃ4phyotwe bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhartu ma hā sarba sid+dhi pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐hrīḥṭhaḥ ces brjod phyag rgya gar skor gyisaḥ zhib tu btsag par bya ba steX dwa la'i nub kyi las rim moḥ sa ma yāḥdenas las kyirdo rje yisaḥ rat+na'i snod mchog legs par 'dzinaḥrgyal theb nyid kyis sman zhal phyesaḥ rdo rje rgyal pos legs par btonaḥ king ka ra yis spos dud spro:rdo dze+e ga bdun glu dang bcasaḥ kun gyis rol mo'i sgra sgogs shingaḥ dad

bsgo/ mos snyan pa'i dbyangs byas teḥ hūṃ hrīḥ bdag ni thabs mchog garma thod phreng rtsalaḥ dgongs pa yongs 'dus dkyil 'khor spro bsdu 'gyedaḥ drag po gī la ya yi lha tshogs rdzogasaḥ bya ba mthar phyin 'od zer spro bsdu 'gyedaḥ dgyes bskyed rngams ma las rab ḍāk+ki steḥ karma rigs kyi dpa' bo dpa' mo 'gyedaḥ kun tu dga' ba dgyes brtse'i brdas bskul nasaḥ ye gnas dbyings la lhun rdzogs bkod pa rnamasaḥ gdul bya'i dpal du thugs rje'i pad+mo lasaḥ sna tshogs 'od zer brtse chen zag med gteraḥ kun 'byung yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po'i gteraḥ su la ma shar sgrub mchog dpal du sharaḥ don rnams lhun grub mdzad pa ngo mtshar cheḥ 'gro khams dong nas sprugs pa'i don kun stsolaḥ 31 garma thod phreng rtsal garma mu tra bṛ hūṃḥ ( hūṃḥbho dhi tsit+ta oṃ līḥm hā su kha swā rmāḥdzñā na dhartu ā bye:ra sa ya na hā ྅ga dṛ ta sid+dhi pha la ma.āḥhūṃḥ ces brjod sman rnams zhib par bcagasaḥdā la'i byang nas bya ba'oḥ sa ma yāḥ de nas rdo rje rgyal po yisaḥ brlan pa'i rdzas rnams rim bzhin blugasaḥ rgyal theb kyis ni bsre bar byaḥ las kyi rdo rjes rab tu mnye: king ka

ra yis bsre bsnun btulaḥ snyan pa'i dbyangs dang rol ma'i sgraḥ sbir la 'di skad brjod par byaḥ hūṃ hrīḥ bdag ni thabs mchog badz+ra thod phreng rtsalaḥ sku la bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs rdzogs gang 'dul paṇa grub rje 'bangs lo tsā 1ཿ ye shes gsang ba rdo rje'i zer bdun spro: dgyes bskyed 'khril ma rdo rje'i ḍāk+ki steḥ bde gshegs dpa' bo dpa' mo 'bum 'bum 'gyedaḥ mi g.yo bde 1nga rol ba'i brdas bskul nasaḥ brtse chen bde gshegs phrin las a dṛ taḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i mnyam pa nyidaḥ ro gcig rol byed rdo rje lce yis blangasaḥ bstabs rngams tshang bcas gnyis su med par bsre ༷ 'khyud ma'i pad+ma'i ze 'bru las rdol nasaḥ 'gags med ye shes gsang ba'i dga' ston 'gyedaḥhūṃ (ཿ bsil ldan bzang po mchog gi dri bzang bsreḥ nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dza gad brlanaḥ bde legs 'tsho ba rgyas phyir 'bri mar byugaḥ dag byed yan lag brgyad ldan gtsang chab sbyaraḥ bsil ldan zug rngu skyob phyir tsan dan bsreḥ nyon mongs gcong nad 'joms phyir rab tu mnye: sgrib bral dag pa shel gyi rang bzhin steḥ yongs su bkra shis

btsan yongs su rnam par stelaḥ hūṃ hrīḥ brtse chen thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyiraḥ dngos grub kun 'byung 'khor lo'i ka pā laḥ bdud rtsi brda thabs phyag rgyas rab bcus teḥ mi nub bde mchog bde chen bum bzang bskyilaḥ bde gshegs thugs kyi rdzas su byin gyis brlabasaḥ gti mug rmongs pa'i 'gro khams dong sprugs shogaḥ rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang drungs 'byen phyiraḥ yid bzhin gter ldan rdo rje'i ka pā laḥ dri bral bdud rtsi brda thabs phyag rgyas bcusaḥ bkod pa rab mdzes bum pa bzang por bskyilaḥrgyal kun sku yi panyung byin gyis brlabasaḥ zhe sdang gtum pa'i 'gro khams dong sprugs shogaḥ byams pa chen pos khengs 'khrugs 'dul ba'i phyiraḥ 'dod 'byung bum bzang rat+na'i ka pā lasaḥ bdud rtsi brda thabs phyag rgya brten bzhin bcusaḥ dpal ldan yon tan bum pa bzang por bskyilaḥ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i yon tan bdud rtsir brlabasaḥ nga rgyal kheng 'khrugs 'gro khams dong sprugs regagaḥ zhen chags 'khrul ba'i 'gro khams 'dul ba'i phyiraḥ ma chags bde bskyed pad+ma'i ka pā lasaḥ myong grol a mṛ brda thabs phyag rgyas

bcusaX dpal spud bde mchog pad+ma'i bum bzang bskyilaḥ 'gags med gsung gi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabasaḥ 'dod zhen chags pa'i 'gro khams dong sprugs shogaḥ phrag dog 'tshubs pa'i 'gro khams 'dul ba'i phyiraḥ las rnams mthar phyin garma'i ka pā lasaḥ a dṛ stong sbyar brda thabs phyag rgyas bcusaḥ ro mnyam bde rgyas las kyi bum par bskyilaḥdus gsum rgyal kun phrin las bdud rtsir brlabasaḥ phrag dog gdug pa'i 'gro khams dong sprugs re/gaḥ hūṃ hūṃḥ bde gshegs thugs kyi rol par byin brlabs pasaḥ gti mug las byung nad rnams gso bar byedaḥ rgyal kun sku yi bdud rtsir byin brlabs pasaḥ zhe sdang las byung nad rnams zhi bar byedaḥ bde mchog yon tan bdud rtsir byin brlabs pasaḥng rgyal las bskyed nad rnams zhi zhing gsoḥ mchog gsang gsung gi bdud rtsir byin brlabs pasaḥ 'dod chags las byung nad rnams bsal bar byedaḥ rgyal ba'i phrin las bdud rtsir byin brlabs pasaḥ phrag dog las kyi nad rnams grol bar byedaḥ ma rig kun rmongs las kyi nad gdon rkyenaḥ bsal phyir pañtsa stong sbyar a dṛ spro: rlung mkhris bad

ba rte gan 'dus pa kun gso zhingaḥ bde mchog ye shes bdud rtsi 'byung gyur cigaḥ a/ badz+ra thod phreng rtsal badz+ra mu tra sarba pañtsa ro ga bisnan dz+wa ra sarba shidzña ku ruhūṃ phaṭaḥ ces brjod snod rnams legs par bkangaḥ dā la'i mdun nas bya ba'oḥ sa ma āḥ nyer gsum rlon sgrub dngos gzhi niḥ pho brang rin po che yi snodaḥ chag gas bug ral dri bral duḥ chang lang nying khu khams phor bcuḥ bzang drug bsres pas chu gtsang bcasaḥ byugs la 'degs byed rgya bsgril stengaḥ shing rtsi sna tshogs sil bur bkramaḥ de steng mo thod mtshan ldan nangaḥ bdud rtsi'i phyur bum mdzes par bkodaḥ steng du dpa' bo'i thod pas bkabaḥ phyi nang chang sbran 'bru yis 'khyudaḥ shing rtsi rlan dang ldan pa yisaḥ bar med phyur bur bkang ba'oḥ de nas khru gang ldeng khrir 'godaḥ thabs shes 'brel ba'i na bza' gsolaḥ g.yas g.yon rdo rje dril bu brtenaḥ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan mdzes pa dngaḥ dar gyi 'phan phab bcas te bkodaḥ phyi nang gsang mchod rgya mtsho sprinaḥ mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar byaḥ de nas rgyan bkod bya ba laḥ rdo rje rgyal po rgyal theb dngaḥ dam gtsang sgrub pa'i

gnyer 'dzin gsumaḥ kun gyi phyag na snang gsal thogasaḥ las kyi rdo rjes sna drangs te: gru ma bskul mas brda glus drangasaḥ tshogs kyi rol mo'i sgra sbir zhingaḥ dā la lan gsum bskor ba'i rjesaḥ snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad doḥ hūṃ hū (ཿ gsang chen rang byung o rgyan he ru ga'iḥ dur khrod mchog la rnam par dpe blang nasaḥ ya mtshan med byung pañtsa a mṛ taḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor brtsonaḥ gta' ru phye brtsal grub pa gsum mthar phyinaḥ sgog tu zag med a mṛ nul mor bsgrubaḥ sku gsum lhun grub rang byung sgyed pu'i kharaḥ dpal chen pho brang dri bral 'dod 'byung mdzodaḥ bde skyong bhan+ta lto sbyor ga'u rtsa chos kun mnyam pa nyid du brda rol ba'iḥ zag bral rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' dbyings suḥ du ma ro gcig bde ba chen por bskrunaḥ dngos grub skal pa bde stong sras gcig puḥ 'gro ba'i dpal du rnam par stsal du gsolaḥ myong grol ye shes mchog gi gzi ngar bskyedaḥ hūṃ hrīḥ ma rig mun sel ye shes sgron ma lngaḥ bde gshegs 'dus zhal bla na med pas sbaraḥ phyogs med 'od 'bar rgyal kun thugs rgyud bskulaḥ dngos grub zag

btsanyu med bdud rtsi'i char rgyun deḥ rgyal ba sras bcas mnyam sbyor byang sems mdangasaḥ zer ngad ma yal nus pa stong 'bar ba'iḥ thugs rje chen po da lta nyid du stsolaḥ kun bzang bla med mtshod pa'i sprin rgya mtshoḥ 'dzad med 1nga nas 'gags med rol par sharaḥ du ma ye shes chen por phyam brdal ba'iḥ rtags mtshan sgrub pa po la stsol ba dngaḥ ltas mtshan bzang pos rgyal khams yongs khyab nasaḥ rdzogs ldan lang tsho dar ba'i dge mtshan zhigaḥ nyam thag 'gro rnams skyob phyir bskyed du gsolaḥ snye āḥhūṃ maṇ+ḍal spra ra ṇa phaṭaḥ sto dhi tsit+ta sirnyi pha la saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ āḥ ces brjod zhal shes ji bzhin bkodaḥ da la'i dbus nas bya ba'oḥ sa ma yuḥ de nas lha bskyed bya ba niḥ rnal 'byor blo sems bag phab nasaḥ dad mos ting 'dzin dag snang bskyedaḥ dgongs pa zang thal don la gnasaḥ rol mo sna tshogs sgra sbir zhingaḥ snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad doḥ sgo/ ka tim na ya bisnan ta krita phaṭaḥ skye med chos sku zig le nyag gcig ngangaḥ 'gags med bde 1nga byang chub sems kyi srasaḥ rang grol rig pa'i rgyal po ye shes skuḥ mdun bskyedacas rgyan rak+ka

thod phreng rtsalaX che btsan 'gran bral srid gsum zil gyis gnon: rngams pa'i nga ro hūm̐ phaṭa brda glu gyeraḥ ma brtsal ye rdzogs lhun grub gzhal med dbusaḥ chags bral pad nyi bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i stengaḥ dmar spug yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po'i skuḥ khros rngams dbu 'bum spyan zlum gsum gsum bkraḥ mnyam nyid zhal gdangs mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigasaḥ ljags 'dril tshem phreng zla ba tshes ltar bkraḥ drag po'i hūṃ sgras ma rig 'khrul rgyun gcodaḥ dmar ser dbu sgra wa mig g.yas su 'khyilaḥ sum rim thod pa'i dbu rgyan cod pan mjesaḥ 'bum phrag drug cu'i khro tshul rnam par mdzesaḥ rab mdzes phyag ni 'bum phrag zung 'jug gisaḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas bye ba phrag brgya bsnamasaḥ kun kyang brtul zhugs he ru ka pa'i chasaḥ rdo rje bhan+ta bsgyur ba'i thabs su 'dzinaḥ 'bebs mdzad ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams dang sbyoraḥ byang chub sems kyi 'od zer spro bsdu mdzadaḥ mi shig bde ba'i mtsho rgyal ye shes skuḥ stong phrag zhal mnga' phyag zung gdongs 'byud kyisaḥ sgrub sde dgu yi lha rnams zhal sbyor bsnamasaḥ rdo rje pad+mo bsre ba'i rnam 'gyur gyisaḥ 'khor 'das

ba tshu dngas bcud byang chub sems nyid duḥ rol pa chen po mdzad pa'i ye shes kyiḥ gsang ba gsum rdzogs bde rol sras su bskrunaḥ sku las mi g.yo bde ba'i rol rtsed niḥ bye ba dung phyur phyogs rnams kun tu 'gyedaḥ 'bum phrag yangs pa'i ḍāk+ki kun bskul nasaḥ gnyis med mnyam pa nyid du bsre sbyor 'khyudaḥ dga' rol bde ba'i dngos grub char dbab nasaḥ stong gsum mnyam brdal bde skyong bum bzang bskyilaḥ nyon mongs gcung nad 'khor ba'i zug rngu bsgral: dwangs ma ye shes mchog gi bsil zer phabaḥ bde gshegs rdo rje'i mdzad pas 'gro ba'i khamasaḥ dong sprugs 'og min sdug po babo da pa ༄sa sbyangs spel bsgyur ba'i phrin las bsam mi khyabaḥ rab mdzes dur khrod dpal chas rus pas brgyanaḥ dar gyi dpyangs pa dril g.yer mdzes pas brgyanaḥsku lus bsko da pa 'ja' 'od thig le'i klongaḥ rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam dkyil 'khor rnamasaḥ ma lus til gong phyur bzhin gnyis med rolaḥ bde rol pad+ma'i ga'ur nor bu bsreḥ gnyis med byang chub sems kyi spro bsdu mdzadaḥ mi g.yo bde klong bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bebasaḥ

rigs bdag he ru ka dpal ḍā dril 'khrolaḥ rdo rje rnal 'byor chen mo 'khril sbyor rolaḥ phra rab rdul gyi grangs mnyam ḍāk+ki yisaḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho stob ༷tshangs ma stobs ma dkar sham bzhin bzang 'dudaḥ lha mchog gnas gsum rdo rje'i srog yig lasaḥ 'od 'phros rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcasaḥ phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan rnam pa dza3 kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin spyan drangs nasaḥ gnyis med ro gcig bde ba chen por bsreḥ badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchodaḥbastod pa glu dbyangs gzhung bzhin byaḥ de nas bzlas pa'i 'khrul 'khor laḥ rang nyid gu ru zhi ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phroḥ mdun bskyed o rgyan rak+ka thod phreng rtsal gyi thugs rgyud bskulaḥ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas zag med bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i rnam par chu klung drag po bab pa ltar skal ldan gdul bya'i dpal du stsol bar dmigs laḥ a badz+ra gu ru rak+ka thod phreng rtsal dzñā na sa ra dza ye sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta sidhi pha latsan āḥhūṃḥ bzlas pa ting 'dzin ldan pas bskyaraḥ dngos grub chu bo'i rgyun

btsa( bzhin bskulaḥ sa ma yuḥ yang bdag nyid he ru sha'i thugs ga'i sngags kyi phreng ba lu gu rgyud du byung zhal nas thonaḥ yum gyi zhal du zhugs sku yi dbyibs brgyudaḥ yum gyi pad+mo nas he ru ga'i rdo rje nor bu'i sbubs su zhugasaḥ bde stong dga' bzhi'i ye shes mchog tu 'baraḥ kun bzang mchod sprin gyi rnam pa'i 'od zer 'phros te mdun bskyed sa rgyan rak+ka thod phreng rtsal gyi zhal du zhugasaḥ sku yi dbyings brgyud nas yum gyi pad+mor babaḥ bde chen ye shes rol ba'i sku gsang brgyudaḥ yum gyi zhal nas he ru ga'i zhal du zhugasaḥ 'od zer dbang gi lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas mchog thun dngos grub kyi char chen po dbab par bsal laḥ e badz+ra gu ru rak+ka thod breng rtsal dzñā na sa ra dza ye sarba sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa sidhi sh-i rat+na sirnyi a mṛ ta sid+dhi puṣ+ṭi ma hā su kha sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ āḥ ting 'dzin ldan pas yang yang bskyaraḥ mos gus nyi mas dngos grub bskulaḥ sa ma yāḥyang rang nyid gu ru zhi ba yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams las 'od zer dbang gi zer du ma 'phro ba'i rnam 'gyur can spros teḥ mdun bskyed rak+ka sgod phreng rtsal la phogaḥ yab yum

snyoms zhugs mdzad pas dgyes brtse'i 'od zer zhal gsang bar du brgyud nas bde stong spros dang bral ba'i gzi 'od kyis bskul nas dngos grub bdud rtsi'i char rgyun sku yi cha thams cad nas bab ste dad ldan gdul bya smin zhing grol ba'i rten 'brel du dmigs laḥ ka badz+ra gu ru rak+ka thod phreng rtsal dzñā na sa ra dza ye sa pa ri wā ra ma hā bho dhi tsit+ta kwa ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta sidhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ smra bcad ting 'dzin ldan pa yisaḥ 'dzab dbyangs byas te dngos grub bskulaḥ sa ma yāḥ yang rang gi thugs ga'i sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phrosaḥ bdag bskyed gu ru rak+ka thod phreng rtsal gyi thugs rgyud bskul yab yum gyi zhal gsang bar du spro bsdu mdzad pa'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba las 'od dmar dbang gi lcags kyu lta bus rtsa khams rgyud sde bzhi drug gi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskulaḥ kun kyang snyoms zhugs mdzad pas bde stong zag pa med pa'i ye shes bskul te byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin dngos grub bdud rtsi'i char rgyun dad ldan gdul bya'i dpal du stsol bar dmigs laḥ 7 badz+ra gu ru rak+ka thod phreng rtsal dzña na sa ra dza ye pañtsa sidhi oṃ

brdezhu āhūṃḥ badz+ra kro ta ma hā bṛ he ru ka ru lu ru lu sarba sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa dzñā na bho dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha a mṛ ta dza gad sidhi ma hā bṛ sa ma ya t+t+waṃḥ ces pa smra bcad ting 'dzin dngaḥ ldan pa'i ngang nas yang yang bskyaraḥ sa ma yuḥ yang bdag nyid gu ru zhi ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phrosaḥ mdun bskyedasnyan rgyan rak+ka thod phreng rtsal yab yum gyi thugs rgyud bskulaḥ bde stong spros pa dang bral ba'i gzi 'od rab tu 'bar bas bskul teḥ dpa' bo'i sku la rol ba'i 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro thams cad dgyes par bskulaḥ zag med bde ba chen po byang chub sems kyi 'od zer sprin 'khrigs pa ltar myong grol ye shes kyi gter bde klong pad+ma'i ga'u nas 'gags med du brtsal te don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub chen po thob par dmigs laḥ bla badz+ra gu ru rak+ka thod phreng rtsal dzñā na sa ra dza ye pañtsa a dṛ ta sh-i dzñā na dhartu ma hā dza gad sarba sirnyi hūṃḥ dzñā na ḍāk+ki pañtsa sid+dhi ngh+ruḥ bzla ḍāk+ki a mṛ ta sidhi saḥ badz+ra ḍāk+ki pañtsa sirnyi 〉ཿ rat+na ḍak+ki pañtsa sirnyi 〉ཿ pad+ma ḍāk+ki pañtsa sirnyi hrīḥ karma ḍāk+ki pañtsa sirnyi āḥ bho dhi tsit+ta oṃ hūm̐ tram̐ hrīḥ.āḥ ma hā su kha

hūṃḥshrīḥshrīḥbye teḥ dzñā na dhartu sarba sirnyi pha la oṃ āḥhrīḥ smra bcad ting 'dzin gsang ba'i ngangaḥ bzlas pa chu bo'i rgyun gyis bskulaḥ sa ma yāḥ yang rang gi thugs sgog bde stong rol pa chen po'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed o rgyan rak+ka thod phreng rtsal yab yum bskulaḥ dgyes chags rdo rje gar gyi rol rtsed bsgyur ba'i gzi 'od kyis phyag gi dā la na bzhugs pa'i pad+ma 'byung gnas bye ba phrag brgya yab yum zung 'jug tu bzhugs pa rnams la phogaḥ kun kyang dgyes brtse'i bde rol mdzad nas sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin mu tig dkar po dri ma med pa'i rnam rol canaḥ zad pa med par byung nas gang 'dul mdzad pa rgya mtshos 'gro khams dong nas sprugs te sku gsum ye shes kyi dgongs 1nga du btsan sa zin par bsam laḥ ka badz+ra gu ru rak+ka thod phreng rtsal dzñā na sa ra dza ye ma hā gu ru dzñā na mu tā sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa a mṛ ta a ral+li hring hringaḥ dzñā na su kha sidhi hūṃḥya ral+li pho pho ཿ ra sa ya na sirnyi pha la sa āḥhūṃḥ smra bcad ting 'dzin ldan pa yisaḥ yang yang bzlas pas lha tshogs bskulaḥ sa ma yāḥ yang bdag gi thugs ga'i 'od zer gyis mdun

gas/ bskyed o rgyan rak+ka thod phreng rtsal yab yum dang rtsa khams kyi lha rgyud sde bzhi drug gi dkyil 'khoraḥ dgyes chags rol ba'i 'bum phrag mkha' 'groḥ rnam par brten pa'i gu ru bye ba phrag brgya yab yum thams cad thugs rgyud bsgulaḥ rol pa chen po'i brtul zhugs kyis mchog thun dngos grub kyi char chen po dbab par bsamaḥ khyad par lha de dag gi gnas thams cad nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phrosaḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba sras bcas dpag med bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams la phogaḥthugs rgyud bskul nas kun kyang sku phyag rgyaḥ gsung yig 'bruḥ thugs phyag mtshan yon tan phrin las thams cad 'ja' 'od thig le'i rnam par byung nasaḥ dpag yas nam mkha' rab 'byams gang bar byon nas 'gyur med sku 'gags bral gsung 'khrul med thugs yon tan re skong phrin las 'gro 'dul: grub pa brgyad la sogs mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol bar bsam laḥ sa badz+ra gu ru rak+ka thod phreng rtsal dzñā na sa ra dza ye sarba sa pa ri wā ra gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni budha saṅga bho dhi sa twa sa ma ya hring hring pho pho ཿ kā ya sidhi

63 wāk+ka sid+dhithang tsit+ta sid+dhishāḥ sarba sid+dhiX dad mos gus pa tshad med pasaḥ rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas bskulaḥ mchog thun ma hā sirnyi'i dpalaḥ yang yang dbab par bya ba'oḥ sa ma yāḥ nyer bzhichogs gnyis rdzogs pa dngaḥ dngos grub gegs med thob pa'i phyiraḥ ma dā na dang mai sa sogasaḥ 'dzoms pa'i ga ṇa tsakra bsagasaḥ de yang brda bskul brda lan niḥ las rdor phyag gsum zhe sa bcasaḥ phod kyi phu dung bsnol nas suḥ ho dgongs su gsol loḥ spros med chos nyid kyi dbyings su lhun grub mnyam par rol ba'i rgyal poḥ dze+ebatsun ma hā gu ru ston 'khor sprul pa dang bcas pa rnams dgongs su gsolaḥ deng gi dkyil 'khor gnyan po ye shes mnyam par rol ba'i skabs 'diraḥ dgongs pa mi g.yo bar bzhugs pa'i ston 'khor 'dus pa rgya mtsho rnams kyis rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs dngaḥ 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs pa'i phyir dngaX mchog thun dngos grub rgya mtsho gegs med yid bzhin du thob pa'i slad duḥ longs spyod tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor legs na bzhes par ci gnangaḥ rdo rje rgyal pos lan gnang baḥ nya
