bas/ 'dir 'dus rdo rje rgyal thebaḥkarma gdangs canaḥlas kyi dpa' boḥsgrol ba'i king ga raḥrdo rje gdong 'khrugs sogs 'dus pa rgya mtsho thams cad gsan du gsolaḥdeng 'dir bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por 'diraḥ tshogs gnyis kyi bre kha gang zhing dngos grub zab mo gegs med yid bzhin du thob pa'i phyiraḥmed byung ga ṇa tsakra'i 'khor lo bskor lags naḥ dngos zhen 'dzin rtogs gis ma bslad par dag mnyam ye shes rol ba chen po'i gzhung bzhin du legs par drongs dang bzhes par gnang ngoḥkun gyis zhal nas 'di skad doḥ.e ma ho a la la heḥ ces bskul gzhung bzhin tshogs mchod phulaḥ de nas bskang rdzas byin brlabs niḥs sarba dharmā ga ga na āḥste/nga pa'i ngang las mkha' dbyings rnam par dag pa'i klong duḥshel gser pad+ma rā ga in+t+ra ni la be+eḍūr+ya las grub pa'i sa gzhi rgya che la bkod legs paḥ mdzes shing khod snyoms pa yo 'khyog rtsub ral ma gas skyon dri ma kun dang bral baḥ yid 'phrog blta na sdug pa'i dbus su ā0 las kā pa la stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang duḥsha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gtso bor gyur ba'i

bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib 'dod yon gyi bkod pa thams cadaḥ me rlung 'phrod sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i brda thabs la brten nasaḥ dngos po mtshan 'dzin gyi dri ma thams cad bsregs sbyangs bkrus laḥ rang bzhin ye shes kyi rgyan bkod phun sum tshogs pa shar baḥ phyi nyer spyod bdunaḥ nang 'dod yon lngaḥ gsang ba rdo rje'i rig ma bcu drugaḥ yang gsang sman gtor rak+taḥ sbyor sgrol byang chub sems bkodaḥ shar phyogs su 'bru yi longs spyod phyur bur spungs paḥ lho ru sman gyi bang mdzod ri ltar brjid paḥ nub tu ma rmos lo thog ku mu da'i rigs byed mtha' yas paḥ byang du dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi rgya mtsho khrus chab yan lag brgyad ldan gyi rdzing buḥ gos dar ras phrug 'jam mnyen srab legs bkod mdzes paḥ tsan dan gyi bsil khang bde ba'i lo 'dab phun sum tshogs paḥ g.yu yi ne'u sang mdzes pa'i skyed tshalaḥ gser gyi bye ma bkrag 'bar ba'i 'od ldanaḥ sbyon bzang dang dril g.yer mdzes pa las chos kyi sgra snyan 'gyed paḥ cang shes sgyu rtsal ldan pas rtse 'jo khrigs khrigaḥ thal dkar mche ba drug ldan gar 'khyug brjidaḥ yangs pa

ba tshu mdongs ldan sna tshogs zlos gar shigs shigaḥri dwags bse ru sgeg bzang rgyu ru logs pas rtsed mo yer yeraḥgadong lnga g.yu ral ldan pa'i gzi mdangs 'khyug 'khyugaḥbaza' bca' mi zad pa dpag bsam shing gi dga' tshalaḥ'adod 'byung mi nub pa gter gyi bum bzang dam paḥyid la bsam 'phel re skong nor bu'i dpal khaḥ'aja' 'od thig le'i 'phan phab gdugs chenaḥrdo rje glu mas brda glu tir tiraḥgar ma rnams kyis gar bsgyur khrig khrigaḥdapa' bo rnams kyis 'bod brda 'ur 'uraḥdapa' mo yongs kyis bde stong phyam phyamaḥging pho rnams kyis bro brdung thag thagaḥging mo rnams kyis bshud glu sang sangaḥlaṅka rnams kyis rnge'u chung ting tingaḥsteng lha yi srid pa'i dpal kha phyur phyuraḥbar mi yi 'dod yon bkod pa chub tshubaḥ'og klu yi nor sna mang po thibs thibaḥstong gsum srid pa'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i mchod rdzasaḥbaskang rdzas sgrub rdzas brten rdzas mthun rdzas rnam pa sna tshogasaḥm tshang ba med pa mig 'phrul lta bu'i gter chen poḥdape 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam rol las byung ba'i mchod sprin rgya che la bkod

legs paḥ rgyu gtsang zhing spus dag paḥ ngo mtshar zhing yid du 'ong baḥ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du yul rgyal ba sras dang bcas paḥ rje mnyam med gu ru pad+ma: dpal yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drugaḥ ma gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'groḥ las byed pa'i pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cigaḥ ces brjod sngags drug phyag drug gisaḥ sbyangs spel bsgyur la byin gyis brlabasaḥ zad med nam mkha' mdzod chen 'phrulaḥ ting 'dzin rol ba'i stobs kyis bskyedaḥ sa ma yuḥ de nas tshogs bsgral 'gugs bstims niḥ tshogs snod e las lcags khang gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du tshogs rdzas de nyid dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad dngos su bskyed laḥ na mo dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal loḥ rtsa gsum rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs rje btsun ma hā gu ru'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bka' bden pa dngaḥdon dam chos nyid gdod nas rnam par dag cingaX kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden stobs kyisaḥ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'tshe zhing sems can gyi bde skyid bcom

btsan par byed pa'i 'byung po bdud kyi sde tshogasaḥ smon log dam sri pho mo rgya 'dre srin po'i rigs su gtogs paḥ kha dkar zhing khong gnag pa dam log dū tra'i tshogs thams cad skad cig rang dbang med par dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cigaḥ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs brjodaḥ de nas gzhung bzhin bsgral las byaḥ sa ma yuḥ de nas lhag gtor bsngo ba laḥ las kyi rdo rjes zhu bskul niḥ hoḥ rdo rje grub pa'i rgyal po'i gtsos 'dir tshogs 'dus sde rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol ༷ sngon gyi tha tshig zab mo mi g.yel ba dngaḥ dngos grub rgya mtsho gegs med yid bzhin du 'byung ba'i slad dngaḥ brin las rab 'byams thogs pa med par 'grub pa'i phyir duḥ lhag gtor 'dod rgu'i dpal yon du sprul nas phul pa la thugs rjes dgongs par zhu: ces brjod gzhung bzhin lhag gtor phul: phrin las bcol la tha tshig bsgragasaḥ gtor ma cha gsum phul nas suḥ 'byung po'i tshogs rnams brngan par byaḥ sa ma yāḥ nyer lnga sgrub pa'i rkyen bzlog phyiraḥ nyul le bsgrad chog bya ba laḥ dug shog la ni dug khrag gisaḥ liṅka dbang tshang

bkod pa yiḥ snying gar dṛ tri dza lto sbyoraḥ bya rog gnam sman ra nu ma ༷ bse mgo klu the'u rgyal bsen rnamasaḥ khug dza zhes brjod bla 'gugs dzaḥ phyi rim bden brjod drag sngags brtsamaḥ dza khram nyer gcig la sogs bskoraḥ lcags khang gru gsum nang du gzhugaḥ de nas e bskyed bya ba niḥ e dzaḥ mdun du e las gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom nag po kha dog la mthil yangs pa'i dbus su triḥlas sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dam sri nyul le thams cadaḥ nyam thag pa'i gzugs can rkang lag lcags gzer gyis theb paḥbu ga dgu nas rnag khrag 'dzag paḥ 'dar phri li li byed pa zhig tu bskyed laḥ na moḥ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal loḥ mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa ba gsum dang bden gnyis baspu ba med pa'i nus stobs kyisaḥ 'byung po dam sri nyul le nag po bdud kyi rigs su gtogs paḥ smon log bdud kyi sde tshogs bsam sbyor gnag byed thams cad skad cig rang dbang med par gzugs liṅka 'di la khug cigaḥ dza ā gar+sha ya dzaḥ tri ā gar+sha ya dza dzaḥ bdun nam gsum nyer gcig la sogs brjodaḥ de nas pho nya bskyed pa laḥ

gas/rnya bdag mdun rnams kyisku yi cha thams cad nasaḥbadud 'dul dpal gyi pho nya 'jigs byed kun thub rgyal mo rngams brjed bltar mi bzod pa dpag tu med pa 'phros teḥganod byed dam sri 'byung po thams cad la las bkug cing liṅka la bstimasaḥl las mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis bsadaḥl las sra brtan lci zhing 'thas pa'i rdzas sna tshogs thogs te gnod byed brgyal zhing mnan pa'i las mdzad par bsam laḥhūṃ khye'udakyil 'gor chen po'i mtha' skyong dam tshig canaḥsgrub pa lung gi pho nya chen mo niḥ'ajigs byed khro mo kun thub rgyal mo zhesaḥsku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang mthing nag rngamasaḥbazhad pa ha heligad rgyang 'brug ltar sgrogasaḥbarda skad phaṭa pho gyer bas sa gsum g.yoḥphyag g.yas spu gris dgra bgegs 'byung po yiḥmago lus tshal bar gtub cing rdul du brlagaḥgayon pas me yis ma rig 'khor ba bsregasaḥmache ba rab gtsigs nyams pa'i sha la zaḥljags dmar slog sdeb dam nyams khrag la gzhib:rngams pa'i nga ros ma rung glad pa 'gemasaḥrdo rje'i 'gros kyis stong gsum yud tsam bskoraḥ

sprin mar me mched bar snang go skabs 'byedaḥ las mdzad pho nya ging chen bsam yas 'gyedaḥ mi lpags g.yang gzhi sbrul dang mgo phreng sprasaḥ ral ba'i gseb nas dug khrag char ba 'bebasaḥ zhal gyi rlangs pas 'byung po 'bog brgyal byedaḥ rdo ngar phur bas zhabs bsgrad srin po gziraḥ bstan bshigs rū tra'i snying 'byin chang bar bcugaḥ dgra la bab na dug gi kha phru 'debasaḥ bgegs la bab na don snying mngon du 'byinaḥ sri la bab na rū pa rdul du brlagaḥ dngos grub 'phrog cing rku ba'i smon log rnamasaḥ thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlag pa yiḥ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ bla gha gha gha ta ya gha ta yaḥ sarba duṣ+ṭhan phaṭa phaṭaḥ gī li ya ki li ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭaḥ badz+ra dha ro a dzña pa ya tiḥ sarba bisnan kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra gī li ki la ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ snyed grum bu a pa tse rū pa tse na ra caḥ tsa me thunaḥ na sha s+t+waṃ bha yak+kaḥ bī na ya gaḥ phye ma phye maḥ rdul phran rdul phran tsit+ta rbadaḥ dz+wa bha ya nanaḥ mā ra ya nanaḥ thum ri li li e khung thum dza rbad sodaḥ ces brjod thun gyi char ba dbabaḥ gu gul dud spro rol mo ziraḥ gnad kyis dgra dpung rdul du brlagaḥ

gas/: dam sri nyul le drungs 'byin 'gyuraḥ sa ma āḥ nyer drug pho nyar gtor 'bul niḥ rin chen snod du dkar gtor bshamasaḥ bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas slaraḥ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can 'phros teḥ ri rab kyi phyogs bzhi nas rgyal chen sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs teḥ dam tshig bskyed pa'i lha la sib sib bstim moḥ badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥbhū baṃ hoḥ a/ dhi ṭa raṣ+ṭa ye sa pa ri wā ra e dam bha ling ta kha kha khwa hi khwa hiḥ 37 be+e ru ta ka ye sa pa ri wā ra e de ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ sa/ be+e ru pak+ṣa ye sa pa ri wā ra e de ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ skyed be+e shra ma ṇa ye sa pa ri wā ra e de bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ lan bdun res phul laḥ biḥ phyogs skyong rgyal chen sde bzhi poḥ rang rang g.yog 'khor dpung dang bcasaḥ 'dir gshegs dam tshig rten la bzhugasaḥ 'dod yon mchod gtor skyems bzhes laḥ'ajigs pa brgyad sogs zhi ba dngaḥ tshe dpal bsod nams 'byor rgyas shingaḥ mos bzhi dbang du sdud pa dngaḥ dam sri tshar gcod drag po'i lasaḥ rab 'byams phrin las ma lus

paḥ thogs med myur du grub par mdzodaX 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog pa dngaḥ dngos grub sgrub pa'i las mdzod cigaḥ dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegasaḥ gnad kyis phrin las gegs med 'grubaḥ sa ma yāḥ de nas dmar gyi gtor ma bshamasaḥ rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyisaḥ gi las bhan+ta lcang lo can gyi nang du sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyuraḥ 3 āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum dang ni mdzod sngags kyisaḥ sbyangs spel bsgyur la byin gyis brlabasaḥ sa badz+ra kro ta ya man+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra e do ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ lan bdun gyis phul dgyes pa bskangasaḥ ho gzhal yas chen po'i sgo srung baḥ khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po yisaḥ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di 'bul bzhesaḥ sku gsung thugs yon dgyes bskang nasaḥ rnal 'byer sgrub pa po rnams laḥ mchog thun dngos grub char bzhin phobaḥdam sri nyul le rdul du rlogaḥ da byung rtags mtshan bzang po stonaḥ dus la bab po sa ma yāḥ ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegasaḥ sa ma yāḥ de nas gtor ma byin

gtsa/ rlabs sogasaḥ gong ltar grub rjeb 'di ltar phulaḥ e badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kurnya li sa pa ri wā ra e dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ lan bdun gyis ni phul bar byaḥ hoḥ dkyil 'khor nang gi sgo srung baḥ khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil ba yisaḥ sna tshogs mngon spyod phrin las kyisaḥ gsang ba mchog gi dal sgo srungasaḥ phyi nang nyer 'tshe zhi ba dngaḥ dngos grub gegs med stsol ba sogasaḥ don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzodaḥ dus drug nyul zhing 'khor ba'i bgegasaḥ smon log dam sri pho mo rnamasaḥ bsgral 'dren drag po'i las mdzod cigaḥ dus la bab po sa ma yuḥ ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegasaḥ sa ma yāḥ nyer bdun bsreg blugs 'bul ba niḥ thab stegs khod snyoms mdzes pa'i stengaḥ lha gnas mchu dang kha khyer muḥ zla phyed rdo rje pa tra risaḥ tshon gyis mdzes pa'i ri mo briḥ las bzhi'i shing gis me hom brtsigasaḥ me dar rlung g.yab tshogs par byaḥbadag mdun bskyed bzlas mchod cing bstod: srung ma gsol mchod nan du byaḥ rigs me dor la he ru ga'iḥ chas su zhugs nas 'di ltar byaḥ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes dang

gsumaḥ dang po sa chog bya ba laḥ dkar gtor rnam lnga shing rtsis brgyanaḥ bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas slaraḥ rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyisaḥtsogamanyo ma mtshar rmad byung las bzhi lhun grub gyiḥ phrin las rgya mtsho spel bar bya ba laḥ dngos grub rtsol med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phyiraḥ phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i sa bdag mched lnga dngaḥ sa yi lha mo sa bdag lto 'bye dngaḥ yul lha gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyong rnams laḥ mchod sbyin gtor ma zag med bdud rtsi 'bulaḥ dgyes bskang phrin las rab 'byams 'grub pa yiḥ grogs mchog mdzad pa'i pho nyar nyer bcol loḥ tha tshig ma g.yel dus bab sa ma yāḥ bla bhu mipā tis pa ri wā ra e rda ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ lan bdun gyis phul dgyes pa bskangasaḥ de nas thig tshon bkye ba laḥ aramazwaḥ rmad byung rgyal bsladakyil 'khor bzhengs pa laḥ chos dbyings ḍāk+ki mdangs phyug 'od ldan masaḥ mi bskyod rang bzhin mkha' tshon mthing ga 'dzinaḥ bde gshegs thugs kyi dwa la bzhengs su gsolaḥgrimed 'od gsal ḍāk+ki ma ma kisaḥ rnam snang rang bzhin chu tshon dkar po bsnamasaḥ mi 'gyur sku yi dā

ba:tshu la 'phrul lu gsolaḥro mnyam ye rgyal bde chen ḍāk+ki yisaḥrin 'byung rang bzhin sa tshon gser mdog 'dzinaḥyon tan gsang mdzod dā la bskyed du gsolaḥbade rol srid pa cha snyoms dbang mo yisaḥsnang mtha'i rang bzhin me tshon dmar po bsnamasaḥgasung mchog dbang gi dkyil 'khor gsal bor stonaḥmangon par dga' byed dam tshig sgrol ma yisaḥdon grub rang bzhin rlung tshon ljang gsal 'dzin:phrin las yongs kyi dwa la bkram du gsolaḥkun kyang thabs stobs gar bsgyur rab mkhas pasaḥmi shig mi 'gyur rdo rje gsang ba'i thigaḥbade stong ro gcig dā lar rgyas thob cigaḥsbyo masnyol badz+ra spa ra ṇa phaṭaḥse ha ra ṇa hūṃḥces brjod thig tshon zhub tu bkyeḥrab gnas bkra shis me tog 'thoraḥtshom bu lha yi bkod 'phrul paḥmadzes shing yid 'ong tshang bar bsagasaḥgasang sngags thabs kyi lam yin phyiraḥdangos grub phun sum tshogs las byungaḥs ma yāḥganyis pa dngos gzhi'i las gzhung lasaḥbasreg rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa niḥbla āshrīḥthabs shes lto sbyor byang chub sems nyid lasaḥrab bskyed bsregs rdzas

ye shes lnga yi bcudaḥ phyi nang gsang gsum bkod pa mtha' yas pa'iḥngo mtshar kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin duḥ dbyings las bton te dbyings khyon bkang bar spelaḥ sa hūm̐ swā ā+ohāX hūṃḥswe ༷shīḥt+t+waṃḥhūṃ badz+ra spra ra ṇa dzaḥ ces pas rgya khyon dpag yas spelaḥ de nas me sbar bya ba laḥ 'bar me thogs la 'di skad doX hūm̐ hrīḥ me yi ngo bo bde gshegs snang mtha' yasaḥ rang bzhin mtshan nyid bzhi ldan rab 'bar bsaḥ las ni gnyis snang mtshan rtog dri kun bsregs: dwangs ma ye shes rol bar sbyangs bsgyur spelaḥ sa/ āḥ(ཿdz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ḥ ces pas me thab sbar bar byaḥ de nas me thab bsangs sbyangs niḥ tshod swa bha wa sa stong par sbyangasaḥ mi dmigs chos dbyings stong pa'i ngang nyid las: lhun grub rang byung gzhal med mdzes pa'i dbusaḥ ma chags pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla'i stengaḥ hrīḥyig 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa lasaḥ mdun bskyed gu ru zhi ba 'dzum mdzes bzhadaḥ dkar dmar mdangs ldan bcu drug lang tshos 'khyud phyag g.yas thod pa'i ṭā ru mkha' la dkrolaḥ g.yon pas bhan+ta bdud rtsi dku la brtenaḥ gsang gos dar dpyangs pad zhwa rat+nas brgyanaḥ

btsa( dmar ser chos gos mthing sham rab mdzes klubasaḥzhabs gnyis sag lham dang bcas rol thabs bzhugasaḥgasang ba'i yum mchog mdzadza rgyal sbas tshul 'changaḥ'aja' 'od klong bzhugs snang srid zil gyis gnonaḥrigs bdag he ru ka pa cang te 'khrolaḥphyogs bzhir dpa' bo thod phreng sde bzhi niḥdar dang rus pa rat+na'i rgyan cha sprasaḥgri gug thod 'dzin gyad kyi 'dor thabs bsgradaḥdangs ma 'od sku 'dzin med lha ru bskyedaḥde rgyab sprul ba'i rig 'dzin chen po brgyadaḥdakar ser dmar ljang mthing gsal 'dzum mdzes bzhadaḥrdo rje bhan+ta bsgyur ba'i thabs su 'dzinaḥstong gsal 'dzin med dwangs ma'i phung por bskyedaḥphyi rim gu ru mtshan mchog rnam pa brgyadaḥbartul zhugs rgyal po rnal 'byor sngags 'chang tshulaḥdage slong sprul sku khro rgyal 'jigs byed dpalaḥrang rang phyag mtshan ma nges sna tshogs 'dzinaḥgazhan snang zil gnon ye shes sgyu 'phrul bskyedaḥde rgyab 'gro 'dul gu ru sde drug niḥsprul sku'i cha byad gzhon tshul lang tshos 'khyudaḥlcags kyu sgrom bu pusti gseg shing dngaḥme chu ral gri bsgyur ba'i thabs su

'dzinaḥ de rgyab grub chen brgyad cu rje 'bangs tshogasaḥ ma 'dres yongs rdzogs til gong phyur bzhin gsalaḥ phyag mtshan sna tshogs ma nges gang 'dul 'dzinaḥ sgo srung las mdzad ging chen sde bzhi dngaḥ dpa' bo dpa' mo las mdzad pho nya 'khrigs: sgyu 'phrul rol rtsal ye shes 'od kyi klongaḥ snang la rang bzhin med par gsal bar bskyedaḥ kun gyi gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gsal lasaḥ 'od zer rab 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcasaḥ gu ru rin po che yi rnam pa dzas spyan drangs dam ye gnyis su med par bstimasaḥ de nas spyan 'dren bya ba niḥ hūṃ hrī ༷ rngams brjid rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo nasaḥ 'gro ba'i mgon po o rgyan pad+ma 'byungaḥ lo paṇa rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcasaḥ mos gus gdung shugs drag pos spyan 'dren naḥ rdzu 'phrul mthu yis skad cig spyan 'dren gshegasaḥ las bzhi lhun grub mdzad pa mthar phyin mdzodaḥ skyo badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ de nas bzhugs su gsol ba niḥ hūṃ hrī: sgyu ma gzugs brnyan chu zla 'ja' tshon bzhinaḥ 'od zer ye shes lnga ldan dā la rtsa dbyings nas spyan drangs ye shes 'khor lor

ga tshu bsreḥ ro gcig bde ba chen por bzhugs par 'tshalaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ de nas phyag 'tshal bya ba niḥ na moḥ skye 'gags 'gyur med ye shes skuḥ rang byung thugs rjes 'gro rnams sgrolaḥ re skong dngos grub char rgyun 'bebasaḥ pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal loḥ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba niḥ rgyas par spro na gzhung bzhin 'bulaḥ bsdu na sngags mchod tsam gyis 'thusaḥ slar yang byon skyems 'bul ba niḥ ( hrīḥ thabs shes byang chub sems kyi rgyun las byungaḥ dgyes mchod pañtsa a mṛ mchod pa'i mchogaḥ zag med ye shes rol bar spel brlabs 'phrulaḥ nam mkha' mdzod kyi mchod chen gus pas 'bulaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ pañtsa a dṛ ta khā hiḥ nyer gcig gis phul dgyes pa bskangasaḥ de nas bsreg rdzas mar khu niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ rtsi bcud 'bru bcud zhun mar mdangs dang ldanaḥ me rlung thabs kyis bskul te zhu ba'i skyemasaḥ zung 'jug brda las 'dzag pa'i a mṛ taḥ ma hā gu ru'i dgyes pa bskang phyir 'bulaḥ las bzhi lhun grub mdzad pa mthar phyin re/gaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hiḥ bdud rtsi

sman gyi dpal la 'tshe ba'i 'byung po sarba sha t+t+waṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma ra sma ra ku ru ku ru shidzña puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas yam shing 'bul ba niḥ / hrīḥ tsan dan a gar shug dmar nya brud dngaḥ 'om bu sur dekar la sogs shing sna yisaḥ phrin las lhun grub mdzad pa mthar phyin phyiraḥ ma hā gu ru'i sku gsung thugs mchog bskangaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ bo dhi brik+ta ye swā hāḥ bdud rtsi sman gyi dpal 'byor bkrag mdangs la bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po sarba sha t+t+waṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma ra sma ra ku ru ku ru shirnyi puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas yungs dkar 'bul ba niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ ma rung gdug pa 'dul byed sngags kyi rdzasaḥ khro rgyani dgyes bskyed yungs dkar mchod chen poḥ rje btsun ma hā gu ru'i dal du 'bulaḥ gdug tshogs drung nas 'byin pa'i dpal mchog stsolaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ sarba atho sid+dhi ye swā hāḥ bdud rtsi sman gyi nus mthu bgegs 'joms zab mo'i dpal du 'tshe ba'i 'byung po sarba sha hūṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma ra sma ra ku ru ku ru shidzña puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas zas mchog 'bul ba niḥ ( hrīḥ dkar gsum

—4(7 mngar gsum 'bru sman bsres pa yiḥ zas kyi mchog chen a mṛ dam pa nyidaḥ rigs kun yongs 'dus ma hā gu rur 'bulaḥ shes rab mchog 'bar bde ba rab ldan regagaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ sarba se pa de swā hāḥ bdud rtsi sman gyibacud chen shes rab mchog gi bde ba la nye bar 'jab pa'i 'byung po sarba sha t+t+waṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma ra sma ra ku ru ku ru shidzña puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas 'bras dkar 'bul ba niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ 'bru yi mchog gyur bkra shis dge ba'i rdzasaḥ 'bradre dkar ye shes bdud rtsir rab bsgyur baḥ ma hā gu ru'i dgyes pa bskang phyir 'bulaḥ mi zad longs spyod 'dod rgu'i char chen phobaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa yeswā hāḥ bdud rtsisman gyi yon tan 'dod 'byung dpal gyi phrin las la bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po sarba sha t+t+waṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma ra sma ra ku ru ku ru shirnyi puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas 'bru nas 'bul ba niḥhūṃ trīḥ zad med yid bzhin gter du byin brlabs pa'i 'bru yi hūṃl po khre nas ro bcud ldanaḥ ma hā gu ru'i dgyes pa bskang phyir 'bul: phrin las gang brtsam myur ba'i shugs

ldan mdzodaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ ma hā be ga ye swā hāḥ myong grol bdud rtsisman gyi dngos grub 'gro ba'i dpal du shar zhing smin grol du tshud pa'i myur ba'i shugs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i bdud bgegs dam sri pho mo sarba sha t+t+waṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma ra sma ra ku ru ku ru shidzña puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas so ba 'bul ba niḥ ( hrīḥrtsol med yid bzhin re skong mchog gi rdzasaḥ 'bru yi dparlo 'phel so ba bsam mi khyabaX ma lus rje btsun gu ru'i zhal du 'bulaḥ dgyes bskang 'bru nor phun sum tshogs par mdzodaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ ma hā bi dzā ye sā hāḥ bdud rtsi yon tan rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug 'bru nor gyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i sgo dam par 'tshe ba'i 'byung po sarba sha t+t+waṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma ra sma ra ku ru ku ru shirnyi puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas yung dkar 'bul ba niḥ ྅ hrīḥ 'bru yirang bzhin nus pa phun sum tshogasaḥ bcud ldarne dpal gyi mchod sprin dam pa yangaḥ ma hā gu ru'i dkyil 'khor dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ nyon mongs gcung nad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ badz+ra ghasma ri ye swā hāḥ

btsa/: bdud rtsi a pro ta nyon mongs gcung nad 'byin pa'i thabs mchog bla na med par shar ba la nye bar 'tshe ba'i 'byung po sarba sha t+t+waṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma rang sma ra ku ru ku ru shit+t+waṃ puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas sran ma 'bul ba niḥ hūṃ trīḥ ma rung rtsad gcad bdud 'dul ye shes smanaḥ 'bru yi dhebs mchog ma hā ba lā yaḥ rje btsun ma hā gu ru'i dal du 'bulaḥ dgyes bskang lus la stobs mchog bskyed du gsolaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ ma hā ba lā ye swā hāḥ bdud rtsi sman gye nus pas 'byung khams gso zhing bskyed par byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri 'byung po sarba sha t+t+waṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma ra sma ra ku ru ku ru shidzña puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas dur wa 'bul ba niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ 'chi med tshe yi ljon shing rab gos zhingaḥ dpal gyi 'bras dhīn rdzas mchog dur wa yangaḥ rje btsun ma hā gu ru'i dal du 'bulaḥ dgyes bskang tshe dpal yon tan bskyed du gsolaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ badz+ra ā yu ṣeswā hāḥbadud rtse sman gye nus pas 'gro ba'i tshe dpal bskyed pa la bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po sarba sha t+t+waṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma

ra sma ra ku ru ku ru shidzha puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas ku sha 'bul ba niḥ hūṃ hrī bkra shis rdzas mchog ku sha'i chun 'phyang niḥ 'jam mnyen rma bya'i mgrin ltar 'khyug pa'i rdzasaḥdapal ldan pad+ma ka ra'i dal du 'bulaḥ dgyes bskang 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsolaX rtsa sngags mtharaḥ a pra ti ha ta badzā ye swā hāḥ bdud rtsi sman gyi nus pas 'gro ba'i lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grol ba dngaḥ bsrung ba'i ra gur du tshud pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po sarba sha t+t+waṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma ra sma ra ku ru ku ru shis puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas shing tog 'bul ba niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ lo 'dab can gyi shing las rab bskyed pa'iḥ 'bras bu rje bcud nus ldan lha yi zasaḥ rje btsun ma hā gu ru'i dal du 'bulaḥ mnyes bskang mi nub bsrung ba'i ra gur stsalaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ gha gha ni gha gha ni bi lo ki ti ye swā hāḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir bsgyur bas 'gro ba'i rigs rgyud dang chos rgyud spel bar byed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po sarba sha t+t+waṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma ra sma ra ku ru ku ru shidzña puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas rdzas gsum

bas/ 'bul ba niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ 'gro ba'i nad sel gi waṃ sman gyi mchogaḥ khams gsum dbang sdud li khri mtshal chen dngaḥ nyon mongs gcung 'byin bzang po drug gi gsosaḥ rje btsun thugs rje'i gter chen dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ e haṃ gha sarba pu dza khā hiḥ bdud rtsi sman gyi nus pas 'gro rnams myong grol du 'god pa la nye bar 'tshe ba'i 'byung po sarba sha t+t+waṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma ra sma ra ku ru ku ru shidzña puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas shug gu rteng dkar 'bul ba laḥ ( hrīḥ 'khrul ldem g.yu 'od 'bar ba lha yi shingaḥ ro bdūd dri ldan bzang po'i ngad pa canaḥ rje btsun ma hā gu ru'i dal du 'bulaḥ mi mthun phyogs rnams 'joms pa'i nus mthu stsolaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ sarba pu dza khā hiḥ bdud rtsi sman gyi phrin las 'gyed pa la bar du gcod pa'i snang srid khams kyi dregs pa'i gdug rtsub sarba sha t+t+waṃ a mu ka da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sma ra sma ra ku ru ku ru shirnyi puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas gzhung bzhin bstod pa byaḥ bskang bshags tshogs mchod rgya chen phulaḥ so rtsi reg bya ༵bul ba niḥ bla badz+ra haṃ bu lā ye swā hāḥ bla badz+ra wasta ye

swā hāḥ ces dang rol mo'i sgra yis bstodaḥ de nas gtang rag mchod pa niḥ hūṃ trīḥ ye shes ting nge 'dzin las bskyed pa yiḥ phyi nang gsang gsum rnam dag mchod pa'i sprinaḥ rje btsun ma hā gu ru'i dal du 'bulaḥ sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dgyes pa bskangasaḥ sa ma hā pañtsa pu dza hoḥ de nas bstod pa bya ba niḥ ( hrīḥ mngal gyis ma gos pad+ma'i sbubs las 'khrungasaḥ pha ma rus rigs rtogs pa'i skyon kun bralaḥ ngang las ma g.yos thugs rje 'phrin las canaḥ pad 'byung ye shes sku la phyam gcig gdod ma'i gzhi la sangs rgyas shogaḥ lan gsum rjes su shis brjod niḥ hūṃ trīḥ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen dar ba dngaḥ skye 'gro yongs la phan bde'i nyi ma sharaḥ don gnyis gegs med yid bzhin 'grub pa yiX bkra shis rgya mtshos phyogs rnams khyab gyur cigaḥ ces brjod me tog sil ma bkramaḥ bsngo smon shis brjod dga' ston byaḥ gnad kyis tshe dpal 'byor rgyas shingaḥ sgrub 'bras gegs med dus su sminaḥ sa ma āḥ nyer brgyad bkra shis glu dbyangs niḥ e maX dga' 'o skyid do mkha' spyod rig 'dzin gyi tshogs dralaḥ bde legs dpal 'bar yon

ba rte tan rgya mtsho yi dus stonaḥ bkra shis skyid kyi nyi ma rnam gsum de shar nasaḥ mkha' khyab phan bde'i char rgyun zag med du spel phyiraḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i phrin las kyi dpal khaḥ ma bsgom chos lnga'i ya rgyal myong grol mchog brtsam nasaḥ rab 'byams zhing khyab byang chub sems mchog gi gzi ngaraḥ bkra shis yon tan 'bras bu dus smin du bstsal nasaḥ rgyal kun gsang gsum rdo rje 'gags med du shar baḥ dus ston skyid kyi ro gsar yar tshes bzhin 'phel nasaḥ mi 'gyur o rgyan he ru'i gnas mchog tu nges shingaḥ mchog sprul pad+ma'i rnam rol ston pa gang rab ngesaḥ rgya gsum chings lngas spras pa'i dam chos kyi nges gsangaḥ tshogs smon las 'phros bskul ba'i dam ldan gyi tshom buḥ mnyam nyid ka nas dag pa dus ston gyi nges donaḥ lnga ldan yan lag bzhi pa'i phrin las kyi dpal sgo mi nub bstan 'gro'i 'dod 'byung tshogs sgrub kyi gsang lamaḥ lha mi srid pa gsum gyis mchod 'os su bsngags goḥ ro gcig ro mnyam bde skyong bum bzang du bskyil nasaḥ dbang byin dngos grub rgya mtsho'i char rgyun de dbab cingaḥ

sgrub mchog dad ldan dpal du shar ba de ngo mtsharaḥ dkyil 'khor gsum ldan sngags kyi zlos gar de bsgyur nasaḥ dbyings gsum 'ub chub bde sang btsun mo yi bha garaḥ rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul rol rtsed skad cig la bsre bsgyuraḥ 'khor gsum yongs dag kun bzang dgongs klong du yan pa'iḥ ngo mtshar bkra shis che ba'i dga' ston de zhu'oḥ ces brjod bkra shis glu dbyangs gyeraḥ dngos grub byin rlabs gegs med 'byungaḥ sa ma yāḥ nyer dgu sgrub pa'i cha lag tuḥ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa laḥ rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyisaḥ.aḥlas bhan+ta lcang ma can yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma dṛḥdang triḥlas dgra bgegs dngos su gsal laḥ na moḥ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum chos skyong srung ma'i bden pa dngaḥ don dam chos nyid ngo bo gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dngaḥ kun rdzob rten 'brel bslu ba med pa rgyu 'bras zab mo'i bden pa'i mthusaḥ rgyal bstan rin po che dang der 'dzin 'dus sde rgya mtsho la bar du gcod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegasaḥ nyes med sems can gyi bde skyid bcom pa'i bdud sde ༷ phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun

bsgo/ gyi dkor la rngams pa'i rkun poḥ bshad sgrub zab mo mkhon 'dzings kyis gtor pa'i dam logaḥ chos byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri: nyams ting nge 'dzin la bar du gcod pa'i bdud steḥ sa lam gyi yon tan la bar du gcod pa'i rgyal bsen: nad mug mtshon 'khrug dus kyi rgud pa slong ba'i 'gong nagaḥ mi brdzu dgu brdzu byed cing phag tu yib cing 'gab tu 'ji ba'i 'byung po gzugs can gyi dgraḥ gzugs med kyi bgegasaḥ tshe len gyi bdudaḥ bar chad kyi rkyenaḥ byad ma rbod gtong lha srung dang bcas pa thams cad skad cig rang dbang med par sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cigaḥ dzahūṃ baṃ hoḥ bdag mdun gyi sku las mtshon thun gyi char dbab pas dgra bgegs kyi gzugs phung khrol gyis gtub nasaḥ rnam shes āḥdakar dri ma med pa'i rnam par bskyed lha yi thugs gar bstim nas sangs rgyasaḥ tshe bsod d+dhiḥyig ljang gu'i rnam par bdag bskyed kyi snying gar zim pas tshe bsod bkrag mdangs rab tu rgyasaḥ gzugs phung sha yi ri boḥ khrag gi rgya mtshoḥ rus pa'i gram khrodaḥ bde stong r+sha shes kyi bdud rtsi'i

rnam par gyur pa srung ma rnams kyis gsol bas bstan dgra dam sri 'byung po'i sde tshogs stong par bsam moḥ chad mdo gtong zhing phrin las bcolaḥ de nas brtan gtor byin brlabs niḥ traḥ las rin po chelisnod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bshal chu dang gtor ma zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dod yon nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyuraḥ a/ āḥ( ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum dag gis byin gyis brlabasaḥ sngon tshe dpal chen po'i spyan sngaraḥ khas blangs ba'i mi sdug khro zhal ma'i bu mo bdud kyi sring mo bzhin dngaḥ dkar sham bzhin bzang ma'i bu mo gnod sbyin mched bzhiḥ sman btsun bde ba gzugs stel ma'i bu mo sman mo bzhi rang rang g.yog 'khor dpung dang bcas pa skad cig gis byon nasaḥ dā la'i rgyab yol ba bkram pa'i phag tu brtan ma dpon g.yog dbu 'phang dma' la tha tshig dran bzhin 'dar yed yed du gnas par bsam laḥ gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcolaḥ de nas bro 'gugs bya ba laḥ gtor gzhong kha sbubs ba dang mnyam du mi mthun pa'i phyogs dam sri 'byung po thams cad nub par gyuraḥ na mo mchog gsum sku gsum

ba tshu rtsa gsum bden gnyis bablu ba med pa'i nus stobs kyisaḥ gnod byed dam sri 'byung po thams cad gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og rol du khug cigaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnod byed dam sri pho mo thams cad 'chi bdag las gshin nag po'i lto bar tshud nas 'phar ldang mgul bskyod mi nus par 'bogs brgyal thul thul song bar bsam laḥ gzhung gi rta bro 'don par byaX gtor gzhong bsod nams kyi snod yar btegs pa'i tshe bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dpal bsod nams 'byor drug gi yon tan thams cadaḥ zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par bsam laḥ hūṃ ā yu pukhye puṣ+ṭi ku ru swā hāḥ ces brjod mtha' rgyas legs par byaḥ gnad des grub 'bras gegs med 'byungaḥ sa ma āḥ sum cu skam sgrub byed pa'i dusaḥ dngos grub bskul len bya ba niḥ mos gus gdung shugs drag po yisaḥ gsol ba gdab pa 'di skad doḥ bye hoḥ rgyal kun spyi gzugs ye shes rdo rje'i skuḥ 'gro ba 'dren mdzad gu ru thod phreng rtsalaḥ a tsar+ya mchog thod phreng sde lnga dngaḥ rig 'dzin rnam brgyad

mtshan mchog brgyad dang niḥ bka' bab bu dgu 'gro 'dul gu ru drugaḥ grangs tshom dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i lha tshogs rnamasaḥ thugs rje brtse ba chen pos dgongs su gsolaḥyang yang bsnyen cing sgrub pa tshad du 'khyolaḥ dngos grub zab mo rtags mtshan bzang por bcasaḥ bdag cag sgrub pa po la stsal du gsolaḥ ma rig le lo som nyi 37ra ba dngaḥdug lnga rlang par spyod dang bag med 'chalaḥ 'byor tshogs mchod gtor chung zhing spyang ku byasaḥ che chung rtog pas bslad cing kha tshar shoraḥ re bas dngos grub 'phrog cing yal du bcugaḥ sku gsung thugs 'gal nongs pa ci song yangaḥ snying nas 'chags so dag tshangs sor chud mdzodaḥ rdo rje gsang bas btang snyoms mi mdzad par: rngams brjid rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo nasaḥ rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa'i phrin las kyisaḥ skad cig 'dir byon rtags mtshan bzang po stonaḥ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar pañtsa a mṛ taḥ ro brgya nus ldan ba ling mchod chen poḥ nyon mongs chags pa bsgral ba'i rak+ta dngaḥ 'dod yon ro mnyam bde rol mchod pa rnamasaḥ gus pas 'bul lo dgyes pa chen pos bzhesaḥ bde stong ye shes

bsgo/ gzi 'bar nus byin gyisaḥ skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe dbang bskuraḥ bkrag mdangs 'od 'bar byin rlabs lus la sboraḥ tshangs dbyangs 'gags med rdo rje'i gsung dbang stsolaḥ 'gags sdud rmongs bral ngag la gzi ngar bskyedaḥ mkhyen gnyis ye shes thugs kyi dbang mchog stsolaḥ 'khrul bral rig stong rjen pa'i rang ngo sprodaḥ'agran bral yon tan mchog gi dbang chen rtsolaḥ nyams rtogs nub med gong 'phel rab rgyas mdzodaḥ 'gro 'dul phrin las zab mo'i dbang mchog stsolaḥ gzhan snang zil gnon 'khor ba dong sprugs shogaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir brlabs pa'i rten 'brel gyisaḥ mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba 'dren par shogaḥ lha mchog khyed zhal dran pa'i skal ldan kunaḥ mi mthun 'jigs brgyad g.yul bzlog nus mthu stsolaḥ gang gi mdzad pa thos pas yi rang rnamasaḥ tshe bsod nyams rtogs rgyas pa'i gzi byin phobaḥ gang skur zhen med mchod sprin stobs rnams laḥ khams gsum dbang sdud re skong dngos grub stsolaḥ gang la 'di phyi'i re ltos bca' ba rnamasaḥ phyi nang bdud las rgyal ba'i nus stobs bskyedaḥ gang drung spos

dang me tog phul ba laḥ rtsol med yon tan rgya mtsho 'khrung bar mdzodaḥ gang dran 'o dod gsol ba 'debs rnams laḥ dus kyi rgud pas mi 'jigs mthu dpal bskyedaḥ gang zhig mi brjed yid la 'dzin rnams laḥ mchog dang thun mongs gnyis kyi dngos grub stsolaḥ yid bzhin gter ldan rdo rje'i ka pā laraḥ dbab bskyil bstims brtan rdo rje thod phreng rtsalaḥ mi g.yo thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ 'dod 'byung dpal spud rat+na'i ka pā laraḥ bsre bsgyur bzhu mnyam rat+na thod phreng gisaḥ yon tan nub pa med pa'i dngos grub stsolaḥ ma chags bde spel pad+ma'i ka pā laraḥ thing dbab spel sgrub pad+ma thod phreng gisaḥ 'gags med gsung gi dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ las rnams mthar phyin garma'i ka pā laraḥ bsdu rol bsre spyor garma thod phreng gis 'phrin las mi zad pa yi dngos grub stsolaḥ dpal spungs bde mchog 'khor lo'i ka pā laraḥ btul phyir rol rtsed budha thod breng gisaḥ 'gyur med sku yi dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ rdo rje gsang ba'i bde sbyor gnyis med rolaḥ 'phrin las gar bsgyur 'khor ba dong sprugs shogaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ kā ya

ba:tshu pañtsa sirnyi maḥwāk+ka pañtsa sirnyi āḥtsit+ta pañtsa sirnyi hūṃḥsarba pañtsa sirnyi 〉ཿkarma pañtsa sirnyi trīḥces dang kha bskang dpal shar sbyoraḥdangos grub bdud rtsi'i char rgyun gyisaḥ dad ldan gdul bya'i myu gu 'khrungaḥde nas rlon sgrub las la sbyoraḥ'agro 'dul phrin las bsam yas sharaḥ sa ma yāḥso gcig bdud rtsi rlon sbyor gyis: sgrub pa mthar son grub pa'i tsheḥ dngos grub bskul ba'i gsol gdab laḥthog mar tshig bdun bzlas ba dngaḥ bzhengs bskul rdo rje'i tha tshig bsgragasaḥ rol mo dbyangs kyis byin chen dbabaḥmos gus gdung shugs drag pos bskulaḥ de nas thal mo sbyar nas suḥsnyan pa'i tshigs gis 'di skad doḥkye hodagongs shig rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsalaḥgason cig dpa' bo mched lnga mtshan mchog brgyadaḥgazigs shig rig 'dzin brgyad dang gu ru drugaḥm g.yel ma bul dad ldan bu la dgongasaḥkaing dang lang ga rig 'dzin bro gar bsgyuraḥdapa' bo dpa' mo rgyal chen las la nyulaḥ rje 'bangs rig 'dzin lo paṇa gnad la dgyesaḥbadag nyid dad pa ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyisaḥyang yang bsnyen cing sgrub pa

tshad du 'byelaḥ dngos grub zab mo stsol len dus la babaḥ thugs la le lo btang snyoms mi mdzad paraḥ rdo rje'i dam dgongs rnga yab dpal ri nasaḥ sku yis gar bsgyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyamaḥ gsung gis chos char dad ldan bu la 'bebasaḥ thugs kyis 'od zer sgrub pa po la sharaḥ yon tan stobs kyis gzhan snang zil gnon cing: phrin las thabs kyis 'khor ba ru rlog nasaḥ ma hā gu ru'i gsang gsum dā la rtsa mngon par byang chub mchog gi dngos grub nyidaḥ mi ring myur ba nyid du stsol bar mdzodaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥkā ya sirnyi tse ཿ wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi 〉ཿ sarba sirnyi hrīḥ 'dzab dbyangs byas te brgya rtsa brgyadaḥ bzlas la mchod cing bstod par byaḥ sa ma yāḥ de nas tho rangs bdag mdun dngaḥbazlas pa mchod bstod gsol mchod rjesaḥ bskang tshogs phul rjes nyul le bsgradaḥ byin chen dbab cing gnad bsdu byaḥ de nas gsol ba gdab pa niḥ kyi hoḥ brgyud pa dgu ldan bla ma dngaḥ rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam lhag pa'i lhaḥ gnas gsum ḍāk+ki dpa' bo dpa' mo dngaḥ tha tshig la gnas dam can nor bdag rigasaḥ kun gyi 'byung gnas ma hā gu

bsgo/ tsu ru rjeḥ rang mdangs ma 'gags 'khor gyi tshom bu bcasaḥ thugs rje brtse ba chen pos dgongs su gsolaḥbadag gidaka' ba dang blang ngal khyad bsadaḥ lus sgog 'ben btsugs lha mchog bsnyen cing sgrubaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i rnal 'byor brtsonaḥ rab 'byams zheng khyab byang sems spro bsdu mdzadaḥ 'khor 'das dwangs bcud ma lus bsdus te bstimasaḥ bde legs phye bsgrub 'dod 'byung rlon sbyor brtsamasaḥ kha bskang bsreg blugs grub phyir phrin las 'gyedaḥ bsags sbyangs spel grub gnad rnams mthar phyin pasaḥ rdo rje'i dam dgongs btang snyoms mi mdzad paraḥ mchog thun dngos grub stsol len dus la babaḥ gsang b.lidus bab rdo rje'i nam yang langasaḥ brten byed rtse la nyi zla 'od 'bar rgyasaḥ rak+ka pho mo bde stong nyams la spyodaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gros rol mo'i sgra snyan sbir: rnga yab dpal ri'i tshogs rje pad+ma 'byungaḥ dam dgongs gnad bskul skad cig 'dir byon laḥ mchog thun dngos grub sbrang char rdol ba bzhinaḥ dad ldan sgrub pa po la stsal du gsolaḥ khye'us pha mar 'bod pa'i gdung dbyangs kyisaḥ

snying po sham bcas bgrangs ba'i sgras bskul naḥ dpal gyi ri nas brtse chen thugs rje yisaḥ sgrub pa'i gnas der byon nas dbang bskur roḥ sa ma yuḥ de nas sman raka gtor mchod 'bulaḥ bro bshags bya zhing yig brgya bzla: sgrib bral shel gyi 'od dang mnyamaḥ dngos grub 'jug pa'i las skal ldanaḥ bdag cag sgrub pa po rnams kyis mos gus drag po tshad med byas pas bskul teḥ mdun bskyed lha tshogs rnams bde stong chen po'i rol rtsed mdzad pas gzi 'od 'byung zhingaḥ gnas lnga dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas byin rlabs 'od zer yi ge'i rnam pa can dngaḥ 'ja' thig phra rags bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par byung steḥ bdag bskyed kyi gnas so sor zim pasaḥ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob teḥ sgrub byed dang bsgrub bya dbyer med du gyur bar bsam laḥ bla āḥhūṃḥ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku dang ye shes bdagaḥrdo rje mi byed gsang gsum mchog gi mdzodaḥ deng 'dir bdag cag sgrub pa po rnams laḥ byin brlabs sku gsung thugs su mdzad du gsolaḥ bla sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kwa ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra swā bha wa ad+ma:ko3nyaḥ de

gas6 nas bum dbang len pa niḥ hūṃX kun zlum bum pa rgya chad phyogs lhung bralaḥ bde gshegs sku yi gsang mdzod bla na medaḥ ma hā gu ru'i dkyil 'khor spro bsdu 'gyedaḥ 'od zer dkar gsal maḥgyi gzi 'od 'baraḥ sgrub mchog bdag gi spyi bo nas zhugs teḥ lus dang rtsa yi sgrib pa kun dag nasaḥ snang stong gnyis med ye shes nyams myong zhingaḥ rnam smin rig 'dzin mchog gi sa nod cingaḥ sprul ba'i sku mchog 'grub pa'i dbang mchog stsolaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ ka ya sidhi saḥ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas gsung dbang len pa niḥ (ཿ bde skyong bhan+ta yid bzhin gter ldan nangaḥ rgyal kun gsung gi gsang mdzod dam pa steḥ 'gags med a li ka li'i rang sgra sgrogasaḥ rta phag zhal sbyor byang chub sems kyi bcudaḥ 'od zer dmar gsal āXyi bkrag mdangs 'baraḥ sgrub mchog rnams kyi mgrin pa nas zhus/sa teḥ ngag dang rlung gi sgrib pa kun dag nasaḥ gsal stong gnyis med ye shes nyams myong zhingaḥ tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin sa nod cingaḥ longs spyod rdzogs sku 'grub pa'i dbang mchog stsolaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ wāk+ka sidhi āḥ wāk+ka a bhi

ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas thugs dbang len pa niḥ hūṃḥ dri bral dwangs gsal ka dag dpe yi rdzasaḥ 'od lnga zlum 'khyil mtshan ma med pa'i dalaḥ bde gshegs thugs kyi gsang mdzod dam pa steḥ skye med yi ge āyi gsung dbyangs sgrogasaḥ kun bzang yab yum dgongs pa ro gcig ngangaḥ 'od zer mthing gsal (ཿgi rnam par mdzesaḥ sgrub mchog yongs kyi snying ga nas zhugs teḥ yid dang zig le'i sgrib pa kun dag nasaḥ rig stong gnyis med ye shes nyams myong zhingaḥ phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin sa nod cingaḥ skye med chos sku 'grub pa'i dbang mchog stsolaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ ཿ de nas yon tan dbang blang niḥ hūṃḥ kun nas zlum 'byil dwangs gsal me long laḥ khams gsum dbang sdud li khri sgog yig mdzesaḥ rgyal kun yon tan gsang mdzod dam pa steḥ ma bcos rang grol nya ri niḥsaḥsgrogasaḥ thod phreng yab yum dgongs pa nyag gcig dwalaḥ 'od zer gser mdog hrīḥyi mtshan pa canaḥ sgrub mchog rnams kyi lte ba nas zhugs teḥ sgo gsum cha mnyam sgrib pa kun dag nasaḥ dbyings rig gnyis med ye shes nyams myong zhingaḥ

gas/ lhun grub rig 'dzin mchog gi sa nod cingaḥ ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i dbang mchog stsalaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ sarba sirnyi hrīḥ sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas phrin las dbang blang baḥ hūṃX khyab bdag mi g.yo 'gro ba'i mgon po yiḥ sku dang ye shes mchog gi gsang mdzod niḥ 'od thig lnga ldan 'ja' zer 'phro 'du canaḥ byin rlabs gzi 'bar rgyal ba kun gyi dbyingasaḥ bdag thim snang gsum shes sgrib phra ba bcomaḥ zad pa gsum rdzogs rgya grol ye shes mjalaḥ khyad chos drug ldan rgyal sar mnga' brnyes pa'iḥdabang byin dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsolaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ karma maṇ+ḍal sid+dhi (ཿ karma maṇ+ḍal a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ ces brjod dngos grub rdzas rnams gnas gsum gtugasaḥ'ajug pa mthar phyin mchog gi dbang blang ngoḥ sa ma āḥ so gnyis sgrub pa'i rdzas rnams kunaḥ ngangos grub mchog tu rol pa laḥ sgrub gtor thogs la 'di skad doḥ hūṃ hrīḥ chos dbyings rab 'byams bde 1nga snod nang duḥ dkyil 'khor rab rdzogs dpal chen pad+ma spungasaḥ ma hā gu ru rje 'bangs lo paṇa tshogasaḥ yongs rdzogs dpal chen 'dus pa'i dā la

steḥ bdag gis sgrub pa tshad them gnad smin pasaḥ bde legs mchog gi dngos grub ma lus paḥ da lta nyid du stsol bar mdzad du gsolaḥ rtsa sngags mthar maṇ+ḍal ba ling ta a bhi ṣiñtsa skyo a la la hoḥ sa a la la hoḥ ka a la la hoḥ ces brjod gnas gsum gtugs la blangasaX nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel zhing rgyasaḥ sa ma yuḥ de nas thod pa ril mar nyidaX dngos grub rol la 'di skad doḥ hūṃ hrīḥ byin rlabs chen po nam mkha'i sprin dang 'draḥ dngos grub zab mo bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bebasaḥ 'chi med tshe yi g.yung drung bcud chen poḥ dad ldan sgrub pa po yi dpal du sharaḥ chags bral bde ba chen pos nyams myong naḥ skye 'chi bsgres rgud bral ba'i dngos grub stsolaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ sa ā yudzñā na ma hā pukhye tshe hūṃ dzaḥdza sarba sirnyi pha la shāḥ ces brjod ro mnyam chen pos spyodaḥ tshe dpal bkrag mdangs gzi brjed rgyasaḥ sa ma yuḥ de nas thud phrum rol byas teḥ hūṃ hrīḥ skye med mkha' dbyings dag cing gsal ba rtsa 'gags med lhun grub rig pa'i nyi ma sharaḥ gnyis med bde spyor dam rdzas rmad byung baḥ sgrub mchog dad dam ldan pa'i dpal du

bsgo/: sharaḥ rnam dag ro la rol ba'i gar bsgyur gyisaḥ gzi brjid bkrag mdangs rgyas pa'i nus byin phobaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ tshe t+t+waṃ ma hā pukhye sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ ཿces brjod 'dzin med dag par spyodaḥ dngos grub thob pas bde stong 'charaḥ sa ma yāḥ de nas lnga ldan rol byas teḥ hūṃ trīḥ rje btsun thugs rje'i gter chen bum bzang lasaḥbrin las lhun grub yon tan rgya mtsho'i gzhiḥ phan bde 'byung gnas dngos grub zab pa'i gteraḥ sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag gi dpal du sharaḥ don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i bde legs stsolaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ tshe sbyo a mā ra ṇi dzi brnyi ye swā hāḥ ces brjod 'ub chub chen por rolaḥ dngos grub grub pa'i rtags mtshan 'charaḥ sa ma yāḥ de nas bzhi dbyibs rol byas teḥ hūṃ trīḥ mi 'gyur tsho yi g.yung drung sra brtan brjidaḥ bde stsol bde ba'i 'byung gnas yon tan mdzodaḥ phan bde'i lo 'dab dar rgyas dpal kha yangaḥ deng 'dir rig 'dzin rnams kyi dpal du sharaḥ bde spyod chags pa bral bas dang du lenaḥ mi nub bstan pa dar rgyas dngos grub stsalaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ ā yudzñā na a pa ri mi ta

sarba sid+dhi pha la hūṃ ཿ ces brjod chags bral dga' bdes spyodaḥ nyams rtogs rab rgyas don kun 'grubaḥ sa ma yāḥ de nas thod rgya rol byas teḥ sa trīḥ nus mthu stobs 'dzoms gsang sngags 'byung ba'i gnasaḥ bde skyong bde rol dpal gyi ka pā laḥ sgrub rdzas ye shes mchog gi snang ba'i dpalaḥ tshogs smon las 'dzoms sgrub mchog dpal du sharaḥ 'ub chub mnyam pa nyid du legs spyod naḥ 'dzad med phrin las gang ga'i rgyun bzhin stsolaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ tshe hūṃ ka pā la ā yu sarba sirnyi trīḥ ces brjod mnyam nyid rol bar spyodaḥdangos grub gang ga'i rgyun bzhin 'byungaḥ sa ma yāḥ de nas tshe 'brang dza gad dngaḥ tshe chang nyi zla kha sprod rnamasaḥ dngos grub rol la 'di skad doḥ hūṃ hrīḥ mkha' la thogs med bsgod pa'i gshog pa steḥ 'phur ldan stobs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ rgya mtshor mi g.yang 'dzul stobs shes pa yiḥ 'jug rol rlabs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ chos dbyings mkha' la rig pa'i nyi ma sharaḥ dgongs pa zang thal dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ dga' stong zung 'jug 'od gsal 'char ba yiḥ bde 'byung tsan+t+ra'i dngos grub stsal du

gas/ gsolaḥ sa'achi bsgres rgud kun dang bral ba yiḥ rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ las bzhi gang brtsam thogs med 'grub pa yi: brin las nub med dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ rgyal bstan nub med so kha bsrung nus pa'iḥ stobs mchog yon tan rgya mtsho'i dngos grub stsolaḥ las snang 'khrul 'khor dbyings su rab gcod pa'iḥthabs chen thugs rje'i dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ 'gro khams rgya mcho dong nas sprugs nus pa'iḥ byang chub sems kyi dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ tshe gcig srid pa'i pha mthar rab bsgal ba'iḥ don gnyis rgya mtsho grub pa'i dngos grub stsolaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ sarba garma gu ṇa pha la sirnyitharngo ār+yāḥ ces brjod dngos grub zab pa'i gteraḥ gang ga'i rgyun bzhin 'gags med 'byungaḥ sa ma yuḥ so gsum bdud rtsi a dṛ ta'iḥ dngos grub len par bya ba laḥ dang po gsol ba gdab pa niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ samed chos dbyengs dag pa'i 'od klong nasaḥ rtsa gsum rgya mche'i spyi gzugs thod phreng rtsalaḥ a tsar+ya mchog gtso 'khor sprul pa bcasaḥ mnyam nyid dbyings las thugs rjes nye bar dgongs mchog thun dngos

grub zad pa med pa'i gteraḥ bdud rtsi a dṛ ta yi dpal kha mchogaḥ sgrub pa'i gnad 'byor skal ldan bdag cag laḥ ring por mi thogs skad cig da lta dza3 dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i bcud chen poḥ da lta nyid du rtags mtshan bzang po bcasaḥ mos ldan bu mchog rnams la stsal du gsolaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ pañtsa sirnyi oṃ āXhūṃḥ brgya rtsa brjod la bskul bar byaḥ mchod cing bstod la dgyes pa bskangasaḥ de nas las kyi rdo rje yisaḥ phyag gsum bcas te lha reg gisaḥ 'khyud de sman sgrom legs par btegasaḥ swā la bskor nas 'di bzhin brjodaḥ a ho0 zhing rnam dag o rgyan he ru ga'i dus stonaḥ yul dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba yi rnal 'byoraḥdon bsags spel bsgyur grub dngos grub du shar baḥ deng mchog gi dpa' ba'i zhabs drung du phul ma ཿ rtsal thugs rje'i bsil zer bdag cag la bstsal nasaḥ lus mi spang rig 'dzin tshogs gral du pheb pa'iḥ dpal dus ston 'gag med shar ba 'di ngo mtsharaḥ ces brjod rdo rje rgyal por phulaḥ slob dpon pad+ma'i phyag rgya bcasaḥ e ma ho rin thang dang bral ba'i rat+na'i gteraḥ bdud rtsi lnga sha chen rnam

bsgo/ pa lngaḥ rgyal ba'i dal nyag gcig shar ba yiḥ dngos kun gyi dngas ma a mṛ taḥ sbyangs spel bsgyur grub pa'i myong grol 'diḥ skal med la ma shar sgrub pa poraḥ dngos grub kyi nyi ma shar ba 'diḥ bde legs kyi 'byung gnas e ma hoḥ ces brjod blang la gnas gsum gtugasaḥ de nas tshom thu yongs rdzogs kyisaḥ shin tu spro ba'i rnam 'gyur bcasaḥ snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad doḥ e ma ho 'gyur lhun po sku yi gsang mdzod nasaḥ bde gshegs yongs la mchog gi nyi ma sharaḥ su la ma shar sgrub mchog bdag la sharaḥ1mi zad sku yi dngos grub a la laḥ 'gags med gsang mchog bde sang rol ba nasaḥ rgyal kun yongs rdzogs gsung gi nyi ma sharaḥ su la ma shar sgrub mchog rnams la sharaḥ 'gags med rdo rje'i gsung dbang a la laḥ 'khrul bral ye shes rdo rje'i gsang klong nasaḥ rgyal kun 'ub chub thugs kyi nyi ma sharaḥ su la ma shar sgrub mchog rnams la sharaḥ mi 'khrul gnyug ma'i thugs dbang a la laḥ re bskang 'dod 'byung dpal gyi bum bzang lasaḥ yon tan rgya mtsho rab rdzogs nyi ma sharaḥ su la ma shar

sgrub mchog rnams la sharaḥ 'gran bral gter gyi dngos grub a la laḥ mi zad phrin las mchog gi bang mdzod lasaḥ gang 'dul phan bde'i 'byung gnas nyi ma sharaḥ su la ma shar sgrub mchog rnams la sharaḥ 'gro khams dong sprugs nus mthu a la laḥ 'jigs tshogs ming med zhi ba'i dngos grub dngaḥ 'byor drug nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel rgyas mdzodaḥ khams gsum srid pa'i dpal la dbang 'byor zhingaḥ drag rtsal bstan dgra'i dpung 'joms mthu stobs bskyedaḥ bdistong phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub dngaḥ sku gsum gsang ba zab mo mngon gyur mdzodaḥ nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa kun dag nasaḥ dungs ma'i 'ja' sku grub pa'i dngos grub stsolaḥ bstsal dang stsol ba mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings: lhun rdzogs rig pa'i ye shes zung 'jug nasaḥ bcu drug ye shes bla ma'i sa thob shogaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ sarba pañtsa a pro ta kā ya sirnyi maḥ wāk+ka sirnyi āḥ tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃsarba sidhi trīḥ ces brjod mos gus drag po yisaḥ rol bar byas pas nyams rtogs rgyasaḥ lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grolaḥ rdo rje gsang ba'i ye shes mjalaḥ sa ma yāḥ che da

bsnye bzhi mchod cing bstod pa yiḥ dmigs 'dun rnam dag bya ba laḥ mchod rdzas bshams pa'i ngo bo stong pa nyid du gyuraḥ stong pa'i ngang las dbyings dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa'i cho rol las 'gyed pa dngaḥ bdag mdun gyi gnas rnams las 'phros pa'i phyi nang nyer spyod bdun gyi mchod pa dngaḥ nang 'dod yon lngaḥ gsang ba sman gtor rak+taḥ yang gsang sbyor sgol de kho na nyid kyi mchod sprin rgya mtsho nam mkha' rab 'byams kyi khams gang bar spros teḥ rdo rje'i lha mo rnams kyis mjes pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma dang ldan pa'i sgo nasaḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bulaḥ sku gsung thugs yon tan brin las rnams dgyes pa bskangasaḥ mthu stobs nus pa gzi brjed dbyings nas dngos grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phel zhing rgyas par bsam laḥ mchod pa 'bulaḥ slar yang mchod pa'i lha mo mdzes 'dzum blta bas chog mi shes pa rnams kyis sku mdzes pa'i gar byed khrigs khrigaḥ phyag rol mo sna tshogs sgra snyan 'ur 'uraḥ zhal 'dzum sgeg lang tshos bde stong phyam phyamaḥ thugs 'dud pa'i dad mos dag snang ban bunaḥ

gsung snyan pa'i bstod dbyangs sna tshogs tir tiraḥ lha tshogs rnams la rdo rje glu yis dgyes bskyed phul bar bsam laḥ bstod pa byaḥ slar mchod bstod kyi dga' ston 'byed pa po thams cad bdag mdun gyi gnas so sor thim pas dbang byin dngos grub thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par bsam laḥ bshags pa byaḥ ho dgongs su gsol loḥ rgyud dang sgrub sde'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi spyi gzugasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs su gsolaḥgasang chen dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i sgor zhugs nas tshogs gnyis kyi bsags spel ma nus pa dang: sgrib tshogs ma rig pa spang zhing sbyangs ma nus pa dngaḥ rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' bzhin du gzhung ma bsrangs pa dngaḥ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig 'gal 'das ral ba dngaḥ yan lag nyer lnga'i sdom dam las 'das te sel zhugs pa dngaḥ nya stong dus drug la tshogs dang gtor ma rgyun chad pa dngaḥ spyang ku kha tshar zhugs shing ser sna rngam sems rlom sems 'bogs 'gril gyis bslad nas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mi dgyes pa'i

btsaX bya ba ngan pa byas pa dngaḥ bag med kyi spyod pa rtsing zhing bcas khrims zab mo las g.yel zhing 'gal ba dngaḥ ta na sgrol ba gnas su ma stobs pa dngaḥ ga ṇa sbyor ba byin gyis ma rlobs pa dngaḥ mchod sngags dang phyag rgya zab mo dang du ma lon pa dngaḥ dge ba bcu yang dag par ma spyod pa dngaḥ mi dge ba bcu rtsad nas ma chod pa dngaḥle lo dang 'du 'dzi g.yeng bas bsgrus nas las nyon ma rig pa'i dbang du gyur nas tshe 'di dang phyi mar sgrib par gyur ba'i las phra rags ji snyed cig bsags pa thams cad mi 'chab boḥ mi sted doḥ slan chad srog la bab kyang mi bgyid naḥ dag cing tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsolaḥ o sa ma yāḥ āḥs ma yāḥ hūṃ sa ma yāḥ badz+ra bhi shud+dhi āḥ yig brgya gsum gyis lhag chad bskangasaḥ des ni sgrib dag dngos grub thobaḥ nyams rtogs yon tan gong 'phel rgyasaḥ don rnams gegs med lhun gyis grubaḥ the tshom sted do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ sa ma yāḥ so lnga phan yon bstan pa niḥ e maḥ gnas phun sum tshogs pa lho rgyal 'dzam gleng gi thig leḥ yul rmad byung sgrub gnas gong ma'i byin rlabs kyi

gzhi ༄ཿ dpal gu ru pad+ma'i phrin las nyag gcig gi ston paḥ tshogs las smon rten 'brel bzang pos bskyed pa yi 'khor bcasaḥ chos nges don zab gsang rdo rje snying po yi dpal khaḥ 'dir sgrub pa kun gyi ya gyal a dṛ ta'i mdzad phrinaḥ zhing rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs gzi 'od kun bskyil nasaḥ gang phrin las rgya mtsho'i bang mdzod myong grol gyi bkod paḥ mar 'gro khams dong sprugs nus pa'i chos 'khor mchog bskor nasaḥ dpal sgo rgyan nyaru ka yi dus ston dang mnyam moḥ don dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i bsrung 'dud ni 'bral medaḥ rje rak+kalirgyal po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi byin rlabasaḥ de mthong thos dran reg lhur len byed pa po kun kyangaḥ don ldan no rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs gral la pheb ngesaḥ lar mdzad med yon tan rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin la gzhal nasaḥ tshig lce brgyas bstod kyang zad mtha'i dpog par ni mi 'gyuraḥ dpal 'di'adralidakyil 'khor gnyan po'i dal zhal re phye baḥ don rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston 'gyed byed kyi lde'u migaḥ steng lha khams spro ba'i mchod sprin me tog gi zil dngaraḥ dus nub med gaṅga'i rgyun

badz+ra bzhin 'byung ba de nges donaḥ bar dpa' bo ḍākri dgyes pa'i rol rtsed kyi gar dngaḥ don mi nub yon tan bdud rtsi'i dpal kha de 'gyed ngesaḥ 'og klu gtod gnyade gyi gdengs kha'i nor bu bzhin bsrung zhingaḥ don 'dzad med skren las 'byung ba'i dpal kha de 'gyed nasaḥ rje gu ru'i mdzad phrin smon lam dus smin 'di ngo mtsharaḥ deng tshogs mchog dam pa khyed rnams dga' spro dang ldan pasaḥ sems 'khor gsum yongs dag thugs smon bzang po re mdzod dang ༷ ye mi ring khyad chos drug dang ldan pa yi rgyal saraḥdapal gzhon nu bum sku'i rgyal srid yang dag la 'byor nasaḥ rtsal phrin las sprul pas bstan 'dza'i bde skyid de spel ngesaḥ ya dga' bo skyid do o rgyan mkha' 'gro yi tshogs gral: we grub po ldan no zangs mdog dpal ri yi zhing duḥ da mi ring sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur rang grol la zhig tsheḥ rje u rgyan pad+ma'i zhabs drung 'tshogs pa yi smon lamaḥ lha drang sgong grub pa'i bden tshig pra ṇi dha brjod doḥ yul rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas 'grub thabs zhig zhu'oḥ zhes brjod mos gus drag po dngaḥ ldan pas ngang nas dag snang bskyedaḥ tshom

bur dpal rir bsgrod pa yiḥ spron lam dri ma bral bar gdabaḥ gsang sngags che ba'i khyad chos 'byungaḥ the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ sa ma yāḥ dngos gzhi las gzhung bsrad ba'i rim pa'oḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥgasum pa rjes kyi rim pa laḥ rnam grangs rim pa lnga yi bstanaḥ dang po rgyal tho bsdu ba laḥmachod gtor byin brlabs pu dza 'bulaḥ gtor ma phul zhing bstod pa byaḥ de nas bshags pa bya ba niḥnyo ste ge mo yi lha tshogs dgongasaḥ bdag ni ma rig dbang gyur teḥ khyed rnams thugs dang 'gal ba'i lasaḥ ma bskang brngan pa ral ba sogasaḥ ci bgyis gnong 'gyed drag pos bshagasaḥ tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsolaḥbadz+ra sa ma ya āḥyig brgya bzlas la lhag chad bskangasaḥ de nas bsdu rim bya ba niḥhe deng 'dir gsang chen zhal phyes nasaḥ thog mar bsnyen cing bar du sgrubaḥ tha ma las sbyor dngos grub grubaḥ bdag gi bsam pa mtha' ru phyin: phrin las rgya mtsho dus su 'byung: sku drin chen por gyur ba legasaḥ da ni rang rang gnas su gshegasaḥ slar yang bsnyen sgrub lhur len tsheḥ thugs rje brtse bas der skyongs shigaḥs ma yā rluḥde nas shis

badz+ra pa brjod pa niḥ / hrīḥ 'dod 'byung dpal gyi bum bzang bzhinaḥ 'gro ba'i re skong thugs rje'i smanaḥ yid bzhin char 'bebs srung skyobs lha'i: phrin las lhun grub bkra shig shogaḥ nyin yang dpal 'bar ta la laḥ mtshan yang bde spyod kyi li liḥ rtag par chos 'khor 'u ru rtsa phan bde 'byung ba'i dge legs stsolaḥ zhes brjod me tog sil ma bkramaḥ bkra shis dga' ston rgya cher byaḥ gnad des phan bde'i lo 'dab rgyasaḥ the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ sa ma yuḥ gnyis ba sman gyi dbang bskur baḥdad ldan mos gus dag snang canaḥ gang zhig smin cing grol ba'i phyiraḥ a dṛ ta yi dpal mchog 'gyedaḥ sa ma yuḥ de yang khrus dang bgegs bsal baḥ bsrung 'khor bsgom la bden don bshadaḥ maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol gdab niḥ bye ho :na rlabs 'byung gnas rdo rje bla ma dgongasaḥ myong grol nyon mongs nad sel a mṛ taḥ dngos kun bdud rtsi bsgyur ba'i bcud chen po'iḥ dngos grub ma lus sgrub pa po la stsolaḥ lan gsum rjes su lan gnang baḥ kyi nyo tshogs smon las 'asgo bzang pos bskul ba yiḥ rigs ldan pho mo dad mos

drags pos gsonaḥ myong grol sman gyi dngos grub sbyin dgos naḥ ro mnyam bde ba'i 'ub chub byed nus/ samaḥ zag med 'dzin zhen bral bas spyod nus samaḥ yid ches nges shes snying nas 'drongs nus samaḥ phan bde'i dga' ston 'gro la 'gyed nus samaḥ yongs su ldan pa'i rnal 'byor skal ldan laḥ bde sbyor mi 'gyur gsang ba'i dngos grub mchogaḥdakyil 'khor yongs 'dus bdag gis sbyin par bya'oḥ de nas slob mas dam 'dzin paḥ kyeho rgyal kun spyogazugs bla ma'i spyan snga rtsa mi 'da' mchog gi sdom pa dam tshig ni ༷ji snyed rim pa ma lus yongs su 'dzinaḥ srog gi slad du mi gtong sa ma yāḥ badz+ra kā wā ci sa ma ya na ra gnaḥ de nas dam chu sbyin pa niḥ ho 'dinidam chig gsang ba'i mna' chu steḥ rdo rje gnod sbyin sgu gsung thugs kyi ngangaḥ rigs ldan slob ma khyod kyi lce la bzhagaḥ dam bsrung mchog thun dngos grub tshe 'dir thobaḥ nyams na rdo rje dmyal bar ltung ta reḥ0〈cog ldog gnad las ma g.yel sa ma āḥ ces brjod dam chu lce la bzhagaḥ dam tshig bsgrags shing tha tshig bgoḥ de nas ste/ba ma lha ru gsalaḥ ye shes dbab bstims nan du

badz+ra tsu byaḥ de nas sku yi dbang bskur baḥ hūṃ hrīḥ skye 'chi med pa rdo rje tshe yi dbangaḥ nub pa mi mnga' g.yu drung tshe yi dpalaḥ snang stong gnyis med rtogs pa'i dngos grub bcudaḥ rigs ldan slob ma khyod la sbyin bgyi'oḥ sa ba bu a yu sidhi pañtsa a mṛ ta ka ya a bhi ṣiñtsa maḥ de nas gsang dbang bskur ba niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ 'gag med rang grol rdo rje lu gu rgyudaḥ bde skyong dpal gyi bcud chen a dṛ taḥ rigs ldan skal pa bzang po rnams la sbyinaḥ gsal stong gnyis med ye shes nyams myong regagaḥ shes k+ta k+ta ka pā la ma hā su kha wāk+ka a bhi shi mi āḥ de nas thugs dbang bskur ba niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ tsu la bral bde spyodang dpal gyi bum bzang lasaḥ cir yang snang grags ma 'gags bde ba cheḥ thugs mchog bdud rtsi'i dpal bcud yang gsang gteraḥ rigs ldan bu mchog rnams la legs par sbyinaḥ bde stong gnyis med ye shes mngon gyur shogaḥ sa ma dze+epuṣ+ṭi ka pa dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃḥ de nas yon tan dbang bskur baḥ hūṃ hrīḥ mi shig mi 'gyur yon tan gsang mdzod lasaḥ bde legs dpal gyi bcud chen zab pa'i dpalaḥ rigs ldan skal bzang rnams la legs

sbyin nasaḥ rigs stong gnyis med ye shes nyams myong shogaḥ sa ca ci ka ke pu pu me tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa (ཿ de nas phrin las dbang bskur baḥ hūṃ hrīḥ 'jen las mi zad dgos 'dod kun 'byung dpalaḥ don grub yon tan rgya mtsho'i phrin las rgyunaḥ sgrub mchog rnal 'byor yongs kyi dpal du sbyinaḥ sgu gsum ye shes mngon du 'gyur bar shogaḥ sa gar haṃ dza ye ha k+ṣe shrī ma hā su kha a bhi ṣiñtsa treḥ de nas mthu stobs chen po yiḥ dbang dang dngos grub len pa laḥ hūṃ hrīḥ lus la skye 'chi 'jigs pa mi 'byung phyiraḥ 'bras bu gsum dang bzang drug nus bcud bskyilaḥ ngag la 'gag sdud bcing sdom mi mnga' ba'iḥ dkar mngar nus ldan mchog gi dngos grub stsolaḥ yid la rmugs 'thibs bag chags mi 'byung phyiraḥzag med rab bskyed sman gyi dngos grub stsolaḥ 'jigs pa brgyad sogs mi mthun rgud pa sogasaḥ zhi zhing stong pa'i dngos grub char ltar phobaḥ 'byor drug tshe bsod nyams rtogs rgyas pa sogasaḥ yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub stsolaḥ khams gsum srid gsum dbang du sdud pa sogasaḥ chags bral bde ba chen po'i dngos grub stsolaḥ log 'dren

btsanyu drungs 'byen ma rung rtsad gcod pa'iḥnus mthu phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub stsolaḥbade stong mi 'gyur phyag rgya chen po yiḥdangos grub zab mo sgrub mchog rnams la stsolaḥdon rnams gegs med yid bzhin 'grub pa yi:phrin las zad med mchog gi dngos grub stsolaḥ.a āḥhūṃ ra sa ya na shrī shrī ma k+ta pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ hrīḥde nas bkra shis rjas brgyad gtad laḥhūṃ hrīḥphan dang bde ba'i'abyung gnas dam pa steḥmi nub bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i rdzasaḥ'adod 'byung dpal ldan rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas gteraḥsgrub mchog snying gi bu la rnam par sbyinaḥgang bsam thogs med 'grub pa'i dpal thob shogaḥ.aṣ+ṭa mang ga le a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥde nas bkra shis rtags brgyad gtad laḥhūṃ trīX skyobs pa gser gdugs 'dod 'byung bum pa bzangaḥrgyang grags dung dkar 'dod 'byung dpal belumi nub rtags mchog brgyad kyi dpal kha nyidaḥrigs ldan skal bzang rnams la bdag gis sbyinaḥbastan 'gro'i don kun 'byung ba'i bde legs stsolaḥrat+na mang ga le a bhi ṣiñtsa.o ཿde nas rgyal srid sna bdun gtad laḥs hrīḥphun chogs

phon tanargya mtsho 'byung ba'i gzhiḥ 'phags pa'i nor mchog bkra shis dga' ba'i rtsalaḥ rgyal srid sna bdun bde legs mdzod chen po'iḥ rigs ldan snying gi bu la dbang bskur roḥ don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal thob shogaḥ ma ṇi rat+na.a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ ཿ de nas shis brjod me tog 'thoraḥ dga' ston rgya chen byed pa dngaḥ tshogs dang dus ston legs par byaḥ gnad kyis bde legs dpal la 'byoraḥ sa ma āḥ gsum pa rdul tshon bsdu ba niḥ snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad doḥ hūṃ hrīḥ skye med chos dbyings gsal ba'i 'od klong nasaḥ 'gag med lhun grub zhing khams bkod pa 'phrulaḥ rtsol med bde legs dpal gyi dngos grub 'grubaḥ 'di phyi'i bde skyid don kun phun sum tshogasaḥ da ni mi shig bde ba chen po'i dbyingasaḥ lhan skyes 'od gsal klong du badz+ra sum̐ḥ zhes brjod rdul tshon mtha' nas bsduḥ dbus su phyur bur spungs ba dngaḥ rin chen bum pa'i nang du gzhugaḥdon gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir: phrin las ma ki'i mkha' ru bstimasaḥ sa ma yāḥ de nas khro phur bsdu ba niḥ ( trīḥ mi dmigs ngang las thugs rje'i rol gar bsgyuraḥ

badz+ra: gdug pa drungs 'byin dpal chen rol ba'i lhaḥ phyogs skyong zil gnon khro bo khro mo'i dalaḥ ye shes rngams brjid rol ba'i rten brten pasaḥ bar chad srung bzlog dngos grub stsol ba sogasaḥ mdzad pa rgya mtsho dus su rab smin pasaḥ gtang rag mchod bstod dam pa 'di bzhes laḥ skye med bde chen klong du gar bsgyur dengasaḥ hūṃ a.a hūṃḥ ces brjod lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yisaḥ khro bcu phur pa bsdu bar byaḥ sa ma yāḥ de nas gter rbed bya ba niḥ shā trīḥ dbang chen gser gyis gzhi mdzes pa'i dbusaḥ mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i mkha' dbyings suḥ 'dod 'byung rat+na 'bar ba'i gter rbed doḥ phyi ru yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde bas 'tshoḥ rtsi thog lo bcud 'bras bu smin zhing rgyasaḥ nang du nad mug mtshon 'khrug g.yul zhi zhingaḥ tshe dpal bsod nams 'byor ba snyan grags rgyasaḥ char chu dus bab legs pa'i lang tsho 'baraḥ sad ser btsa' than 'bu srin ma nad zhiḥrdzogs ldan gsar ba'i lang sto yar zla bzhinaḥ gong nas gong 'phel nub med rab rgyas mdzodaḥ longs sprod nor gyi char chen rab 'bebs mthusaḥ shog skom dbul phongs rgud

tshogs zhi gyur cigaḥ byang chub sems dang ldan pa'i smon lam mthusaḥ 'gro khams rgya mtsho dong nas sprugs gyur cigaḥ dbang chen sa yi lha mo'i dgyes bskangs mthusaḥ rgyal bstan mi nub dar zhing rgyas par shogaḥ gsang ba sgog gzungs snying por gzhug pa'i mthusaḥ zab lam rdo rje'i bstan pa dar gyur cigaḥ 'bru sna mang pos phyur bur bkang ba yisaḥphyogs rnams kun la longs spyod char 'bebs re ga: skyid pa'i nyi ma sprin gyis mi sgrib paraḥ rgyal khams yongs khyab bkrag mdangs cher 'phel ba'iḥ bkra shis zla ba log pas mi bslad paraḥ bsil zer dpal la gdul bya bde legs re gaḥ phun tshogs gza' skar dud pas ma gtsen paraḥ bde legs dga' ba'i dus ston 'khrung bar re/gaḥ nyin yang dpala'abar dge mtshan kyi li liḥ skye rgu chos kyi 'khor lor spyod par shogaḥ mtshan yang bkra shis dpal 'bar da la laḥ 'od gsal 'khor yug don la gnas par shogaḥ rtag tu mi 'gyur byang chub ljon shing rgyasaḥ chos mthun bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shogaḥ 'o su sti sidhi maṅga leḥ ces brjod dwa la'i gzhi 'og sbaḥ bkra shis me tog sil ma bkramaḥ

btsaX dga' ston bya zhing glu dbyangs 'uraḥ sa ma yuḥ bzhi pa sku drin gso ba niḥ mched lcam lu gu rgyud sbrel nasaḥ phyag gsum zhe pa dang bcas teḥ mos gus dad pa drag po yisaḥ snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad doḥ e ma hoḥ rab 'byams rgya mtsho'idakyil 'khor gcig bsdus dpalaḥ rje btsun ma hā gu ru'i dkyil 'khor gyiḥ gsang ba'i zhal phyes bsnyen sgrub rtags mtshan brtesaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsi'i rnal 'byor bla na medaḥ ro mnyam ye shes gsang ba'i grub 'bras sminaḥ zag med dga' stong rdo rje'i rtse gar bsgyuraḥ byang chub sems kyi bcud chen a mṛ taḥ phrin las mi nub gdul bya'i dpal du sharaḥ 'gro don rgya mtsho ngo mtshar bsam mi khyabaḥ thams cad 'byung gnas rdo rje'i bla ma dgongasaḥ mnyam brdal ye sangs rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor laḥ ma rtog 'khrul ba'i rab rib rtsad bcad nasaḥ phun tshogs lnga yis dal zhal phye ba yangaḥ bka' drin bsam yas nyid kyi mthu las byungaḥ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi pa'i rten 'brel lasaḥ sbyang bya las nyon ma rig sgrib bcom zhingaḥ sbyongs byed ye shes rdo rjer btsan sa zinaḥ sbyangs 'bras sku

gsum mthong ba khyed kyi drin: grub pa'i yon tan khyad 'phags ji snyed dngaḥ mthong ba bcu drug mngon gyur brgyad la sogasaḥ ma lus 'byung gnas rgya mtsho'i gter gcig puḥmatshungs med gu ru nyid kyi sku drin yinaḥ stong gsum gser gyis phyur bur bkang nas suḥ bla ma nyid la phul kyang gzo mi nusaḥ rat+na khyad 'phags yangs pa'i khams bkang nasaḥsku gsung thugs la phul kyang bskang mi nusaḥ bdag rmongs 'byor ba dbul bas rgyu rkyen chungaḥ bsogs 'jog ser sna'i rkyen gyisabaskang ma thubaḥ rdo rje'i thugs 'gal dri ma mthol lo bshagasaḥ zhal du rin chen skyems mchog a dṛ 'bulaḥ sku la lha yi reg 'jam pañtsa gsolaḥ thugs pyon rig ma sgeg 'dzum lang tshos 'khrudaḥ dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa rgya mtsho 'bulaḥ sku yi dam tshig gso phyir tshogs kyis bskangasaḥ gsung gi nyams sgrib sbyang phyir sngags kyis gsoḥ thugs kyi nyams chags sang chen lta bas bshagasaḥbashags bya bshags byed gnyis med ye gzhi'i ngangaḥ bskang dang bskang ba mi dmigs rdzogs pa cheḥ mchod sogs dngos po rnam dag gnas lugs ngangaḥ ma bcos rang grol so

btsan ma rig pa'i klongaḥ bla ma rang dang thugs dgongs dbyer med bsreḥ zhes brjod sku la na bza' tshang phulaḥrdo rje'i ljags la dza gad drangasaḥ thugs byon rdo rje'i rig ma 'bulaḥ phyag 'dud zhe sa bskur sti dngaḥ ldan pas zhabs nyid spyi bor blangasaḥ rtag tu sku drin dran par byaḥ sa ma yuḥ de nas smon lam gdab pa niḥ ston 'khor yongs kyis mar me dngaḥ bdug pa spos me ngad ldan gyiḥ ring bu thogs la lug rgyud sbrelaḥ snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad doḥ e ma nyo bde chen gsang mchog rol ba'i dkyil 'khor 'diraḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir grub pa'i rnal 'byor baḥ mnyam nyid phun tshogs lnga yis dāl bzhengs pa'iḥ rdo rje slob dpon rgyal kun yongs 'dus dpalaḥ lta dgongs mnyam pa'i rdo rje rgyal theb dngaḥ rab 'byams las la mkhas pa'i 'gyur gdangs paḥ rdo rje gdong 'khrugs darma mu tā zungaḥ mched dang lcam dral 'dus pa rgya mtsho rnamasaḥ nam zhig byang chub lhums su zhugs pa'i tsheḥ ma rig 'khrul ba'i rba rlabs mi g.yo zhingaḥ ye shes 'od 'bar sgon me rab rgyas shingaḥ gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i dri ma kun bcom nasaḥ

kun tu 'od kyi sa la phyin par shogaḥ gnyis med rol ba 'khor gyi tshom bu bcasaḥ dgongs pa zang thal don gyi sgron me yisaḥ mngon sum snang ba phra ba'i rol bar 'phosaḥ dag pa 'bras bu'i sa chen mngon gyur re/gaḥ sprul ba 'gag med ye shes rgya mtsho'i mdzodaḥ longs spyod rdzogs pa bsam mi khyab pa'i 'khoraḥ dbyer med zlum 'khyel nang gsal drug ldan dpalaḥ kun bzang ye shes bla ma'i sa thob re/gaḥ de ltar ma yin gang 'dul phrin las laḥ mngon par zhugs tshe snang gsal sgon me yisaḥ rab rib mun pa ma rig kun bcom nasaḥ gzhan phan thugs rje'i lo 'bras rgyas gyur cigaḥ 'gro drug 'khor ba'i gnas rnams mthong na'ang: rmad byung bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i byin rlabs dngaḥ snang gsal mar me phul ba'i thugs rje yisaḥ ma rig dug lnga'i mtsho mo rab skems nasaḥ ye shes snang ba'i 'od la spyod par shogaḥ sgon me rnam dag sku gsum grub pa'i rtenaḥ myong grol dam rdzas mthong thos dran reg kunaḥ rnam par grol ba rdo rje'i byin rlabs canaḥ gang gi mthu yis 'gro khams dong sprugs shogaḥ ji lta ba bzhin 'khor gsum yongs su dgaḥ ji snyed gzigs

bsgotshu pa'i ston 'khor tshom bu bcasaḥ cir yang ma 'gags sku gsum lhun grub zhalaḥ gdod ma'i mgon po'i dgongs par byang chub shogaḥ de ltar smon lam rnam dag gdabaḥ 'khrul rtog ngan pas mi bslad paraḥ 'khor gsum yongs dag ngang la gnasaḥ gnad kyis don gnyis lhun gyis grubaḥ the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ sa ma yuḥ lnga pa bkra shis bya ba laḥ 'bras dkar dri bzang byug pa yiḥ me tog char dbab ring bu sbaraḥ phyi nang mchod sprin mtha' yas stobasaḥ snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad doḥ hūṃ hrīḥ ka dag dri bral chos dbyings nam mkha' laḥ skye med lhun rdzogs ye shes nyi ma sharaḥ ma chags pad+ma brtsegs pa'i bkra shis gangaḥ bde gshegs snang ba mtha' yas bde legs stsolaḥrang bzhin rang gsal ma rig dri ma bralaḥ 'gags med ye shes mchog gi lang tsho 'baraḥ byams dang snying rje'i gter chen 'gro la stsolaḥ longs sku nam mkha' rgyal po'i bkra shis shogaḥ mdangs ldan dri med dha na ko sha'i mtshoraḥ ya mtshan rmad byung brdzus skyes sprul ba'i skuḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gror chos kyi 'khor lo bskoraḥ rig 'dzin mtsho skyes rdo rje'i

bkra shis shogaḥ thor cog dgu ldan rat+na'i pho brang dbusaḥ 'od 'chang la sogs lnga brgyar bde stong spyodaḥ pra dzña kirti'i sras mdzad rgyal srid bskyangasaḥ mi g.yo pad+ma rgyal po'i bkra shis 31gaḥ bka' skyong phug tu grub pa'i rtags mtshan brnyesaḥ a su ra yi brag phug chen po dzas kun dga' bo brten sangs rgyas gnyis par gragasaḥ 'dul 'dzin shākya seng ge'i bkra shis re gaḥ bya skyib tshal dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i ljongasaḥ ma nges gnas su gsang sngags ston pa yisaḥ rjes bzung rgyud sde rgya mtshor mkhas dbang brnyesaḥ sngags pa blo ldan mchog sred bkra shis shog: lhun grub brtsegs dang pad+ma brtsegs la sogasaḥ dur khrod gnas su mchod rten rgyab brten nasaḥ sbyor sgol ma nges chos kyi 'khor lo bskoraḥ gu ru nyi ma 'od zer bkra shis re gaḥ za hor yul du gdul bya'i thugs rgyud bskulaḥ smon log 'dus nas mer bsregs chu ru bsgyuraḥ gzhan snang zil gnon rgyal khams sprin grol mdzadaḥ dge slong pad+ma sam bha'i bkra shis shogaḥrdo rje gdan dang zangs gling gser gling giḥ lta log mu stegs ston pa'i rtsod pa bzlogaḥ ngan sngags bdag po drag sngags mthu

ba tshu yis bsgralaḥ bdud 'dul seng ge sgra sgrogs bkra shis shogaḥ stag tshang seng ge bsam 'grub ke'u tshang duḥ gdug pa bdud dang dam sri thams cad btulaḥm 'ongs don du zab gter dpal kha 'gyedaḥ rdo rje gro lod rtsal gyi bkra shis shogaḥ rgya mtsho'i gling dbus phyogs bcu'i ḍāk+ki laḥ gsang sngags o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i brda skad kyisaX mi g.yo bde ba chen po'i chos 'khor bskoraḥ skye med gu ru zhi ba'i bkra shis shogaḥ dur khrod brgyad du dgongs pa'i btsan sa zinaḥ sgrub sde brgyad kyi gsang mdzod zhal phyes nasaḥ gdul bya smin grol lta log drungs nas 'byinaḥ mchog sprul rig 'dzin brgyad kyi bkra shis shogaḥ 'gro drug 'khor ba'i mtsho mo rab skem shingaḥ pha rol phyin drug mdzad pa rgya mtsho yisaḥ gang 'dul thabs mkhas brtul zhugs gsang ba 'dzinaḥ 'gro 'dul gu ru drug gi bkra shis de gaḥ rab 'jigs 'phags yul grub pa'i gnas rnams suḥsbyor sgrol ma nges gang 'dul spyod pa skyongasaḥ ro langs bde ba ku ku rā dza sogs: grub dbang rig 'dzin brgyad cu'i bkra shis shogaḥ mtha' 'khob bod yul mun pa bsal ba'i

phyiraX mchog zung kun dga' bsam bzhin gar bsgyur baḥ ska cog ku ma be+e ro tsa na sogasaḥ lo paṇa nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bkra shis shogaḥ byang chub sems kyi 'od zer spro bsdu 'gyedaḥbade stong dga' bzhi'i zlos gar zag med bsgyuraḥ phan bde 'byung gnas mthong thos dran reg grolaḥ gu ru a tsar+ya mchog bkra shis shogaḥ dngos kun rnam dag dwangs ma'i rol gar bsgyuraḥ zag pa med pa gsang gsum gter du sprin: rmad byung pañtsa a mṛ 'byung ba'i gzhiḥ brnya dbu 'bum rtsal gyi bkra shis shegagaḥ zhe sdang 'khrul 'khor skad cig ru bzlog nasaḥ me long ye shes nyid du dag mnyam rolaḥ mi shig rdo rje grub pa'i gsang ba 'dzinaḥ badz+ra thod phreng rtsal gyi bkra shis shogaḥ nga rgyal khengs sems gdug pa'i dpa' skongs shingaḥ mnyam pa nyid kyi dgongs klong yangs par rolaḥ 'dod 'byung yon tan rgya mtsho'i gsang ba 'dzinaḥ rat+na bzhad pa rtsal gyi bkra shis shogaḥ 'dod zhen chags pa'i rtog tshogs drungs 'byin zhingaḥ sor rtog ye shes chen po'i 1nga du rolaḥ ma chags dri bral bde legs 'byung ba'i gnasaḥ pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi bkra shis shogaḥ phrag dog 'khrul

gtsa/: 'khor sna tshogs gting nas 'byinaḥ bya grub ye shes mchog gi gsang bar rolaḥ las rnams mthar phyin don kun grub pa'i rjeḥ karma thod phreng rtsal gyi bkra shis regagaḥ mi g.yo lhun po bde gshegs gsang mdzod lasaḥ gang 'dul 'brin las 'gag med char chen 'bebasaḥ dad ldan gdul bya'i lo tog smin mdzad pa'iḥ grangs tshom dkyil 'khor lha yi bkra shis shogaḥ mthong gros draco reg rnam kun grol mdzad cingaḥ gzhan phan 'od dkar mi nub gdul bya'i gsosaḥ dngas ma'i zer bcud rnga yab dpal ri bsdusaḥ 'phrin las rgya mtsho bdud rtsi'i bkra shis shogaḥ bkra shis gnas mchog bde ba'i dga' tshal nasaḥ phan bde'i gsang mdzod rat+na'i dpal kha lasaḥ bstan 'gro yongs kyi phan bde'i 'byung gnas mchogaḥ zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i bkra shis shogaḥ skye rgu ma lus dam chos la brtson nasaḥ rtag chad mtha' grol yang dag don la gnasaḥ kun gyi 'byung gnas rang byung nor bu yisaḥ dgos 'byung dbul ba sel ba'i bkra shis re/gaḥ nyin yang dge mtshan dpal 'bar kyi li liḥ mtshan yang mi nub 'od gsal ta la laḥ rtag

par chos kyi 'khor lo 'u ru rtsa thog mtha' bar gsum dge ba'i bkra shis shogaḥ ces brjod me tog sil ma bkramaḥ dga' ston bya zhing rol mo 'khrolaḥ bsngo ba smon lam mtha' rgyas byaḥ gnad des don rnams lhun gyis grubaḥ rdul tshon chu ru gshegs par byaḥ gtsang ma'i bsil chab dal la 'bebasaḥ thams cad kun tu dge legs rgyasaḥ the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ sa ma āḥ rjes kyi rim pa'i rnam bzhag goḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ de ltar sgrub pa kun gyi ya gyal mchogaḥ myong grol sman gyi spyor ba brtsam pa yisaḥ yon tan bgrang bral bsam gyis mi khyab kyangaḥ 'phel ba'i rtags kyang bcu dang zung du 'byungaḥ sa bcud 'phel te snum 'od 'bar bar 'gyuraḥ rtsi shing 'phel rtags lcug tshal lo mdog 'baraḥbacud 'phel rtags su ku mud sna tshogs 'khrungasaḥ 'bras bu 'phel phyir ma tog gong 'phel sminaḥ legs tshogs 'phel rtags char chu dus 'bebs rgyasaḥ 'dod don 'phel phyir gnag phyugs god zhi 'phelaḥ bsod nams 'phel rgyas zas nor longs spyod phyuraḥ kha rje dpal 'phel las rab rdzogs ldan spyodaḥ dbang thang gong 'phel lha 'dre mi gsum

bsgotshu 'dudaḥ rlung rta rab 'phel snyan grags phyogs med rgyasaḥ tshe srog gong 'phel mthar phyin brgya ru bsringasaḥ phung khams dpal 'phel bkrag mdangs gzhon tshul 'phelaḥ don rnams gong 'phel gegs med 'grub par 'gyuraḥ sa ma yuḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir sgrub pa'i ltas mtshan duḥ rab tu rgyas pa'i rtags kyang bcu gsum 'byungaḥ'abyung ba rgyas pa'i drod bsil khod snyoms soḥ phung khams rgyas pa'i 'du ba cha snyoms bdeḥ dus tshod rgyas pa'i nad mug mtshon 'khrug zhiḥ char chu rgyas pa'i lo 'bras rtsa ldum sminaḥkhams rnams rgyas pa'i zad nub 'phel stobs cheḥ nyams rtogs rgyas pa'i dbyings rig zung 'jug rtogasaḥ tshe bsod rgyas pa'i lha yi lus dang ldanaḥ dbang thang rgyas pa'i chos mthun bsam pa 'grubaḥ mthu stobs rgyas pa'i bstan dgra drungs nas 'byinaḥ gzi brjid rgyas pa'i gzhan snang zil gyis gnonaḥ rtsal rnams rgyas pa'i mkha' la thogs med bsgrodaḥ phrin las rgyas pa'i 'gro khams smin grol byedaḥ yon tan rgyas pa'i bshad sgrub bstan pa skyongasaḥ mi nub don kun gegs med yid bzhin rgyasaḥ sa ma yāḥ phan bde'i

'byung gnas bdud rtsi bsgrubs pa yisaḥ rtags mtshan bzang po thob pa bcu gsum 'byungaḥ gnas la byus thab 31 rgyan he rur mtshungasaḥ yul la nus thob bde skyid snang bas mdzesaḥ mi nub dbang thob nyams rtogs yon tan rgyasaḥ thogs med rtsal thob bsgyur 'jug bsam bzhin spyodaḥ bde stong mthu thob zag med ro la rolaḥ 'bar ba'i mthu thob gtum mo gos su bgoḥ rig pa'i mthu thob gang snang 'dzin med grolaḥ rtogs pa'i mthu thob cir yang chos skur 'charaḥ rang grol don thob grags pa na dar sadaḥ gnyis med bde thob tshul khrims dri bsung 'thulaḥ re dogs med pa'i gdeng thob zad sar 'byolaḥ ci ltar bsam pa'i don thob thogs med 'grubaḥ yon tan bdud rtsir mthu thob bkra shis dgeḥ gnad 'di sbyor bas kun gyi mthun grogs byedaḥ yon tan yar ldan char dang lo 'bru bzhinaḥ bog 'don stobs bskyed grub pa gdon mi zaḥ sa ma yāḥ kun 'byung pañtsa a mṛ grub pa'i 'bras rdzogs pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga ru 'byungaḥ yon tan rab rdzogs gol sa ma lus zhiḥ byin rlabs yongs rdzogs rtsa gsum dgongs 1nga mnyamaḥ nus mthu

gas/: yongs rdzogs o rgyan rgyal tshab bo: grub 'bras yongs rdzogs lha dang skal ba mnyamaḥ gdeng thob yongs rdzogs 'og min zhing la ngesaḥ de lta bu yi khyad 'phags rtags mtshan kunaḥ thogs pa med rnams bdud rtsi'i mthu las 'byungaḥ sa ma yāḥ bde sbyor bde sang rol ba'i brtul zhugs kyisaḥ yon tan rmad byung grub pa brgyad kyang 'byungaḥ dpa' bo grub pa'i rigs la mnga' dbang 'byoraḥ dpa' mo grub pa'i sngags la rnam par bsreḥ rdo rje grub pa'i gzung ma'i gsang sgo 'byedaḥ ye shes grub pa'i cir yang thogs med 'charaḥ las rnams grub pa'i rgya mtsho bdun mthar phyinaḥ 'bad med grub pa'i dgos 'byung nor bu rtedaḥ rdzu 'phrul grub pa'i bye ba phrag brgyar spyodaḥ smon lam grub pa'i 'gro drug gnas ngan 'drenaḥ zag bral ye shes mchog gi gsang lam laḥ rnam par brten pas 'bras bu thogs med 'charaḥ sa ma yāḥ byen rlabs char 'bebs bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i tsheḥ bsrung ba'i yon tan rnam pa bcu tu 'byungaḥ rgyal khams bsrung ba'i bde legs nyi ma 'khrungaḥ rnal 'byor bsrung ba'i phyi nang gsang rkyen zhiḥ gnas mchog bsrung

bas dag pa'i zhing dang mnyamaḥ grogs su bsrung bas dpa' bo dpa' mor sadaḥ dus khams bsrung pas bde legs yar zla bzhinaḥ nub med bsrung bas rgyal khams chos kyis 'tshoḥ zad med bsrung bas dpal 'byor rigs rgyud 'phelaḥ g.yo med bsrung bas lta sgom spyod mthar phyinaḥ 'chugs med bsrung bas rdo rje'i gsang lam spyodaḥ 'gags med bsrung bas phrin las bsam yas 'byungaḥ thams cad yon tan bdud rtsi grub pa yisaX 'bras bu phan bde'i nyi ma 'char bar ngesaḥ sa ma āḥ dngos po dngas mar sbyang spel bsgyur ba yisaḥ zag med bdud rtsi grub pa'i rtags mtshan duḥ 'gran zla bral ba'i yon tan bco brgyad 'charaḥ bskyed pas mi 'gran gang snang phyag rgyar sadaḥ bzlas pas mi 'gran 'byung 'jug grags tshad sngagasaḥ dmigs pas mi 'gran rdo rje gsang ba'i srogaḥ ma hās mi 'gran thams cad chos sku'i dngaḥ a nus mi 'gran gnas g.yo gnod gsum grolaḥ'og mas mi 'gran theg tshogs zil gyis gnonaḥ spros pas mi 'gran grangs tshom dkyil 'khor 'khrigasaḥ sgrub sdes mi 'gran kun gyi ya gyal loḥ rtsol bas mi 'gran byang chub

btsan sems kyi gsangaḥ bram ze'u mi 'gran grub pa'i rnal 'byor lamaḥ yo ga sgeg pas mi 'gran bla na medaḥ gcig gis mi 'gran dngos kun bsre bsgyur sminaḥganyis su mi 'gran gnyis med don la spyodaḥ bdud kyis mi 'gran bar chad g.yul rgyal rdzogasaḥ sems kyis mi 'gran rig pa ye shes gsangaḥ rdzas kyis mi 'gran byang chub sems bcud dmaḥ zag pas mi 'gran zag bral rdo rje'i skyemasaḥ zhing gis mi 'gran rab 'byams rgyal kun bstimasaḥ brjod 'das yon tan rgya mtsho'i gsang mdzod lasaḥganyis rtog mtshan ma'i g.yul gyis 'gran zla bralaḥ rgyu bde lam bde 'bras bu bde ba yiḥ bde ba'i rol rtsed bsgyur ba'i a mṛ taḥ 'khor 'das gnyis med dngas ma gcig tu drilaḥ kun 'byung kun gyi dpal mchog e ma heḥ sa ma yāḥ sgrub pa'i phan yon dang bkod pa'i yon tan gyi rnam bzhag cung zad bshad pa'oḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ e maḥ lha gnas gcig la bkod tshul brgyaḥ bkod pa re la rnam 'gyur stongaḥ 'gyur khug bye ba phrag brgya reḥ zhing rer sgrub pa'i da la 1ཿ brjod bral sems kyi gsang ba cheḥ myu gu smin pa'i bgo skal

teḥ legs 'ong pad+ma ga'ur sadaḥ lnga ldan dpal gyi gsang mdzod mchogaḥ rdo rje'i rigs la mngon par bsngagasaḥ rin chen rigs la gsang ba bskulaḥ chags bral pad+ma'i snod bkang bskyilaḥ las rnams 'gyur 'gag bral bar rdzogasaḥ snying po thugs kyi dkyil du sbasaḥ thogs med shes rab rno la 'drongasaḥ grags pa'i ba dan yongs la bsgrengasaḥgasal khyab nyi ma'i 'od dang 'grogasaḥ dus smin kun bzang mchod sprin bzhinaḥ g.yu mdog dbyar rnga'i sgra bzhin snyanaX rma bya'i zlos gar dbang med bsgyuraḥ bung ba pad+ma'i tshal na rtseḥ gzhon nu lho mon grogs dang 'grogasaḥ phyogs kyi rgya stag ri sul 'grimasaḥ gdong lnga'i dbang po gangs la 'gyingaḥ phal ba'i rigs rnams zil gyis gnonaḥ chu bo gang ga'i rgyun bzang teḥ las ldan skom sel 'dod la dbangaḥ mkha' la brten pa'i nor bu deḥ mig ldan shes rab can la dbangaḥ dpag bsam shing gi 'bras bu deḥ bsod nams bsags 'bras can la dbangaḥ dug sbrul mgo yi nor bu deḥ the tshom yid gnyis bral la dbangaḥ bsgod 'dod chu yi gru bo deḥ mnyan pa lag skya can la dbangaḥ chu srin gre ba'i

btsan nor bu deḥ sngon bsags blo thag chod la dbangaḥ rgyal po chen po'i srid 'khor deḥ rang sras ya rabs shom la dbangaḥ phyogs kyi chu bo thams cad kunaḥmatha' yi rgya mtsho nyid la dbangaḥ 'di rigs rus nor gang mi gtso: dad mos dam tshig gtong phod galaḥ mthon pos spyod na dma' bar lhungaḥ dman gyis rted na yar dar rgyasaḥchags pa can la re bas 'jomasaḥ zol zog bral bas bgo skal rted: sprin gyi kha chu ma zag gongaḥ 'brug gi nor bu ma stor sngonaḥ dgra bla'i dar thag ma chad gongaḥ pho sems mo yis ma bsgyur sngonaḥ sngar gyi 'bras bu dus su sminaḥ dus kyi lo bcud sad las rgyalaḥ 'gong pos 'khri bslad gang ma zhugasaḥ sman gyi phor ba bcud kyis gang: spyod 'dod che zer mang na'angaḥ nges par spyod pa shin tu dkonaḥ rigs bya snying gi nor bu deḥ yongs la mnga' yang lkog tu 'gyuraḥ bdun nam bcu gsum spyod yul lasaḥ tshogs kyis spyod pa ngas ma mthongaḥ gter gyi bum pa bzang po deḥ shar nas shar gyi phyogs su 'groḥ gser gyi rus sbal lto gzhung ralaḥ chu bo lding ga'i yan lag skamaḥ mgo bo shar la chad pa'i tsheḥ
