mjug ma lho yi phyogs su 'groḥ sto ba nub byang gnyis kyis rtsodaḥ sgra tshig grul bum khyim la snyanaḥ g.yag pho'i snying 'dar 'bri la skyabasaḥsha ba'i sa bud srin phyogs 'groḥ mkhong 'dod mthong zer mgo mngaḥ nges par rig pa mchog ldan lngaḥ gser gyi gdan khri yangs pa'i stengaḥ brjid ldan lha yi bum bzang deḥ lnga nas lnga ldan thig le 'dzinaḥ chu bor gang gi gzugs brnyan bzhinaḥ ma nges phyogs nas phyogs su bskyodaḥ ces pa'i gsang tshig brda sbyor niḥ pad+ma saṃ bhas man+ta raraḥ dus kyi gso sman sbyar ba'oḥ sa ma yāḥ brda tshig mkha' 'dza'i zhus lan 30 rgyan yul gyi chos srid bskyangs tshul loḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ e maḥ rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha wasaḥ ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yisaḥ snying dang 'dra ba'i yang zab rmad byung baḥ them la them med brda la bstim yod rgyaḥ rin chen phra yig ro/ga skya gnyis pa'i skor:grub pa'i dbang phyug 'brog ban khyod la gtadaḥ da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstimaḥ mi 'gyur bkra shis zal mo'i rdzong la sbasaḥ ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga mtshang mngon gyur skabs: grub pa'i dbang phyug nus ldan rdo rje dngaḥ 'phrad nas rgyal

gas/ bstan rin chen 'dzin skyong spelaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir bsgyur nas myong grol brtsamaḥ bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya mtsho ltar stel tsheḥ las can chos kyi bdag po rnams la 'doms ཿ gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min zhing la bkodaḥ 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yodaḥ

bsnye: zab gsang rdagarjab snying po lasaḥragis 'dus ma hā gu ru'i zab sgrub bsdus pa bdud rtsi'i bcud chen bzhugs soḥbatsa/: na mgasnye ru pad+ma kā ra yeḥ 4)ñtsa'adi 4)1steju310 dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi ye shes rdo rje phrin las gcig rdzogs garaḥpad+ma kā ra 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mi 'bral ba chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchodas 'angos las can skal bzang pho mo yiḥtshe chos kun gyi bar chad sel ba dngaḥnyams rtogs yon tan 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phyiraXdangos grub kun 'byung byin rlabs gter gyi mdzodaḥbadag gi zab sgrubadud rtsi'i bcud len zhes༅gi bdun rdalda'ebabazlas pa dang 'brel ba'iX nyams len don 'dus yid bzhin nor lta bu'iḥdabul phongs rgud sel gter gyi bum bzang bstanaXs ma yādawangasbyar dngaso rjes gsum rim pa lar dang po sku gsung thugs rten sgrub pa'i rdzasaḥyo byad kun bsags phyi nang dam rgya sdomaḥbade ba'i stan la bag phab spro shugs bskyedaḥkhrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro byas laXskyabs su 'gro /zhing sems bskyed rim pa niḥnamacabargyud gsum dzaprobla ma pad+ma 'byungaḥrigs kun yongs 'dus chen por skyabs su mchiḥ'akhrul snang rgyud lnga'o dasems cad ma lus paḥgadod ma'i gzhi la 'god phyir semarba

bskyed doḥ lan gsumaX de nas yan lag bdun pa niḥn re brgyud pa dgu ldan bla mar phyag 'tshal loḥ snang srid kun bzang rgyan gyi mchod pa 'bulaḥ gzung 'dzin las nyon dri ma mthol lo bshagasaḥ zag dang zag med dge la rjes yi rangaḥ gang 'dul theg pa'i chos 'khor bskor du gsolaḥ rgyal rnams mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debasaḥ dge tshogs gcig tu bsdoms te 'gro la bsngoḥ phyam gcig gdod ma'i rgyal pa zin par regagaḥ lan gsum brjod la tshogs zhing bsduḥ de nas bgegs bsgrad rim pa niḥṣ+ṭhad gtor 'dod pa'i longs spyod spelaX bsangs sbyangs bsgyur spro grub nas slaraḥ rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyisaḥ hūṃ 〉hūṃḥ khams gsum 'de ra bar 'phyan pa'i 'dre bo cheḥ dug gsum gdon bgegs 'byung po bdud kyi tshogasaḥ 'dod yon lnga ldan glud gtor 'di khyer laḥ rang rang so so'i gnas su dengs shig phaṭaḥ hūṃ hūṃ u tsa ta ya phaṭaḥ hūṃ bzhi'i sngags bsgo thun gyis brabaḥ de nas bsrung 'bar bsgom pa niḥhūṃ hrīḥ snod bcud snang srid dag mnyam rgyal ba'i zhingaḥ ma dag log 'dren gdon las rnam par dbenaḥ 'on kyang glo bur gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i bgegasaḥ rang grol chos dbyings ngang du mtshams

gas/ bcad doḥ sa dzñā na badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa t+t+waṃḥ de nas byin chen 'bebs pa niḥ ( hrīḥ rang snang mi shig dag pa 'od kyi zhingaḥ lnga ldan zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo nasaḥ rje btsun ces rgyan pad 'byung ston 'khor bcasaḥ gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ yis āX/ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma kā ra sa ma ya pho pho ཿ a we sha ya a āḥ de nas mchod rdzas byin brlabs ni hūṃ hrīḥ yul drug 'dod yon snang ba'i gter chen poḥ dag mnyam ye shes rol pa'i gnad kyis gziraḥ kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin dpung niḥ mi zad nam mkha' mdzod du rnam par spelaX yis āno/ badz+ra spra ra ṇa dzaḥ sngon 'gra'i las rim zab ma'oḥ sa ma yuX gnyis pa dngos gzhi sgom pa laḥting 'dzin gsum gyi khog phub niḥ.aḥ byedas rnams mi dmigs gzhi rtsa kun dang bralaḥ rang gsal 'gags med byang chub sems kyi mdangasaḥ rgyu yi ngo bo hrīḥyig 'od 'bar baḥ thabs shes dbyer med mkha' las rnam par sharaḥ hrīḥdzñā na cit+ta sa ma dhi (ཿ de nas chos sku dag mnyam bskyed pa niḥ hrīX snod bcud dag mnyam yum chen lnga yi klongaḥ rang gsal mtshan ma bral ba'i pho brang niḥ phyi nang bar med zang thal mnyam pa nyidaḥ

lhun grub rang gsal gzhal yas khang dbus suḥ rin chen zur brgyad sna tshogs pad+ma dngaḥ bde stong zung 'jug nyi ma zla ba'i stengaḥ rang rig ngo bo o rgyan pad+ma 'byungaḥ phyag rgya zil gnon ye shes rol ba'i skuḥ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dkar la dmar mdangs chagasaḥ mdzod sbu'i 'od zer bye ba sa ya lasaḥ mi mjed 'gro mgon pad 'byung re re 'gyedaḥnyi zla'i sbyan 'khyug bar snang khams su gzigasaḥ dbu la theg mchog pad+ma'i mnyen zhwa gsolaḥ shangs nas raḥtsaḥhrīḥya'i snang glu lenaḥ zhal 'dzum chags pa'i rnam 'gyur bu la dgongasaḥ 'gags med tshangs dbyangs gsung gis chos sgo 'byedaḥ dri bral gsang gos dkar po g.yu tshom bkraḥ 'dung ma dmar po gser gyi ri mo canaḥ sngags kyi phod chen mthing nag rlung gis g.yengasaḥ dmar spug sham thabs mdzes pa be+eḍūr risaḥ chos gos dmar po gser gyi ha ris bkraḥ dar dpyangs ljang sngon phyogs su 'phur la ldingaḥ rin chen snyan cha mgul rgyan do shal dngaḥ gnam lcags 'bar ba'i bcud ldan sked phur brtenaḥ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje sa la bsdigasaḥ snang srid zil gnon srid gsum 'gran

btsa/: zla bralaḥ g.yon pas bhan+ta bdud rtsi snyan thad btegaḥ rgyal kun mchod cing sgrub la dngos grub 'bebasaḥ zhabs gnyis sāg lham 'ja' khra ldan pa yiḥgayas bskum rgyal po rol pa'i cha lugs canaḥ 'khor ba mi spangs thugs rje'i lcags kyus 'dzinaḥ g.yon pa gar gyis zhabs mthil phyir la ngomaḥ srid zhir mi gnas ye sangs rgyas pa'i rtagasaḥ mchan g.yon lha lcam sbas tshul kha ṭ+wāṃ brtenaḥ ye shes lnga ldan 'ja' zer gur khang dbusaḥ cung zad g.yon 'gying sgeg pa'i rnam 'gyur canaX mtshan bzang blta bas chog mi shes pa'i skuḥ snang stong 'dzin bral 'od kyi rang bzhin gsalaḥ sku dbyings dwangs gsal rgya mtsho lta bu'i sangaḥ bde chen 'khor lor khrag 'thung lha tshogs dngaḥlongs spyod 'khor lor sprul dang yang sprul sdeḥ rje 'bangs lo paṇa rgya mtsho skar ltar 'khrigasaḥ chos kyi 'khor lor zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyisaḥ sprul pa'i 'khor lor gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dngaḥ bde skyong 'khor lor dpa' bo dpa' mo kingaḥ til gyi gong bu phyur bzhin lam mer gsalaḥ gzhan yang ba spu dung phyir phrag 'bum sangaḥ sangs rgyas stong dang

dus gsum bde bar gshegasaḥ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi 'du 'phro 'khrigasaḥ gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon yig 'bru lasaḥ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag med 'phrosaḥ rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas rgyud bskul teḥ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su sa ma dzaḥ de nas sbyan 'dren bya ba ni hūṃ hrīḥ 'di nas lte nub rak+ka srin yul gyiḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mchod bstod byed pa'i gnasaḥ tsit+ta gzing 'dra'i rtse mo pad+ma 'od: lhun grub bde ba chen po'i gzhal yas nasaḥ o rgyan pad 'byung rje 'bangs lo paṇa rnamasaḥthugs dam gnad bskul dbyings nas spyan 'dren gshegasaḥ mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur ba dngaḥ bgegs dang 'o ga 'dren bar chad bsal ba dngaḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ sa badz+ra ma hā gu ru bidu dha ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ de nas bzhugs gsol niḥ ( hrīḥ gdan gsum tshang ba rdo rje phung po'i lharaḥ dbyings nas drangs ba'i ye shes lha tshogs rnamasaḥ du ma so sor snang yang ngo bo gcigaḥ chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin brtan par bzhugasaḥ snyen badz+ra sa ma yā tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ de nas phyag 'tshal niX na 33 dus gsum

gtsa) sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba 'dzinaḥ mthu stobs rmad byung gdug pa kun 'dul mdzadaḥ chos kyi sgron mes khams gsum ma rig bsalaḥ mtshungs bral pad+ma'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal loḥ a badz+ra shrī na mo na ma hoḥ de nas mchod pa niX hūṃ hrīḥ skrang blang med pa snod bcud 'dod yon chosaḥ rang grol kun tu bzang pos rgyas btab nasaḥ nam mkha' gang ba'i phyi nang gsang mchod kyisaḥ bla med bla ma'i sku gsung thugs mchog bskangasaḥ bla ma hā pañtsa dzñā na pu tsa khā hiḥ de nas bstod dbyangs niX hūṃ hrīḥ ma bcos ye sangs rgyas pa chos kyi skuḥ 'gags med kha sbyor bdun ldan longs spyod rdzogasaḥ zung 'jug pad sdong las 'khrungs sprul pa'i skuḥ mtsho skyes rdo rje'i gsang gsum dbyings la bstodaḥ mi mjed 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya nas gang la gang 'dul mdzad pa rmad byung stonaḥ thugs rje ye shes rnam 'phrul mtha' yas paḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas mchog la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥgazhan yang 'jig rten bod khams thabs kyis skyongaḥ thugs rje'i 'od zer stong gi bsil zer gyisaḥ dad ldan gdul bya'i blo yi pad+mo 'byedaḥ sku drin bsam mi khyab la phyag 'tshal

bstodaḥ bdag ni 'di bzung ci srid chos sku'i b.raḥ skad cig 'bral ba med par rjes bzung zhingaḥ zhal gzigs lung bstan dbugs dbyung gzeng bstod nasaḥ dpal ri pad+ma 'od du grol bar mdzodaḥ de nas spyogs pa ni0 hoḥ rig 'dzin bla ma 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor dgongasaḥ bdag ni ma rig kun rmongs dbang gyur teḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig chags nyams rnamasaḥ mi 'chab mi sped gnong zhing 'a༄1da pas bshagasaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya sdo bye āḥ yi ge brgya bas 'gal 'khrul bshagasaX dngos gzhi'i las rim zab mo'oX sa ma yā gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la gsol ba 'debs cing bzlas pa bya dang po snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcasaX mos gus mchi ma 'khrugs pa yisaḥ thal sbyar thod rnga'i sgras bskul la hūṃḥ ces rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshamasaḥ pad+ma ge sar sdeng po laḥ ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyesaḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su gragasaḥ 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskoraḥ khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyisaḥ byin gyis rlabs phyir gshegs su gsolaḥ ces 'di brgya stong khri la sogasaḥ bzlas pa tshad du 'khyol bar byaḥ gnyis pa dmigs pa'i 'khrul 'khor niX lha hrīḥ rang nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas kyiḥ thugs 1nga zla steng he ru ga'iḥ

ba rte snying gar nyi steng gser rdo rjeḥ rtse lnga'i lte bar rig pa hrīḥ dmar gsal spu yis bris tsam laḥ rtsa sngags rgyal pos g.yas su bskoraḥ bzlas pas snang srid 'khor 'das kunaḥ dbang byin dngos grub ma lus paḥ bsdus te bdag thim gzi brjid 'baraḥ nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyasaḥ ji lta ji snyed ye shes rdolaḥ snang grags rig gsum chos sku'i ngangaḥ shes āḥbadz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba hūṃḥ bye ba gcig tu bzlas pa yisaḥ rgyal kun thugs kyi sras su 'gyuraḥ dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub thobaḥ the tshom med do sa ma yuḥ de nas sgrub pa'i 'dzab bzlas niX hūṃ hrīḥ snang ba lha yi rang bzhin rdzogasaḥ sgra grags sngags kyi gshis su dgaḥ 'gyu 'phro chos sku'i rol par smināḥ 'khor 'das bde ba chen po laḥ dga' bzhi'i ye shes byed las kyisaḥ dbang dang dngos grub nya~Xs su myongaḥ grol thob rdzogs pa'i sangar+sha rgyas soḥ snyed badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba drernyi pha la hūm̐ āX bye ba gcig gis dngos grub thobaḥ nyams rtogs yon tan tshe dpal rgyasaḥ dga' bzhi'i ye shes gong 'phel zhingaḥ gu ru'i zhal gzigs lung bstan 'gyuraḥ sa ma phuḥ las sbyor dmigs pa'i 'khrul 'khor niX hūṃ hrīḥ snang srid bla ma'i dkyil 'khor lhaḥ dbang dang dngos

grub klong dgu'i mdzodaḥ bskul bas rgyal kun 1nga mdzod rdolaḥ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od zer 'baraḥ thugs rje'i gzi byin spros pa lasaḥ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sbyangaḥ thams cad dpal gyi ri la bkodaḥ rig 'dzin lha dang lha mor gyuraḥ phyi nang snod bcud 'khor 'das kunaX rang grol rol pa'i dgongs pa niḥ mngon gyur ye bab chos sku'i ngangaḥ snyed badz+ra ma hā gu ru cisamaḥnyariḥniḥrusaraḥtsaXsayaXtsit+ta tring tring dza sarba sidhi pha la hū āḥ rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i yang snying 'diḥ 'bum phrag bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskulaḥ srid pa gsum la mnga' dbang thobaḥ 'gro drug 'khor ba'i ded dpon 'gyur0 the tshom med do sa ma yuX rjes rim bzlas dmigs 'khrul 'khor roḥ rgya rgya rgya de ltar bsnyen sgrub tshad 'khyol ba'iḥ rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rnams kyisaḥrgyun du yi dam byas nas suḥ snying po tshul bzhin bgrangs nus na phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad selaḥrgyal dbang pad+mas sras ltar skyongasaḥ nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel zhing rgyasaḥ dam pa chos kyi mdzad spyod 'grubaḥ phyi ma rnga yab dpal rir 'god the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ shin tu gsang ba zab pa'i gteraḥ nga sprul nga dang dbyer med paX nus ldan rdo dze+edang 'phrad nas bstan pa'i 'gro don 'byung gyur cigaḥ sa ma yuḥ ཿ rgya rgya rgyaḥ zab sgrub bdud rtsi'i bcud chen rdzogs soX gter rgyaḥ

gtsaX gtad rgyaX sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgyaḥ gu h+yaḥ brda thim o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka'aḥ bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'oX snyi0 ces pa 'di'ang rang gi nu bo o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab bsod nams lde'u btsan gyi dar bcas bzhed pa dang/ chos bdag shes rab thogs med dang / chos bdag pad+ma chos 'phel sogs kyis yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal ngaX1sa te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bskang ba pad+ma'i chun 'phyangs bzhugs soḥgatsaX na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ tsang/dza('gres/zu) rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus thams cad kyiḥ ye shes rdo rje skye 'gags mtshan ma bral gnyis med 'ub chub pad+ma kā ra laḥ byang chub snying po'i bar du phyag bgyi'oX sa ma yāḥ ma 'ongs las can skal bzang pho mo rnamasaḥ yang gsang bla ma'i sgrub la brtson pa'i tsheḥ tshogs bsags ga ṇa tsakra'i gnad la 'badaḥ de yi cha lag bskang ba zab mo bstanaḥ sa ma yāḥ nye bar mkho ba'i rnga dang rol mo bsgragasaḥ mchod par 'os pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum sprinaḥ snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad gyer bar byaḥ dad dang mos gus drag pos bskul byas teḥ hūṃ trīḥ ka dag spros bral chos dbyings pho brang nasaḥ ye sangs rgyas pa chos sku rdo rje 'changaḥ ye shes gsang bas 'khor 'das ro mnyam brdalaḥ chos sku kun tu bzang po'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ rang bzhin ma 'gags lhun grub pho brang nasaḥ ma chags dri bral bde ba chen po'i skuḥ chags bral thugs rjes 'khor ba kha ma bsgyuraḥ ma ngas sku snang ba mtha' yas thugs dam bskangasaḥ mdangs ldan sid+dhi'i dwangs

mtshor pad sdong sbubasaḥ ya mtshan rmad byung mchog gi dngos grub brnyesaḥ gdul bya ma lus thabs kyis 'dul mdzad pa'iḥ sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje'i thugs dam bskangasaḥdur khrod brgyad gshegs brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzadaḥ sgrub sde brgyad kyi zhal gzigs dngos grub thobaḥ las ldan ma lus rang snang dpal rir 'godaḥ sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad thugs dam bskangasaḥ 'gro drug 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo 'joms pa dngaḥ thugs rje lcags kyus gdul bya ma lus 'drenaḥ btang snyoms gru bos 'khor ba'i g.yang las skyobaḥ 'gro 'dul gu ru drug gi thugs dam bskangasaḥ yul brgyad mtshan ma rang sar gcod pa dngaḥ phan dang bde ba'i gru char phyogs bcur 'bebasaḥ zab gsang chos kyi sgron mes 'gro ba 'drenaḥ yang sprul rig 'dzin brgyad kyi thugs dam bskangasaḥmun gling bod khams chos kyis dkar por bsgyuraḥ sa gzhi zhabs bcags sgrub gnas byin gyis brlabasaḥ sku tshab lung bstan thugs gter mkha' ltar spelaḥ bka' drin 'gran bral mchog gi thugs dam bskangasaḥ bskal ba'i rtsub 'gyur ru 'dzing gzhom pa dngaḥ las can ma lus smin grol

bas/ lam la 'godaḥrgyal bstan nub med skyong ba'i thugs rje can:grub pa'i gter ston rnams kyi thugs dam bskangasaḥbargyud pa drug ldan byin brlabs chu bo bzhi'iḥ'abyung gnas dam pa 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabasaḥdamus long rmongs pa'i ge sar zlum phye ba'iḥrtsa rgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskangasaḥbyen brlabs mchog thun dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnasaḥrgyud sde bzhi'am drug gi khong tshud pa'iḥsgrub pa po yi wag pa'i lhar gyur baḥyi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangasaḥchos nyid mkha' la thugs rje nyi ltar gsalaḥbade stong dga' bzhi'i sbrang char zil ma 'bebasaḥganas yul dur khrod he ru'i zhing skyong ba'iḥdapa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs dam bskangasaḥhūṃ spyothugs dam gnyan dza bskang ba'i dam rdzas niḥlha rdzas phyi mchod nyon mongs nang mchod dngaḥgasang mchod ga ṇa tsakras thugs dam bskangasaḥ1 gar bro yi mchod pas thugs dam bskangasaḥsnang srid sku gsum mchod pas thugs dam bskangasaḥrnal 'byor lta spyod dag pas thugs dam bskangs:rlung sems rang sar dag pas thugs dam bskangs:bde

stong 'bar ba'i 'dzag pas thugs dam bskangs: sbyor sgrol byang chub sems kyis thugs dam bskangasaḥ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yis thugs dam bskangasaḥ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsis thugs dam bskangasaḥ chag pa rab bsgral rak+tas thugs dam bskangasaḥ zung 'jug bā ling mchog gis thugs dam bskangasaḥ snang srid 'khor 'das ro mnyam thugs dam bskangasaḥ bskang gyur dbang dang dalnga sa dza/ba sa pa du gadzadalaḥ yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags par bya gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag don gnyis 'grubaḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sgrog las grol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus thob: bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal: bka' log lag tu ma shor spu gri gsumaX sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu h+yaḥsnyi0 ces pa 'di yang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtsho dngapad+ma shes rab thogs med gnyis kyis yang yang bskul ba dang gre gas mo rat+na sa ra dang slob dpon chos gsal gyis bri bzhi shog dkar dang bcas yang yang bskul ngorabadag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes soX

btsan zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru la brten pa'i zab sgrub bsdus pa'i tshogs mchod yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥbatsaX na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra yeḥ che 〉ja) mdangs ldan dha na ko sha'i mtshoraḥ ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brtes: lhun grub rig 'dzinagro bo lodaḥ bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchod bdag 'dra pad+ma saṃ bha was0 ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyisaḥ shin tu zab pa thugs kyi bcudaḥ yang tig zab sgrub bsdus pa yiḥ tshogs mchod yid bzhin nor bu bstanaX sa ma yāḥdeyang spyor dngos rjes gsum lasaX dang po la yang 'byor tshogs kyiX dngos po ma lus bsdums byas teḥ ka pā la yi snod du gtamasaḥ bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs grub par bya sngon 'gro'i rim pazhwasargyaḥ sa ma yāḥganyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa laḥ dang po byin gyis brlabs pa niḥ yis rang byung bhan+ta yangs pa'i snod nang duḥ sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lnga yis gtamasaḥ rgyal ba rnams kyis sku gsung thugs su brlabasaḥ 'dzad med nam mkha'i mdzod du spel bar bgyiḥ.oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho ༷ཿ lan gsum rjes su spyan 'dren bya ba niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po laḥ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshamasaḥ dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du: pad+ma ge sar sdong po laḥ ya

mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyesaḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su gragasaḥ 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskoraḥ khyod kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyisaḥ byin gyis brlabs phyir gshegs su gsolaḥ gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob laḥ sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskuraḥ bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad solaḥ mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsalaḥ ma.āḥhūṃbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ de nas tshogs phud 'bul ba'i rim pa niḥhūṃ hrīḥ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi'i ngad pa 'phroḥ 'dod yon longs spyod phyi nang gsang mchod sprin: rmad byung lha mo'i gar bsgyur dang bcas nas: rtsa gsum 'dus zhal ma hā gu ru mchodaḥ 31 ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa la khā hiḥ de nas bshags pa bya ba'i rim pa niX hūṃ hrīḥrigs kun yongs 'dus ma hā gu ru dgongasaḥ bdag ni gsang ba rdo rje'i lam zhugs nasaḥ rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chags kunaḥ zhal zas tshogs kyis bskang zhing bshags par gyiḥ ma badz+ra sa ma ya shukhye āḥ yi ge brgya pas nongs pa ma lus bshagasaḥ de nas bsgral ba'i las ni 'di ltar roḥ / bh+yoḥ mi dmigs chos dbyings dbus mtha' bral ba nasaḥ gzhom

bas/: bral rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnamasaḥ dbyings las skur bzhengs log rtog ru tra yiḥ phung po dum bur gtub la rdul du rlogaḥ sarba rū tra d+dhi tri sha t+t+waṃ mā ra ya rbadaḥ de nas bstab pa bya ba'i rim pa niḥ hūṃ bh+yoḥ gzung 'dzin rū tra bsgral las byung ba yiḥ sha khrag drod dbugs phung khams skye mched rnamasaḥ ye shes gsang ba'i 1nga du stob) lags naḥ dgyes bzhes mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsolaḥ sa sarba sha hūṃ ma ra ya rbad khā hiḥ de nas tshogs mchod rol ba'i rim pa niḥ e ma ho rin chen bla na med pa'i bdud rtsi mchogaḥbade gshegs rgyal ba'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdzasaḥ reg tshad ngan song sgo gcod thar lam thobaḥ dengs 'dir dngos grub brnyes pa skal ba bzangaḥ a la la ho de nas lhag ma 'bul ba'i rim pa ni mthoḥ lhag la dbang ba'i bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogasaḥ zhal zas lhag gtor mchod pa rab bzhes laḥ dzan las rab 'byams myur du 'grub pa dngaḥ rnal 'byer phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bzlogaḥ thugs dam ma g.yel badz+ra sa ma yāḥ yin dzñā na ḍāk+ki ni sarba sa ma ya u tsi ṭa bā lirnyi khā hiḥ dngos gzhi'i nyams len rim palhorgyaḥ sa ma yāḥgasum

pa rjes rim bskul ba bya ba ni hūṃ bh+yoḥ lto nub srin yul thod pa'i sku mkhar nasaḥ o rgyan chen po rak+ka thod preng rtsalaḥ sngon gyi thugs dam ma g.yel gnad nas bskulaḥ gdong dmar bod phrug spe'u'i tsha bo rnamasaḥ thugs rjes yal bar ma dor rjes su zungasaḥ log lam bdud kyi 'khor ba kha lo bsgyuraḥ ma rig 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo dbu mar sgolaḥ nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gong 'phel mdzodaḥ tshe gcig sangs rgyas sa la 'god pa dngaḥ phyir mi ldog pa'i btsan sa zin par regagaḥ ces brjod thugs dam gnad nas bskul bar byaX de nas chad mdo bstan ma gtong ba niX hūṃ bh+yoḥ sngon tshe o rgyan pad+ma thod phreng giḥ bka' dang tha tshig la gnas dregs pa'i tshogasaḥ sde dpon sum cu dregs chen bco brgyad dngaḥ dbang drag shan dmar gza' bdud ra hu laḥ spu gri mched gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogasaḥ sngon gyis khas blangs dam tshig ma g.yel b.raḥ 'dod yon rgyan gyi gtor ma rab bzhes laḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen bsrung ba dngaḥ dkon mchog dbu bstod dge 'dun 'dus sde spelaḥ rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi bar chad thulaḥ mtha' mi dbus su 'tshubs pa'i cho rol

gas/ bzlogaḥ nad mug mtshon 'khrug ming gi lhag mar gyuraḥ rdzogs ldan lang tsho dar ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥ khyad par bod khams skyong ba'i tha tshig canaḥ bstan ma bcu gnyis dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcasaḥ 'dir byon bshal chu'i mchod gtor rab bzhes laḥ 'jig rten dkar po chos kyis 'tsho ba dngaḥ legs pa'i yon tan yar ngos zla ltar bskyedaḥ phyogs las rnam rgyal bkra shis snang ba khyodapaḥ bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ ces brjod gtor skyems gtsa sar gshegs par bya de nas bro mnan bya ba'i rim pa niḥ hūṃ hrīḥgasang ba ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'diraḥ bar chad byed pa'i bdud dang dam sri rnamasaḥ mnan no brub khung e yi klong du rgyaḥ nam yang ldang bar ma byed stum bha yāḥ de nas bzod gsol bya ba'i rim pa ni ho rtsa gsum 'dus zhal ma hā gu ru dgongasaḥ bdag ni kun rmongs 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur teX gzhung bzhin ma ldan 'gal 'khrul nyams chags kunaḥganong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshagasaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya shudhe āḥ yi gebargya bas lhag chad kha bskang ngoḥ de nas bsngo ba smon lam gdab pa niX dzaḥ zag dang zag med dge rtsa ci

bsags pa ཿ kun mkhyen ye shes thob phyir 'gro la bsngoḥ dmigs med zung 'jug rig stong don gyi dbyingasaḥ bde gshegs snying po'i gzhi thog grol bar shogaḥ lan gsumaḥ de nas bsdu ldang bya ba'i rim pa niḥ ā snang cha thabs su shar ba'i dkyil 'khor lhaḥ rnam thar gsum ldan btsun mo'i mkha' ru āḥ shes rab dbyings las 'gag med ye shes rtsalaḥ 'gro 'dren sgyu ma lta bu'i spyod lam bya'oḥ de nas bkra shis brjod pa'i rim pa ni hūṃ hrīḥ lha mchog thugs rje'i bdag nyid he ru garaḥ gsol 'debs bu la mchog thun dngos grub 'bebasaḥrnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi skyabs gcig puḥ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i bkra shis re/gaḥ snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos sku cheḥ med byung dkyil 'khor gsum du dag mnyam rol: lhun grub 'gag med rang byung ye shes zhalaḥ ji bzhin mngon sum mthong ba'i bkra shis shogaḥ 'jig rten khams su char chu dus 'bebs shingaḥ lo phyug rtag legs phan bde'i lang tsho spelaḥ rdzogs ldan gsal ba'i dga' ston dpal 'phel ba'iḥ bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis regagaḥ de ltar la sogs bsngo smon mtha' yas byaḥ bkra shis dge mtshan

—414 spel la phyogs kun bkramaḥ gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag don gnyis 'grubaḥ rjes rim mtha' rten las tshogasalja)rgyaḥ sa ma yā yem rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha wasaX ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yisaX shin tu zab pa rdo rje snying po'i chosaḥ myur lam rmad byung bsgrub bcud chen po 'di grub pa'i dbang phyugakhye'u chung khyod la gtadaḥ da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thobaX mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya mdzod ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dusaḥ nga sprul dpa' bonus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas las can bsam mi khyab pa 'drenaḥ skal bzang bu la dngos grub gru char 'bebasaḥ bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsalaḥ bka' log lag tu ma shor spu gri gsumaḥ las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ gter rgya gtad rgyaḥ sbas rgyaḥ zab rgyaḥ gsang rgyaḥ gu hraḥ snyiḥ ces pa 'di yang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtsho dngaX las ldan shasi rab thogs med zung gis yang yang bskul ba dang / grogs mo rat+na sa ra da / dad snan gyi slob bu chos gsal zhes byas bri gzhi shog dkar sgrub pa'i me tog nan tan gyis bskul ba'i ngorabadag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge'o/ dge'o/ sarba maṅga lam̐/

ge rdo snyan brgyud rin po che'i sgon me lasaḥdon dam bla ma'i sgrub pa'i gsol 'debs gzhan phan thugs rje'i nyi ma bzhugs soḥge pa na mo gu ru leḥ byugarnogrimi ༷ e ma hoḥbade stong spros dang bral ba'i pho brang nasaḥka dag don gyi bla ma yab yum laḥye grol mngon gyur ngang nas gsol ba 'debasaḥnyag gcig mtha' bral rtogs par byin gyis rlobasaḥrang rig 'od lnga lhun grub pho brang nasaḥmanyam nyid don gyi bla ma yab yum laḥrang rig rjen pa'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debasaḥ'od gsal sgrib bral rtogs par byan gyis rlobasaḥthugs rje'i ma 'dres zang thal pho brang nasaḥrang snang ston pa bla ma yab yum laḥshar grol rjen pa'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debasaḥgazung 'jin spros bral rtogs par byin gyis rlobasaḥm bcos gzhi yi bla ma kun tu bzangaḥm 'gags lam gyi bla ma thod phreng rtsalaḥm rtsal gdul bya'i skyabs gcig he ru gaḥgasol ba 'debs so dgongs rgyud rtogs pa spelaḥrang bzhin gnas pa med pa'i chos nyid 'diḥblo bral thad gar mthong bar byin gyis

rlobs: sgrib g.yogs bral ba'i lhan skyes 'od gsal 'diḥ rang rig rjen par mthong bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ yod med khas len bral ba'i lta ba 'diḥ rtogs ges sgro 'dog chod par byin gyis rlobasaḥ nyag gcig gsang ba blo bral sgom pa 'diḥ dgag sgrub spros dang bral bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ shar grol blo bder phan pa'i spyod pa 'diḥ chos kun zad sar skyol bar byin gyis rlobs: lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa'i rgyal srid laḥ don dam mtha' bral gsang gsum dbang 'byor re gaḥ de ltar bla ma'i gsol 'debs 'di 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i ngoraḥ rang rig ston pa he ru sha'i rtsal snang thugs sras dam ldan paḥ zad med mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod lasaḥ rten 'brel dus la bab pa'i tsheḥ gdul bya'i zhing bzang smin pa'i phyir bkra shis chos kya gsal sgo phyes ༷ las can bu la smin grol shogaḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ gu rgya brda thimaḥdhiḥ zhes pa 'di'ang chos bdag shī la'i mtshan can dang las smon 'phro 'dzoms dh+wa dza'i mtshan can zung gis bskul ngor kho bo nam mkha'irdo rje nus ldan gling pas chos nyid dgongs pa'i gsang mdzod las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni bskul ba po phyi mas bgyis pa dgeX sarba maṅga lam̐/

rwa( zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: sngon 'gro rnam mkhyen lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so:gas/ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye: shāzwakhrusashā~X/zhe ma 'ongs las can skal bzang pho mo rnams: yang gsang lam la mos pa thob pa'i tshe cha lag lam rim sngon 'gro'i gdams pa 'di: rin chen srog dang mtshung sa par nyams su longs: sa ma yā: dang po dal 'byar rnyed da ga' bsgom pa ni: kyi ma 'gro drug gnas nas dal 'byor rnyed par dka': mi lus thob kyang chos dang 'phrad par dka': dka' bzhin rted pa'i nor bu rin chen 'di: 'du 'dzis ma bslu sgrub pa'i snying po longs: gnyis pa 'dus byas mi rtag bsgom pa ni: skyes pa'i sgyu lus 'chi ba'i rang bzhin can: zhag dang nyin mtshan skad cig dus mi rtag snum zad mar me ji bzhin 'chi phyogs 'gro: mi rtag snying nas dran cing sgrub la 'bod: gsum pa zhabar ba'i sdug bsngal bsgom pa ni: da res 'khor ba'i gnas las ma thar na: khams gsum gar skyes sdug bsngal rang bzhin can: 'gro drug duḥkhas bzod med nyam thag mnar: chags zhen 'khri bag chod la dam chos sgoms: bzhi

ba rgyu 'bras bslu med bsgom pa ni dge sdig las kyi rnam smin bslu ba med: bde sdug snang ba sems kyis byed cing myong: blang dor mi rmongs rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin du gzob pa lhur len 'jug ldog mkhas par mdzod: 'phror ba'i gnas las thar bar bla ma mkhyen: sdug bsngal 'dam las sgrol mdzod bka' drin can: khri mun gnas nas dbugs dbyung byin rlabs can chos dred blo ngan sgrol cig gu ru rje: lam gol dman par ma gtong nus mthu can: gnyis med bla ma'i gdul byar 'gyur bar shog: lnga ba skyabs su 'gro ba'i rim pa ni na mo: skyabs kun 'dus zhal bla ma dkon mchog gsum: rtsa rlung thig le rnam dag rtsa ba gsum: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor la byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi: drug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ni ho: mtha' med 'khor ba sdug bsngal gsum gyi gzhir: dbang med spyod pa'i dmus long 'gro ba rnams: 'od gsal chos sku'i dbyings su ngal gso'i phyir don dam byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: bdun pa rdor sems bsgom bzlas bya ba ni: a: rang nyid tha mal gnas pa'i spyi bo dza/ pad zla'i gdan la

gas/ bcom ldan rdo rje sems: dkar gsal longs sku'i rgyan rdzogs rdor dril brnams: snyems ma yum 'khril 'od klong phyed skyil bzhugs: thugs gar zla steng 〉ཿla yig brgyas bskor: bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs rang gi spyi bor zhugs: nad gdon sdig sgrib dri ma dag par dmigs: sa/ badz+ra sa twa sa ma yā: sogs āḥ brgya stong la sogs stobs bzhi tshang pa'i sgos: bzlas pas nyes skyon dri ma dag par dmigs sdig sgrib kun dag rang lus 'od phung 'bar: slar yang rdor sems 'od zhu spyi bor thim: bdag snang badz+ra sa twa 'dzum mdzes bzhad: rgyan dang chas rdzogs rigs kyi sras su gyur: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams rol par sad: sa badz+ra sa twa hūṃ ci 'grub bzlas la dmigs med chos sku'i ngang: rig stong rdo rje sems dpa'i nyams len bya: brgyad pa tshogs bsags maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni: ces āḥhūṃḥ rin chen maṇ+ḍal stong gsum bkod pas mdzes: rang lus maṇ+ḍal dbang po lnga yi brgyan: sems nyid maṇ+ḍal rig pa'i bcud chen po: tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir dkon mchog gsum la 'bul: dgu pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni: rang snang rnam dag bde chen mkha' sgod zhing: bkod pa phun tshogs rnam

par dag pa'i gnas: ma chags pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng du: rang lus rdo rje rnal 'byor sku mdog dmar: gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug pad phreng mdzes: zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs mtshan dpe'i 'od phung 'bar: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas gri gug brten: 'ja' zer 'od lnga'i gur khang 'khrigs pa'i 1nga: rengs pa'i tshul gyis steng gi nam mkhar gzigs: sna tshogs dar dang rat+na'i rgyan chas spras: mdun mkhar 'ja' 'od thig le zlum 'khyel slong: bla ma'i ngo bo pad+ma 'byung gnas sku: dkar dmar mdangs ldan bcu drug lang tshos 'khyud: gzi brjid 'od 'bar mtshan dang dpe byad bkra: gsang gos 'dung ma sngags kyi phod chen mthing: chos gos sham thabs za 'og per chen klubs: pad zhwa rin chen rtse phran sgro dar mdzes: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas thod bum bsnams: lha lcam sbas tshul kha ṭī mchan du brten: zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs: snang srid zil gnon ye shes 'od kyi gdangs: rgya bod rig 'dzin lo paṇa spro bsdu 'gyed: dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mchod sprin rtag tu stobs: rmad byung 'gro ba 'dren pa'i skur bsgom

gas/ mo:hūṃ:rnga yab gling dbus zangs mdog dpal gyi ri:pho brang pad+ma 'od ldan gzhal yas nas:dus gsum sangs rgyas gu ru rin po che:rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'dza'i spro bsdu bcas:bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs phyir gshegs su gsol:bla āḥhūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūṃḥbadag lus zhing rdul grangs sprul gus phyag 'tshal:'dod yon kun bzang rol pa'i mchod pa 'bul:gzung 'dzin ma rig las nyon mthol lo bshags:rnam dkar dge ba'i las la rjes yi rang:gang 'dul theg pa'i chos 'khor bskor bar bskul:rgyal rnams mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par bzhugs:dge tshogs gcig bsdus mar gyur 'gro la bsngo:phyam gcig kun bzang bla ma'i sa thob regag:lan gsum rjes su gsol gdab ni:kye ho:dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku:rje btsun gu ru rin po che:ye shes yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter:byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub mdzod:bka' drin bsam na brjod las 'das:zhal mthong ma rig mun pa sel:mtshan thos the tshom dri ma gcod:yid dran dgongs pa'i byin rlabs 'pho:sku reg dngos grub 1nga chen

rdol bod kyi mun pa sel ba'i dpal: btang snyoms gru la nye ring bral: gangs ljongs bstan pa'i rgyan gcig pu: gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgron me che: 'gro ba'i mgon po pad 'byung mkhyen: bdag la re sa gzhan na med: skyid sdug re ltos khyod shes pas: thugs rjes zungs shig bka' drin can: byin gyis rlobs shig nus mthu can: sgrib kun sbyongs shig thugs rjes gter: dbang bzhi bskur cig rdo rje 'chang: dgongs rgyud byin rlabs btsan thabs 'phos: ma rig mun pa drung 'byin mdzod: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i 'phyangs pa khrol: mkhyen gzigs ye shes sang rdol nas: 'ja' lus chen por byin gyis rlobs: nam zhig 'pho ba'i dus byung tshe: rang snang rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing: zung 'jug dag pa'i gzhal yas su gzhi lus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: gsal 'tsher 'od kyi gong bu dza gyur nas rje btsun pad 'byung dang: dbyer med chen por sangs rgyas re/ga: de nas dbang bzhi len pa'i rim pa ni: bla ma'i dpral bar zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po las: 'od zer dkar po skar mda' chad pa ltar 'phros te rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs: lus dang rtsa yi sgrib pa

ba:tshu dag: sku bum pa'i dbang thob: snang stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mjal: lus rdo rje sku yi rol par byin gyis brlabs: sprul sku'i go 'phang gi skal pa rgyud la bzhag par bsam: masprin parathangayig dmar po gsal ba las: 'od zer dmar po glogs zhags 'khyug pa lta bur byung ste rang gi mgrin pa nas zhugs: ngag dang rlung gi sgrib pa sbyangs: gsung gsang ba'i dbang thob: gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mjal: ngag rdo rje gsung gi rol par byin gyis brlabs: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i go 'phang gi skal pa rgyud la bzhag par bsam: thugs gar hūṃ yig mthing nag gsal ba las: 'od zer mthing nag sprin dpung 'thibs pa ltar byung ste rang gi snying gar thim: yid dang thig le'i sgrib pa sbyangs: thugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob: bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mjal: yid rdo rje thugs kyi rol par byin gyis brlabs: chos sku'i go 'phang gi skal pa rgyud la bzhag par bsam: slar yang bla ma'i gnas bzhi nas: 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan dang thig le phra mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste rang gi gnas bzhir

thim pas: sgrib gnyis bag chags thams cad sangs kyis dag: ka dag tshig gi dbang thob: rig stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mjal: sems rnam par dag pa yon tan dang phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rol par byin gyis brlabs: ngo bo nyid sku'i go 'phang mngon du gyur par bsam la: kwa ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sidhi pha la hūṃ āḥ skyabs gnas kun gyi ngo bo: drin chen mtsho skyes rdo rje: rtsa gsum spro bsdu'i bdag nyidaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshom bur: snying nas gsol ba 'debs so: rtag tu dbyer med thugs rjes:bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs nas: ro mnyam chen por sangs rgyas: rnga yab dpal rir grol nas: ston 'khor dbyer med gyur cig lan gsum:slar yang bla ma gu ru rin po che 'od du zhu nas rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs snying dbus mi shig pa'i thig le dang 'dres par bsam mo: de ltar dad mos gdung shugs drag po yis: bla ma'i rnal 'byer byed pa'i gang zag la: dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub char chen 'bebs: bskyed bsgrub bsgom bzlas gzhan gyis do zla min nyams rtogs yon tan yar nga'i zla ltar rgyas rang snang bla ma'i zhabs drung rdzogs sangs rgyas: the tshom med do rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' de phyir

btsa( dad ldan yongs kyis nyams su longs:sa ma yā:e ma:rgyal ba'i dbang po o rgyan pad+ma ngas ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis:snying dang 'dra ba'i gdams pa rmad byung ba rdo rje snying po'i chos sde bcu gsum po grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thob:mdo khams tsa ri'i gnas su dgongs pra mdzod:ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas las can chos bdag rnams la 'doms: gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min zhing la 'god: bstan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcu kun tu sgogs:'brel tshad rgyud la thar ba'i sa bon 'debs: bka' gsang thub par srung sheg ngas nus ma: skal med lag tu ma 37ra a tham rgya:sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya:gu rgya:sngon 'a11 rnam mkhyen lam bzang zhes bya ba rdzogs so:gter rgya gtad rgya:sbas rgya:zab rgya:gsang rgya:tsit+ta rgya:snyed rgyan gyi bye ba dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda thim snyi ces pa 'di'ang lung zin rma rin sprul pa skyes mchog pad+ma nor bu'i thabs shes rdor dril dbang lnga'i cod paṇa gser dngul rin po che sna tshogs dang bkra shis lha reg dang bcas nas yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: sngon 'gro rnam mkhyen lam bzang gi brgyud 'debs byin rlabs bcud chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so: them medasnyi:badz+ra na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye: ༄'idzu ba6)byusha/༷ dad dang mos gus gdung ba drag po yis: thal sbyar snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do: e ma ho: gdod nas ye sangs rgyas pa kun tu bzang: lhun grub 'gags med rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho: thugs rje rmad byung bcom ldan rdo rje sems: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: chos kyi 'byung gnas dga' rab rdo rje dang: rdzogs chen ston pa rig 'dzin shrī seng: mkhas shing grub pa mañdzu mi tra la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pad+ma 'byungaḥ bī ma mi tra ye shes bka' rgya mtsho: zag phung 'od skur grol ba mtsho rgyal la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: blo gros dbang phyug khye'u ye shes dbyings: don gnyis mthar phyin rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga: brtul zhugs mthar phyin bdud 'dul rdo rje la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: don gyi

rig 'dzin dpa' bo rol pa rtsal: chos nyid klong rdol rdo rje khro bo lod: snyigs ma'i 'gro mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: skye med dbyings las dgongs pa ma g.yos kyang: thugs rje'i rang gzugs rdo rje'i bla ma yis: rjes bzung dbang bskur blo sna chos la bsgyur: phyi nang rkyen zhi sa lam mthar phyin nas:kun tu bzang 21'i rgyal sa zin par thegag: de ltar gsol btab phyi nang bdud las rgyal: nyams rtogs yon tan yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel: dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras su rnam par 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje pad+ma'i bka':shin tu zab pa las kyang ches zab pa: rmad byung rdo rje snying po'i chos sde rnams: grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thob: mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya mdzod ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang: 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel: byin rlabs rno nus gzhan las khyad par 'phags: bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal: dkon mod rgyal khams 'grims la ltos dang mthong: bka' gsang thub par srung shig ngas nus ma: skal med lag tu ma re ra a tham rgya: las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par re ga: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: brgyud 'debs byin rlabs bcud chen rdzogs so: gter rgya:

btsa(4 gtad rgya sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya gu rgya yo rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda thim: snyi: ces pa 'di'ang rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags pa'i skyes mchog pad+ma nor bus rdzas sna tshogs dang bcas nas yang yang bskul ba dang: chos bdag pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtsho dang: slob bu ye shes rat+na sa ra rnams kyis nan du bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes 'bros phug ḍak+ki'i 'du gling rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gros byin brlabs mdzad pa'i gnas nas pad+ma'i gsang brda zab mo las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel: sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: bla ma dang 'du 'bral med pa'i smon lam shel dkar bum pa bzhugs so:bsgo/ cas (1: na 31 gu ru we don dam mi shig rdo rje'i bla ma la: 'du 'bral med pa'i smon tshig gdab pa ni: mdun mkhar bla ma dpang du btsugs: mos gus dad brtson dbyangs kyis 'di skad do: na mo gu ru 〉 phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa'i: ye shes skur gyur mchog gi gu ru rje: las ldan gdul bya 'dren pa'i ded dpon du: chu zla'i rol gar rang snang skyong du gsol: bdag ni skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du: dpal mgon rig 'dzin bla mas rjes bzung te: byams dang snying rje zab mos rgyud sbyangs nas: mar gyur 'gro la phan bde ster bar regag: dad pa'i rgyud dag thos pa'i nor phyugs shing: gzhan phan sems brgyas phyin drug brtson pas bsgrub: byang chub sems brtan shes rab klong nas rdol: stong nyid snying rje'i don dang ldan par shog: mos gus nyi brgyas dad pa'i 'od zer 'khyugs: byin rlabs char sdud dngos grub 'bad med stsal: lta sgom spyod pa'i yon tan nar son cing:

dpal ldan bla ma'i bzhed don 'grub par shog:nges med snying po'i don sgrub mchog gi nor:dad brtson dpa' bsgos lus ngag yid kyis bkur:lus dang longs spyod chags zhen med par 'bul:mnyes pa gsum gyi bla ma brten par re ga:mngon lkog med par dam tshig bsrung ba dang:gdams ngag zab mo zags su mi 'jug par:'chi dus blo lhag med par dga' spro bcas:khrel med gsum gyis rang rgyud 'dul bar re/ga:tshogs drug snang ba sgyu mar shes pa dang:gang shar dag pa rab 'byams lam du khyer:rang byung ye shes mnyam rjes zung 'brel bzla:'khrul med rgyal ba'i spyod lam brten par shog:ci mdzad chos su mthong ba'i mos gus kyis:log lta ngan pa'i dgra bo bsad bcom nas:bla ma'i byin rlabs rang rgyud dul bar shog:'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar:rigs bzang blo rno bla ma mchog la dad:snying rje che zhing dam tshig gtsang ma yis:bla ma mig bzhin brten la mkhas par re ga:rnam pa kun tu yang dag slob dpon dang:'bral ba med par chos la longs spyod cing:sa lam yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel:'gyur

ba:tshu med rdo rje 'chang gi sa thob shog: chos dbyings spros bral rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha': rmad byung khyad chos drug ldan bum pa'i sku: gdod ma'i rgyal ba kun tu bzang po'i 11nga: mnyam dza gas bla ma'i thugs dang ro gcig regag: ces brjod bsam pa'i don kun 'grub smon lam bden tshig grub nges pa'i drang srong rnams kyis rab tu bsngags baspu med mchog gi tha tshig yin: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: gu h+ya: 3): ces pa 'di'ang dad pa'i slob bu chos gsal gyis yang yang bskul ngor sngags ming nus ldan rdo rjes bris pa dge'o: dge'o/ legs so/ sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rig 'dze+en bla ma'i sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i rdo rje tshigs bdun dang 'brel ba'i man ngag zab mo bzhugs soḥbatsasdo na byed gu ru pad+ma kwa ra ye: sa/nathā/phyo/zle/: rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma 'byung lhun grub rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal: gang des zab lam rnal 'byor ni: dad mos brtson pas nyams su longs:sa ma yā de yang spyor dngos rjes gsum las: dang po rten bskyed rim pa ni: āḥ rang mdun 'ja' 'od thig le'i klong: seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: skyabs kun yongs 'dus ngo bo nyid: drin chen mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang: snang srid zil gnon cha byad can: dngas gsal 'od sku yangs pa'i sbubs: lo paṇa rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtib: snang stong sgyu ma'i phung por bskyed:thugs rjes bdag la brtser dgongs bsam: gnyis pa gsol ba 'debs pa ni: kyai sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo nge: rgyal ba'i phrin las pho nya: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter chen: 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gcig: 'khor 'das spyi dpal chen po: bka' drin mtshungs zla bral ba'i: drin chen mtsho skyes rdo rje paṇa grub rgya mtsho'i tshom bur: dad brgya'i gsol ba

'debs so: thugs dam dgongs pa'i dpa' byung: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i lcags kyus: bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs shig: phyi nang bar chad kun sel dngos grub char ltar phob la: nyams rtogs yon tan nar bskyed: rtsa rlung thig le'i mdud grol: dga' stong ye shes rtsal 'bar: rang rig tshad la pheb nas: sku gsum rgyal sa zin par:pha cig tshon rgyan pad 'byung: skyid sdug legs nyes khyed shes: mtho dman gar gtong bla ma: mkhyen no thugs rjes zungs shig: rtag par 'bral med skyobs mdzod: lan gsum la sogs ci rigs bskyar: mos gus mchi ma 'dril ba dang: lus kyi ba sbu gzing tsam bya: skabs su tshig bdun ci mang dang badz+wa gu ru'i bzlas pa bskyar gsum pa dbang bzhi len pa ni: bla ma tsan rgyan rin 11 ches: sku gadza/nga thugs 31na ma lus pa: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser 'byung: bdag gi gnas bzhi la thim pas: sgrib dag dbang thob lam snod gyur: dga' sbar stong gsal rig sku mjal: bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim: smra bsam brjod bral ngang la blta: blo 'das chos skutsanamaho: mnyam par bzhag cing thun bsdu tshe dge rtsa bsngo zhing smon lam gdab gnad des dbang dang dngos grub thob phyi nang

brterdo bar chad sel bar nges ze tshom med do sa ma yā dam can rgya mtshos thub par srung rgya rgya rgya:gu h+ya phyoX/1110 lja ces pa 'di'ang chos ldan rat+na sa ra dang glen pa chos gsal zhes byas bskul ngor mkha' 'gro'i brda ris las zhal r+sās te nus ldan rdo rjes dag par phab pa dge'o/legs so/sarba maṅga le//

bas/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rig 'dzin bla ma'i sgrub pa byin rlabs 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so:bas/: na mo gu ru le: dujo)gyes rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi gzhi: rdo rje bla ma pad+ma ཿnga: mthon mthing ral bas b.lo te 'dud: de yi zab sgrub bcud rigs bstan: sa ma yā: blo 'das dgongs pa rang grol gyis: dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni: na mo rig pa sku dang ye shes la: ngo mtshar chen pos skyabs su mchi: 'khor 'das mnyam brdal byang chub sems: bskyed du med de ye yin ngang: lan gsum: gnyis pa dngos gzhi wa bskyed ni: u blo 'das dgongs pa gnyug ma'i gshis: so ma rang bzhin ye shes ni: rdo rje bla ma pad+ma 'byung: dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhi ma khro: phyag g.yas thod pa'i cang te'u 'khrol: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdus: g.yon pas bhan+ta bdud rtsi bsten: bu la mchog thun dngos grub 'bebs:rus pa'i rgyan drug dar dpyangs dang: e rag thod pa'i phreng ba sogs: he ru ka pa'i chas rnams rdzogs: sku dbyings dngas gsal rgya mtsho'i klong: rgya bod paṇa grub rig 'dzin

rje gas: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas: spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstim: zang thal mnyam pa nyid du bzhugs dmigs bsam dag pa'i phyag 'tshal lo: dag mnyam kun bzang mchod pa 'bul: so ma rang grol ngang nas 'dud bdag thugs nyi zla kha sbyor dbus: rig pa trīḥl sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas dbang gi dngos grub bskul: bde stong dga' bzhi'i ye shes 'bar: snang grags rigs gsum bde ba che: lha sngags phyag rgya chos sku'i ngang: skye badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sirnyi ྅:yengs med ting 'dzin gnad ldan pas bye ba gcig tu bzlas gyur na: nyams rtogs yon tan mkha' ltar rgyas: the tshom med do sa ma yā gsum pa mchod cing bstod pa ni ces: cesas dbyings 1rdol pa chen 17 las: sna tshogs rang shar mchod pa'i sprin: kun tu bzang po'i rol pa yis rig 'dzin bla ma'i dgyes pa bskang: ka ma hā pañtsa pū tsa ho: hūṃ trīḥ sku gsum kun dngos rdo rje 'chang: rigasakun yongs 'dus 'gro ba'i mgon: o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rje la: rnam kun dad pas phyag 'tshal bstod: 'di bzung gdod ma chos sku'i bar: skad cig 'bral med rjes bzung

btsa/: nas: nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan bskyed: snang srid brda dang dpe char shar: 'khrul snang bag chags dbu mar gzhig: thim la ma rmugs ye shes zhal:mngon gsum rig pa gcer mthong nas: dmus long 'gro khams dong sprugs te: gdod ma'i kun bzang rgyal sa la: pad+ma'i phrin las mthar phyin te: 'gyur ba med pa'i dpal 11ba thegag: gzhan yang shis brjod bsngo smon sogs: spyi dang mthun par rgyas par bya: gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag nyams rtogs yon tan mkha' ltar rgyas: the tshom med do sa ma yā: e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was: ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis: snying gi yang tig gdams pa rmad byung ba: grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la thob: mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs pra mdzod ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus: nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang: 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro la phan bde spel: the tshom med do rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: rig 'dzin bla ma'i sgrub pa byin rlabs 'byung gnas rdzogs so: gu h+ya brda thim:31: ces pa 'di'ang zab gter spyod pa'i skyes bu pad+ma dbang gis bskul ngor bdag 'dra nus ldan rdo rjes dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra tsu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rig 'jin bla ma'i sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i rdo rje'i tshigs bdun dang 'brel ba'i man ngag tshogs bskang zab mo bzhugs so: bas/: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: ju/ca sa /(/ba( rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma 'byung: lhun grub rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal: gang des zab lam rnal 'byar gyi tshogs bsags bdud rtsi'i zig pa bstan: sa ma yu: de yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las: dang po 'byor tshogs byin brlabs ni: e āhūṃ: mtshan ldan bhan+ta yangs pa'i nang: bza' bca' btung ba 'dod yon gter: myong grol ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: zad med nam mkha'i mdzod du spel: 'bru gsum ha ho hrīXyis spel: spyan 'dren pa ni: nywa hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brtes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor:khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: 0( badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni sa ma yā dza dza: gnyis pa 'bul bshags bsgral stabs ni: dzñā hrī: rnga yab gling la

mnga' mdzad cing: bod khams skyongs bas skyabs gcig pu: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i spro bsdu bcas: rig 'dzin rgya mtsho dgyes pa'i phyir: phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs mchod 'bul: dgyes bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol: dngos po chos nyid yangs par bskangs: snang ba ye shes chen por bskangs: gsal ba shes rab 'bar bas bskangs: kun rdzob don dam gnyis med bskangs: bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: bdag rmongs blo yis dbang gyur nas: gzung 'dzin nyams chags nyes lhung sgo ma lus mi 'chab mthol lo bshags: dag tshangs sor chud dngos grub stsol: gzung dang 'dzin las byung ba yi: bdag rtog rū tra'i sde tshogs rnams: ye shes mtshon chas rab bsgral nas dkyil 'dzadar lha tshogs zhal du bstabs bar chad bdud sde stong gyur cig: sgo ma hā ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi: sa ma ya shukhye āḥ dṛḥtri sha t+t+waṃ ma ra ya phaṭa: kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ grangs bsogs na: re ye khaṃ: bla āḥs: chogs rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi rnams: 'bul ba'i gnas ni dkon mchog gsum: khyad par lhag pa'i lha mchog ni: o rgyan

gtsa/: yul gyi nub byang mtshams: sogs gshegs su gsol: ga ṇa tsakra'i mchod pa 'bul: dam tshig nyams chags mthol lo bshags: gzung 'dzin rtog pa dbu mar sgrol: ye shes gsang ba'i klong du stobs: dbyer med chen por dgyes rol nas: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bskangs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: ma ma hā ga ṇa tsakra dzñā na pu tsa la kha kha khā hi khā hi: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bsags gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag de nas tshogs la rol gsum pa lhag ma bsngo ba dang: lhag chad kha skong bsngo smon no: lhag ma ni:tho : lhag la dbang ba'i pho nya ni: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang: ma thogs myur du gshegs su gsolaḥ rgyan dang cod paṇa pu ru ru: phyag rgya gar stabs shigs se shig:bshugs glu brda skad ti ri ri: sgrub la gdung shugs nyi li li: ma thogs myur du gshegs su gsol: pham phab bka' yi lhag gtor bzhes: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: ces brjod gtor ma gtsang sar gshegs phrin las rab 'byams thogs med 'grub bzod gsol ni ho: rigs 'dus bla ma dgongs su gsol: bdag ni ma rig

rmongs 'khrul gyis: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur te: rtsa ba yan lag dam nyams bshags: sa ma ya āḥ yi ge brgya bas lhag chad bskangs bsngo smon ni: : trīḥ rig 'dzin bla ma bsgrub la sogs: dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa: ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: phyam gcig dpal rir grol bar regag: lan gsum bsdu ldang ni: gis snang cha thabs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams: blo 'das chos sku'i dbyings su sum̐: lhun grub dag pa'i rten 'brel las: bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su sad: a āḥ phaṭa de nas bkra shis ni: hrī: ma chags bye na gyis ma gos shing: pad+ma rgyas pa'i mdangs 'dra ba'i: o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rje yis: mdzad brin mchog gi bkra shis shog: de ltar rdo rje'i tshigs bdun dang 'brel ba'i bzlas pa tshad du 'byol khyad par tshogs bsags gnad 'dir brtson bsam pa'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub tshe 'dir phyi nang bar chad zhi: phyi ma rnga yab dpal rir grol the tshom med do sa ma yu dad ldan pho mo su yin kyang: mos gus can la bzang ngan med: 'brel ba thob pa thams cad kyiḥ rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug pa ni: bod kyi lha skal yin phyir ro: snyigs dus skyobs pa nga las med: gdug pa 'dul ba nga las med rtsub 'gyur gso ba nga las med nad yug bzlog pa nga las

—ste/ji med: de phyir kun gyis yi dam mdzod: snyigs ma'i mi rnams cho rigs rgod: bka' la nyan pa med mod kyang: las ldan rnams kyi sems la zungs brtse ba'i kha ta zab po'o: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: gu khya brda thim snyi: ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshos bskul ba dang grogs mo rat+na sa ra gren nag chos gsal blo gsal las rab kyis dar dang bcas te bskul ngor bdag 'dradapa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni smon sems kyis bgyis pa dge'o: legs so: sarba maṅga le/

'cha: zab gsang rdor snying chos skor las rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i tshem grangs bzhugs so/gsaX bla ma la phyag 'tshal ma / thog mar gsol 'debs dngos grub char 'beb6/ sngon 'gro rnam mkhyen lam bzang 7/ brgyud 'debs byin rlabs bcud chen2 gsol 'debs bde stong bum bzang4 cha lag rim pa nyi shu 13 zab sgrub dngos grub 24gter bum/ gdung sgrub 20 'dzab dgongs 3 gnad bskul byin rlabs char 6'bebs/ bstan srung zab sgrub8/ gsol mchod dgra bgegs rdul brlag bskul ba dug khrag 4khol ma/bshags pa dag gsal6me long / rjas bskang 3 tshogs mchod bsdus 2pa bskang ba pad+ma 4rgyal po gter bsrung bskang 4ba gsol 'debs byin rlabs 5char 'bebs/ thugs dam gnad 4bskul smon lam bdud rtsi'i thig 4pa bum pa sgrub pa'i cho ga 5 /dbang gi lo rgyus 2 don dbang mdzes pa'i do shal 10 las bzhi'i bsregs blugs8/ sgrub khog thugs rje'i nyi ma45/ las tshogs rim pa 29nyer lnga bla ma'i sgrub 3pa/ tshigs bdun 2man ngag zab mo / tshogs bskang 4/ rjes gnang bdud rtsi'i bcud rig smon lam shel dkar bum pa gsang ba gnad kyi bcud thig brda byang gser gyi bum 10chung / them byang gsal 3bas lde mig dge'o/ sarba maṅga le/
badz+ra zab gsang rdo dzasnying po las: rig 'dzin bla ma sgrub pa'i chos sde: las chogs kyirim pa nyi shu rtsa lnga phrin las kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

0〈rte na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: māṃrgamajurgoskanaskobyusgrirlu/〉khyo rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa'i: ye shes gcig rdzogs 'gro mgon pad+ma 'byung: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i spro bsdu dang bcas la rnal 'byor mos gus dad brgyas phyag 'tshal lo: ma 'ongs las can skal bzang skyes bu la: phan pa'i thabs mchog zab mo chos kyi bcud: kha bskang las tshogs rnam pa nyi shu lnga: sgrub pa po yi dpal du rnam par bstan: sa ma yā: de yang sgrub pa'i bla rdo zab mo ni shog dkar dri bral 'jam la dngas pa'i ngor: mtshal dang bzang drug bsres pa'i rdzas dag gis yar ngos tshes bcu phun tshogs sbyor ba'i nyin rnal 'byor lha yi nga rgyal ldan pa yis: shar la kha kyu tshig bdun bzlas pa bya de nas mu khyud rim pa bco lnga bskor: lte bar gu ru zhi ba'i sku gzugs dang: srog hrī gsang ba'i 'bru bcu gser gyis bri mu khyud gnyis par pad+ma 'dab brgyad la: rdo rje rat+na pad+ma ral gri dang dbyug to 'khor lo be con tho ba bri: kun la srog yig hrīḥyi rnam par mdzes: mu khyud gsum par 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la rdor dril ṭā ru kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rje gdengs: pad phor me long lhung bzed lcags phur bri: srog kyang mi 'gyur gong bzhin legs par bkod:mu khyud bzhi par pad+ma 'dab drug la: lcags kyu pi waṃ ral gri pusti dang sgrom bu me chu ma 'dres legs par bkod: sgog gi snying po hrīḥyig mtshon par bya: mu khyud lnga par 'khor rtsibs nyer lnga la: ral gri phur ba bhan+ta rdo rje dang: kha ṭ+wāṃ me

gsaX long pad+ma lcags kyu bum: tho ba be con ṭā ru mda' dar dang dbyug to po ti thod dbyug pad phor dril bya dang stag g.yag chang bum mda' gser 'khor: shing lo rnams bkod srog snying hrīḥyis mdzes: mu khyud drug par pad 'dab brgyad cu la kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rje lcags phur bhan+ta dang: ral gri dung dkar pad+ma 'khor lo rnams: bcu bcu bsnol nas mu khyud legs par brtsams: srog gi snying po tsa k+ṣe hrī2)ga bkod: mu khyud bdun par bsnyen sgrub las sbyor sngags dbu can tshag med chad lhag bral bar bri: mu khyud brgyad par 'di ltar dbu can gyi: rje btsun ma hāgu ru zhi mdzad he ru ka pa thod breng sde lnga gu ru mtshan brgyad rig 'dzin chen po rnam brgyad rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga 'gro 'dul gu ru sde drug dpa' bo grub chen brgyad cu las mdzad ging dang liṅka sprul 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams chags par gyur cig sgrub pa po la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol cig ma hā gu ru sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ hrī: mu khyud dgu par 'di ltar dbu can gyis ma badz+ra ma hāgu ru sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan pad+mo yo gi ni sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: ma bzhe thod phreng rtsal sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha wan: yo badz+ra thod phreng rtsal sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: ma rat+na thod phreng rtsal sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan ma pad+ma thod phreng rtsal sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: ma garma thod phreng rtsal sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: ma dzñā na hūṃ ka ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan ma badz+ra mañdza tra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lan: o badz+ra na ga dzu na sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha

lhan yo badz+ra pra bha hasti sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: ma badz+ra dha na saṃ kri sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan oṃ badz+ra bi ma mi tra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan shes badz+ra ram bu gu rgya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha wan 31 badz+ra sharnyi bha sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: sgo badz+ra pad+ma ka ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan:sgo badz+ra blo ldan mchog sred sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: yo badz+ra sur+ya rasmi sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan nye( badz+ra seng ge sgra sgrogs sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: snyen badz+ra pad+ma saṃ bha wa sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: 31 badz+ra pad+ma ra dza sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: sgo badz+ra shākya seng ha sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan yo badz+ra gu ru gro bo lod sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan badz+ra sur+ya puṣ+ṭi sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: o smyo gu ru pad+ma sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: badz+ra gu ru shrī dha na e rna sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: ka badz+ra gu ru seng ha ko li ni tra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: o badz+ra gu ru dza yan+tu pha la sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan ma badz+ra rā dza e nan sarba dṛ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan zhi badz+ra gu ru sarba sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan yo badz+ra gu ru sa pha ra ṇa ja ya rda ra mu khe sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhi badz+ra kiṅka ra ḍaka ḍak+ki ni sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan:mu khyud bcu pa 'di ltar bri bar byaḥ 'chang ba po la rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams rdzogs par gyur cig: nad gdon sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags nyes lhung thams cad zhi bar gyur cig tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig: khams gsum srid gsum zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i phywa g.yang thams cad dbang du 'du bar gyur cig: gzung

gtsa( 'dzin gnyis snang nyon mongs log 'khrul bar chad bdud bgegs thams cad tshar gcod par gyur cig shidzña puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa mu khyud bcu gcig pa la dbyangs gsal byed:rten 'brel snying po dang bcas tshar lnga bri:mu khyud bcu gnyis pa la rdor phreng bkod:de rgyab bcu gsum gnas su rdzas rtags dang rgyal srid sna bdun nor bu cha bdun bri:mu khyud bcu bzhi pa la 'byung ba bzhi dang lcags kyu zhags pa sgrogs dril legs par bkod:mu khyud bco lngar nor 'dzin pa tra bri:rdzas ni byang sems dkar dmar dang:li khri gi waṃ sismyo ra dang ni:shel dang dung g.yu byi ru in+t+ra spod gzi mchong sa le sbram dang ra ga spug:a bar skyur gsum dza sug ka ko la:cu gur li dang rtag ngu sgron shing dang:tsan+dan dkar dmar 'bras dang gro nas ril ja chang bsres nas legs par myo ba 'o mi mthing 'gyur dri dkar bral 'dod ser 'byung chags pa bral:las ljang rnams mthar phyin phyir du rgya lnga bsdam thabs shes dkar dmar zung 'brel dar gyis dril nas su:rin chen snod gzhug rnam lnga nyer spyod bkram bsnyen sgrub tshul bzhin byas la rab tu gnas:de nas 'bral med bci ba'i byin rlabs theb:legs pa'i chos byed gong 'phel chud mi za sdig pa bsags kyang gong 'phel dran shes brten shin tu zab pa rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i srog skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya:sa ma yā:las kyi rim pa dang pozhwag:rgya rgya rgya:e ma ho:gu ru zhi ba la brten pa'i tshig

bdun sbyan 'dren las tshogs zab mo ni: hūṃ: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brtes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags:'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: byin gyis brlabs phyir gshegs su gsol: ma hā gu ru sidhi hūṃ: dang po 'bum ther bzla ba gong bsnyen ni: rjes su las la sbyor ba man ngag go: nad byung dogs na tshig bdun bzlas pa'i mjug sarba ro ga sharnying ku dzag ye swā hā: 'bum bzlas nad kyi g.yul las rgyal sa ma wā: bgegs byung dogs na tshig bdun bzlas pa'i 'jug: sarba bisnan rngonarnyi gu 〈co ye swā hā: 'bum phrag bzlasapas gdon bgegs g.yul las rgyal sa ma yā: yams byung dogs na tshig bdun bzlas pa'i 'jug: sarba dz+wa ra pra ro/ ma ṇi swā hā: 'bum phrag bzlas pas yams las rnam par rgyal sa ma yā: sgrib sbyangs 'dod na tshig bdun bzlas pa'i 'jug sarba pā paṃ da ha na shadhing ku 〈co ye swā hā: 'bum phrag bzlas pa'i sdig sgrib nyes lhung dag: sa ma yu: gnyan gdon 'dul na tshig bdun bzlas pa'i 'jug: sarba duṣ+ṭan dur ta sod dur mi sod: gnyan mgo chod: kha la dza: gas pur nan sod: cha phe le 〉ཿ 'bum phrag bzlas pas dug nad gnyan rims 'joms: sa ma yā: dam sri 'dul phyir

—8rdo tshag bdun bzlas pa'i 'jug: sarba tri dza tri hrīḥdam sri mā ra ya nan phaṭa: 'bum phrag bzlas pas dam sri nyul le 'dul sa ma yā rgyal 'gong 'dul tshe tshig bdun bzlas pa'i 'jug: rā dza s+t+waṃ bha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya mā ra ya mā ra ya dresad: 'bum phrag bzlas pas rgyal 'gong nye mi nus: sa ma yā: nyams rtogs rgyas phyir tshig bdun bzlas pa'i 'jug: ma hā su kha kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta sa ma ti sid+dhi pha la hūṃX 'bum phrag bzlas pas nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas: sa ma yā: tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir tshig bdun bzlas pa'i 'jug: byas ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa la khā hi: sa ma ya sdo bye āḥ mā ra ya phaṭa: ha hi stobs: ma ma bā ling ta khā hi: 'bum bzlas mchod pas tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag 'gyur: sa ma yā: sregs blugs 'dod na tshig bdun bzlas pa'i mjug: nyes badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐: sarba pu tsa khā hi: sharnyi puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa swā hā: 'bum bzlas mchod pas phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub sa ma yā: tshe bsring 'dod na tshig bdun bzlas pa'i mjug: skyes tshe t+t+waṃ dṛḥdza sarba a ma ra ṇa dzi wan ti ye swā hā: 'bum phrag bzlas pas dus min 'chi las rgyal sa ma yā bsod nams spel na tshig bdun bzlas pa'i mjug sarba rat+na ba su kha dhe na na sid+dhi pha la hūṃ: 'bum bzlas bsod nams longs spyod 'phel rgyas 'gyur: sa ma yā rten 'brel nyes 'joms tshig bdun

bzlas pa'i 'jug ma dhu dzami bye ru dza ya mu khe :: rten 'brel nyes tshogs shadhi ku ru phaṭa: legs yon gong 'phel puṣ+ṭi ku ru sbyo: 'bum bzlas rten 'brel nyes kun sor chud 'gyur: sa ma yā: bya ba rtsom tshe tshig bdun bzlas pa'i mjug: ces su sti sirnyi maṅga lam dza yan+tu bṛ puṣ+ṭi sidhi t+t+waṃ: 'bum bzlas bya ba mthar phyin bkra shis dge: dngos grub bsdu na tshig bdun bzlas pa'i mjug: skyes badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sidhi pha la :: 'bum bzlas dbang dang byin rlabs thob par 'gyur: the tshom med do rdo rje ṅgel po'i bka' kun la ma hā gu ru'i ting 'dzin gnad: nor bu ji bzhin 'dod rgu ngang gis 'byung bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal shin tu zab pa rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i srog: skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya: sa ma yā: las rim gnyis pasnyi: rgya rgya rgya: e ma ho: byin rlabs 'byung gnas ma hā gu ru la brten nas nor sgrub 'dod na 'di ltar ro:bkra shis rtags brgyad bkra ba'i shel bum nang 'bru sna rin chen phye ma sman sogs gtams: o rgyan dze+e lha'i snying po dbus su gzhug rnam lnga nyer spyod tshogs rdzas yo byad bkram rnal 'byor lta spyod dag pa'i las gzhungs bsrangs bstod mjug 'dzab kha dbye ba'i rim pa ni: phaṭa dza: bkra shis rat+na 'bar ba'i pho brang dbus: skyes rgyan dze+e lha sku mdog gser gyi mdog: phyag g.yas lcags kyus khams gsum dbang du

'dzen sdud: g.yon pas ne'u les dgos 'dod char rgyun 'bebs: zhabs gnyis rol stabs seng chen steng du bsgyur: 'ja' 'od zer gsum khu sbrang sil ma 'bebs: dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mchod bstod gar bsgyur stobs: ngo mtshar yid 'ong bkod pa phun sum tshogs: bdag thugs 'od kyis gu ru'i thugs rgyud bskul: byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bar bas khams gsum khyab: dus ngan dbul phongs rgud pa kun bsal nas: bde mchog dpal la skye dgu rtag spyod cing: chos mthun bya bas 'dzam gling 'a31 bar dmigs:yin badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba rat+na bā su kha dhe na na a d+dhiḥtriḥ.a gar sha ya bsdus bsdus sirnyi pha la hūṃ āḥ brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs ci 'grub bskyal:de nas g.yang 'bod bya ba'i rim pa ni:bsang dud spro zhing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas e: thugs dam ma g.yel gu ru rin po che: snyigs ma'i 'gro ba dmu rgod snying rje'i yul: dbul phongs bkres skom gdung ba drag pos mnar: nad mug mtshon chas kha ma bsgyur ba'i skabs: las spron mthu las bskyed pa nged cag gis: dka' ba'i rgyu bsags dkon pa'i zas btsal nas: yar mchod mar sbyin

bsags sbyangs gnad la 'bad: snyigs dus skyobs mdzad sa rgyan pad+ma la: gasdudatha ba lhang lhanga'adebs shing 'bod lags na: ma thogs sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs: skyod rgyan nor lha'i tshogs rnams nyi li li: pho rgyud dpa' bos nor 'bebs sha ra ra: mo rgyud mkha' 'gro'i glu len kyu ru dza phywa g.yang nor gyi char pa si li li: 'bru drug sman gyi bkod pa sbungs se spung: dar dang ba dan 'phan yab lhubs se lhub: rol mo snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs ti ri ri: bza' btung longs spyod sna tshogs bkrags se bkrag:sbos dud dri zhim ngad pa phyu ru rtsa snang gsal mar me'i 'od brgya ta la la steng phyogs lha yi longs spyod kyu ru rtsa bar srid mi yi 'dod yon sga ra ra:'og srid klu yi mnga' thang me re re: 'dir khug 'dir 'dus sgrub pa'i rdzas dang 'dres: phyu g.yang longs spyod char bas bang mdzod gang: nad mug mtshon chas gzings pa dbyings su bzlog: rdzogs ldan lang tsho dar ba'i dga' ston gyis: 'dzam gling tha gru kun tu khyab gyur cig: yangs pa'i rgyal khams skye 'gro sems can kun: bdag gis dam pa'i chos la gzud byas te: skye ba

pa:: 'di 'phos rnga yab dpal gyi rir: pha gcig gu ru pad ma'i zhabs drung du: mi 'bral tshom bu gcig tu sangs rgyas shog: sa sā snyisirnyimaṅga le: ci tsob brjod cing tshogs mchod btang ba dang: bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis brtan bzhugs bya: gnad des chos mthun 'byor rgyas bsam pa 'grub: bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel bar nus the tshom med do rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' shin tu zab pa rig 'dzan 'dus pa'i srog: skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya: sa ma yā: las rim gsum pasnyi rgya rgya rgya: yim ho rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i chos sde las: 'jigs brgyad zhi phyir bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bstan: shog dkar dri bral ngos su rgya snag gis mu khyud rim pa lnga ru bskor bar bya lte bar gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram sbubs: mi(1ju/tsho/〉khro: de rgyab mu khyud la ni 'di bzhin bri: badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba ju nad gdon 'jigs pa bcu drug de rgyab mu khyud gsum par 'di ltar bkod: 'chang ba po la nad gdon 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug sarba zhi zhi zhig zhig sharnyi ku ru ye swā snya de rgyab mu khyud bzhi par 'di bzhin bkod dbyangs gsal rten snying su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang skugadzaXmabazhesgadrusgogasgabazla/ skyo nad gdon 'jigs brgyad sgrib gnyis bag chags thams cad sharnying ku ru ye swā snya de rgyab mu khyud lnga par nor 'dzin bri rdzas ni bzang drug bdud rtsi chos sman byug: rgya lnga bsdams la dar gyis dril bar bya:

dag gis byug par bya rgya lnga'i bsdam la da la'i dbus su gzhug ha la me 'bar stong dang rten snying khri: phe lam̐ hūṃ ni bye bas rab tu gnas: 'bral med lus la 'chang bas rgya 'dre 'dul pha rol rdzas sbyor ngan pas tshugs mi 'gyur: the tshom mi dgos rdo rje rgyal po'i bka': shin tu zab pa rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sgog: skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya sa ma yā las rim bco lnga pazhwa : rgya rgya rgya: e ma ho rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i chos sde las: shes rab blo 'phel ril bu'i sdeb spyor bstan: a ru gser mdog skyu ru ngad dang ldan: bde drod bskyed byed pi pi ling dang ni shing mngar ba dang dug nyung a dkar sgron go snyod rtag ngu a wa gur kum rnams: zhib btags ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsis dril:ril bu che chung sran ma tsam du bya las gzhung bsrang la bsnyen sgrub tshad ldan bya: de nas tsa gong mur bar bya ba'o: zhag bdun gyis ni lce yi dig pa 'dag: bcu gnyis zos pas skad gdangs khyung bzhin 'gyur: bcu gsum tshe na mi brjed gzungs thob 'gyur: zla ba gcig bten rgas med lang tsho dar shes rab ye shes me ltar 'bar bar 'gyur spobs pa'i gter chen brgyad grol tshe dpal thob sha rus rdo ltar sra zhing nad mi 'byung: yon tan bsam mi khyab po rjes 'jug rnams: the tshom mi dgos rdo rje pad+ma'i bka': shin tu zab pa rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sgog: ska sha med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya: sa ma yā las rim bcu drug pa snyi: rgya rgya rgya: e ma ho: rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i chos sde

bsturdo las:ngag gi rkyen bzlog za yig man ngag bstan shog dkar dri bral gtsang zhing dag pa la:rgya snag mngar gsum bsres pa'i 'di bzhinabri:byed rten 'brel snying po stong gis byin gyis brlabs de nas lto stong rlung rig dwangs ba'i tshe:'jam dpal dbyangs can la dmigs lan gsum rol:ngag gi nyes dig lkug 'gag pa sor chud nas:skad gdangs mtho zhing rab tu snyan par 'gyur:the tshom mi dgos gu ru pad+ma'i bka':shin tu zab pa rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sgog:yāḥlas rim bcu bdun pasnyi:rgya rgya rgya:e ma ho:rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i chos sde las:rlung gi bcud len man ngag zab mo bstan:rnal 'byor chas brten rnam gsum 'khor lo lnga dang ldan pa la bzhugs nga/'a wa tshogs gzhung las gsal ltar dmigs rgyal kun byin rlabs gsang mdzod ye shes rluja :kha dog lnga ldan ro rkyang 'bacud kyis dbu ma'i nang kun chil chil gang:lto ba rlung gis gtams nas shes rig kyang bzo med ka dag ngang la lhug par bzhag nus pa thob tshe rlung gi bcud len

rlung rtsal yang yang sbyangs stobs ldan tshe na dben gnas ri khrod du: zas gos tshol mi dgos pa ya mtshan che byin rlabs rno nus gzhan las khyad par 'phags: bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal: shin tu zab pa rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i srog: skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya: sa ma yā: las rim bco brgyad pa snyi: rgya rgya rgya: e ma he rigasa'adus ma hā gu ru'i chos sde las ser ba bsrung thabs man ngag zab mo bstan: 'dre 'dus gsum gyi sa sna bcu gsum dang: chu sna bcu gsum ri rdo g.ya' shog dang: gangs thig brag rtsi sna tshogs dang bsres la tshwa tshwa nag po mchod brgyad ri mo can rgyal phur 'dzoms tshe legs par brtsam nas su zung 'jug dug shog ngos su dug snag gis rmayizartsu༄ sbyashishibhe—sdejurgyadiyobh+yorajutshordosang rizumasasnyojudzadzar+sha.oṃzhinugrujenāsnesarjapazug6 lag chad med par bris la dgu sbyor byug: yungs dkar 'bru bdun bcas nas snying por gzhug dal dbus gzhug cing rnam lnga nyer spyod bkram: las gzhung bsrang la 'dzab kha dbye ba ni phaṭa dza tshwa tshwa yongs gyur nā ga rak+ka'i sku: sngo nag dbu dgu phyag ni bco brgyad pa: rin po che yi sgog zhu mdzes par gsol: dmar ser ral pa gyen brdzes me ltar 'bar: spyan mig rtsa bdun glog dmar ltar du 'khyug: rno dkar mche ba bco brgyad bgegs la rngams: smar smin me yi tshwa

btsaX tshwas rgyal bsen bsreg: sku la dur khrod dpal chas mdzes par brgyan: phyag g.yas dgu na khyung lnga dur phag sdigs: seng chen stag mo mgo dgu bsnams par byed: g.yon pa sa bdag klu gnyan tsit+ta bsgrengs: sku smad gdug pa sbrul mjug g.yas su 'khyil: sa bdag klu gnyan ma lus 'dul bar byed: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon yig 'bru las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas spyan drangs bstim: sku las mtshon thun sna tshogs 'phros pa yis: bdud bgegs rgyal bsen sde brgyad tshar bcad nas:bar chad sel ba'i g.yul ngo zhi bar dmigs: glu phe le hūṃ: shes hūṃ hrīḥbhukho badz+ra bha wa tri rnyo tiṣ+ṭha bhu khaṃ swā hā: rten 'brel snying po su pra tiṣ+ṭha bcas: stong phrag brjod la rab tu gnas par bya: de nas mchod cing bstod pa rgyas par bya: snyen badz+ra tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bhi reg dha ni swā hāḥ lan gsum gyis ni ye shes kyi spyan dbye'o: snyen gisahūṃ swā hā: lan gsum brjod cing rdo rje'i bsgyur stabs kyis: bskyed pa'i lha zhu thugs rten rnam par 'gyur: dpung rgyan bsang khrus sngon du 'gro ba yis 'dzer po'i gser mkhar nyid la sbas pa'i tshe: ser ba'i g.yul las lo bcud rgyas par 'gyur: the tshom med do gu ru pad+ma'i bka': shin tu zab pa rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sgog

skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya sa ma yā: las rim bcu dgu pa 3gi rgyargyargya: rigasa'adusam hāgu ru'i chos sde las char 'bebs man ngag bdud rtsi zeg ma bstan de yang chu rdo gnam ma mthong ba'i ngor mthing gis nā phu baṃ gsum chu ri ram: chu lhum lo mar mtshal gyis dpa' 'khor bri: 7ḍālernayig gsal bar bkod: bzang drug klu sman sbyar la mtsho chur sbaḥ chu dkar phyar rgyur sngags 'di brjod la brlabs: ces sarba ar+yāta re ༷ ste na ghar+bha tram̐ swā hā: stong brjod phu btab legs par phyar ba'o: khyad par char 'bebs sngags 'di yang yang bzla: na ma sarba ta thug ta sbye: sarba mu khe sbye: sarba tha gu lu gu ༷/: gu gardza gardza ma hā byu ta bye:bha ra bi tu nga ma la: nga ra nga ra: sidhi sidhi: ka pa ka pa baṃ baṃ 'dus 'dus: sidhi pha la t+t+waṃ hūṃḥ brgya stong la sogs brjod la chu rgyun nyid: phyogs bcu kun 'thor char ba dbang med rdol:rno nus byin rlabs ya mtshan khyad par 'phags: bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal shin tu zab pa rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i /sgog skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya: sa ma yā las rim nyi shu pazhwag rgyargyargya: e ma ho:rigs 'dus ma hāgu ru'i chos sde las kha char gcod pa zab pa'i man ngag bstan de yang lan tshwa nya sha chu bya'i sha: glang ma spang spos tshwa la bsres pa can me la bsreg cing bzlas pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni rang nyid khyung dmar me phreng babye/ma:

btsa(rnya khyung gi tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: char ba char bdag kha ba rnams: bsreg skam me yi rang bzhin gyur: ka pad+ma khro ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa: nā ga ram̐ ram̐ kho khaṃ tshig tshig: shā baṃ dz+wa la ram̐: char ba char bdag badz+ra ram̐ ram̐ swā hā: spra bcad ngang nas bzla zhing kha phu 'debs: kha char gdug pa'i la yog skems par 'gyur bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal: shin tu zab pa rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sgog: skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya sa ma yā las rim nyer gcig pa3/ rgya rgya rgya: e ma ho rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i chos sde las: chu sbyin bya ba tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho bstan de yang bzang drug bsres pa'i mar ril bu: brgya stong la sogs ci 'byor bsags byas nas: 'o chab dkar po zangs kyi snod gangs ste sngags dang phyag rgya drug gis byin brlabs bya: bdag snang gu ru zhi ba nyid du gsal: hūṃ: dasko/na mdzadag gsum dang rtsa gsum rgya mtsho rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo: ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro ba rnams: bla med kun tu bzang po'i sa thob shog: ma ma hā shudh+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swā bha wa ad+ma ko3nya: bcom ldan bde bar gshegs pa rin chen ming: gzugs mdzes 'byams klas

'jigs kun bral ba yi: de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la gus phyag 'tshal: zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di: bla ma yi dam dkon mchog lha la 'bul: se bha ra dang bsgrags la 'o ril 'bul: dam tshig nyams chags nyes lhung dag pa dang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: lan gsum bdud rtsi 'dod yon lnga ldan phung po 'di: srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul: saṃ bha ra dang 'o chab ril bu 'bul bar chad dre la la phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs: tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i lam 1 gas mdzod: lan gsum: bdud rtsi zad med nam mkha' mdzod chen pos: 'gro ba rigs drug snying rje'i mgron la 'bul: se bha ra dang 'o chab ril bu 'bul: las snang sdug bsngal bag chags kun bral nas: bde ba mchog ldan drin lan 'khor gyur cig lan gsum bdud rtsi sha lnga gang 'dod mkho rgu'i gter bgegs rigs lan chags bu lon mgron la bsngo: se bha ra dang 'o chab ril bu 'bul:lan chags bum na sha mkhon byang ba dang: gdug sems zhi zhing bde ba mchog ldan gyur: lan gsum bdud rtsi zag med chu rgyun byin rlabs gter: yi dwags bkres skoms

ba66 gdung bas mnar la 'bul:so bha ra dang 'o chab kun tu 'thor:sarba dz+wa la me dam pre ta bh+yaḥswā hā:lan gsum gyis 'bul:gaṅgaliklung mnyam yi dwags ngoms shing tshims:bkres skom gdung zhi bde dpal thob par shog:lan gsum dgon mchog srid zhuyimagron rnam thugs dam bskang:mgon po yon tan mgron rnams mnyes gyur cig:rigs drug snying rje'i mgron rnams tshims gyur cig:lan chags bu lon bdag po ngoms gyur cig:kun kyang chos sku'i ngang la gnas gyur cig:bdag blo ma rig dbang gyur nor 'khrul rnams:ma 'byor ma rted ma tshang ser snas sbag:rtsa ba yan lag chags nyams byung ba rnams:gnong zhing 'gyod sems drag pos bshags bgyi'o:yi ge brgya ba lan gsum bzla bar bya:mchod bya mchod byed mchod yul ma lus pa:sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor zhig pa ci bzhin du:gnas lugs 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang du bzhag:ka dag chos sku'i dgongs pakunamardo bsags sbrangs spel ba'i dge ba ji snyed kun:'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bsngo bar bgyi:ma dag snang ba dbyings su zhig ma thag:kun mkhyen

garngordod ma'i mabo na 17'i sa lnga ba regag: lan gsum brjod cing bsngo ba smon lam gdab gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag sangs rgyas 'gyur thabs mang dka' ba med pa'i sngags kyi lam ma 'ongs rig pa 'dzin pa'i dpal du shog skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya sa ma yā las rem nyer gnyis pa ljag rgya rgya rgya:yem ho regasa'adus ma hā gu ru'i chos sde las:(ba rnams bsang ba bdud rtsi'i sprin dpung bstan de yang shug pa sur dkar 'om bu dang sba snyug nya brud ba lu spen dkar pa: mkhan dkar tsan dan dkar dmar sgon shing dang bzang drug spos rigs 'bru sna phye mar bsre: dar tshon chang dang shel tshig sbyar me la bsreg nas bsang dud spro bsang sbyangs byin mas grub nas 'di skad do: na mo bslu med daspun mchog rin chen rnam gsum dang: chos can chos nyid rgyu 'bras bslu med mthus: bdag cag slob dpon yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs kun dag gyur cig: kyi: bzang dzang shug pa 'om bu sba sbugs dang: stag pa sur dkar nya brud gser mdog can: a dkar tsan dan dkar dmar bzang po drug: mkhan pa spen dkar phye mar dkar mngar sgyur ja chang 'o phud dar zab stag gzig ras: 'byung ba me la bsreg pa'i dud sprin ni: kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum

ba:tshu tshogs:ngo mtshar yid 'ong bkod pa chen po yis:bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsang:chos skyong nor lha gter bdag dam can bsang:dgra lha yul lha 'go ba'i lha rnams bsang:rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs 'khor bcas bsang:mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i dri ma dag gyur cig:kyi shing rtsi sna tshogs sman gyi dud pa yis:mdze bo dam nyams grib kyis phog pa bsang mgar ba yug mo'i grib kyis phog pa bsang ro nag nal ma'i grib kyis phog pa bsang:sdig can shan pa'i grib kyis phog pa bsang mna' zan dme bo'i grib kyis phog pa bsang:mthu gtad hom zor grib kyis phog pa bsang kla 1'i rdzas sbyor grib kyis phog pabasang:rgya 'dre 'byung po'i grib kyis phog pa bsang sde brgyad lha 'dre'i grib kyis phog pa bsang mdor na mi dang mi min las byung ba'i:mnol grib dri ma'i tshogs kun dag gyur cig:phyi snod rnam dag zhing khams rol par 'gyur:nang bcud dag sangs dpa' bo mkha' 'gror sad:gnas dang sbra khang dag pa gzhal yas che:zas nor dag sangs 'dod rgu'i gter du shar:lha srung bsang

bas mthu stobs nus rtsal 'bar: 'dir 'dus bdag cag dpon slob mched lcam bsang: mi mthun rkyen gyis 'tshubs ma bar chad byang: bde skyid longs spyod mnga' thang phun sum dzadzhags: 'di phyi'i mdzad lja/da gegs med 'grub gyur cig: ces brjod bsang dud gnas dang yo byad la phog pas grib dang mi gtsang nyes skyon dag: gang 'dod bya ba gegs med yid bzhin 'grub the tshom mi dgos gu ru pad+ma'i bka': bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal: shin tu zab pa rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i srog: skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya: sa ma yu: las rim nyer gsum pa snyi rgya rgya rgya: e ma ho regs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i chos sde las: gsur mchod dus ngan snyigs ma'i g.yul bzlog bstan: 'bru sna'i phye ma sha tshil bsres pa can: bsregs la gsur dud rgya chen btang bar bya bsang sbyangs spel la bsngo ba'i rim pa ni: yis ma ste thugs rje chag thogs bral ba sbyan ras gzigs: 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs rje btsun tā re ma: gdug pa kun 'dul badz+ra ku ma ra: mtha' mi'i byad bzlog seng ha ḍāk+ki ma:snyigs mi'i skyabs mgon gu ru rin po che: rje btsun lha lngar snying nas gsol ba 'debs: dus ngan rgud pa'i ru 'dzings 'tshubs slong skabs: las ngan log par spyod pa'i 'gro
