badz+ra: ba ni: lha 'dre'i kha g.yar shi 'dre 'khyams po ba: rgya 'dre me zhon 'byung po rlung zhon dang: du ru ka yi rigs byed ma rung ba: dmar mchod sha dang khrag la dga' ba'i rigs: dmag 'khrugs mtshon cha 'gyed pa'i ma rung ba: 'gro kun sdug la sbyor ba'i rgya 'dre'i rigs: skye rgu'i shes rgyud brlabs pa'i rgyal bsen rnams: sbyin bsreg me mchod 'di yis tshim gyur nas: ngoms shing mgu la gnod gdug bsam pa bral: phan pa byang chub sems kyis rgyud brlan nas: rang rig bde ba chen por sangs rgyas regag: snyen āXs brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs ci 'grub bzla gnad des 'gong po dam sri kun tshims nas nad gdon ngos mi zin pa sos par 'gyur: bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal shin tu zab pa rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sgog skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya: sa ma yā: lasarim nyer bzhi pa snyi rgya rgya rgya: tsogam lho regs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i chos sde las bstan srung la mo'i bla rdo sgog 'khor bstan: de yang shog dkar dri ma bral ba'i ngor: mtshal dang bzang drug bsres pa'i mu khyud ni: rim pa bdun bskor lte bar sku gzugs dang: srog yig maḥbakod de rgyab mu khyud la: ra lipra ma na sa ma ya hring dzaḥpho : dza silim ṇi dza: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan de rgyab mu khyud

gsum par 'di ltar bri: bstan srung lha mo ngas nus ma dang: gnod sbyin mo 'dre 'bod nag mo klu mo bsam 'phel mo: dgra sgog gcod pa mo: bdud po mig gcig gnod sbyin mdung thung can sgog 'dren btsan dmar tha chung zu ra skyes ming sring brgyad kyi bla chags par gyur cig: sgog brtan par gyur cig sku gsung thugs gnas par gyur cig: gzhan yang re ma ti mched bzhi sprul pa dur khrod kyi ngan ne+e ma brgyad dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs chags par gyur cig: bla gnas shing srog brtan par gyur cig: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma yā s+t+waṃ: de rgyab mu khyud bzhi par mig nyer gcig: lnga pa la ni dbyangs gsal rten snying bri: drug par nor bu cha bdun sna bdun bkod bdun pa la ni me ri pa tra mdzes dzos ni gser dngul g.yu byur be+e ḍār+ya: pad+ma rā ga mu men shel mchong spug: sa le sbram dang gzi spod mu tig rnams za 'og kyis dril dbus gzhug rgya lnga bsdams: dal gzhug rang sngags 'bum dang rten snying stong smra bcad bzlas la rab tu gnas par bya: 'bral med sha rul sbrang ma 'dus pa bzhin: mkha' 'gro ma 'khor yid bzhin nor bu 'dra: rnal 'byor lus la rtag tu bcing bar bya rgyas par mos na zab sgrub rgyas 'bring ltar legs par shes dgos man ngag dam pa'o shin tu zab pa rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sgog: skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya: sa ma yā: las rim nyer lnga pa3ni: rgya rgya rgya: ye ma: shin tu zab pa las kyang ches zab pa: rmad byung rdo rje

brterdo snyingapo'i chos sde ya :riga'ardzan bla ma'i sgrub skor bdud rtsi'i bcud rtog ge ngan pas rang bzos bslad ma zhugs:lta dman blo chung rnams ni sgrag mdzad pa'i:theg mchog seng ge'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba:grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thob mod khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs pra thob ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus:ngaspruladapa' lanus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas zab gsang 'dzin pa'i chos bdag ni:rma rin sprul pa sku skyes pad+ma'i ming:g.yu sgra'i zer 'phos pad+ma pra dzñā dang be+e ro' gar bsgyur pad+ma 'od brgya 'bar ldan ma'i sprul pa ku mud dharma pa:dzñā na ku ma dngos gyur pukhye pa:ye shes dbyangs dngos g.yu sgra zhes su 'bod rong sngags nyi ma kun bzang la sogs pa'i bstan pa 'dzin skyongs spel na yangs pa'i khams:rdo rje snying po'i ba dan mdzes pas brdal:gdul bya 'bum phrag rnga yab dpal rir 'god:skal ldan rnams kyis grub rtags mtshan bzang brnyes:ya mtshan rmad byung chos 'di khyad par 'phags thub par srung shig shazangs nus ma:skal med lag tu ma shoraspugrigasum:las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par re ga sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya las tshags nyishu rtsa lnga phrin las kun 'byung zhes bya ba rdzogs so:gter rgya:gtad rgya:sbas rgya:zab rgya:gsang rgya:gu h+ya:angargyan rgya slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka':bdaga'adra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o:brda thim lja:ces pa 'di'ang chos

kyi bdag po lung zin pad+ma nor bus thabs shes rdor dril bkra shis lha reg mthing mdzes cod pan rin chen dang po g.yu byur sogs yid 'ong gi rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas nas bskul ba dang chos bdag dharma ku mud kyis yangayang bskul ba dang: chos bdag sku skyes mched zung dang slob bu ye shes dad ldan chos gsal grogs mo rat+na sa ra rnams kyis nan tan chen pos bskul ba la brten nas bdag 'dradapa' be nus ldan rdo rjes 'bros phug mkha' 'gro'i'adu gling gi gzim chung pad+ma 'khyil ba'i nang sra brtan bde ba'i khri la gnas te skyid pa'i nyams 'od gsal chen po ru shar ba'i ngang nas gsang brda zab mo zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel: sarba maṅga le/

btsa/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs so:gas/ na mo gu ru le: dzaXs/she)0 dad dang mos gus gdung ba drag po yis: bla ma mdun mkhar gsal gdab 'di skad brjod: e ma ho: sku gsum rgyal ba kun dngos sa rgyan rje:bka' drin zla bral mi mjed phrag brgya'i mgon: mtha' 'khob bod kyi mig gcig pad+ma 'byung: yang yang dran zhing gsol ba 'debs lags na: thugs rjes zungs shig 3 rgyan chos kyi rje byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen: srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las: da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs: bdag sems skad cig chos la mos na yang: bar chad rkyen mang shin tu bsgyur sla ba'i: nyam chung tshug mi zin pa'i byis pa bdag: thugs rjes zungs shig cod rgyan chos kyi rje: byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen: srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las: da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs: chos tshul bzung kyang la la 'du 'dzis 'phrog: bzlas brjod brtsam kyang ngag 'khyal ku

rer g.yeng: dul bar sems kyang rang rgyud rdo ltar gyong: thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje: byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen: srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las: da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs: sgrub la spyor yang 'du 'dzi shin tu 'tshubs: brtson par rtsam kyang bya bzhag las ga mang: phan sems bskyed kyang nye rang phyogs ris shor: thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje: byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen: srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las: da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs: 'du gral sleb tshe khro gnyer tshul 'chos byed: 'dun ma gtam par mi chen gol sa snyogs: slong mor nyul tshe 'jam dal smra re mkhas: thugs rjes zungs shig sa rgyan chos kyi rje: byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen: srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las: da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs: lo zla tsam sgrub yus che rang mthong sbos: bslu byed 'khor bar zhen pa ldog mi nus: ser sna 'jur gegs shin tu bsogs la mkhas: thugs rjes zungs shig sa rgyan chos kyi rje: byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab

ba:tshu gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs:dben pa brten yang sems rtog grong yul shor:'khor ba spang kyang chos brgyad 'ur 'go gshogs:mi rtag bsgom kyang rtag tu sdod grab byed:thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs bla ma brten kyang dag snang sbyangs ma nus:gdams ngag stsol yang nyams su len ma mkhas:thugs rjes brkyang yang phyin log phyogs la 'phyangs:thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs:brtsebaliman ngag mtshang rgol khong khro slong:kha gsag ngo bstod byas na bzhin 'dzum dga':dbang gral chos sgo mthong la sba 'tshang byed:thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyi du pad+ma 'od der

drongs:dam tshig sdom pa bsrung la chog shas byed:chos kyi snying po bsgom la le los bslu:dad mos chung zhing log lta g.yo ba'i tshe:thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs:theg chen 'dod kyang dman pa'i blo ltar dub:a ti bsgom kyang rtag chad mtha' rer lhung:zang thal sems yang phyogs gtad mdud pa sra:thugs rjes zungs shig 37 rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs:rig par smra yang dag mnyam phyogs re ba:rtogs par sems kyang gnyis 'dzin blo rtse rgod:grol bar re yang 'khrul ba kha 'byams bdag:thugs rjes zungs shig 3 rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs:lta ba masgo yang kha 'byams had po 'doms:bsgom pa zhib kyang sems las dben ma nus:spyod pa legs snyam rgyu 'bras 'chol nyogs

ba tshu bslab:thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs:tsho ni skad cig sgyu mas bsgrus te zad:sems ni dug lnga'i smag gis bslad de myos :chos ni chos min 'khrul ba'i sprin gyis bsgribs:thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs:snyigs ma'i dus ngan 'tshubs ma'i smag khrod 'dir:blo chung byis pa bdag 'dra'i chos byed pa:las ngan phyi nang rkyen gyis 'phrog la nye:thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs:blo rtse rgod kyang dkon mchog re phug bca':bya bzhag mang yang dam chos sgrub la mos:dran sgo 'tshubs kyang snying nas bla mar dad:thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab

'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs:las ngan bdag kyang sngon chad tshogs re bsags:sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i thugs rjes gzigs byar gyur: bla med bla ma gu rus rjes su bzung:thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje: byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las: da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs ma rig mun khams srid pa'i btson khang du:nyon mongs 'dam rdzab gzeb las skad cig nyid: bde legs dam chos dpal gyi 'tsho ba ༄stethugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje: byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las: da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs:sdang zhen gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i bag chags gzeb:chos brgyad brel longs 'du 'dzi sna tshogs las:rnam par rgyal nas yang dag chos spyod par:thugs rjes zungs shig 31 rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las: da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs:rtag par bka' drin mnyam med bla ma la:'dud

ba tshu bstod brtsi bkur mos gus dad pas bsnyen:ci mdzad gang gsung chos dang gdams ngag shes:thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs:mnyes pa gsum kyigu ru mchod cing brten:khrel med gsum gyis rang rgyud rtag tu 'dul:rtag brten bslab gsum mi rmongs mkhas pa dzasathugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs:gtad med shun bral zang thal lta ba skyongs:'dzin med byung rgyal rang lo bsgom pa'i bab:gol shor nor bral rnam rgyal spyod pa brten:thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs:dran shas bag yod rtag tu rgyud la brten:dad mos dag snang mi nub rgyun chags sbyor:brtse gdung snying rje nges 'byung skyo shes bskul:thugs rjes

zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs:yod la des chog rin chen byang chub sems:med mi rung ba stong nyid snying rje zung:gnad kun 'dus pa rang rig ye shes skyongs:thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs:lugs 'byung srid gsum 'khor ba ru bzlog nas:lugs ldog srid rtse'i bag chags kun bcom nas:sku dang ye shes btsan srid zin pa dza3thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs:snying nas bla mar gsol ba yang yang 'debs:rtag tu kun bzang mchod sprin 'dzin med 'bul:las nyon rmongs pa'i dri ma mthol lo bshags:thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje:byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen:srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las:da lta nyid

badz+ra du pad+ma 'od der drongs: mkhyen brtses rab dgongs dbang bzhi bskur du gsol: sgrib pa bzhi dag rig 'dzin rnam bzhi 'grub: ye shes bzhi mthong sku bzhi 'grub pa rtsa thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje: byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen: srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las: da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs: skad cig nyid du smin cing grol bar mdzod: 'dug sa 'di ru nyams rtogs yon tan bskyed: gdan thog 'di ru rtogs grol dus mnyam mdzod: thugs rjes zungs shig o rgyan chos kyi rje: byin gyis rlobs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen: srid pa'i 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i chu bo las: da lta nyid du pad+ma 'od der drongs: bdag dang 'brel thog pha ma sems can rnams: nam zhig 'phos tshe dpal ri pad+ma'i drung: 'khor gyi thog ma nyid du gyur pa dang: gzhan phan phrin las rgya mtshos phyugs bzhin du: dpal ldan bla ma'i bzhed rngorten 'khru1ba par thegag: de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i mi: phyi nang bar chad g.yul las rgyal: tshe bsod nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gu rgya snyi: ces pa 'di'ang

rang slob dad ldan pad 'dzin gyis dar bcas bskul ba dang: nye gnas dharmā kirti smon sems gnyis kyis dga' spre'i me tog bcas yang yang bskul ngor nus ldan rol pa'i rdo rjes bris pa dge legs 'phel: sarba maṅga le/

ba tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa lag mthil du bkram pa gsang ba gnad kyi bcud thig zhes bya ba bzhugs so:badz+ra: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: rdohūṃ 17lo ts+tsha khyab bdag gdod malimagon po ye shes sku: lhun grub sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'khor lo'i dbyings: gsang gsum 'gag med 'ub chub rol pa'i lhar: ngo mtshar yid ches dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje btsan mo'i mkhar: thabs shes zung 'jug bkod pa rdzogs pa'i gnas: mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i dal khang nas: kun tu bzang dngos pad+ma kā ra yis: rang rtsal rje 'bangs lo paṇa tshom bu la: zad med sang yangs sku gsum mdzod sgo phyes: dgongs pa ro mnyam ngang nas gdams pa gling: dus gsum mnyam nyid ka dag zang ma thal: gang las byung bas man ngag snying 'dra ba: tshogs smon las 'phro can gyi dpal du shar: yi ma ho sna chogs ma 'dres so sor snang ba'i chos: dbyings kyi rgyan te sku yi 'khor lor shar: sna tshogs grags stong sgra yis bye brag kun: dbyings kyi rgyan te

gsung gi rol par shar:'gyu 'phro rnam rtog lu gu rgyud tshogs rnams:dbyings kyi rgyan te thugs kyi rnam par shar:stong pa rnam par dag pa thams cad kun:dbyings kyi rgyan te chos kyi dbyings nyid do:gsal la rang grol dag pa thams cad kun:dbyings kyi rgyan te dag gsal me long ngo:mnyam brdal ro gcig dag pa thams cad kun:dbyings kyi rgyan te thams cad mnyam pa nyid:chags thogs kun bral gsal dag rol pa yang:dbyings kyi rgyan te sor rtogs kun grol klong:rnam par dag cing rang sar grol ba'i chos:dbyings kyi rgyan te bya grub ye shes ngang:phung po mi dmigs dmigs gtad bral ba'i don:dbyings kyi rgyan te sku lnga'i 'khor lor shar:'byung ba rnam grol 'ub chub bde ba'i gshis:dbyings kyi rgyan te yum lnga'i 'khor lor shar:tshogs yul zhen bral rang sar rnam grol gshis:dbyings kyi rgyan te byang chub sems kyi klong:snang ba kun bzang bde chen yab kyi dal:rdo nga pa kun bzang spros bral yum gyi sa nga:shar ba kun bzang sems dpa' chags thogs bral:17la ba kun bzang sems ma der 'dzin dben:gnas pa

su( kun bzang mi g.yo mgon po'i zhal: 'gyu ba kun bzang mi dmigs chen po'i ngang: nyon mongs kun bzang rang grol rigs lnga'i gdung: rtogs tshogs kun bzang byang chub sems dpa'i dal: bde dga' rang grol chags med rgyal ba'i zhal: stong gsal zhen med ye shes mkha' 'gro'i 1nga: 'di na ma dag snang ba rdul tsam bral:) ga zhes bya ba zhen 'dzin g.yul las rgyal: gser gling lta bur dbye bsal bral ba'i gshis: rtsol sgrub dma' ba'i theg lam zil gyis gnon: rmad byung kun tu bzang po'i ngang lugs yin: sa ma yā: 'khor 'das dag parab 'byams su la bzla ba'i man ngag go: gu bya: e mashe ga: gdid nas dag yi'aganyug ma byang chub sems: yod pa ma yin gzugs rdzas mtshan ma bral: med pa ma yin 'khor 'das mched pa'i gzhi: skye ba las 'das gnas yul bdag po bral: 'gag pa'i mtha' bral 'gags yul bdag po ) ben: 'gro 'ong mtha' bral 'gro 'ong dmigs su med: tha dad ma yin 'khor 'das bde slong 'khyil: gcig zhes bya ba'i dngos rtog mtshan ma bral: phyi nang bar med brdal

khyab stong pa nyid:nges brjod ston bya'i dngos po'i mtshan ma med:shar grol dus mnyam 'bras bu yid smon bral:sku dang ye shes bkod pa lhun gyis grub:re dogs mtshan ma'i sbubs las rnam par 'das:gang shar rang grol kun bzang dgongs pa'i gshis:ye nas grol ba nam mkha' lta bu'i 1nga:bskyar gzhi dmigs med rnam par grol ba'o:rang grol rol ba sbrul mdud mkha' bor bzhin:mtha' grol klong yangs kun bzang rol ba che:gcig grol rang bzhin thig le gcig tu bzlum mnyam grol ngang la skyon dang dri ma bral:shar tsam grol ba chu bo'i rba rlabs 'dra:cer gyis grol ba rdo tshan char bab ltar:nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rtsal rdzogs 'gyur:sa ma yā:chos nyid spros mtha' bral ba'i don rang grol gshis lugs kyi rnam dbye bshad pa'o:gu h+ya:e ma ho:'khor 'das mnyam brdal byang chub sems kyi klong:ji bzhin mngon byung rjen par mthong ba'i tshe:'das pa mi dmigs ma 'ongs sngon bsu bral:da lta shes rig rtse mo byung rgyal 'di:mthar 'dod bcas bcos blo yis mi bslad par:shar grol dus mnyam rang gsal ngo

btsarnya bor blta: 'di yin 'di min sgro 'dogs mtshan ma bral: sems rtog 'khrul pa'i bcos bsgyur gang yang med: rgya mtsho 'khyil bzhin 'gyu rtog dben sar gnas: ri rgyal lta bur g.yo 'gul med par bzhag: nyi zla ci bzhin gsal 'grib bral bar bslabs: shar cha ma nub rang gsal brdal ba che: der 'dzin shes pa'i dpyod cha phra ba bral: mngon lkog 'gyu ba'i rtsis gdab ga la dgos: yengs gnas sa bsrung bzhag pa lta ci 'tshal: thim la ma rmugs nang gsal rig pa zhes: 'gyu rtogs 'gags pas thom yor 'thib po min: 'phro rgod rnam rtog rlung gis ga la 'khyer: sems kyi rtsis las rnam par 'das pa'i don: khyad chos bzhi ldan ye shes yon tan mdzod: nor bu ji bzhin 'dod yon rang grol gshis: 'khor lo lta bur kun nas 'khyil zhing zlum: btsun mo ji bzhin 'khor 'das bde klong sbrum: blon po lta bur gzung 'dzin zil sgyes gnon: rta mchog ji bzhin mkhyen gnyis rtsal sgo 'bar: glang po che ltar 'khor ba'i 'dam las grol: dasnyag dpon ltar du 'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal: rgyal mtshan lta bur phyogs lhung

bral bar gnas:theg mchog rgyal po'i rang lugs skyong tshul ste:gshis la re/ra dang rmongs pas gol sa bral:bde dang gsal ba mi rtog bslu brid dor:sgom zhes bya ba'i blo rtog mtshan ma bral:mi bsgom 'khrul ba'i 'dzin stangs rnam par dag:tha mal shes pa rang gsal zang ga ma:'du 'bral dmigs su med pa'i ye shes nyid:bsgom pa'i nang gsal rig pa'i rtsal sgo 'bar:bde gshegs chos sku'i dkyil 'khor rtogs gyur na:gang snang thams cad dag pa'i 'khor lor shar:stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug rig pa'i zhal:mthong ba'i dgra gnyen chags sdang 'dzin pa dag:ye shes chen po'i dgongs pa mngon gyur na:chags thogs bral ba'i mkhyen gnyis shes rab 'bar:dmigs med lta ba'i phu thag chod pa'i mthus:'dir snang sgyu ma'i yul gyi zhen 'dzin ldog:dad dang mos gus yon tan bsam mi khyab:rmad byung kun tu bzang po'i khyad chos yin:g.yel med theg mchog snying po nyams su longs:sa ma yā:nyams len gnad thog tu dril ba'i man ngag zab mo'o:gu hra:e ma he:gsang chen rmad byung rdzogs pa chen po'i chos:tshe

gas/ gcig lhur len byed pa'i skyes bu yis: kun gzhi chos sku mi nor shan 'byed 'phyongs: phral gsal 'gags med mkhyen cha'i dbye ba gal: rnam shes ye shes shan 'byed zab pa'i sgo: yid dang shes rab mi nor nyams len 'phyongs: grol dang 'khrul ba'i sa 'tshams dbye ba dang: go ba rtogs pa'i la shan dbye ba dang: bsam dang rig pa'i shan 'byed ma nor ba: myong dang zhen pa ma nor shan 'byed 'phyongs: 'byams dang klas pa'i go don ma 'khrul ba: gshis la shor dang rang gsal ma nor ba: gshis brten rmongs dang zang thal shan 'byed dang: bde ba'i gol sa rang grol la shan dbye: gsal ba'i bslu brid ro mnyam chen por dbye: rmongs pa'i 'thibs cha 'ub chub nor mi bya:'khrul ba'i bslu brid 'khrul grol shan 'byed gal: sangs rgyas sems can dbye ba'i shan 'byed 'phyongs: ma nor shes rab mig 'bras zum pa phye: nor 'khrul rmongs pa'i blo ngan drung nas 'byin: shes rab ye shes nyi ma 'od po ches: lta ba yas 'bebs snang srid chos skur blta: spyod pa mas 'dzeg dran shes bag yod gzab: 'dod yon sgyu ma'i mi

bslu zhen med gdengs:dag pa'i snang bar ma dag log spyod spangs:'gro drug pha mar dgra gnyen chags ldang dor:'khor 'das bden med stong pa'i rtsal sbyongs bslab:bla ma sangs rgyas dad mos dag pas 'dud:sgog gis bsdus pa'i mched la brtse gdung sbyangs:'dus byas chos rnams blo gtad med pas spangs grub zin med pa 'khor ba'i bya 'phro bcad:ngo lkog med par dam tshig sgog ltar bsrung:tshe gcig yengs med dam pa'i chos la dril:man ngag gdams pa chud zos med par brtson:nges med ri sul 'grims la brtul zhugs spyod:lta spyod phyogs rer mi gol rang rkang skyongs:mi dge'i las rnams dug bzhin dor ba dang:zhi dul bag yod gzob pa lhur len gnas:chos brgyad 'ur mo'i bya ba rgyab tu dor:re dwogs mtshan ma'i rtog pa drungs nas 'byin:gol shor nor gsum 'phrang kun bsal bar bya:phyi slong lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul rang sar gcod:nang slong lus kyi nad gdon yul med ngang:gsang slong sems kyi dga' sdug rang grol brtson:rdzun pa'i nyams snang sems kyi gshis su grol:rkyen theg bzod pa'i khur chen lus la

gas/: bgo: gang snang gang shar sku dang ye shes klong: bsal bzhag bral ba rin chen gser gling 'dra: snang srid sku gsum lha sngags chos sku'i ngang: re drogs med pa byang chub sems kyi slong: rgya grol rig pa nam langs nyi shar 'dra: thams cad 'ub chub kun bzang dgongs pa'i sang: gces pa'i srog ltar zab mo'i gnad gsang skyongs:sa ma yu: shan 'byed kyi gnad dang bog 'don gyi man ngag zab mo'o: gu bya: e ma ho: de ltar lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad skyongs tshe: ngo bo rang byung ye shes sangs rgyas nyid:sems can kun dang dbyer med mnyam pa nyid: nges shes tshe na rang gnas gshis lugs skyongs: bar med zang thal 'od gsal la goms na: skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas par 'gyur: bsgom pas mi 'grub ma bsgom bzhag pas 'khru/ba: bsgrub pas mi 'grub ma bsgrub gnas pas 'grub: bzlas pas mi 'grub ma bzlas mthong bas 'grub: bltas pas mi 'grub mi blta bzhag pas mthong: blo bcos mkhas kyang zab mo'i don mi gsal: shes pa gsal yang rang grol gshis ma shes: dka' bas btsal kyang

yang dag don ma rnyed: des na rang grol mchog gi rnal 'byor pas: yang gsang bsgom sgrub zab mo'i gnad brkyangs pas:rtogs myong goms pas gdengs chen rtsal rdzogs nas:kun tu bzang po'i bha gar rdzogs sangs rgyas: tshe gcig gzhon nu bum skur 'ub chub nas:slar yang gdangs kyi 'khor ba ma stongs par:dbyings las ma g.yos ye shes gzugs kyi skus:'gro khams rgya mtsho dong nas sprugs par byed:myur lam theg mchog zab gsang rdzogs pa che'i:dgongs pa mthar thug shin tu 'byon par dka':gsang chen gnyis ldan che ba'i yon tan rdzogs: gcig shes kun grol yid bzhin nor bu 'di:skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya: las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par re ga: sa ma yā:khyad 'phags yon tan dang 'bras bu rnam bzhag gi rim pa'o:gu h+ya:de ltar zab gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i chos:shin tu gsang ba tshe gcig sangs rgyas lam:grub pa'idabang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad: da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thob: mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs pra mdzod: ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus:nga sprul dpa' bo

badz+rashā nus ldan rdo rje dang: 'phrad nas gdul bya 'bum phrag ma lus pa: 'og min chos dbyings zhing la 'god par 'gyur: the tshom med do rdo rje rgyal po'i bka':zabang rgesang thub par srungs shig ngas nus ma: skal med lag tu ma regar a tham rgya: rgya rgya rgya: gsang ba gnad kyi bcud tig dzadags so: gter rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya:gsang rgya: shes rgyan gyi stsodab dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: gu h+ya: brda thim: 3|: ces pa 'di'ang sprul pa'i sku mchog pad+ma nor bus thabs shes kyi rdzas dang: gser dngul g.yu byur rin po che'i bkod pa mang po bkra shis lha reg zhal gsung rdo rje'i sgra dang bcas nas yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dragater spyon nus ldan rdo rjes mdo khams tsā ri'i gnas mdun bkra shis skyid pa'i dga' tshal nas dag par phab pa phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dge zhi bkra shis par gyur cig: sarba maṅga le/ da yan+tu/

gtsa/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i chos sde'i: brda byang gser gyi bum chung zhes bya ba bzhugs so:badz+ra na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: 'tshishe6rdo(1ཿ gdod nas spros bral ka dag nam mkha' che: lhun grub sku dang ye shes chen po'i mdzod: rang byung rig pa de bzhin nyid kyi lhar: ngo mtshar lta ba dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra sa rgyan pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i: thugs kyi sgrub pa yang snying bcud phyung ba: srog las 'phang yang bstan dang 'gro ba'i phyir: snyigs ma'i 'tshubs slong rgud pa bcom pa'i thabs: grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad: da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thob: gter bdag bzang phyir tsā ri'i 'dabs su sbos: sum cu kha ral snyigs ma'i gzings lang tshe: nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang: 'phrad nas phan bde'i nyi ma gsal bar byed: the tshom mi dgos rdo rje rgyal po'i bka': zhes gsungs so: de nas khye'u chung lo tsa dang ye shes mtsho rgyal rma ban rin mchog be+e ro tsa na g.yu sgra snying po cog ro klu rgyal sogs kyis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal dngos

'byor yid sprul nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa zhig phul nas mgrin gcig gis gsol ba 'di ltar btab po:kye ho:dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i dpal:bka' drin 'gran bral thugs rje'i gter:o rgyan chen po dgongs su gsol:nyid kyi zab sgrub rat+na'i rdzongs:bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu 'di:rnyed pa'i rig 'dzin ji ltar lags:chos bdag rim pa gang ltar mnga':srid pa'i legs nyes 'byung 'jug gang:bstan pa'i 'gro don ci tsam 'byung:dus gsum gsal ba'i lung byang zhig:ma 'ongs don phyir gsung du gsol:zhes zhus tshe gu ru'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas 'di ltar gsungs so:e ma ho:bskal mang gong nas thugs bskyed rnam dag pa'i:las can rig 'dzin rgya mtsho gsan du gsol:bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid gso ba'i phyir:thugs bskyed rnam par dag pa ngo mtshar che:bdag ni ye sangs rgyas kyang thugs rje'i rtsal:gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la bab phyir 'phrul:ma chags dri med brdzus skyes sprul skur grags:skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i sgog thob po:dur khrod brgyad gshegs brtul zhugs spyod pa

btsan bskyangs: mi dang mi min bsam yas dpal rir bkod: rgya bal bod yul rin chen gter gyis bkang: sa gzhi zhabs bcag sgrub gnas byin gyis brlabs: mdo sngags chos spyodasgron me rab tu sbar: bka' bab bu dgu rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga: thams cad ma lus smin grol lam la bkod: 'jig rten bskal pa dbyings su ma stongs par: dngos sam sprul pas 'dul bar dam bca' thob: mkhan slob chos gsum 'dzom pa'i sku drin yin: blo dman spre'u tsha dag gis mi go yang: nam mkha' lta bu'i thugs la phyogs ris bral: bdag gi thugs kyi sgrub pa zab mo 'di: phyi nang gsang ba nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam yang: sgo 'dir bla sgrub rim pa bcu gsum la: rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sum cu rtsa dgu'o: skabs 'dir gu ru zhi ba'i bsdus don gyi: brda byang gser gyi bum chung 'chad bgyi'o: dad mos mi brjed gzungs kyis gsan du gsol:agam ho yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i khye'u chung ba: bskal pa grub nas 'jig rten ma stongs par: 'gro ba'i don mdzad thugs bskyed bsam mi khyab: zab pa'i gter gyis 'dul ba

nyi shu lnga: mchog gi sprul sku'i 'gro don brgya rtsa brgyad: ma nges du mas 'dul ba'i phye phrag brgya: gsang ba'i mtshan ni rdo rje grub pa rtsal:rje gas sangs rgyas pa mos pa mtha' yas grags: gsang chen 'di dang 'phrad pa'i dus skabs ni: snyigs ma sum cu kha ral lung gi dus: nad mug mtshon chas gzengs pa ldang ba'i tshe:gu ru khre dza lod kyi gdung 'dzin pa: yab ni tshangs pa lha yi me tog rtsal:yum ni brag btsan sha za ḍāk+ki yi: bde stong rtsal las bskrun pa'i nirma ga: dga' bzhi'i rol rtsed brtul zhugs thabs la mkhas dpa' bo rigs mchog nus ldan rdo rje zhes: zab gter rgya mtsho'i klong chen sgo 'byed pa: gter rgya mchog gi ston pa phun tshogs so: byin rlabs bcud rdzogs man ngag 'dus pa'i mdzod zab bcud gang zag 'jug sgo dang mthun pa'i: bskyed pa'i sgo nas pha rgyud don dang mthun: rdzogs pa'i cha nas ma rgyud rlung gtsor bton: gnyis med lam nas a tir snying por dril: rmad byung rdo rje snying po'i chos sde rnams: gtad rgya dam chos phun sum tshogs pa'o: rdzongs chen bco brgyad dag gis rab mdzes shing: chu mtsho klu mig bde

bsgo/: dga' rdzogs pa'i gnas:rtsi shing nags tshal rdza spungs bkod pa'i sprin:ba gam brag dang ri dwags rtse 'jo sgeg:snyan pa'i glu sgrogs bya rigs 'phur ldeng g.yo:lto phyogs bsod nams dpal 'phel rgyas pa'i mtsho:sbas rgya sgrub pa'i gter gnas phun tshogs so:rma rin sprul pa sku skyes pad+ma'i ming:byams dang snying rje gtong phod dam tshig dag:'dul khrims ldan zhing shes rab spyan yangs po:skyes bu de ni chos 'di'i bka' bab lags: g.yu sgra snying po'i zer 'phos pad+ma'i ming:gtad med byung rgyal tsab tsub 'ur zings che:nyams len la gdung shes rab 'od zer 'bar:byams dang snying rje brtul zhugs gnad dang ldan:skyes bu de yang chos 'di'i bka' bab lags:bi ro'i gsang gsum 'phrul ba pad+ma'i ming: blo gsal khams dwangs dad dang mos gus ldan:grub pa'i rtags thon sngags la gdung sems che:zab mo'i gter la spyod pa'i rnal 'byor mchog:skyes bu de yang chos 'di'i bka' bab lags:cog ro'i sku dang 'bru ban thugs kyi sprul:rnal 'byor brtul zhugs ldan pa pad+ma'i ming:lta ba'i gdengs thob 'ur

bslang zings mo ba: dad dang mos gus byams brtse'i 'od zer rgyas: 'di snang rgyab bor phyi ma dang du len: skyes bu de yang chos 'di'i bka' bab lags: gnyags ban dzña na'i sku gsang pad+ma'i ming: thos pas rgyud grol byams dang snying rje ldan: bskyed rdzogs gdams pa'i drod rtags thob pa dang: dad ldan gdul bya'i lo tog smin mdzad pa'i skyes bu de yang chos 'di'i bka' bab lags: sku mchog rig pa 'dzin mdzad rnam pa lnga: bsam bzhin 'gro ba'i dpal du bzhengs pa ste: 'gran bral gar gyi dpa' bo khyad par 'phags:brtul zhugs blo gsal rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin yin: gnub ban pukhye'i sprul pa pad+ma'i ming: blo rno spobs pa mtho la tsab tsub che: ye shes dbyings dngos btsun pa g.yu sgra'i ming:dad brtson mos gus nyams len nor gyis phyugs rong sngags nyi ma'i sprul pa kun bzang ming: spro thung blo gsal dad pa dam tshig dag: mtsho rgyal gsung gi zer 'phos rig pa'i ming: blo gsal dad dam ldan cing chos la mos: 'brog ban zer 'phos dharma gīrti'i ming: nyams 'ur blo gsal dad dam mos gus ldan: lha dpal sprul pa stobs kyi

btsa/ mtshan can ni:gsang sngags rigs can nyams rtogs rgyas pa'o:skyes bu de dag chos 'di'i bka' bab lags:ma nor nyams dang rmi lam rtags dang sbyar:rang skal gdams pa ma ral gtad par mdzod:rang gzhan don 'grub rtags mtshan khyad par 'phags:bden rdzun lag tu masangs dang nges shes gsal:gab rgya dam tshog ldan pa'i chos bdag go:mi dpon dbang che ku pa u yu rwa:chos brgyad ldan pa'i sku skyes su bhi lam:thos tshogs blo gsal dge bshes sa lam we smra mkhas sde dpon a shwa dhu dhu lam:ngan sbyor sna dgu sgong ba'i pukhye dang:se phung zhang blon a yu gdugs ma sba:sprel mgo khra mig stobs dang pha la'i ming:de sogs dam sri'i sprul pa bco brgyad la:phyogs tsam ma bstan chos kyi rno so nyams:gsang rgya snyedad min gang zag rim pa'o:zab pa'i brda sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig ni:gsang gsum klong gsal rigs lnga'i dam rtags 'dzin:mcho rgyal dngos sprul bṛ'i mtshan 'chang ba:tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i pho nya mo:shel dkar sprul pa dharma'i ming can ni:bde stong gar gyi rnam rol bsgyur la

mkhas: rgyal po'i sras mo rat+na'i ming can ni: bde legs yon tan bskyed pa'i phyag rgya mo: sku gsung thugs mchog bskang ba'i pho nyar bsngags: gdams pa gtad pa'i bde chen ḍak+ki gsum: rang skal chos kyis smin grol mchog la 'god: bse mo bcu gsum skabs skabs blo 'phrul 'gyed: drung du min no rang du gnas par bya: snying rgya sde mig dbye bsal rim pa'o: de ltar gter dang 'phrad pa'i las ldan la: zhal ta tshig gsum snying gi gtam du bsgo: dang po lha 'dres 'jam rtsub slong tshad ston: gang gis bslu bar ma byed rang sar gzhom rang ma smin par gzhan don mi 'byung bas: slob 'bangs bsten ma snga la rang nyams sbyor: smin grol bskyed rdzogs drod rtags theyopa gal: 'dul las grong chog 'dre brdung dga': bslu brid bdud po gar 'ong cha med yin: bu lon ma spel khe drag ma sgrub rem: zin pa med pa'i chos brgyad ro snyoms zhog: snying po bral ba'i chags sdang 'khor ba sbongs: zab gter spyod pa'i 'khor ba'i skal ba med: 'khor ba sgrub la dam chos skal ba med: zab gsang spel ma snga la bsdam ma drag: gtam tshig chal chol ma

gas/ mang don gtam smros:nor gyi mchog gyur 'phags pa'i nor bdun spyod:zas ni bde stong mchog la spyod na rab:za dang tshod ma sngo la brten na 'bring:'dod chung chog shes gyi na srog 'tsho bsten:'phyug med dbul bral brgyag spro ldan pa tha:nges med dben khrod ri sul 'grims pa rab:gong ma'i sgrub gnas brten la bsnyen sgrub 'bring:chos dang chos min bsre gnas byed pa preḥ'agal rkyen med pa'i gnas su sgrub pa gyis:'dre dang srin po'i rigs la blo ma gtad:bslu med ma hā gu ru spyi bor brten:'khrul snang rmi lam a 'thas mdud pa bor:gtam gyi lab rog dpa' bo mkha' 'gror brten:sngags pa mthu med grong bar khyi bzhin brdung:mthu rtsal che ba'i srung ma sgrub la 'bod:brtse brtse dung dung kha ta bdud kyis nyen:su dang blo sems ma bsre rang tshugs zungs:dad zas gshin zas mang spyod rang nyid 'chings:dkor dang mi dge'i sdig 'phro bcad la brtson:sangs rgyas dgongs pa rang byung ye shes de:dad brtson sgom pas mchod bstod 'bad la rem:bsags sbyangs spel ba'i lam la brtson pa ni:ya

rabs brgyud pa gong ma'i mdzad spyod yin: 'dod sred can la bka' rgya nan mi bkrol: log lta mkhan la gsang chen sgogs mi bya:thos nyung bze re can dag nye mi brten: sgom rtul rgyud gyong ba dag phyogs su bsal: chags sdang mda' lnga'i bslu ba rang sar gzhom: gdul byas bskul tshe thugs rjes de ru skyongs: slob mas bskul tshe rang skal gdams pa sbyin:srung mas bskul tshe gnas der bsnyen sgrub skyongs: mkha' 'gros bskul tshe brda yi lung la stel: dug lngas bskul tshe ye shes snying pos gzer: 'du 'dzis bskul tshe bya btang ri khrod gtug: nam zlas bskul tshe mi rtag sgyu ma sgom: mtha' mis bskul tshe gnyen pos 'bur 'joms mdzod:sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgron me sbar la 'bod: bla ma lhar bcas 'di phyi'i rgyan du 'chong: yar mar dus drug tshogs bskang rgyun ma bcad: gtad med ku yangs blo bde'i gshis lugs skyongs: 'gro phan stong nyid snying rje'i zer la drongs:pha gcig bdag gi phyag bzhes mdzad brkyangs na: nga dang lta spyod mthun no snying gi bu:chos brgyad 'du 'dzi'i 'phrang la rab gol na: nga dang mi mthun 'khor ba'i rjes su snyogs:

gtsan de ltar ma yin gter bdag 'ong gyur na:nyin mo byung ris thugs (chen po bsgom:mtshan mo.u rgyan nga sgoms gsol ba thob:gser dang ra gan ma brje snying ge bu:dbye bsal mi shes gter ston ga la mchisaḥzog po'i 'gro mgon srid na lung dang 'gal:phongs 'tshengs nus pa rin chen snying po'i gter:dper na dug sbrul mgo yi nor bu 'dra:bdud rtsi lta bu'i zab gsang bcud rnyed pa:gangs seng dkar mo'i 'o rgyun reg dang mtshungs:rang gi gdul bya 'dren par ma nus na:sku skyes bstan don byon pa dgos med legs:tshe phug mthar phyin don gnyis lhun gyis grub:gsang 'dus tshe yi nyams len gnad smin rem:tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag 'gro don 'bad med 'grub:dpa' bo mkha' 'gros lus dang grib bzhin bsrung:lung byang ral mi 'jug pa mdo rtsa yin:ma 'ongs nga sprul rol ba'i rdo rje yis:sha tsha snying gtam thams cad sems la zhog:i:lho zhol smad nas dug mtsho 'byur rkyen gyis:gser bya ser po'i mjug sgro bcu gsum la:mi bde 'ur 'ur zing zing ya ma srongasaḥdamar po byi ba'i khug sna gzings pa'i tshe:

mjug ma cha shas re 'byams sbubs su nub: smad nas dug mtsho sngon mo 'byur ba'i tshe: mgo log kha gsum lan tshwa de ru zhi: 'thor ba'i me stag cha shas stod du 'gro: ke yi thod dar ke yis 'phrog pa'i tshe: hur ba sa pa'i snang ba'i go skabs mchis: gsang chen bstan pa gnubs kyi dgon pa ༄sa ma hā gu ru dpal chen ku ma ra'i: lo sgrub bsgom na rkyen gyis rā dza 'joms: mi mthun dug gi ngad pa mkha' la yal: gsang sngags snying po'i 'od stong 'bar la nye: sa stag rgyal po'i 'dzam gling zhon pa'i tshe: sbas yul phyogs 'dir sgrub zab bcu gsum 'dzug: rgyang grags de ru ma yinaphyogaḥrgya gser bya ser po'i sgro chen bco brgyad la: dus su bdud kyi bar chad ldang srid pas: sgro chen mchog gi ming la ngad zer phog: smad kyi dug zer lha ldan phyogs la 'gro: stod nas thig le lto rgyud zhol du 'bebs: sngon po g.yu thig byang nas 'phrul zer skad: 'dzam bha la dang smad rong sngon po dza grong mkhar bcu gsum dgon gnas bcu gsum 'gul: bzlog thabs rgyas pa mkha' 'dza'i brda lung bzhin: rdo rje 'bar ba'i lha grangs rdzogs pa'i rten: bdud 'dul

ba tshu thugs rten dam sri'i mgo la bzhengs:che chung tshad ni gzhi 'dom bdun pa bya:rab tu gnas pa bdun phrag ma brtson na:bdud 'dul bdud kyis bzung na bdud du 'gyur:badz+ra gu ru'i dar mdung lus tshad stong:phyogs mdog phyogs kyi ri bo rnams la 'dzug pad+ma bka' yi thang yig rdo la bri:snyigs dus skyobs pa'i lha lnga'i bsnyen sgrub dang:gsol 'debs bsgom bzlas g.yel med brtson par bya:'byung po brngan phyir gsur dang lan chags bsngo:yul lha rnams la bsang dang rlung rta bsags:ka 'dzug rgya chen ri khrus mnol bsang dang:snang srid zhi ba dag gis brngan par bya:rje bo rnams kyis khrims bsrung las ka gtsang:'khor sde kun gyis ya rabs sngar srol skyongs:cha lugs mi bsgyur rkun gye jag khrims sdom:bsam spyod dkar zhing rnam dag dge bar 'bad:gnad des gser bya'i lang tsho bzhad re skad:dpa' bo 'byen pa'i dpa' las de dag sgrubs:rgud pa gso nus zhe blo bde ba'i las:pha gcig nga yi phrin las 'grub pa yin:ma brjed thugs kyi dkyil du 'chongs shig bu:srid pa'i legs nyes brda byang

gsal ba'i don: rgyas par bshad na bsam gyis mi khyab kyang: lung byang 'bring po rgyas pa dag la gzigs: don bsdus snying po 'dis kyang srid gsum gsal: rin chen brda la thob cig sa ra bye: mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs pra thob: ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus: nga sprul grub pa'i dbang phyug nirma kwa: bla rgyan rig 'jin nus ldan rdo rje yis: mdo khams rgyas pa'i mtsho las legs bton nas: gtan la dbab pa'i dus tshig shing pho khyi: sgrub pa'i sgo 'dzug sa pho stag gi lo: chos bka' gtad pa'i gzhi ma skyes bu bzhi: rtags dang rten 'brel ral bar ma gyur na: phyi ru rgyal khams yongs la phan bde spel: nang du rnal 'byor nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas: bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel bar byed: gdul bya 'bum phrag rnga yab dpal rir 'god: bde skyid nyi ma gsar du 'khrungs par 'gyur: bka' gsang thub par srungs shigangs nus ma gdams bcud zags su ma 'jug bstan bsrung tshogs: las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par re ga: zhes gsungs so: 'khor rnams rjes su yi rang nas bka' drin gtang rag gi tshul du maṇ+ḍal

ba:tshu dang tshogs ston rgya chen po mdzad do: bka' gsang lhag chad med par brda la bkod pa'o: sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgya: brda byang gser yi bum chung rdzogs so:gter rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gu rgya: 6du rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda thim: 3): ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma nor bu'i yang yang rdo rje'i gsung gis bskul ba dang: thabs shes rdor dril dbang lnga'i cod paṇa bkra shis lha reg sogs kyis skyes chen po phul ba dang chos bdag pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshos yang yang bskul ba'i ngor: gser shod rnga la stag rtse'i mdun zur rje btsun 'phags ma'i gnas kyi mdun ngos pad+ma bde ba'i dga' tshal thang gi spang ljongs nas skyid pa'i nyams dang spro ba'i shugs kyis bskul te bdag 'dra dpa' tho nus ldanardo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel: sarba maṅga le/

bsgotshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rig 'dus ma hā gu ru yi: bka' srung sha za ngas nus ma'i bskul ba dug khrag khol ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so:bas/: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: /the byuXtshaX rab 'byams rgyal ba'i phrin las gcig bsdus dpal: 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig o rgyan thod phreng rtsal: mthon mthing ral ba'i gtsug gi rgyan du mchod:'du 'bral med par thugs rje'i byin gyis rlobs: ma 'ongs las can skal bzang skyes bu yis srung ma bsgrub cing rtags mtshan mthong ba'i tshe: bar chad dgra la bskul las byed dgos na: dmar gtor bshams phral 'gugs gzhug grangs ldan bskyal: sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab byas te: dngos po dgra bgegs sha khrag rol pa las: ngo bo ye shes bdud rtsi'i rnam par dmigs tshil chen gsur dud bshug glu rkang gling sgrog: snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di ltar bskul bar byaḥ hūṃ bh+yo dza: sngon tshe dpal chen po dang pad+ma 'byung: grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnams kyis byin rlabs pa'i: dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal klong nas: sha za ngas nus lha mo drag tu bskul: shar phyogs ro ha tshal gyi dur khrod nas: sha za ka li nag mo drag tu bskul: lho phyogs 'ur 'ur 'tshubs ma'i dur khrod nas: sha za ya kau dmar mo drag tu

bskul: nub phyogs si ta ḍa li'i dur khrod nas: sha za gtub byed sngon mo drag tu bskul: byang phyogs rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i dur khrod nas: sha za khrag 'dzag smug nag drag tu bskul: shar lho ling ga brtsegs pa'i dur khrod nas: sha za rkang ldag ljang nag drag tu bskul: lho nub g.yo byed 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: sha za ging rus ma mo drag tu bskul:nub byang dmar nag rak+ta'i dur khrod nas: sha za pra mo ta tir drag tu bskul: byang shar 'tshubs ma 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod nas: sha za dug 'gyed nag mo drag tu bskul:'jigs byed mun pa can gyi dur khrod nas: las byed pho nya ma tshogs drag tu bskul: brag dang chu mtsho gtams pa'i dur khrod nas: bka' nyan sha za ma tshogs drag tu bskul:brngan pa'i gser skyems rgyugs chang myur du bzhes: gtor ma dgra bo'i phung khams mnyam du bzhes: khyed rnams mthu dang nus rtsal ldan gyur na: rgyal bstan rin chen bdud dang dam sris bshig: chos mdzad skyes bu sabha 'byung pos mnar: rnal 'byor bdag gi tshe bsod dgra bos bcom: khrel med rkun po'i rigs rnams lang la shor: skye 'dza'i

btsan bde skyid nub ri'i phyogs la gtor: nyes med khrims gtug dge btsun dgra ru gsod: sngags 'chang sgrub po'i zas nor hab thob byed: mtha' mi dbus su 'tshubs pa'i la nye tshang: ma chen khyod ni med dam ra mdar rgyug: dam nyams rnams la bka' yi chad pa chod: pho rgyud rtsad chod mo rgyud mngal nas skoms: chung gsum me tog ser bas bcom ltar rlog: dgra la bab na ltas ngan sna dgu 'gyed: bgegs la bab na dug gi kha phru thob: sri la bab na sgog snying tshal bar gtub: zhing bcu tshang ba'i tsit+ta dpa' zas kyis: btso sregs mi khoms rlon pa grum grum rol: 'o dod brang brdung cho nge 'debs su chugs: mig 'byin lus gcus snying khrag gnam la gtor: kags ltog 'bras gzer khur thum rgyug 'gyel thongs: rtags mtshan rmad byung khyad chos ston par mdzod: gnam sa yo log byed pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: dgra sde drung 'byin las gshin zhal du stobs: ma g.yel ma g.yel sha za ngas nus ma: ma g.yel ma bul sha za sgog len brgyad: ma g.yel ma 'gyang sha za nyi khri 'bum: ma g.yel ma zhan myur mgyogs pho nya'i

tshogs: dgra la mthu rtsal ston pa'i dus la bab: bgegs la rngams zas byed pa'i dus la bab: dam nyams gnas ngan stongs pa'i dus la bab: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: 31 ma ma ra li pra ma ṇa dza dza: trag rak+ka rasmo bh+yo: 'ur ba 'ur ba cho cho rgyug rgyug: bring bring: shag shag: tshal tshal: thogs thogs: yer yer: chum chum: dgra bgegs gnod byed kyi tshe dresag chod la re ga: brgya rtsa brjod la gser skyems mchod: dmod pa bor dar nag g.yab: gtor ma rdeb ral ba bsigs: khrag zor gtor: de yi tshe 'ur sgra thug sgra chen po byung na dgra bo brlag pa'i rtags yin no: gnad des dgra dpung pha lam yin kyang 'jigs bar chad bdud kyi tshogs rnams ming med brlag mthu yi grags pas sa steng yongs la khyab: bka' 'di snying las btsa' shes byed pa gal: sa ma yā: e ma: rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha ngas ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag zab bcud rnams grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad: da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thob mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs pra mdzod ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus: nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas gdams bcud chos bdag bu la 'doms:

—4rdo dam sri mang po'i sde dpung thal bar brlag:sangs rgyas bstan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur bsgrengs gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min zhang la 'god:bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal bka' gsang thub par srungs shig ngas nus ma skal med lag tu ma re ra a tham rgya:las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par re ga sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya srung ma'i bskul ba dug khrag khol ma rdzogs so:gter rgya gtad rgya:sbas rgya:zab rgya:gsang rgya:brda thim:o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o:gu h+ya:snyi ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma nor bus thabs shes rdor dril dbang lnga'i cod paṇa bkra shis lha reg zhal gsungs rdo rje'i sgras yang yang bskul ba dang:chos kyi bdag po dharma ku mud kyis bzhed ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga le/

ba:tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i sgrub skor bsdus pa'i them byang gsal ba'i lde mig zhes bya ba bzhugs so:ba:: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: snyo5 61zum1zlotwo gdod nas ye sangs rgyas mod kyang: thugs rje brtse ba'i rlabs phreng gis: 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bzlog phyir sprul pad+ma kā ra la phyag 'tshal: bdag 'dra pad+ma saṃ bha was: ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis: snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag mchog: zab gsang rdor snying chos sde bstan:sa ma yā: de yang rtsa gsum chos sde ni: rim pa bcu gsum kha bskang bcas: re re la yang rgyas 'bring bsdus: phyi dang bye brag du ma bkod: 'dir nigu ru rin po che'i zhi ba'i sgrub pa chung ngu'i sde: bka' rtsis phyag rgyas btab par bya: khye'u chung lo tsā'i dad mos bskyed: brda la thob cig sa ra bye: de yang man ngag snying 'dra ba'i: brda byang gser gyi bum chung dang: sngon 'gro rnam mkhyen lam bzang grags: gsol 'debs bde stong bum bzang dang: cha lag rim pa nyi shu gcig zab sgrub dngos grub gter gyi bum: bskang ba

pad+ma rgyas pa'i chun 'phyangs dang:gnam phud gter bsrung bskang thabs bcas:srung ma'i zab sgrub phrin las lhun grub dang:gsol mchod dgra bgegs rdul brlag thabs:'khrugs bskang drag bskul zab mo'o:bum pa sgrub pa'i cho ga dang:don dbang rat+na'i do shal can:lo rgyus shel gyi me tog dang:don bstod thugs dam gnad bskul dang:las bzhi'i bsregs blugs zab mo'o:bshags pa dag gsal me 61nga dang:rdzas bskang byin rlabs gnad bsdu ba:tshogs bsdus bsod nams 'byung gnas dang:smon lam bdud rtsi'i thig pa dang:gsol 'debs byin rlabs char 'debs so:gsang ba gnad kyi bcud tig dang:las tshogs nyer lnga mkho rgu'i gter:thugs dam dgongs pa'i gnad bsgul bcas:ma 'ongs las ldan don phyir du:snying phyung lag mthil bkram la bkod:da lta spel ba'i dus ma yin:ma 'ongs lnga brgya'i dmus long rnams skyobs phyir rin chen brda la thob:mdo khams gnas su dgongs pra mdzod:shan dmar yak+ka nag mo la:gdams zab bsrung ba'i gnyer kha bcol:rin chen sgog dang mtshungs par

gas/ srungs: skal med lag tu ma shor cig: khye'u chung nus ldan rdo rje dang: 'phrad nas skyes mchog rnam brgyad la: 'doms cing bstan pa'i ba dan bsgrengs:'gro don lho dang byang nas 'byung: khyad 'phags sku skyes rnam gsum ni: bstan pa'i rtsa ba rin chen snying: mi nub rgyal mtshan bsgrengs byed dpal: las smon rten 'brel dbang gis 'dzom: bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal: yid gnyis mi dgos rdo rje'i bka': bslu ba med do sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya:them byang gsal ba'i lde'u mig rdzogs so: gu bya: brda zim: o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: 233) sni: ces pa 'di'ang lung zin chos kyi bdag po pad+ma nor bus thabs shes kyi rdzas cha shas dang bcas nas yang yang bskul ngor: bdag 'dradapa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam̐/
badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rig 'dzin bla ma'i sgrub skor: dbang gilo rgyus shel gyi me tog spro shugs 'byung ba'i gzhi ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

gas/ na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: byeṅgā/byeX)bye(1tho dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi phrin las gcig bsdus 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon: sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma thod phreng rtsal mi 'brani bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchod tshogs smon las 'dzom skal bzang dhīs bu rnams: yang gsang mchog gi lam la zhugs pa'i tshe: dang po smin byed dbang bskur thob pa gal: de yi cha lag lo rgyus zab mo bstan: sa ma yā:slob ma grwal 'khod khrus dang bgegs tshogs bsal: de nas bden don bshad par bya ba ni: 'o: tshogs smon las 'dzom gyi skyes bu: dad pa dam tshig dang ldan pa rnams ma yengs par gson cig:'di ltar nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du sems can la'ang mtha' yod pa ma yin pas: gnas dman ma ga lam du mgo rmongs su gyur pa'i sems can rnams zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi rgyal sa la 'god par bya'o: de'i ched du bskyed rdzogs zab mo bsgom pa'i cha lag: smin byed dbang gi dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhi tshang pa'i rnal 'byor la bslab par bya bsam pa'i dmigs 'dun rnam par dag par bya'o: de yang gnas phun sum tshogs pa rngams brjed rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang: dus chen

bsgo/ yar ngo'i tshes bcu mdzad pa phun tshogs bkra shis kyi nyi ma: ston pa o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa gu ru zhi ba 'gro 'dul bzhad pa rtsal dang: 'khor rje 'bangs lo paṇa rig 'dzin dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor: chos rmad byung rdo rje snying po'i sgrub sde bka' gter gyi bcud bsdus pa yang snying bla ma sgrub pa'i man ngag:smin byed dbang gi dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa la thog mar byung tshul gyi lo rgyus zur tsam du zhu na: ngo bo chos sku kun tu bzang por ye sangs rgyas kyang: rang bzhin ma 'gags chags med snang ba mtha' yas su shar ba: thugs rje 'jig rten gyi khams su sprul par mdzad pa la: gnyis med thub pa chen po'i sku gsang: 'gro 'dul 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 'phrin las: chags med ku ru kul+le'i gsung mchog: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin: ma chags snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs ga'i 'od zer dmar gsal trīḥyig gi mchan pa can chad de mdangs ldan 'o ma can gyi rgya mtshor phog: gdul bya dus la bab tshe 'dul byed kyi ston pa me tog pad+ma dmar po bram za'i rigs las sku bltams: dpa' bo

dang mkha' 'gro ma bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod bstod dang bkur sti byed pa de nyid rgyal po in+t+ra bo dhis spyan drangs: rgyal srid phul lo lnga'i bar du zab mo'i chos kyis bskyangs: mthar brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad: srid 'khor thabs kyis spangs nas rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs pa mdzad: dur khrod brgyad du gshegs nas brtul zhugs rmad byung gi mdzad pa bskyangs: lta log mu stegs kyi sde tshogs tshar bcad: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pal mkhas par mnga' brnyes: slar gdul bya gang yang ma mchis tshe dur khrod bde chen rol pa'i yang rtse: na bun g.yu sbrang gis bsil char 'bebs pa'i gnas mchog: nam mkha' 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i dal khang la bzhugs nas dgongs pa ting nge 'dzin la gtad: bde stong pad+ma'i bum zhu gsol zhing: sku la gsang gos mthing nag dang chos gos mthing sham sogs kyis mdzes par spras nas 'od kyi rang bzhin du shar ba'o: de'i tshe rgya mtsho'i gling gi ḍāk+ki pad+ma'i gdengs ka can dang: bsil rgyun 'bebs pa'i dbang mo: chags med bde ba'i dga' ster: yid 'ongs mdzes 'dzum lha mo bzhi byung ngo: o rgyan

btsañtsa yul gyi mkha' 'gro ma bde ba'i go cha:las kyi dbang mo che:gsang ba ye shes ma:gsang sngags 'dzin ma dang bzhi byung:gsang ba dur khrod kyi gnas nas:sur+ya sirnyi bde ba'i dngos grub:nyi 'od 'bar ma:nyi zla'i phreng ba can dang bzhi byung ngo:gsang ba sgrub pa'i gnas nas:mkha' 'gro gser gyi rna rgyan can:mkha' 'gro g.yu yi zur phud can:mkha' 'gro dung gi gtsug rgyan can:mkha' 'gro pad+ma'i chun 'phyangs can dang bzhi byung nas:thams cad kyi lus kyis phyag 'tshal zhing mchod sprin mtha' yas pa stobs:ngag gis tshangs pa'i glu dbyangs la drangs nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig brjod pas bde stong ting nge 'dzin dga' bzhi'i ye shes kyis brgyud de 'di skad gsol to:e ma ho:gdod nas ye sangs rgyas mod kyang:lhun grub ye shes gsal ba'i sgu:mngal skyon ma gos brdzus skyes mchog pad+ma 'byung gnas dgongs su gsol:bdag cag skal pa ldan rnams la:smin grol gsang sngags zab pa'i don:thugs rje can gyis gsung du gsol:ye shes lcags kyus 'dzin par zhu:zhes zhus tshe gu ru rin po ches zhal

'dzum pa dang bcas nas 'di ltar gsungs so: e ma:las ldan ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs:brtse ba chen pos gsan du gsol:bdag ni ye sangs rgyas mod kyang:'gags med snying rje'i rnam rol las:'gro ba 'dul ba'i dus bab tshe:gdul bya'i chu snod dwangs pa'i ngor:'gro 'dul pad+ma bdag skur shar:dur khrod brgyad byin gdul bya rdzogs:smin grol mchog gi gru gzing btsug:ye shes gsang ba'i lam la 'god:deng skabs gzugs can 'dul dus min:bde stong mkha' 'gro 'dul dus bab:nyi ma sprin char 'dren pa'i gur:bde chen nam mkha' yangs pa'i ngang:thugs ni mi g.yo chos kyi sku:lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs mdzad dpal:ngang las ma g.yos ngo bo nyid:chos nyid zhi zhing chags pa bral:gu ru zhi ba zhes su grags:khyed rnams dad mos gus shugs bskyed:ga ṇa tsakra bsam yas sgrubs:de nas phun tshogs lnga ldan gyi:gsang chen ye shes snying po bshad:rtogs grol dus mnyam lam la 'god:ma g.yel ma bul mkha' 'dza'i tshogs:zhes gsungs nas phyag g.yas pas thod rnga 'grel ba'i sgras:dag pa dbyings

ga rte gsum na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'dza thams cad spyan drangs nas thibs kyis bzhugs: mkha' 'gro ma tshogs kyis steng lha'i bdud rtsi: bar mi yi longs spyod: 'og klu yi nor bu: srid pa gsum gyi zas nor longs spyod bsdus te ga ṇa tsakra'i rnam par spungs nas mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams kyi mgrin gcig gis 'di skad gsungs so: a ho: gnas mi mngon rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings: rje tso( rgyan gu ru zhi ba bzhugs: 'khor nga tsho dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dus rang gsal ye shes rjen pa'i skabs: chos gsang chen ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos: yul lha klu mi yi dga' ston gyis:don rtsa gsum spro bsdu'i bdag nyid can: skyabs gu ru rin po che la stobs: da zab gsang sang sgo 'byed du gsol: ces zhus tshe gu ru zhi ba'i dpral ba las 'od zer lnga bcu rtsa brgyad spros pa'i rtser khrag 'thung khro bo rol pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs pa dang:mgrin pa nas 'od zer bye ba 'gyed pa'i rtser gu ru rin po che bsam mi khyab pa bzhugs pa dang: snying ga nas 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis spros pa'i rtser zhi ba'i lha

tshogs bkod pa dang: lte ba'i 'od zer ser po bye ba sa ya 'byed pa'i rtser dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams btegs: gsang ba las 'od zer sna tshogs gi 'du 'phro 'byed pa las 'gro khams bsam yas rnam par 'dren cing ye shes chen po'i gzi 'od ḍak+ki rnams la phog nas bde stong gi nyams bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyas par gyur: de nas gu ru rin po ches tshogs kyi mchod pa rnams rol cing bde stong tshim pa drug ldan gyi nyams rab tu rgyas shing 'bar bar gyur nas: gsang ba ye shes snying po: gsang ba sgyu 'phrul drwa ba: gsang ba khrag 'thung rol pa gsang ba mnyam pa chen po rnams rgya mtsho'i gling gi ḍāk+ki bzhi la gdams tshe klu yi mkha' 'gro ma bye ba bco brgyad smin cing grol nas rig 'dzin gyi sar gshegs so: yang gsang ba bde klong rol ba: gsang ba pad+ma'i snying po: gsang ba nyi zla kha sbyor: gsang ba rnam par gnon mdzad rnams o rgyan gsang ba'i gling gi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la gnang tshe gsang ba'i ḍāk+ki bye ba nyi shu rtsa lnga mngon par grol ba thob po: yang gsang ba rngams bzlog chen po gsang ba rnam par brtsegs pa: gsang ba bde stong 'ub

ba:tshu chub:gsang ba kun bzang ro mnyam rnams dur khrod sbas pas ḍāk+ki ma bzhi la gdams tshe mkha' 'gro bye ba bcu gsum rig 'dzin gyi sa nod nas rnam par grol ba thob po:yang gsang nyag gcig klong grol:gsang ba rdo rje sra brtan:gsang ba mi g.yo ba'i rgyal po:gsang ba gnyug ma'i thig le rnams sgrub pa'i gnas kyi mkha' 'gro mched bzhi la gdams tshe ḍāk+ki bye ba lnga bcu rnga yab dpal gyi ri la rnam par grol lo:dinas bla rgyan chen po'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas nas 'di ltar gsungs so:yem:khyed chogs smon 'dzom pa'i ḍāk+ki rnams:thugs mkhyen brtse nus pas gsan 'tshal lo:lar dus gsum 'byon dka'i man ngag bcud:dpal rdo rje 'chang gi snying tig mchog:bcud byin rlabs ro nus ma ral ba:rkyen dam sel 'khris bslad ma zhugs pa'i:bcud gangs seng 'o ma'i rno nus can:dpal grub pa'i dbang mo rnams la gdams:tshegs chung kyang don chen 'grub pa'i thabs:da gzhan la ma spel a tham rgya:skabs las smon 'dzom pa'i skyes bu la:don gnyis med chen por bdag stsal nas:dus snyigs ma'i

sems can mang po kun: phan thog nas rnga yab dpal rir 'god:ngo mtshar ba'i gnas la spro chen bskyed:dus ma g.yel zab gsang so kha bsrung:las ma bul rnal 'byor phrin las sgrubs: dpal dam tshig gnyan la ma ral cig:ces gsungs so: de nas dpa' bo dang mkha' 'dza'i tshogs kyis skyid pa glu drug gi sgra la drangs nas mngon bstod dang dam bca' gsal 'debs kyi gsol tshig rnams gsungs so: slar yang ḍāk+ki ma tshogs rang gnas su byon: brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad: dag pa 'og min gyi pho brang chen por gshegs par mdzad do: gu ru rin po che nyid kyi thams cad mkhyen pa'i ting nge 'dzin la brten nas gdul bya gang la gnas pa der byen nas las can rgya mtsho rjes su bzung zhing rgya bal grub pa'i sar byin gyis brlab cing: las ldan pho mo smin grol du gzhug nas zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi rgyal sa la 'god par mdzad do: slar gangs can bod kyi yul gru 'dre ma sang gdug pa can gyis bzung ba'i sa cha:srin po mi zan gyi so bar: ma rung shin tu gdul bar dka' ba'i rigs rnams 'dul dus la bab tshe 'dzam gling mi yi rgyal po

badz+ra khri srong lde'u btsan sku bltams nas gdan 'dren bsu ba byung tshe sngon smon thugs bskyed dag phyir o rgyan rin po che byon nas: lam la gdug pa'i lha 'dre du ma btul: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung zhing gnyer byang gtad: slar rgyal po dang mkhan chen bho dhi sa twa o rgyan pad+ma saṃ bha wa rnams mjal 'phrad mdzad nas thugs dgongs gcig tu 'dres: bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gling bzhi gling phran nyi ma zla ba'i tshul du legs par grub: sku rten lha yi bkod pa snang brnyan ris kyis yongs su bkang:sprul pa'i lo paṇa brgya rtsa bsdus nas rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du brdzangs nas mdo sngags kyi chos sgo mtha' yas pa bsgyur nas yi ger bris te paṇa grub nyer lnga spyan drangs nas dag ther zhib tu bton: rab gnas dang me tog 'thor la gzhal med khang gtam mo: zab mo sgom sgrub kyi gzhi btsug nas bka' bab bu dgus ar+ya pa lo'i gnas su bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal gzigs: zab gsang gter gyi bsgrub pa dang lta gon mdzad nas dpal chen sgrub sde mos yi ger bkod: rje 'bangs so sor

gtad rgyas sbyin la smon lam btab nas sgrub gnas gtsug lag khang dang dur khrod chen po rnams su gter rgyas btab nas srung ma so sor gter kha bcol: khyad par skabs kyi gdams pa 'di yang rje thams cad mkhyen pa pad+ma saṃ bha nyid gu ru zhi ba'i tshul bzung nas bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus: yak+ka ltag log gi pho brang chen po nas grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung lo tsā la gtad pa dang: bka' bab chos kyi bdag po be+e ro tsa na: g.yu sgra snying po: dzñā na ku ma rma ban rin mchog:cog ro klu rgyal ye shes mtsho rgyal dharma saṅga: 'o bran dpal gyi dbang phyug rong sngags nyi ma gnub ban pukhye pha la: ye shes dbyings: lha dpal sogs la smon lam bka' dbang stsal nas gcas gab pa'i gnad rnams bsal bar byas te dgyes sde mos brda ris su bris: rin po che bse yi sgrom du gzhug la gter srung spu gri mched gsum dang sha za ngas nus ma la bcol nas mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs pra btab pa: de nas khye'u chung lo tsā'i gtso'i sprul pa'i rje 'bangs rnams kyis bka' drin gtang rag gi tshul

064 du tshogs dang maṇ+ḍal phul la mnyes pa bskang ngo: slar gu ru rin po che khra 'brug tu byon nas zab mo'i sgrub chen btsug cing: sprul pa'i lo paṇa thams cad smin grol du gzhug: gsang ba'i gnas mchog gsum nas zab mo'i gsang lam phyes: dad ldan jo mo rnam gsum la zhal gdams ngo sprod gnang: gzhan yang bod yul mun pa'i gling du dam chos kyi sgron me sbar: grub thob kyis lung pa bkang: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba bzhin dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do: slar srin yul du gshegs par dgongs nas bod yul mi re la zhal gdams re gnang nas gung thang la khar yo 'bogs pa btang nas: rgyal sras mu tig btsad po'i gtso'i rgyal rigs rnam pa lnga: rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi gtso'i sngags skyes lnga bcu rtsa drug dang be+e ro ska cog ku ma ra yi gtso'i lo tsā brgya rtsa brgyad dang: khye'u chung ye shes blo'i gtso'i 'gro 'dul smon lam mthu btsan nyi shu rtsa lnga mkhar chen ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi gtso'i bod skyong jo mo bcu gsum dang: yon bdag mkhar chen rgyal gyi gtso'i sbyin bdag pho mo bsam gyis mi khyab pas rol mo snyan pa'i sgra

dang bcas te skyel ma byas la gung thang la rtser phyin: gu ru rin po ches bod yul yongs la zhal gdams 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsungs nas rnga yab dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang du gshegs so: rje 'bangs yongs kyis dud mo 'byin cing rang gnas su log la dam pa chos kyi gzhi bzung: sems can gyi phan bde spel: rgyal bstan mchog gi gzhi ma nyid phyogs bcu kun tu dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do: de nas rje 'bangs so so'i sku dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs nas slar lto nub srin po'i yul du bzhud do:mthar o rgyan chen po'i spron lam gyi mthus: snyigs ma'i rgyu 'dzing rgud pa re shar tshe gso ba'i phyir du sprul pa'i gter ston gling pa rnam lnga: gter chen brgya rtsa gter phran stong rtsa sogs byon pa'i nang tshan: grub mchog khye'u chung lo tsā'i yang sprul: rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje'i sku phreng: dpa' bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis mdo khams tsa ri tra'i lto phyogs bsod nams rgyas pa'i mtsho las bton te mi lo bcu gsum la bka' rgyas btab te mthar rten 'brel dus la bab tshe mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda las legs par bton

btsa/ pa'o: 'di'i brgyud pa ni: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas: longs sku nam mkha' rgyal po: sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas: yang sprul gu ru mtshan brgyad: grub mchog 'brog mi lo tswa: mkhas mchog be+e ro tsa na: rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po: rma ban rin chen mchog: gnyag pa dzñā na ku ma: cog ro klu yi rgyal mtshan: gzungs ma mkhar chen mtsho rgyal:grub chen ye shes dbyings nas rim par drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar brgyud ldan rig 'dzin gyi zam pa ma chad byin rlabs mchog gi dngos grub kyi rno myur ma rdul: bar chad sabha dam sel gyis 'khris slad ma zhugs: gdams ngag zab mo'i rno nus kyi gzi 'od ma yal: dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs kyi gsang ba chen po: ma rgyud mkha' 'dza'i tshogs kyi gsang ba srog tig zab mo: tshegs chung ngus don chen po 'grub pa'i myur lam rdo rje snying po'i chos sde: rig 'dzin bla ma 'dus pa'i sgrub skor gyi dbang mchog rat+na'i do shal zab mo'i ma rgyus shel gyi me tog zhes bya ba'o: zhes pa'i brda sbyar slob ma'i mos gus bskyed: sgo gsum lhos med maṇ+ḍal tshul du 'bul: gnad de ldan pa'i dbang mchog zhu bar bya: byin rlabs mchog gi pha phog

thob par 'gyur: bskyed rdzogs sgrub la gegs med yid bzhin 'grub phyi nang rkyen sel 'dod 'byung nor bu 'dra: skal ldan rnams kyi brtson pas nyams len mdzod sa ma yāḥ e ma: rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma sa bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis: thugs kyi yang bcud rdo rje snying po'i chos: rmad byung tshe gcig rdzogs sangs rgyas ba'i lam skal ldan 'jug pa'i dga' tshal myur bde ba:grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thob: mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs pra mdzod: ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel las can chos bdag sku skyes rnam pa lnga dpa' bo mched brgyad chos 'di'i bka' bab ste: zab gsang mchog gi gdams pa gtad par bya gnad des bstan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur bsgrengs: bde legs phan bde'i nyi ma gsar du 'khrungs: nad mug mtshon chas gzengs pa bzlog par byed: gdul bya 'bum phrag 'go min zhing la 'god: shin tu zab pa rtsa gsum srung ma'i sgog: skal med lag tu ma re ra thub par srungs zab gsang thub par mdzod cigaras nus ma skal med lag tu ma re ra a tham rgya las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma yu: rgya rgya rgya dbang gi lo rgyus shel gyi me tog rdzogs so: gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya: gsang rgya gu rgya: ma rgyan slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas

—4khro bkod pa'o brda thim: snyi ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshos bskul ba dang rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags pa'i sku skyes ku mud ma ṇis thabs shes rdor dril dbang lnga'i cod pan bkra shis lha reg gser dngul rin po che sna tshogs kyi rdzas dang sgrub pa'i me tog dang bcas nas bzhed ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga lam̐/ dza yan+tu/

dmi zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rig 'dzin bla ma'i sgrub pa rdo rje'i tshog bdun dang 'brel ba'i shin tu bsdus pa nyid kyi rjes gnang bdud rtsi'i bcud tig zhes bya ba bzhugs so: bsnye na mo gu ru pad+ma kwa ra ye: sogatsamamarurīsdirdosgros dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras gcig pu 'gro ba'i mgon po pad+ma 'byung: gang sku 'od zer stong 'bar ba: spyi bo'i mchod cing gtsug gis btud: sa ma yā: rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru la: brten nas tshig bdun bzla 'dod na: med mi rung ba'i rjes gnang 'di: srog gi gta' ru 'dzin par 'tshal: de yang sgrub gtor rat+na'i rdzongs shin tu mdzes par bkram pa'i rtser: rig 'dzin bla ma'i snang brnyan bkod: rnam lnga nyer spyod mchod pas bskor bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas slar: rnal 'byor gzhung bzhin 'od zhu bar: grub phral mdun bskyed bsgom pa ni:ā bdag snang glu/ rgyan pad+ma yi: mdun mkhar dpal gyi gtor chen ni: lhun grub rang byung gzhal med dbus: pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i steng: trīX las gu ru rin po che: sku mdog dkar la dmar mdangs chags: he ru ka pa'i cha byad can: phyag g.yas cang te'u mkha' la 'ashesal: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar sdud: g.yon pa'i thod bum dku la brten: sgrub la

mchog thun dngos grub 'bebs: zhabs gnyis rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs: dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin bsgom: sku la rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs thugs gar dpal gyi be'u'i klong: thod phreng sde lnga rig 'dzin brgyad: 'gro 'dul drug dang mtshan brgyad grags: rje 'bangs lo paṇa nyer lnga sogs: til gong phyur bzhin lam mer gsal:gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros rnga yab dpal ri nas rig 'dzin rgyal ba sras dang bcas: spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstims: thugs sgog hrīḥl sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas 'khe ra 'das bde ba che: snang grags rigs gsum chos sku'i ngang: tshig bdun bzlas pa brgya rtsa ni dad mos gdung ba drag pos bskyar: de nas gu ru sidhi yi: bzlas pa brgya stong khri sogs bsgrangs de nas mchod cing bstod pa ni: 33 dmigs med chos sku'i mkha' klong nas: lhun grub rang gsal mchod pa'i sprin: ma hā gu ru'i sku la 'bul: gsang gsum dgyes bskang dbyid du gyur: ma ma hā pañtsa pu tsa ho: hūṃ hrī: mdangs ldan ko sha'i ku mud ze'u 'bru las: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig bsdus gar: rmad byung khye'u chung chog mi

btsaX shes par bltams: 'dren pa bla med 'gro ba'i mgon por 'dud: yig brgya bzla zhing nongs pa bshags: byin rlabs dngos grub bang mdzod dmigs: de nas slob ma gral 'khod nas khrus dang bgegs bsgrad srung 'khor bsgom: maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol gdab ni: kye: mnyam med 'dza ba'i skyabs mchog bla ma dgongs: bdag la rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru yi: byin rlabs dbang gi dngos grub ma lus pa: da lta nyid du gnang ba'i sku drin stsol: lan gsum de nas bla mas lan gnang ba: kyi ho: las spron dus 'dzam rigs mchog ma lus dgongs: khyed la gsang gsum dbang mchog sbyin dgos na: sdom pa dam tshig rim par bsrung nus sam: yongs su ldan na legs par sbyin bgyi'o: mi nus pa rnams phyir dengs skal ba med: de nas slob ma'i dam tshig 'dzin pa ni na mo: mchog gsum ngo bor bla mar bdag skyabs mchi: 'gro ba'i don du byang chub sems mchog bskyed: zhing rdul grangs mnyam lus sprul gus phyag 'tshal: snang srid dag mnyam kun bzang mchod pa 'bul: sdig pa mi dge'i las bsags mthol lo bshags: 'gro ba'i dge la snying nas yi rang ngo: gang 'dul chos 'khor

'gro la bskor bar bskul: rgyal rnams mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par bzhugs: dge tshogs gcig bsdus mar gyur 'gro la bsngo: 'khor gsum yang dag chen po'i don la bslab:rigs lnga'i sdom bzung byang chub sems bsgom nas: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig ma lus bsrung: srog phyir sdom las mi 'da' sa ma yā: lan gsum: de nas dam chu sbyin pa ni hūṃ: 'di ni dam tshig sgog gi chu: rdo rje gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor che: slob ma khyod kyis lce la bzhag: gnad las mi 'da' sa ma yā: ma badz+ra sa ma ya na ra gaṇa: de nas slob ma lha ru bskyed ye shes dbab bstims nan du bya: dngos gzhi dbang bskur bya ba ni snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do hūṃ hrī: 'gro ba'i don mdzad byas rgyan thod phreng rtsal rgya gar yul pyon thos bsam brtul zhugs mdzad:bod yul khams byon gdug pa ma lus 'dul: o rgyan yul du bstan pa'i sgron me sbar: rnga yab gling dbus srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: da lta pad+ma 'od du tshom bur 'tshogs: sku drin mnyam med gu ru rin po che: mdzad pa rmad byung brtul zhugs bsam mi khyab: thugs dam ma g.yel dgongs pa gnad nas bskul: dad ldan rjes su 'dzin pa'i dus la

bas/ bab: ྅: o rgyan yul gyinub byang mtshams: dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: dad ldan skyes bu ma lus pa'i: lus la sku yi dbang mchog bskur: rnam smin rig 'dzin 'grub par shog: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: ྅: tsho rgyan yul kyinub byang mtshams: sogs gshegs su gsol: dad ldan skyes bu ma lus pa'i: ngag la gsung gi dbang mchog bskur: tshe dbang rig 'dzin thob par shog: rtsa sngags mthar wak+kas bhoṣiñtsa āḥ shā o rgyan yul gyinub byang mtshams:sogs gshegs su gsol: dad ldan skyes bu ma lus pa'i: yid la thugs kyi dbang mchog bskur: phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin thob par shog: rtsa sngags mthar: rtsat+ta.a bhe ṣiñtsa hūṃ: ྅:o rgyan yul gyinub byang mtshams: sogs gshegs su gsol: dad lngan stes bu ma lus pa'i yon tan re bsgang dbang mchog bsgar: lcan grab rig 'dzin thob par shog: rtsa

sngagasamathar sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa sa:hūṃ:o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams:dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du:pad+ma ge sar sdong po la:ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pad+ma 'byung gnasazhes su grags:'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor:khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis:byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol:dad ldan skyes bu ma lus pa'i phrin las 'gro 'dul dbang mchog bskur:mchog gi rig 'dzin thob par shog:rtsa sngags mthar maṇ+ḍal a dzhai ṣiñtsa hrīḥsmon lam gdab cing shis pa brjod gnad des byin los dngos grub thob nyams rtogs yon tan mkha' ltar rgyas bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal:the tshom med do sa ma yā rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha ngas snying gi yang tig zab pa'i bcud:nusaldan rdo rje'i dpal du bzhag:skal med rnams la a tham rgya:sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po dharmā'i mtshan can dang grogs mo rat+na sa ra dad ldan chos gsal slob bu ye shes rnams kyis yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes 'bros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas brda lhag chad med par phab pa dge legs 'phel:sarba maṅga le/
0( zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i don dbang bsdus pa rat+na mdzes pa'i do shal can zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

gtsa(5 na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: rnasgogrusno sgro༅ dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las gcig bsdus dpal: 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mchog rdo rje 'chang ngo mtshar med byung pad+ma kwa ra ya: mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchod bdag 'dra rgyal dbang pad+ma saṃ sto wa'i: ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis shin tu zab pa thugs kyi sgrub par grags de yi cha lag smin byed zab mo bstan: sa ma yā: de yang mdzes pa'i da la gru bzhi pasnye dbus su gtor ma bum pa rnam gnyis dang: shes rab ḍāk+ki bhan+ta bdud rtsi bskyil 'ja' shel mdangs ldan me long tsa ka li: bkra shis rdzas rtags phyi nang nyer spyod dang: ga ṇa tsakra rgya chen sbungs bar bya: las gzhung bsrangs la bum pa rnam gnyis sgrub: gter srung brngan dang rig pa'i me tog dor bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga yongs grub rjes slob ma gral 'khod khrus dang bgegs tshogs bsgrad bsrung 'khor bsgom zhing bden pa'i don kyang bshad maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdabs pa ni kyai sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rdo rje slob dpon dgongs: bdag ni zab gsang rdo rje snying po yi: rmad byung gsang gsum dag la spro ba che: byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub zab pa'i bcud: da lta nyid du gnang ba'i sku drin stsol: lan gsum rjes su bla mas lan gnang ba kye ho: tshogs bye na las 'phro ldan pa'i skyes bu rnams: yang gsang theg

gas/ pa mchog gi sgor zhugs nas: sor byang sngags kyi sdom pa dam tshig rnams: yongs su bsrung na dbang dang dngos grub sbyin: mi nus pa rnams rang gnas phyir dengs chagag: ces pas dbye bsal bya zhing gsang sngags la: zhugs nas thabs mang dka' ba med pa'i phyir: don chen 'grub pa skyabs sems lan bdun dang: rigs lnga'i sdom bzung sor byang sngags dam 'dzin: de nas mna' chu sbyin pa'i rim pa ni: hūṃ trī: 'di ni dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi: gsang ba'i mna' chu dam tshig sgog gi bcud: rdo rje khro bo gnod sbyin rang mdangs can: deng 'dir slob ma khyod kyi lce la bzhag: dam tshig nyams na srog gi gshed du 'gyur: yongs su bsrung na dngos grub thob par byed: de bas dam la gnas mdzod rigs kyi bu: o badz+ra sa ma ya na ra gaṇa: ༷ bye ṭha ṭha: rak+ka du dza: lce la reg cing gnas gsum thig le bya: sku gsung thugs kyi dam srog thob par bsam: de nas me tog sbyin la 'di skad do: snyen badz+ra 861 shrī rat+na hūṃ: de nas mig dar bkab la 'di skad do: sgo/ tsakyu bhan+ta dṛ wan du khe swā hā: de nas slob ma lha ru bskyed pa ni: 31 ma hā shu h+ye ta dzñā na badz+ra sā bha wa ad+ma ko3 nya: gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad mi dmigs pa

—1nga pa nyid du sdomar: —1nga pa'i ngang las: lha bskyed gzhung ltar ye shes dbab par bya: spyan drangs lha rnams brtan par bzhugs su gsol me tog dor zhing mig dar dbye bar bya me tog nyid kyi dbang mchog bskur ba ni:hūṃ hrī: bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus 'dus pa'i mdzod: byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub mchog gi bcud: 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan rnam pa dza3 dbu ma'i lam zhugs mi shig thig le dang: ro gcig 'dres nas rgyal kun klong mdzod rdol: chags thogs bral ba'i mkhyen gnyis rtsal 'bar nas: rang rig don gyi sangs rgyas myur 'grub regag: pra ti ghi ha ṇa tiṣ+ṭha e me sarba sirnyi badz+ra 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod gsang ba bla na med pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i tshe gsang ba'i mtshan gang lags ma chags pad+ma mtha' bral lags so: 'o na khyed rnams ma 'ongs pa'i dus su mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe don gyi mtshan gang lags: sangs rgyas pad+ma'i snying po lags so: de nas dngos gzhi'i dbang mchog bskur ba la: maṇ+ḍal phul zhing gsol ba gdab pa ni kyi bka' drin mnyam med rdo rje slob dpon dgongs: gsang ba bla med rdo rje snying po yi: dngos gzhi'i dbang mchog smin grol gsang ba'i mdzod da lta

btsa(: nyid du bdag la stsal du gsol: lan gsum rjes su bum pa thogs byas la: hūṃ trī: kun zlum bum pa grwa zur mtshan ma bral: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'dus pa'i bcud kyis gtams: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: lus dang rtsa yi sgrib dag bum dbang thob: bskyed rim bsgom rung rnam smin rig 'dzin 'grub: snang stong gnyis med mjal ba ngo mtshar che: sprul pa'i sku mchog 'grub pa'i dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: de nas gu ru'i sku gzugs gtad la: hūṃ trī: ngo mtshar mdzad pa rmad du byung ba yi: gangs can bstan dang 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig pu: rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i dbang bskur ro: 'gro khams dong sprugs nus pa'i dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya.a bhi ṣiñtsa khro: de nas rig 'dzin brgyad kyi sku gtad la: hūṃhrī: tshogs brgyad rnam dag ye shes gsang ba'i dbyings: rmad byung thugs rjes 'gro khams bde la bkod: sgrub sde dgu yi gsang mdzod klong nas rdol: sprul pa'i rigs 'dzin brgyad kyi dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar: kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: de nas gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi sku gtad la: hūṃhrī: dur khrod brgyad

gshegs brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzad: thabs mkhas lcags kyus 'gro khams bde la bkod: rgya bal bod yul chos kyi sgron me sbar: gu ru mtshan mchog brgyad kyi dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ma: de nas 'gro khrul gu ru'i sku gtad la hūṃ hrī: khams gsum rigs drug 'khor ba'i sgo gcod cing: log 'khrul srid pa'i rgong nga bcom pa dang:tshad med thugs rjes nye ring phyogs ris bral: 'gro 'dul gu ru drug gi dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: de nas grub chen brgyad cu'i sku gtad la: hūṃ hrī: rmongs 'khrul 'khor ba dbyings su stong pa dang: gdul bya ma lus sbyor sgrol lam la 'god: bka' bab grub chen brgyad cu'i dbang bskur ro: brtul zhugs ye shes chen po'i dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: de nas rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i sku gtad la nyu trī: rmad byung thugs rje'i rlabs g.yos 'gro ba'i mgon: bstan pa'i sgron mes gangs ljongs gsal bar mdzad: mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul grub rtags mnga' brtes pa'i: rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ma: de nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sku galo la:

gtsa/ hūṃ trī: chos nyid mkha' la thug rje'i shugs kyis 'gro: dag pa'i ngang las bde stong dga' bzhi bskyed: skal ldan yongs kyi phyi nang nyer 'tshe gzhom: las mdzad dpa' bo mkha' 'dza'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar:kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: de nas ngas nus ma'i sku gtad la nyu hrī: zheng bcu tshang b.lidagra sde brlag pa dang: sgrub pa po yi phrin las thogs med rtsol: zab gsang rdor snying bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i: gter bdag sha za ḍāk+ki'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: de nas gsang dbang bskur ba ni:bhan+ta bdud rtsi gtad la: shā trī: mtshan ldan bhan+ta yangs pa'i sgod nang du: bde stong byang chub sems kyi bcud chen gtams: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngag dang rlung gi sgrib dag gsung dbang thob: gsang sngags bzlas rung tshe dbang rig 'dzin 'grub: gsal stong gnyis med mjal ba ngo mtshar che: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dpal la dbang 'aX1ra regag: rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi ༷don āḥ de nas sngags 'khor gtad la shā trī dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi: gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags

snying po'i sngags yongs rdzogs bcud dril dam pa'i dbang bskur ro: sgra grags sngags su 'grub pa'i dpal thob shog rtsa sngags mthar:wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas sngags phreng gto la hūṃ hrī: yi shes 'od zer 'bar ba'i lug rgyud du: 'brel ba'i dri med shel phreng brgya rtsa 'dis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ba'i: 'byung 'jug rdo rje'i gsung 'grub dbang thob shog rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āX de nas bzlas lung sbyin pa ni: hūṃ hrī: sa chu me rlung nam mkha' 'byung ba lnga: ye shes chen po lnga ༄ rnam par dag grags dang bzlas pa sgra tshig 'byung 'jug rlung 'gags med rdo rje'i gsungs su smin grol shog: rtsa sngags mthar oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal a āḥ maḥhaḥriḥniḥsaḥ.i.ā+oṃ raḥtsa hrīḥyaḥ.ulū:dzñā na sarba sa ma ya li lī: bho dhi tsit+ta e zhe: ma hā su kha o o: dzñā na dhartu e ā ka kha ga gha nga: shirnye ku ru hūṃ: tsa tsha dza dzñā nya: puṣ+ṭi ku ru sa: ṭa 'i ḍa dha ṇa: wa shaṃ ku ru sum̐ ta tha da dha na ma ra ya phaṭa: pa pha ba bha ma: las bzhi lhun gyis grub par gyur cig: ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ta: rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar gyur cig: ma hā su kha

gas/ sarba sidhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ de nas sher dbang bskur ba ni:rdo rje'i rig ma gtad la: hūṃ trī: bde ba'i rang bzhin bcu drug mdangs gis 'khyud: mdzes 'dzum blta bas chog mi shes pa'i gar: zhal nas ut+pa la yi dri bzang 'thul: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'du shes gsum gyi sbyor ba'i 'phrul rtsed kyis: yid dang thig le'i sgrib dag sher dbang thob: tsaṇ+ḍa'i snod rung phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin 'grub: bde stong gnyis med mjal ba ngo mtshar che: chos kyi sku yi dpal la dbang 'byor shog: rtsa sngags mthar: tsit+ta pra dzñā dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa ྅: de nas ḍā ma ru dang bhan+ta gtad la: hūṃ hrī: ma rig dbyings dkrog dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sdud: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi bcud la rol pa'i rtags: phyag mtshan yongs 'dus chen po'i dbang bskur ro: rab 'byams las kyis 'gro 'dul dpal thob regag: rtsa sngags mthar: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: de nas phyag mtshan rigs lnga gtad la hūṃ hrī: 'pho 'gyur med pa rdo rje lta bu'i rdzas: rigs lnga'i dam rtags phyag rgya rnam pa lnga'i: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ye shes lnga yis 'gro 'dul dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags
