mthar: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa ྅: de nas dung dkar gtad la: / hrī: snyan grags chos kyi dung chen skad po che: bkra shis dpal gyi rdzas mchog dam pa 'dis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'dzam gling chos kyis 'tsho ba'i dpal thob re ga: rtsa sngags mthar cit+ta a snyi ṣiñtsa :: de nas 'bras snye gtad la:/ hrī: dad ldan gdul bya'i lo tog smin pa dang: bde legs dpal 'phel 'bras kyi snye ma yis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gdul bya smin cing grol ba'i dpal thob re ga: rtsa sngags mthar cit+ta a dzhai shings :: de nas tshig dbang bskur ba ni: 'ja' shel gtad la: hūṃ hrī: ka dag dri bral dwangs ba'i 'ja' shel ni: ngo bo stong la rang bzhin rnam par gsal: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro ba 'dis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: don dam 'gyur med dpe la rab brten nas: sgo gsum sgrib dag tshig gi dbang mchog thob: khregs chod snod rung lhun grub rig 'dzin 'grub: rig stong gnyis med mjal ba ngo mtshar che: ngo bo nyid sku'i dpal la dbang 'byor shog: rtsa sngags mthar sarba a dzhai ṣiñtsa hrīḥ de nas a dkar gtad la: hūṃ hrī: a ni skye

bsgo/ ba med pa chos kyi dbyings: rang gdang ma 'gags ye shes 'char sgo can: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: don dam 'gyur med rtogs pa'i dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ de nas rdo rje mthing nag gtad la: hūṃ trī: 'gyur med rang byung rdo rje mthing gsal mdzes: mi shig sra brtan 'pho 'gyur kun bral 'di: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rdo rje lta bu'i dgongs don rtog par shog: rtsa sngags mthar sarba a snyiX〉〉 hrīḥ de nas rtsal dbang bskur ba la: me long dngas gsal gto la: hūṃ trī: dwangs gsal kun nas zlum la rnam par 'khyil: rang gsal ma 'gags snang ba'i 'char sgo ldan: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la gtad pa yis: rang mdangs 'od gsal brda' la rab brten nas: snang gsum sgrib bcom rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob: thod rgal snod rung mchog gi rig 'dzin 'grub: rig pa gcer byung mjal ba ngo mtshar che: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dpal la dbang 'byor shog: rtsa sngags mthar: sarba garma a bhi ṣiñtsa trīḥ de nas 'od lnga'i thig le gtad la: hūṃhrī: skulnga yi shesalnga dang rab ldan cing: skad cig nyid la gnyug

ma'i 'char sgo 'byed: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rang gsal rjen pa rtogs pa'i dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: sarba garma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: de nas thig le stong sgron gtad la: hūṃ hrī: dbyings nyid rnam dag chos sku'i rang bzhin las: ye gdangs bcud 'dus thig le stong sgron gyis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rtog grol dus mnyam 'grub pa'i dpal thob re ga rtsa sngags mthar: sarba garma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ de nas kun tu bzang po'i sku gtad la: hūṃ hrī: 'khor ba ma spang ye rdzogs chos sku'i ngang: 'das pa ma bsgrub rig pa sku gsum 1nga: dbyer med ro mnyam rig pa de bzhin nyid: 'pho 'gyur med pa da lta'i gnyug ma 'di: dus gsum kun tu rang grol bde ba che: phrin las bzang pos dug lnga rming nas bshig dmigs med rang grol gtad med kun bzang gis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bde stong rtsal gyis 'gro khams dong sprugs shog: rtsa sngags mthar: sarba garma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: de nas po ti gtad la: hūṃ hrī: mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden pa dang: bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i nus stobs kyis: rmad byung zab

badz+ra gsang rdo rje snying po yi: chos bcud bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa rnams: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs mchog khyod la gtad: bstan pa 'dzin skyongs spel gsum bsrung ba dang: bshad dang sgrub pa'i bya ba mthar phyin nas: don gnyis lhun grub gdul bya 'bum phrag bcas: dpal ri pad+ma 'od du phyin par re ga: rtsa sngags mthar ye dharma dhartu dzñā na tsit+ta sarba a bhi /don oṃ a hūṃ hrī: de nas mtha' rten gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba ni: hūṃ trī: brdal khyab ka dag yangs pa'i gzhong pa dzas lhun grub dpal gyi gtor chen rnam par 'dzes: nyi zla 'od zer 'bar ba'i rgyan rdzogs pa: bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi 'phro 'du can: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la gtad pa yis: theg mchog 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid la: dbang thob don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa dang: sku dang ye shes mdzad pa mthar phyin re/ga: rtsa sngags mthar: maṇ+ḍal bā ling ta a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ ā ༷hūṃ swā hā: de nas mtha' rten rdzas rtags gtad: dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor bkra shis bsngo smon rgya chen bya: gnad des zab mo'i dbang mchog thob: bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i lam la 'byor phyi nang bar chad sel ba dang: nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan

'bar bar chad bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal bsam pa ma lus lhun gyis grub byin rlabs rno nus khyad par 'phags bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal sa ma mā:e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was:ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis yang zab thugs kyi gdams pa sgog lta bu snying las phang yang khye'u chung lo tsā dang:mkhar chen mtsho rgyal rma ban rin mchog dang chos bdag rnam lnga bcas la gtad rgyas sbyin:da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thob mdo khams rtse 37da gsham du dgongs rgya mdzod ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang:'phrad nas las can chos bdag rnams la spel:bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen rnam par 'byung:gtan la dbab pa'i dus tshig bskal ba khyi skal ldan bcu las khroms la spel mi rung bkrol rgya che na ma dang mkha' 'gro yis:bka' chad drag po nam mkha'i thog ltar 'bebs:gtad rgya'i sbyin yul chos kyi bdag po las snod min 'u tshug can la kha tham rgya las can snying gi bu yi dpal du shog gdams bcud thub par srungs shig ngas nus ma skal med lag tu ma (snar sa ma yā:rgya rgya rgya:don dbang bsdus pa rat+na'i do shal zhes bya ba rdzogs so:gter rgya gtad rgya:sbas rgya:zab rgya:gsang rgya gu rgya:o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa 'o:brda thim snyi ces pa 'di yang chos kyi bdag po sprul pa'i sku mchog pad+ma nor bus thabs shes kyi rdzas 'ga' re

btsa( bcas nas yang yang bskul ba dang /chos bdag pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtsho'i bzhed ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge'o/dge'o/dge'o/legs so/sarba maṅga lam̐/

badz+ra tsu snyan rgyud snying gidum bu:rig 'dzin rtsa sgrubasnyi tsuse/sgo/ āḥdagongs pa zang thal chos sku de bzhin nyid:lhan skyes ye shes mtha' bral snying rje'i mdangs:zung 'jug rig pa 'pho medahrīḥru spros:khyab brdal mkha' la lhun grub snang ba'i gzugs:dag chen yum lnga'i mkha' 1nga yangs pa nasarab gsal gzhal med brda rtags bkod pa rdzogs:dngas gsal dri med dha na ko sha'i mtsho:gting zab yan lag brgyad ldan rab rgyas dbus pad+ma'i sdong po lo 'dab rab gyes khar:bsil zer ri bong 'dzin pa nya gang bar:rgyal kun phrin las dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung:sku mdog dkar dmar 'bar ba'i gzi 'od 'khyug:phyag g.yas rig stong gser gyi rdo rje bsdegs:g.yon pas snang stong thod bum sku la bsten:theg dgu yongs rdzogs rtags kyi cha lugs su:gsang gos 'dung ma phod chen za ber klubs:mazing sham chos gos dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phur:a ti sde gsum ma 'dres ston pa'i brdar:sha ba'i gnyen zhu dar sna sgo yis brgyan:gdul bya'i yul la thugs rje g.yo ba'i rtags:nyi zla nor bu 'phan phran 'ja'

'khyug mdzes: 'od 'bar 'ja' lnga'i thig le bkrag 'bar dbus: zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol ba'i stabs kyis 'gying: gsang yum sbas tshul kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan du brten: khams gsum dbang sdud srid gsum zil gyis gnon: che ba'i stobs rdzogs gar gyi dbang phyug gi: mdun gyi pad steng 'gre /'dul dbang po sde: dkar gsal he ru ka pa'i chas rgyan spras: bde stong zung 'jug spri thod bsnol thabs 'dzin: bcu drug lang tsho'i dpal 'khyud 'dzum mdzes bzhad: phyed skyil stabs bzhugs dngos grub gzi 'od 'khrigs: snang stong zung 'jug 'od kyi sku ru gsal: lho yi pad steng so khya de wa smug: gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan spras pad phreng mdzes: phyag g.yas dngul dkar rdo rje thugs shar 'dzin: g.yon pas bde stong phyag rgyas bhan+ta 'chang: zhal 'dzum spyan dwangs dgyes brtse'i 'od zer 'bar: dbu skra thor cog zar bu sku rgyab 'phyangs: byin rlabs dngos grub gdul bya'i dpal du 'gyed: nub kyi pad steng ṭosnyi he ru ga: dmar gsal zhi ma khro 'dzum rnam 'gyur can: dbang gi lcags kyu spri gug dku la brten: rol ba'i stabs kyis stag mo'i khri la rol:

gas/ 'ja' zer sprin gyi dra gur 'khrigs dbus bzhugs:shes rab sbas tshul wa ṭ+wāṃ mchan du brten:dag chen ye shes sgyu ma'i sku ru gsal:byang gi pad stengasna nam ye shes dkar:zhal 'dzum spyan dngas dgyes brtse'i 'od zer 'bar:dar dpyangs e rag rat+na'i phreng ba dang:pad+ma'i do shal dung gi snyan cha mjes:phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon pas gter bum 'dzin:phyed skyil rol pa chen po'i thabs su bzhugs:stong gsal 'dzin med 'od kyi sku ru bskyed:de yi phyi rim pad 'dab nyi shu dgu:kha dog ma nges 'ja' sprin bkod legs pa'i:shar du gnubs bananam mkha'i snyeng po dkar:tshe mda' bum 'dzin longs sku'i rgyan cha spras:'ja' 'od lnga 1nga rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs:rim bzhin yon tan mchog thob g.yu sgra snying dkar dmar mdangs ldan 'khor lo glegs bam 'dzin:parnyi ta yi chas rdzogs phyed skyil bzhugs:mkhas grub dbang phyugaska ba dpal brtsegs dkar:'a byem pa'i nyams rgyas spyan zung mkha' la gzigs:gsang bam chos gos sham thabs rgyan du 'chang:mnyam rol phyag gis rgyud sde'i glegs bam

'dzin skyil krung gis bzhugs rtogs pa'i gzi 'od 'bar:sngags kyi dbang phyug dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyis:rdo rje phur ba gdengs ba'i thabs su 'dzin stag sham rus rgyan dar gyi dpyangs pa dkar:dbu sgra thor cog dar sna'i rgya chings gdab:thod pa'i phreng ba me long se ral byas:rol ba'i stabs bzhugs gzhan snang zil gyis gnon:rtogs pa phul phyin rma ban rin mchog ni:dkar dmar gzi 'bar gzhon tshul lang tshos 'khyud:phyag gnyis thod dbyug bhan+ta bsgyur thabs 'dzin:zhabs gnyis phyed rol dge slong cha byad can:chos rgyal tshangs pa lha yi me tog rtsal:dbang gi ber chung 'dung ma za ber klubs:dar thod rat+na'i chas rgyan sna tshogs 'chang:phyag mtshan gser gyi 'khor lo pad phreng 'dzin mthu stobs yon tan rgya mtsho'i gzi 'bar bskyed log 'dren dpung 'joms rdo rje bdud 'joms smug:gsang gos dkar po mthing sham dar dpyangs ljang:dbu sgra thor cog rin chen snyan cha mdzes:phyag g.yas lcags phur g.yon pas bhan+ta 'dzin:me rlung 'khrigs dbus rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs:chos kyi char dbab cog ro

ba tshu klu'i rgyal mtshan:bsgres pa'i nyams can rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs parnyi ta'am lo tsā'i cha byad can:chags bral pad+ma rgyud sde'i glegs bam 'dzin:gdos bral dwangs ma 'od kyi sku ru gsal:rdzu 'phrul thogs med dzñā na ku ma ni:dkar dmar mdangs ldan gzhon tshul lang tsho'i 'khyud:shes rab ral gri rin chen zhags pa 'dzin:gsang bam chos gos dmar po sham thabs spras:cung zad g.yas 'gyeng bkrag mdangs lang tsho'i 'khyud:sgra dang yi ger phul phyin legs sbyin nyi:dar dpyangs smad sham sgom thag dkar khra mjes:phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag bhan+ta bdud rtsi 'dzin:skyil mo krung bzhugs lta stangs nam mkhar gzigs:stong gsal 'dzin med sgyu ma'i sku ru gsal:mkhyen pa'i gter mdzod ldan ma rtse mang ni:dkar la gzhon tshul dpal 'khyud lang tshos sgeg:phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas tshe bum 'dzin:skyil mo krung bzhugs dge slong cha byad can:ye shes dwangs ma 'od kyi sku ru bzhugs:grub pa mngon gyur dpal gyi seng ge ni:dkar gsal rnal 'byor spyod pa'i cha lugs can thod rnga rin chen zhags pa phyag

char 'chang: phyed rol bde stong nyams 'bar sku ru shar: zang thal klong gyur rgyal ba byang chub nyid: dkar dmar 'dzum sgeg bkrag mdangs lang tshos 'khyud:rdo rje dril bu bsnol ba'i thabs su 'dzin:chos gos gsum gsol sde snod gsum zhwa mdzes:chos nyid mkha' la rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs:gzhan snang zil gnon dran pa nam mkha' nyid:zhi ma khro 'dzum spug nag rngams pa'i sku:phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas sdig pa gtser: gar chen stabs bzhugs dge slong cha byad can: dag chen dri med 'od kyi rol par bzhugs:log 'dren rdul brlag sog po lha dpalani: dmar smug dbu sgra thor cog zar bu 'phyangs: phod mthing dngul gzan dmar po sham thabs spras: ral gri phur ba gdengs ba'i thabs su 'dzin: me long thod phreng sked phur sngags chas mdzes: zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs: gzi mdangs bkrag 'khyud me yi tsha tsha 'phro:dbang chen gsung gi gar 'dzin rgyal mchog dbyangs:dmar gsal dgyes rol rdo rje'i gzi 'od 'khyud: lcags kyu sbrul zhags 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas bsdams: mdzes pa'i rgyan bkod parnyi

gsatshu ta yi chas: rta skad gtsug spud ma rig rū dra 'joms: 'od lnga'i slong du skyil mo krung gis bzhugs: grub pa'i yon tan mchog thobayishas dbyings: dkar dmar phyed rol rnal 'byor spyod pa'i chas cang te'u bhan+ta gar gyi phyag rgya 'chang: bdud dpung zil gnon che ba'i yon tan rdzogs: mkhas grub 'o bran dpal kyidabang phyug ni:dkar dmar mdangs ldan gzhon tshul lang tsho'i 'khyud: kha ṭ+wāṃ phur ba bsgyur bkan stabs su 'dzin: mdzes pa'i rgyan cha dge slong cha byad can: chags bral bde stong byin rlabs gzi 'od 'byug: rdo rje gar gyi bzhugs stangs rnam par rol: yon tan mchog thobadapal kyirdo dzini: dmar smug rnal 'byor rol ba'i cha lugs can: rdo rje'i phyed skyil 'gyur med gdan la rol: thabs shes zung 'jug mda' gzhu 'geng tshul mdzad: 'od lnga zlum 'khyil bkod mdzes dbus su 'phyang: rlung sems dbang thob mkhar chu dpal dbang phyug: dmar smug dbu skra thor cog nor bus brgyan rat+na'i do shal 'dung ma dmar spug dang: dngul gzan mthing sham za 'og ber chen klubs: rol ba'i thabs bzhugs

lcags phur bhan thod 'dzin: stobs kyi yon tan du mas rnam par mdzes: bka' rnams 'dus pa'i dngos grub mchog brnyes pa: khye'u chung ma tsā bcu drug lang tsho'i 'khyud:sngags kyi chas rdzogs dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phur: mgo phreng me long lcags phur sked du 'chang: rol ba'i stabs bzhugs rdo rje lcags phur gdengs: gdos por ma grub dwangs ma'i 'od sku gsal mkhyen gnyis gzi 'bar rba yi sang shī ta: dkar gsal mdzes 'dzum lang tsho'i bkrag mdangs 'khyud: rdo rje dril bu bsnol ba'i stabs su 'chang: 'od lnga'i klong du dge slong cha byad can: brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur du mas 'khyud bzhin bzhugs: phrin las bka' bab yi shesamatsho rgyal ni: dkar dmar mdangs ldan bcu drug lang tshos 'khyud: e rag dar dpyangs rus pa'i rgyan drug sprus pad phreng dbu sgra thor cog rat+nas brgyan: phyag mtshan phur pa bhan+ta bsgyur thabs 'dzin: stong gsal 'dzin med 'od kyi phung por bskyed: grub brnyes chen po shud pu dpal seng ni: dmar sprug zhi khro mdzes 'dzum sgeg nyams rgyas: sngags kyi chas rdzogs phur pa thod phreng 'dzin: dbu skra thor cog

btsarnya dar gyi cod paṇa bcing:snyan cha dung gi wa mig dngul gzan bkra:brtul bzhugs rol ba chen po'i thabs su bzhugs:mkhas shing grub brtes rgyal ba'i sgo grosani:dkar dmar 'dzum sgeg lang tsho'i dpal gyi 'byud:sde snod gsum zhwa chos gos rnam gsum gsol:thod rnga lcags phur 'gyeng gdengs thabs su 'dzin:'khrul ba ru bzlog gar chen bsnol bas bzhugs:bdud dpung zil gnon 'brog mi dpal ye shes:sngags kyi chas 'chang dkar dmar lang tshos 'khyud:stag sham mgo phreng me long sked phur brten:phyag g.yas spu gri g.yon pas sdig mdzub mdzad:me dud 'khrigs dbus rgyal po rol stabs bzhugs:chos srid dpal skyongs lha sras dri sted grags dmar gsal mdzes 'dzum lta bas chog mi shes:rat+na'i srog zhu dar gyi la thod mdzes:zhi ba'i phod chung 'dung ma mthing ka dang:za 'og ber klubs rat+na sna tshogs brgyan:'dor lo glegs bam thugs gar steng 'og 'dzin:rgyal po rol ba'i stabs bzhugs 'gran bral bskyed:kun mkhyen ye shes lha sras dam 'dzin rtsal:dkar dmar mdangs ldan dbu sgra

thor cog la: rat+na'i rtse phran pad+ma'i gdengs ka spung: sna lnga'i cod pan gser dngul snyan rgyan mdzes: phod mthing dngul gzan dmar smug sham thabs dang: za 'og ber chen me long sked phur brten: rin chen phreng ba sum rims do shal byas: phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon pas bhan+ta 'dzin: 'od lnga'i gur klong rgyal po rol stabs bzhugs: brtul bzhugs mthu thob gru gu e bag ni: mthing gsal gcer bu rus rgyan gzig sham dang: dar dpyangs sgom thag dkar khra mdzes par brgyan: gri gug zhags pa bsgyur ba'i stabs kyis 'dzin: rdo rje gar gyi rol rtsed bsgyur thabs bzhugs: kun kyang mtshan 'dzin rtog pas ma gos par: dag chen bde sang rang bzhin 'od gsal ba: chos kyi lhun po ze ro tsa na ni: mi g.yo zang thal parnyi ta yi chas: gar gyi phyag rgya rdo rje mkha' la bkrol: gdos por ma grub chos dbyings sang la rol: ngo bo chos nyid sku yi rnam rol ngom: rang bzhin 'gags med sku mdog phyag mtshan shar: thugs rje'i phrin las brda bkod khyad par 'phags: de yi phyi rim pad+ma 'dab bzhi la: rdo rje ging chen dkar gsal rus rgyan spras:

ba:tshu rin chen ging chen gser gyi chas rgyan 'chang: pad+ma'i ging chen g.yer breng 'ja' sham can: las kyi ging chen gzig sham zhing lpags brgyan: kun kyang ru dar dam rtags mdzes pa 'chang: gsang ba'i rnge'u chung lcags zhags sgrog dril 'dzin: rdo rje'i bro gar sna tshogs 'brab bzhin rol: bar mtshams dpa' bo dpa' mo rlung ltar 'tshubs: dgyes pa'i bro 'khrab mkha' la thogs med rgyu: nyams dga' glu len bshug pa brda skad 'ur: 'khrul pa gzhir bshig chos zad blo 'das kyi: dgongs pa zang thal rigs ldan bu la ster: dam tshig lcags kyu gsang ba gsum gyi gzer: kun khyab zhing la spro bsdu'i phrin las sgo mi nub phyag rgya yi ge sna tshogs pa'i: rnam par spyan drangs dam ye ro gcig bsre: gnas lugs rig pa 'pho med chen po dzas bzhengs bzhugs gnyis las ldog med rgyas gdab po: sgo badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: de ltar mdun bskyed gsal bstims pas:'bras bu mi nub gong 'phel 'byung: sa ma yā 'i 'i rgya snyi:skad cig nyid la sems kyi chos: rig pa'i ye shes cher dag nas lhan skyes rnga yab dpal ri mched:rang byung pad+ma 'byung gnas dang:gleng pa bdud 'dzoms dbyer med pas:

man ngag gsang mdzod rnyed dka'i chos rtsa thugs gdong sgrub zhes bya ba: lha yi nor bu gdong sgrub ste: lhan skyes pad 'byung mngon du 'gyur mi yi nor bu rtsa sgrub ste rtsa thig rlung grol sku gsum mjal: klu yi nor bu thugs sgrub ste:chos zad blo 'das sa ru skyol: bla ma'i snying tig rtsa ba yin: mchog gi dngos grub 'di las 'byung: yi dam snying tig thugs sgrub mthil: nyams rtogs yon tan 'di yis bskyed: mkha' 'gro'i snying tig gdong btsug sgrub bde stong rtogs pa nyi ltar 'char pha yi gces nor rtsa rgyud ste: rtsa ba rang byung ye shes rtogs: ma yi gces nor thugs rgyud ste rgyal kun spro bsdu'i mthil gcig rtogs: zung 'jug gces nor gdong rgyud de dbyings rig thig le rnam par rtogs yang snyingaphun tshogs dam pa 'di: nus ldan rdo rje'i mnog chos yin rigs bzhi'i mtshan la gtad rgya bkrol snyan rgyudasnyi dag snangasnyi: yang gter snying gi bu yi bgo skal3/: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya:

'a tshu snyan rgyud snying gi dum bu rig 'dzin thugs sgrubazhi: rgalgigīX āḥ blo 'das tshos sku thig le nyag gcig klong: mtha' bral ye shes kun la snyoms par brdal:'pho med bde chen zung 'jug rig pa trī: dag gsal mnyam rol dbyings kyi ba gar rol: mtshan 'dzin gnyis snang rnyog ma'i dri kun dben ye shes chen po phyogs ris mi dmigs pa mtha' grol rdo rje'i drwa gur 'khrigs pa'i klong: rgyu yis ma bcos rkyen gyis mi shig pa: sku gsum sang yangs bde gshegs kun 'dus zhal pad+ma 'byung gnas ting 'dzin rgyal po'i sku: chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i zhal mnga' ba: ji ltar mkhyen pa'i ji snyed gzigs pa'i spyan: kun rdzob don dam slong rol snang glu len: sku gnyis mngon gyur brda don snyan zung rgyas: gdul bya'i yul skyongs mdzod spu'i 'od zer 'gyed: bde stong zung 'jug dkar la dmar mdangs chags kun khyab spros pa rab dben 'dzum nyams rgyas: ma rig g.yul bzlog cung zad khro tshul chags: chos sgo 'byed pa'i ljags srab tshems phreng dkar: bag chags dri bral gsang gos dkar gsal dang: theg pa ma lus a

tir ston pa'i brdar:sngags kyi phod chen mdzes pa be+eḍūr ris:mdo sngags mi nub zung 'dug 'gyed pa'i brdar:chos gos dmar po gser gyi ha ris bkra:phrin las mi nub phyogs kun khyab pa'i rtags:ljang sngon dar gyi dpyangs pa 'od mdangs 'bar:khams gsum dbang sdud srid pa chos skur rol:brda rtags zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol stabs 'gyeng:theg pa ma 'dres sa ler ston pa'i brdar:phyag g.yas wa ṭ+wāṃ zil gnon phyag rgyas bsdigs:mchog thun dngos grub bu la 'bebs pa'i brdar:'chi med bcud bkang bhan+ta snyan thad 'dzin:sde gsum ma 'dres sa ler gzigs pa'i brdar pad+ma 'od 'khyud kun bzang sprin zhwa gsol:tshos dbyings rig pa 'pho med ston pa'i rtags rtse rgyan rdo rje nyi zla nor bu mdzes:yon tan ye shes dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i:don rtags rat+na'i snyan cha mgul phreng mdzes:tshad med thugs rjes gzhan snang dbyings sgrol rtags:'ja' 'od lnga ldan thig le'i klong na 'gying:chos sku spros bral mtshan 'dzin ka nas dag:longs sku mnyam nyid ma 'dres sa ler gsal:sprul sku bde chen snang stong zung 'jug ngang:

badz+ra: dbyer med pad+ma 'byung gnas dkyil 'khor shar: dgyes bskang bde stong gzi 'bar dbyings phyug mo: de yi phyi rim pad+ma 'dab bzhi la: mdun du bal 'bangs ka la sirnyi dkar: g.yas su bal mo shākya de wa ser: rgyab tu ye shes mcho rgyal dmar gsal mdzes: g.yon phyogs lha lcam man+ta ra ba mthing: kun kyang mdzes 'dzum lha mo'i cha byad can: pus btsug 'dud rgya g.yas rnams bhan+ta stobs mi g.yo bde ba chen po'i gzi 'od 'khyug: chags pa'i 'gro khams thugs rje'i sman gyis dgrol: dgyes 'dzum brtse bas dad ldan sprin grol byed: stong gsal 'dzin med sgyu ma'i sku ru gsal: de yi bye rims pad+ma 'dab lnga pa'i: mdun g.yas 'dab steng bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: mthing gsal chos dbyings nam mkha' kha dog 'chang: dpa' bo 'bod pa'i thod rnga mkha' la 'brol: ḍāk+ki bskul ba'i dril bu dku la brten mi 'gyur bde chen rol ba'i 'khyud stabs bzhugs: shar gyi 'dab steng rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: dag gsal rnyog bral dung ltar dkar ba'i sku: gzhan snang zil gnon rdo rje rtse lnga bsdigs: 'khor los rgyan rol bhan+ta

dku la brten srid gsum zil gnon rgyal po rol thabs bzhugs:che yi 'dab steng rat+na thod phreng rtsal:yon tan lhun 'thug rab rgyas gser gyi mdog:'chi med tshe dbang mchog stsol mda' dar dang dgos 'dod char 'bebs rin chen gter bum 'dzin:'od lnga'i gur 1nga phyed rol thabs su bzhugs:nub kyi pad steng pad+ma thod phreng rtsal:chags bral bde stong gzi 'bar rā ga'i mdangs:khams gsum dbang sdud pad+ma'i lcags kyu dang:ma rig mun sel dngul dkar me 'o nga bsnams:'khor 'das mnyam rol zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs byang gi pad steng garma thod phreng rtsal bya ba lhun grub in+d+ra'i gzi 'od 'bar:ma rig rtsad gcod shes rab ral gri dang:dug gsum dbyings rol kha ṭ+wāṃ gdengs thabs 'dzin:bdud dpung zil gnon phyed 'gyeng stabs su bzhugs:de yi phyi rim pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi shar du rig 'dzin hūṃ chen ka ra dkar:gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan rdzogs ṭā dril 'khrol:'ja' 'od lnga klong phyed skyil thabs su bzhukas:lho ru rig 'dzin mañdzu mi dra ser:stag sham rus rgyan rat+na'i do shal mdzes:zhabrul pa

ba:tshu gzhir bshig ral gri bhan thod 'dzin:stong gsal gdos bral 'od lnga'i klong du bskyed:nub kyi 'dab mar klu grub snying po dmar:dar sham rus rgyan rat+na'i phreng bas mdzes:chags bral dbang gi lcags kyu tshe bum 'dzin:dngas ma 'od phung ye shes sgyu 'phrul shar:byang gi pad steng rig 'jin pra bha haḥljang gsal rus rgyan dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phur:gdug tshogs drungs 'byin rdo rje lcags phur gdengs:mtshan ma'i gdos bral 'ja' 'od sku ru bskyed:shar lha'i 'dab steng dha na se kridakar:pad+ma'i do shal rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzes:dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭ+wāṃ me long bsnams:snang la rang bzhin ma grub 'od skur bskyed:lho nub mtshams sudzadam mi tra mthing:mdzes 'dzum lang tsho'i dpal 'khyud rus rgyan spras:tshe mda' bum pa 'chi med dpal ster 'dzin:dngas ma 'od sku rgyal po rol stabs bzhugs:nub byang pad steng raspu gu h+ya smug:zhi ma khro 'dzum gzig sham rus rgyan spras:skye 'chi dbyings sgol gri gug zhags pa 'dzin:gdos por ma grub snang stong gnyis med bskyed:byang shar 'dab dbus shadzña

gar+bha ni mthing nag zhi 'dzum sgeg pa'i rnam 'gyur can: rus pa'i rgyan rdzogs dbyug do bhan thod bsnams: snang la rang bzhin ma grub 'od skur gsal:de rgyab 'ja' 'od thig le bsam yas 1nga: dpa' bo pho tshogs bro gar khrigs se khrig: dpa' bo mo tshogs glu len kyu ru ༄/ ging dang lang gas brda skad sang sang sgogs: lha mo rnams kyis dar gdugs 'phan yab bsgrengs: klu mo sna tshogs me tog char ba brnyil: shāk+ki ma rnams tshogs ston bsam yas spro: chos nyid stong pa'i rang sgra rol mo 'ur: kun khyab rdo rje'i brda bstod 'gag med shar: thams cad ma 'dres kun tu bzang po'i 1nga: ngo bo gcig la rnam rol mtha' yas kyang: mi 'gyur bde chen rdo rje'i ra ba las 'pho 'gyur mi dmigs don dam gnyug ma'i lha: ye rdzogs rig pa 'pho med chen por blta: sku gsung thugs su spros pa rnam dag kyang: mi 'gyur 'gag 'khrul bral ba'i dbyings klong nas: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor ro: mi 'da' bde chen rig pa'i go rar bsre: nyag gcig thig le chen por brtan bzhugs gsol: tso badz+ra sa ma ya dza: a la la ho sa ma ya

——— ste: sa ma yā:ṭha ṭha:༷/rgyaḥsngon spron rten 'brel bzang po'i mthus dus sad gdul byas bskul ba na:chags bral thugs rjes der bskyang ba:bung ba pad tshal brtse bzhin no:dgos 'byung snying gi mun sel 'di:rin chen nor gyis mi 'gugs pa:mkha' 'gro'i gsang mjad zab mo yin:gces pa'i srog las phang na'ang:skal ba can la brtse bas sbyin zob dang ma bsre nyams su longs:gnas min la srungs dam rgya mdzod thugs dam thugs kyi pad+mor dril:snying gi bu la gcig brgyud mdzod:bka' gsang srung shiganges nus ma:sa ma yā:rgya rgya rgya:pha cig bdud 'joms gling pa yi bsdu gtor yi ge sgra chen brdas:zhing bkod 'di ka rtsal nyams snang:snyan brgyud brda la bor rgyu med:rig par skad cig rang byung gter:kho bonus ldan rdo dze+eyis:mnog chos gab sbas ma byas par:snying gi bu chen rnam pa gnyis:rgya mtsho'i ming gi cod pan can dgyes pa bskang phyir gus pas phul sarba maṅga le/

bas/: snyan rgyud snying gidum bu: rig 'dzin gdung sgrubasnyi 2sgesgagagato āḥ chos sku kun khyab mtha' bral nam mkha' che: phyogs ris ma khyab snying rje mnyam par brdal: rig pa 'khor 'das yongs kyi srog tu shar: mtshan ma tshig bral chos dbyings yum gyi mkhar: bde glong ma ki'i rang bzhin mdangs ldan dbus: chags pas ma gos sor rtogs pad stong khar: mnyam nyid thugs rje'i gzi 'bar ze'u 'bru'i dbus: bya ba lhun grub 'ja' 'od zlum 'byil lter: skye bzhi'i skyon gyis ma gos ye shes sku: rgyal kun phrin lasagasang 'dze+en pad+ma 'byung: sku gnyis zung 'jug brda rtags dkar dmar mdangs: gdul bya'i pad+mor brtse ba'i 'dzum mdzes bzhad: dgongs pa zang thal klong 'byed spyan zung khro: gsang chen theg pa'i yon tan dpral dbyes rgyas: tshad med rnam bzhi'i 'gro 'dren rdzi smin legs: mnyam nyid shangs las dpa' bo'i brda glu len: mnyam brdal zhal las chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs: thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug snyan zung la: 'ub chub bde klong rol ba nyi zla'i brgyan: rig 'dzin sprin dpung 'khrigs pa'i pad zhwa la:

sde gsum ma 'dres rdzogs pa'i rtags gsum brgyan: mi 'gyur a ti yo ka ston pa'i brdar: rat+na lnga ldan rdo rje'i gtsug rgyan mdzes: shes rab rang byung dar sna lnga yis spras:snang ba ma 'dres don ston phyag g.yas pas: rig 'dzin ḍak+ki'i sprin sdud cang te'u 'dzin: stong chen mnyam par sbyor ba'i phyag rgya yis: mchog thun dngos grub 'bebs pa'i bhan thod brten: srid zhi mnyam par rol ba'i brda thabs su: zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs: bag chags dri ma'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i: rdo rje'i gsang gos dkar po dung 'od 'bar: bde stong gsal dag 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: dmar smug sham thabs mdzes pa be+eḍūr ris: sde gsum sgol 'dzin sangs rgyas gnyis pa ste: chos gos dmar po gser gyi ha ris bkra: khams gsum dbang sdud srid gsum zil gnon rtags: za 'og ber chen rat+na'i mgul phreng mdzes: gdul bya ma lus dpal rir 'god pa'i brdar: rin chen thod phreng phyag g.yas gru mor bkal: shes rab stong pa'i rgyas 'debs man+ta ra: mtshan 'dzin dbyings su bsre ba'i brda ru 'chang: ngo bo chos sku gdos pa

ba tshu spros dang bral:dngos 'dzin ma grub dwangs ma 'od kyi sku:rang bzhin ma 'dres longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dal:zhal phyag rgyan bkod ma 'dres sa ler gsal:thugs rje ye shes sprul pa sku yi brdar:'gro don phrin las mdzad pa bsam mtha' yas:sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin spro bsdus bdag pad+ma 'byung gnas rtsa ba'i dkyil 'dor las:shar gyi pad steng brtse chen thugs rje'i mdangs:mcho skyes rdo rje chos dbyings nam mkha'i mdog:gcer bu rgyan bral rdo rje skyil krung mdzes:snang stong mnyam sbyor rdor dril bsnol thabs 'dzin:ma chags dri bral pad phreng do shal mdzes:snying rje rang mdangs lho yi pad 'dab steng:stobs kyi bdag nyid blo ldan mchog sred dkar:rus pa'i rgyan drug dar gyi sham thabs mdzes:phyed skyil rol ba'i 'khor ba kha lo bsgyur:dar thod rat+na'i rtse phran pad+mas bcings:snang stong zung 'jug ṭa ru bhan+ta 'dzin:'ja' 'od lnga klong ye shes sku ru shar dga' chen rol ba'i mdangs 'bar nub pad steng:'khor 'das bde rol nyi ma 'od zer ser:rngam spyod 'dul bas stag gi sham thabs dang:srid

pa ru bzlog rnal 'byor spyod pa'i chas:ma 'dres yongs rdzogs brda don rtags rdzogs 'chang:dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭī rtse gsum dang:ma rig mun sel nyi zer phyag gis 'dzin:bde sbyor mnyam pa chen po'i gzi 'od 'bar:zhabs gnyis rdo rje gar gyi dam rgyas rol:stobs kyi phrin las byang gi pad 'dab steng:'khor ba dbyings sbyoramango gesgra sgre gas mthing:khrag 'thung khros pa'i rnam 'gyur du mas 'khyud:dur khrod dpal chas dpa' bo'i rtags su 'chang:'jig rten zil gnon rdo rje sdig mdzub gdengs:bdud bzhi rtsad gcod gyad kyi 'dor stabs bsgrad:gnyis snang dri bsregs me yi sang du 'gyeng:ha hi rdo rje'i gad mo 'brug ltar sgrogs:rol ba chen po'i gar bsgyur shar lto ru:sde gsum srol 'dzin pad+ma se bha wa dkar dmar mdangs ldan bcu drug lang tshos 'khyud:chos gos gsum gsol zhabs gnyis byed skyil bzhugs pad phor skyabs sbyin rdo rje'i phyag rgya bsgyur:byin rlabs yon tan rgya mtsho'i gzi 'od 'bar:sde snod gleg bam za ma tog mdzod 'chang:kun mkhyen 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon por bzhengs:nus pa'i stobs

badz+ra: 'bar lho nub pad steng du:'khor 'das dbang bsgyur pad+ma rgyal po dmar:dbang gi ber chung mthing sham rat+na'i rgyan:phreng ba do shal snyan cha gdu bu mdzes:dar gyi la thod rat+na'i sgog zhwa dang:pad+ma'i cod pan rgya g.yu mu tig mdzes:bden gnyis chos kyi char 'bebs ṭa ru dang:gsal khyab sku gsum don stong me long 'dzin:srid zhi mnyam rol phyed 'gyang stabs kyis bzhugs:srid gsum nor sna 'dod yon phyur bur 'khrigs:gang yang ma 'gags der 'dzin spros pa bral:mnyam rol kun khyab rdo rje'i ngo bor shar:'dres pa'i pho nya nub byang pad steng du:shākya seng ge mtshan bzang dpe byad rdzogs:sprul sku'i cha lugs ma 'dres gsal bar 'chang:rtog bcas mtshan ma bcom pa'i sa gnon dang:thams cad mnyam par rol bas lhung bzed 'dzin:rin chen btso ma'i mdangs 'bar 'od zer spro:phrin las mi nub sangs rgyas byang sems 'gyed:dus gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dpal du bzhengs:brtul zhugs rol gar byang shar pad steng du:dpal chen yongs 'dus bla ma khro bo lod:spug nag rdo rje lcags phur

gdengs thabs 'dzin: dregs pa zil gnon khro gtum bzod dka'i nyams: theg dgu'i chos char gdul byar 'bebs pa'i brda: thod skam sum rim dbu yi rgyan du 'chang: ye shes lnga ldan dar sna'i cod pan mdzes: sor rtogs gzi 'bar dbu sgra wa mig 'khyil: ma chags dri bral dung gi snyan cha byas: 'jigs rung bdud dpung 'dul ba'i am gtsig bsdams: rgyal bsen ru tra drungs 'byin sprul pa 'gyed: chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i thugs mnga' ba: bde stong 'du 'bral med pa'i gzi 'od 'bar: kun rtog 'khrul ba ru bzlog mgo phreng dang: zab mo gter gyi sgo 'byed sked phur 'chang: theg tshogs a tir bsdu ba'i phod kha dang: rim gnyis ma 'dres ston pas mazing sham dang: mdo sngags zung du sbrel bas chos gos spras: mnyam rol rgyal po tshul 'dzin sag lhum bcas: chos min bdud kyi rgol 'joms stag mo'i khrir: gzhan snang zil gnon gyad kyis 'dor thabs bsgrad: 'od 'bar me yis ma rig mun khams bsregs: rtsa gsum yongs 'dus rdo rje 'chang du bzhengs: rig kun 'dus pa tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor ste: mi 'gyur mi shig rdo

pa( rje'i rang gdangs shar:mtshan 'dzin rtog pas ma gos don dam pa:dri med pad+ma 'od kyi bkod pa che:gzhan yang sprul pa'i rig 'aron chen po brgyad:gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan 'chang ṭ+wā dril 'khrol:phyogs bzhi phyogs mdog mtshams bzhi mthing ga'o:zhi ma khro 'dzum rdo rje'i gar bsgyur rol:de rgyab 'gro ba 'dul ba'i guru brgyad:sngags 'chang rgyal po sprul sku'i cha lugs sogs:gang la gang 'dul mdzad pa bsam mtha' yas:'phrul mtshan nyer lnga ma pan brgya rtsa brgyad:snying gi bu dgu grub tshen brgyad cu dang:gter ston brgya rtsa phrag brgya'i gu ru sogs:thams cad ma lus gu ru gangs chen mtsho'i:'od zer phra rab rdul gyi bkod pa ste:sems kyi dri bral rig pa'i dpal du bzhengs:bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor cher spros pas:g.yas na dpa' bo pho tshogs thams cad kyis:nyams dga' glu len bro brdung khrigs se khrig:g.yon na dpa' bo mo tshogs thabs cad kyis:bde stong nyams 'bar brda skad sangs se sang:mdun na ging pa las byed thams cad kyis:rolabaku'i sgrashigags gar bsgyur shigs se shig:

rgyab na dam can pho nya rgya mtsho yis bka' nyan las byed rol ston tshubs se tshubs: bar snang 'ja' 'od dar gdugs 'phan yab 'khyugs: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs bkod pa khyad par 'phags: sku gsum gsang dbyings rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi: dam tshig sgog gi bskul te ye shes pa: mi gnas mi dmigs rnga yab dpal gyi ri: bde stong spros bral pad+ma 'od zhing nas: rig pa'i rgyal po ce rgyanachos kyi rje: gtso 'khor sras bcas spyan drangs gnyis med bsre: sa ma yā tha tha:snyi: rten 'brel smon lam mthu btsan pas gdul bya'i yul te thugs rjes bskyangs: ngang mo'i dga' tshal rdzing bu bzhin: ltog skom gdung ba sel ba'i sman: rgud pa sna tshogs 'joms pa'i rtsi rin chen rin thang bral ba ni: stong gsum nor gyis phyur gtam pas: yon gyi mi 'gugs mkha' 'gro'i brda pad+ma'i chos mdzod sgo byes nas rim gnyis rnal 'byor sgom pa'i tshe: phyi nang gnyis 'dzin dri ma dag rig pa kun khyab kyi ngo bor gnas tshe: pha cig bdud 'dul rdo rje: a skye med kyi rang mdangs su bzhengs te bsdu gtor thabs shes kyi yi ge mthu las snang ba'i zhing khams kyi bkod pa 'di'o: snyan rgyud kyang yin skad cig gi gter ro dag snang ngoḥ yang gter snying gi bu yi bgo skal du shar ba'o:
bye/ go gsal reg pa libardamadzod las:rngasedzamo'agugs bstemi rgyas gdab kyi rim pa bzhugs so:

tshulo na mo dzñā na ḍāk+ki ni wa ra hi ye:dzonyaḍornguphyo| thun mthar tshe 'gugs bya ba ni mda' dar g.yab la 'di skad do:hūṃ trī:rang snang mi shig dag pa'i zhing:'od gsal dngas klong gzhal yas nas:rgyal ba rigs lnga tshe yi bdag:'chi med grub pa'i rdo rje'i sku:phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam:thugs rje lcags kyus tshe bsod 'gugs byams pa'i zhags pas bkrag mdangs bskyed:dga' ba'i sgrogs gis bla sgog gso:btang ste mas dril bus mchog thun gyi:dngos grub ma lus bde bar sbyin:yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas dpal:brda thabs tshe mda'i rgyud kyis bskul:gsol 'debs gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'bod:rdo rje'i tha tshig dus gnad bsgrags:brtson 'grus drag pos bsnyen cing sgrub:dngos grub bskul phyir re smon gsol:thugs dam chen pos nyer bzhes nas:skye 'chi med pa'i tshe khug la:bsgres rgud bral bar bkrag mdangs bskyed:tshe dbang rig 'jin nyer thob nas:'chi med ye shes mngon gyur shog:/ hrī:dbus mtha' bral ba'i gzhal yas nas:snang dbyings 'du 'bral med pa'i sku:stong gsal thig

tshun le'i gur khang nas:sangs rgyas phag mo tshe yi bdag:'chi med g.yung drung rdo rje'i sku:mdzad phrin mi nub nam mkha' mdzod:thugs rje'i gzi byin 'khyugs pa las:'khor 'das 'byung ba'i dwang bcud stobs:thabs chen yi ge 'bru gsum gyis:rnam par lu gu rgyud byung nas:rnal 'byor khams drug 'dus pa'i rten:bla srog dwangs ma'i thig ler bstims:skye med tshe yi gzhal yasa.āX 'gag med brten zhing 'phel ba'i hūṃ:rtsol bral tshe rten n+ni ljang sngon:gsal 'tsher bkrag mdangs gzi byin 'bar:'chi med tshe yi dpal rgyas nas:don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung gyur cig:hūṃ hrī:rdul dang bral ba'i gzhal yas nas:dbyings ye 'du 'bral med pa'i sku:dkar gsal thig le'i klong yangs nas:rdo rje phag mo tshe yi dpal rgyas nas:don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung gyur cig:bar gtong ngo:hūṃ hrī mtshan 'jin bral b.ligazhal yas nas:bde stong 'du 'bral med pa'i sku:ser gsal thig le'i klong yangs nas:rin chen phag mo tshe yi dpal rgyas nas:don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung gyur cig:bar gtong ngo:hūṃ hrī:gdos chogs

bral ba'igazhal yas nas: gsal stong 'du 'bral med pa'i sku: dmar gsal thig le'i sang yangs nas: pad+ma phag mo tshe yi dpal rgyas nas: don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung gyur cig: bar gtang ngo: hūṃ hrī: gzung 'dzin bral ba'i gzhal yas nas: snang stong 'du 'bral med pa'i sku ljang gsal thig le'i klong yangs nas: las mdzad phag mo tshe yi sogs cig: bar gasto: hūṃ hrī: rngams brjid rnga yab dpal ri nas: rab 'jigs srin po yongs kyi rje: gsang chen ston pa brtul zhugs can: rdo rje gar dbang pad+ma 'byung: bzhe thod phreng tshe yi bdag: de mtshams badz+ra tshe yi bdag: pad+ma tshe yi bdag: karma tshe yi bdag: zhes sbyar ro: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i sku: bsgres rgud bral ba tshe yi lha: phrin las zad med nam mkha' mdzod: thugs rje'i 'od zer bye phrag brgya: mi mjed 'jig rten khams su spros: lha 'dre mi gsum tshe bsod nams: ma lus 'ub bsdus snying por bskyil: bla srog mi 'gyur ka ba brtan: 'byung ba'i khams kun dar smin rgyas: rnal 'byor las ldan skal ba bzang: tshe dbang rdo rje'i don rtogs shog tshe gzungs brgya rtsa brjod la tshe rgyas par bya'o: ma skye med tshe yi

rten gzhal yas khangaḥ t+t+waṃ: 'gag bral mi zad rin chen gter: tre 'dod yon mdzod la dbang 'byor smin: hrīḥ ye shes thugs srog 'gyur med brtan: āḥ kun bzang dgongs rtogs byang chub shog: hūṃ tra tra shag mu tra ho: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: brgya rtsa brjod la tshe sba bstim bya'o: cha: 'grub par gyur cig rdo rje'i sku: 'chi med don rtogs gsang ba gsum:mngon gyur gzhan phan phrin las ni: nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam gyur cig: ces lan gsum me tog bcas smon lam gdab po: : hrī: tshe lha rgyal ba'i bden stobs dang: bden gnyis bslu med nus mthu yis: tshe 'phrang 'jigs pa mtha' yas kun: zhi ba chos nyid chen por bacho ga: ces lan gsum bskyar la 'chi bzlog bya'o: de 'bras che dpal bkrag mdangs rgyas don gnyis yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur sa ma yā: rgyal dbang pad+ma'i gsang mdzod brda: bdud 'joms khyung drag rtsal gyis rnyed bstan pa rigs ldan bu lngas 'dzin gsang bkrol dzñā na sa ra dza: slob dpon sku tshe mdzad phrin rgyas: gdul bya bsam yas smin grol byed: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gu rgya: brda thim:snyi ces pa 'di'ang bdud 'joms ye shes khyung drag rtsal gyis dag par phab pas/ chos bdag bu lnga grogs dang bcas pa'i re smon bskang ba'i rgyur gyur cig sarba maṅga le/

pa:: phyag rgya dran rdzogs chen po ni: āḥ smra bsam brjod bral chos dbyings mkhar: lhan skyes bde chen ye shes sku: dran rdzogs dzñā na ḍāk+kir lta: gang shar ma bcos rig pa'i ngang: zhes brjod phyi nang 'dzin zhen grol gang shar rang grol don la gnas dran pas 'ub chub phyag rgya che: mngon gyur rtogs pa'i rtsal sbyang thobasnye sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: lha snang lta ba gyad sku ni: ā ༷ bye 'das ye ro|sa zang thal gnyug ma'i gshis: ma bcos ye grol gu ru pad+ma 'byung: nyag gcig sku dang ye shes phrin las rdzogs: 'ub chub bde chen khyab brdal chos sku'i ngang: ma/ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sidhi hūṃ: ye rdzogs ngo bo rig tsam grol: dgongs pa zang thal don la gtad bskur thob bral ba'i lha zhal mjal: rdzogs pa chen porayi ma ho sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya: 'gro mgon li hi'i gar bsgyur me tri'i ngor:klong yangs sngags kyi badhe dza 5sa bris
—— rgya 'dre 'byung po'i tshogs la gsur dang lan chags gtong ba gdug pa'i sems zhi bzhugs so:

shā 71ro/ṭa/tha rje// skyabs sems ni: na mo dkon mchog kun 'dus sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs par: bdag gzhan sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi:༄de lnga'i myos pa'i snyigs 'dza'i smon lorge rnams: 'khrul ba rang sar grol phyir sems bskyed do: bdag bskyed ni: hrīḥ stong dang snying rje zung 'jug rang rtsal hrīḥ yongs gyur bdag snang gu ru pad+ma 'byung: snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i sku ru gsal: che btsan nus mthus 'byung po zil gnon dmigs: dngos po 'phrul bsgyur ni: t+t+waṃḥ rin chen sna tshogs snod mchog yangs pa'i nang: 'bru gsum 'od zhu rang rang yid mthun rdzas: rgyu bzang bkod legs blta na sdug pa yi: nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi'i khams yangs pa dog mor byed pas 'dod yon phun tshogs gyur: sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis spel kyi smon log 'bras bu dus su smin pa yis: rgya 'dre bse shing ya ma mgo dgu dang: mi nag gyad po che dang ha la'i gdong: si lan ta yi bu mo sma ra can: bse shing rta rna can dang lcags gzhung bsrengs: spug po mdung rtse can dang kha tog rnams: gsur sprin 'dod lnga'i dga' ston 'di rol la:

mcho lha klu gnyan gtod zo dor rgya 'dre yis: zhabrugs rtsod sbyor ba rang zhi rang grol nas: mtha' dbus mi rnams gral kha so sor gyis: chos dang chos min lha choX shan 'byed nas: rgyal khams bde skyid ldan pa'i phrin las mdzod: skyo āḥhūṃ: du ru ṣa shidzha ku ru sā hā: grangs bsogs: kyi: grogs skam tshol gdung che pa'i ha lan+ta: gol bar brten pa'i mdung shing masprin bzang gdong: khrag gi drod pa nad rims dug snying can: bse 'gong lcags zhwa can dang kha spu ba: dred po sgod skyam kha kha ri bong sogs: lan chags dmar po mer sbyangs gsur mchod 'dis: ngoms pa skongs shing re ba 'jo bzhin du: nad sna gdon rims tshangs gza' mgo bsnyon sogs: sems can mi bde'i zug ngu kun zhi nas: bde skyid chos bzhin spyod par mdzad du gsolaḥ au āḥs: du ru ṣa shirnyi ku ru sā hā: grangs bsogs kye: rgya changs rgyal po tsan+t+ra zla ba'i gdong: re ba'i g.yab mo dbugs sdud chu sbubs can: me 'khor rlung ring mtshon rdzong spug skyal khol: har ṣa dur sol khrag gi mchin pa kha: dug mtshon can dang chu yi 'khor lo sogs: mkhon sbyangs

lan chags mer bsreg gsur mchod 'dis: ngoms pa skong shing gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor zhi: nad yams 'khrugs rtsod kha char zu yug sogs: ming med stong pa chen por zhi gyur cig: skyed āḥhūṃ: du ru ṣa shirnyi ku ru swā hā: |: spo bo su ru'i gdong nas mgrin bzang gdong: gnam nu sa 'gam chu sri me tshwa 'phro: rlung tsag rbab rgod khrag tshos rdul phung po:du ba thang shing nags tshal lce spyang gdong: khos kha'i dug rtse kur ba dkar sog skyes: bse rung ha ti ca lan nag po dang: gdong dgu nga ro che dang ri glang sgra: snar thang gsus po che dang gzhung ring po: ko mi kho mig ya rang ṣa lan sogs: rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs can rgya 'dre'i tshogs: lan chags mer sbyangs 'dod lnga'i gsur sprin ni: sha khrag dmar mchod myong grol 'di rol la: ngoms pa gdung zhing nad mtshon mu ge dang: kha char sbu yug grang lhag zhi gyur nas: mi phyugs nor gyi tshe 'phrang rkyen bzlog cig: ma āhūṃ du ru ṣa shidzña ku ru sā hā: grang bsogs 'di dag ni byang kha phyog kyi rgya 'dre srin po yi rigs kyis mi yi mgo sdud phyugs kyi khral len sogs sgud pa sna mang zhi phyir smon nas bkod: ram̐ ye khaṃ: yin āno/: de bzhin btagags pa

shā kyi mthong ba don ldan la: gus pas phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi: rgya tsi nas bu mo glang mgo can: rgyu skar tshogs dang mi sdebs par: sha khrag gsur (dīrdo 'di rol la: kha char zu yug nad mtshon bzlog: za kha 'thung kha rang gnas bsgyur: 'gro ba'i bde sgyid ma 'phrog cig: a āḥhūṃ: du ru ṣa shirnyi ku ru swā hā: de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i snying po la: gus pas phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi: rgya pa la'i bse shing rta mgo can: gnam nas grang ba me dgu 'khor: bar nas gnyan rims sbos dgu 'khrul: sa nas tsha ba 'bar dgu 'phyo: gdug pa'i bdud mo sma ra can: sha khrag gsur mchod 'di rol la: gnam sa bar kyi ru 'dzing bsgyur: kha char rbu yug nad mtshon bzlog: za kha 'thung kha rang gnas bsgyur: 'gro ba'i bde skyid ma 'phrog cig: rlu āḥs: du ru ṣa shidzña ku ru swā hā: de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i sgra dbyangs la: gus pas phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi: rgya man kre'i ta byi a khro bo sman: mi srun sdig pa mgo dgu can: gser tshos bsgyur ba'i g.ya' sman ma: gang dkar bslad pa'i gro rag skyes:

bstan pa bsnub pa'i spron log mo: sha khrag gsur mchod 'di rol la: mdo sngags bstan la rgol ma byed kha char rbu yug nad mtshon bzlog za kha 'thung kha rang gnas bsgyur:'gro ba'i bde skyid ma 'phrog cig ma āX hūṃ: du ru ṣa shidzña ku ru swā hā: de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i 'od zer la: gus pas phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi: rgya gang shod bse shing ra mgo ma: 'gong bo bse rag the'u rang 'khor: 'dzam gling dpal g.yang 'phrog pa mo: sha khrag gsur mchod 'di rol la: mi phyug g.yang la 'jab ma byed: mgo bsnyen grib gdon sna tshogs sel: kha char rbu yug nad mtshon bzlog za kha 'thung kha rang gnas bsgyur 'gro ba'i bde skyid ma 'phrog cig: o āXhūṃ du ru ṣa shidzña ku ru swā hā:de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs dpa' bstan la: gus pas phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi: rgya zi lan ta yi phag mgo ma: rgya yi dpal khas bod khams bslu: bod kyi bsod nam dbang thang 'phrog: sgra yod med mgo la tog 'dzug ma: gos yod med gong khal rtag gzhugs mo: sha khrag gsur mchod 'di rol la: phung 'gyed 'phrul gyi zhag pa

—14 bsdus: smon lam log pa'i bsam ngan brgyur: kha char zu yug nad mtshon bzlog: za kha 'thung kha rang gnas bsgyur: 'gro ba'i bde skyid ma 'phrog cig:skyesa.āḥrdos du ru ṣa shirnye ku ru swā hā: lho rgyud zhol gyis rgya 'dre srin po'i rigs kyis mi yi mdang len phyug kyi khral bsdu sogs rgud pa sna mang las skyobs phyir bsngo bar bya'o: phyes āḥlhas me dmar bya btagags can khyu mkha' nas 'ong: ri ṣa lcags sder can ni sa nas 'tshubs: me ka phag mchu dug 'gyed mtshan mo rgyu: tsi nas dom snying dred mgo'i sna khrid byed: gang ljongs bod spyi'i bde skyid 'phrog byed pa'i: rgya 'dre sog gdon kun rgyu'i smon log 'phrul: nyi rdul zla rdul snang min nag rdul 'tshubs: ma mo 'khrugs nas skye rgu yal bar dor: 'gro ba'i rtsa dbugs khams la dug 'bu 'debs: sngar med gsar 'byung nad yams gdon gzer 'byung: 'bogs brgyal gas 'ching 'chi ba thog bab byed: ma rung mi bzad gdon las grol ba'i byir gsur mchodasha khrag 'dod lnga'i dga' ston rol: gdung ba zhi zhing ngoms pa skong bzhin du: nad mtshon mu ge btsa' sad mtshon 'khrugs dang: kha char grang rag

tsag rgod kun zhi nas: 'gro rnams bde skyid ldan pa'i phrin las mdzod: ces āḥhūṃ: du ru ṣa shidzha ku ru swā hā: smad rgya gdeng gi 'dre gdon rgol ba'i zug ngu nad mtshon mu ge zhabrugs slong thams cad zhi phyir bsngo bar bya'o: mthar phrin bcol bsdu rim ni: na mo: skyabs baspu med dkon mchog rin chen mkhyen: bdud rgya 'dre'i gdug sems zhi gyur cig: rlung g.yo 'khrugs a 'thas 'chang rgya yang: dbyings skye med nam mkha'i 1nga la sbyor: me dmar bo btsan dug nga ro'i rkyen: 'khrugs rtsod pa zhi ba'i brin las mdzod: rlung sa rdul sprin dmar gnam sa sbrel:stobs nus pa'i mthu yis gzhom du gsol: mi skye rgu'i blo sems mi bsgyur bar: lha mchog gsum bden mthus dge ldan mdzod: sems gcung rung bdud kyi rgol 'tshubs las: mgon pad+ma'i thugs rje'i gdung zhi mdzod: yongs 'gro rnams bde skyid ldan pa dang: gnas thar lam byang chub thob par shog: badz+ra sum̐: bsngo spron ni na ma dkon mchog kun dngos o rgyan pad ma dang: bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi byin rlabs mthus: med snang stong gzugs 'khrul snang rjes 'brang gdon: rgya bod lha 'dre'i gdug sems zhi gyur cig:

——— byams dang snying rje'i ngang la gnas gyur te: nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal ba zhi bar shog: lan gsum shes brjod ni na mo thugs baspyod dam bca' khur lci o rgyan rjes: mdzad pa'i phrin las mi g.yel myur mgyogs pas: mtha' mi dbus 'tshubs nad mtshon mu ge'i rkyen: ming gi lhag mar mdzad pa'i bkra shis re/ga: dngos ngan bdag kyang rgya 'dre 'byung po mchod bstod brten na dga' ba'i ma yin kyang: bod skyong dkar phyogs 'dis dbu 'phang dma' ba dang: rkyen des sa'i bcud nyams shing skye rgu'i g.yang dpal rgud pa dang me long gi byad chu ltar dregs ldan mang po mtha' nas bcum bod skyong dbu 'phang dma' ba dang: bstan ma'i 'du tshogs brel longs kyis kha ba grang rbud tsag rgod me 'dre chu 'dre sbab 'dre 'khang 'dre ldang ba dang: 'dzam gling sum gnyis kyi phyugs ma rgya la thob shor gyis ru 'dzing ma bzod nas rgyal khams kyi gral mtha'i spyon pa na mo ku su li pa kun bzang nyi mas bris pa sarba maṅga le/

'o/ 'byung po rgya 'dre ngom pa'i dri gsur phan bde'i snyi ma bzhags:——4 snying dus skyobs pa'i lha ( 11'di phyi'i re ltos bcol bzhin du: rgya 'dre'i ngom pa skong /ba'i phyir dri gsur bdurdo rtsi'i rgya ༵tsho spel: sa ma yu na mo gu ru ྅: snyigs dus kyi'agro ba skyobs pa'i dam bca' can o rgyan rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo: mtha' yi dmag gi dpa' rkong bar mdzad pa'i rig ldan rdo rje rnon po dang: mtshon cha'i 'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o: dus ngan snyigs ma lnga yi smag rum 'di phu nad mug mtshon gsum gyi sgo slong bar byed cing: bsam pa dug du 'gyur ba sbyor ba rtsub mo la gnas pa: sgo dor gyi rgol bas dpa' rkong mi btub pa'i rgya 'dre ha la nag po'i rigs su gtogs pa'i shar dug mtshon can dang: lto chu 'khor can dang chu yi 'dabs ma can: nub mtshon rdzong gling mtha' me 'khor can dang: byang ha ri ṣa dug mkhan bdud srin mo khrag gi dug skyal can la sogs smon lam log pa'i dam sri'i rigs su gyur ba rnam la bsngo'o: 'bul lo:

sbyin no: de ltarangom pa rkong ba'i gsur mchod 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung po: sha med sha yi ri bo: khrag med khrag gi rgya mtsho: drod med drod kyi phung po: dbug med dbug gi ba dan: sems med sems kyi ltad mo: ngoms pa skong ba'i bdud rtsir dmig nas 'bul lo: gnod gdug gi sems dang bral nas phan pa byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang ldan par mdzod cig: sems can thams cad la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba phun sum tshogs pa mi 'gogs par 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: 31 ādo/: du ru ṣa shidzña ku 〈co ye swā hā: zhes pa'ang dus kyi ru 'dzing ngan pa ma bzod nas 'gro la lhag bsam dkar ba'i blos nus ldan rdo rjes spel ba maṅga le/

ge rdo khyed āḥs: lha yibla ma 'jig rten skyobs pa'i dpal:dbang phyug chen pos mthu rtsal dpa' byung la: rgya 'dre 'byung po'i blo sems lcags kyus drongs:dbang gi zhags pas thar mchor med par chings:'bar ba'i 'od kyis bde ba chen por myos:rgyal ba'i bstan dang 'gro la mi 'tshe bar:tshad med byams dang snying rjes dgongs rgyas thob:skye rgu'i tshe dang bsod nams phywa g.yang nor:gang la mi 'jigs dus kyi rgud pa sol:dri gsur 'dod lnga'i dga' ston ros bskangs nas:spyi mthun las kyis bskul ba'i nad mug mtshon rgud pa sna mang zhi zhing ring du byer:khyad par kha ba bu yug grang gzer cag:sum sbrel rkya ya chu ser mi yi nad:tshang gza' mgo bsnyon mchis 'gong phyug gi gdon:sa'i bcud rkye rgu'i g.yang rku 'gong 'dre rnams:dmar gsur 'dod yon lnga ldan tshab mar gtong: hab thob rol zhing nyes tshogs mi gtong bar:'gro rnams bde skyid ldan pa'i brin las mdzod:khyad ā:nyu du ru ṣa shidzña ku ru ye swā hā:

dpa oṃ āḥ(: bdud dug minag po srog gi bdag: yongs skye rgu'i tshe nor g.yang la bza': gsur sha khrag dri yi ngoms byos la: nad 'brum bu shu ba rgya thor dang: dreg grum bu bal nad rgyugs 'gyel rigs: gnyan rims yams be ge lhog srin sogs: dbyings ma mo 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs dang: phyogs sde brgyad gdugs pa'i cho 'phrul nad: thabs zhi gyur zab mo 'dis ngoms nas: yul rgyang thag ring bar bsgrad la byer: ma 'gro ba'i bde skyid mi bcom par: mgon o rgyan thugs rje'i grol gyur cig:sarba /shā dzag ṣa dz+wa ra pra ro/ ma ṇi swā hā: grangs bsags na gal che bar 'dra nas nus ldan pas bras pa dza yan+tu/

—11 dus ngan snyegs ma'irgyad gso gter ston nus ldan rdo rje'i nyams snang gsur mchod bzhugs so:——1) rgya 'dre'i gzing pa phyogs bzhir ldang: sems can blo sems rmong par byed nad yams kha char bu yug dang: nyes pa sna tshogs gzings ling tshe: 'bru bye sha tshil mar gyi spag: snying rje'i gter chen gsal bzhin pa'i gsur rdzas sngags dang khyag rgyas spel rnga gshang dkrol bzhin 'di skad brjod: yin āḥ&: mtho srid pa'irtse mo man chad: dma' na rag dmyal ba yan chad: bar gling bzhi 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag gnyis 'dzin gyi 'khrul ba rngams po can gyi gdon: pho gdon rgyal po: mi gdon bse mo: klu gdon sa bdag: gza' gdon rgyu skar: ya bdud rgyal po: ma bdud rgyal mo: btsan kha bzhi: 'byung po sde brgyad: rgyal po dang 'byung po:sha za dang dang ro lang: gnam sman dang btsan gshed: gnam sa bar snang gi the'u rang dang: yul 'dre dri za gshed 'khyams nad rims yams kyi bdag po bdag mo: tshe rab thog med nas lan cing chags pa'i bu lon sha mkhon gyi bdag po: btsa' sad ser gsum kyi bdag po:

glo han rngo ṇi'i bdag po: tshang gza' mgo spyon gyi bdag po: kha tshwa mid nad gyi bdag po: lted 'theng rngo 'bras kyi bdag po ldan 'dus gdon gsum gyi bdag po: kha 'gong mig 'gong snying 'gong gi bdag po: mkhris pa rtsa rgyug gsum sbrel gyi bdag po: tshad gnyan rlung mkhris rgyu tshad kyi bdag po: kha ba bu yug grang dbal gyi bdag po: rgya 'dre 'byung po yi tshogs su gyur pa rnams la 'bul lo: sbyin no: gnod gdug gi bsam pa dang bral nas phan pa byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par mdzod cig: sems can thams cad la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba phun sum tshogs pa mi 'gogs par 'byung bar mdzad dul gsol: 31 ādo/sdas ru ṣa shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: grangs bzung par bya: maṅga le/

—13 gsur mchod bzhugs ram̐ yi sa: au āḥhūṃ: gsur 'dod pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa nam mkha' mdzod du gyur: sa badz+ra spa ra ṇa sa: kye: ma rig pa las 'khrul ba'i 'dre dri za gnas gdon las gdon dang: shi gson grong 'dre pho mo rnams: rig pa ye shes gsur mchod 'dis: ngom shing tshims la grol gyur cig: se bha ras sngags lan bdun brjod sarba bisno gahā bsngo smon bya: a pan nas bskul nus ldan pas so/ snyigs ma'i ru 'dzing 'tshubs dus su nye bar mkho ba'i gsur mchod ni: ram̐ ye dza: nyes āḥhūṃ:skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs pad 'byung mkhyen: snying rjes 'gro ba 'dor med spyan ras gzigs: gdul dka' 'dre bdud ar gtad thal 'byin lha: mtha' mi'i rdzas sbyor byad bzlog bdud 'dul ma: 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs rje btsun myur ma dpal: rgyal ba'i tha tshig gnyer 'dzin bka' sdod bcas dgongs pa'i dbyings las thugs rjes rtsal bskyod la: gdul dka' nyon mongs 'dul ba'i ru mtshon phyor: gtum rngams a la ha la'i gad rgyang sgogs: dpa' brjid khro la 'khros pa'i rnam 'gyur ngoms: nad mug

mtshon 'khrugs dmag gi gzengs pa bzlog: bod phung dam sri'i shes rgyud dam la thob: rgya 'dre me zhon 'byung po rlung zhon dang: char sdud chu sbubs can dang sbugs skyal khol:dge legs dpal 'phrog re ba'i g.yab mo can: ra mgo phag thod rnga mong dred kyis gzugs: rgyal tshabs sku yi gegs bdud kha mig mang: su ru nu ru kha la kha ro yug:ma lus re ba 'jo ba'i rten 'brel rdzas:sha khrag drod mo ṣa mngar skyur zas rigs: ra dang lug gsob bya pho ri bong rna: kun 'byung 'dod yon tshangs ba'i gsur mchod 'di: rgya 'dre srin po'i rigs gtogs yongs la bsngo: sras bcas rgyal ba'i bden mthus thob gyur cig:ngoms pa skong nas re ba 'jo bzhin du: rang gnas phyir ldog rgud pa zhi gyur cig:nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhir brten bcas pa'i: the 'gong bse reg dbul sri kun ngoms nas: rgya 'dres bod phong 'phrin blon mi byed par: sa 'og chos kyi rgyal bo'i bka' khrims bzhin: rgyu 'bras bslu med don la gnas par gyis: za kha 'thung kha yus rngams gdug rtsub khrims: nyes med sdug sbyor bsam ngan rbod gtong mkhan:ra dza slar 'khri

—10 bse mo rjes 'brang pa'i: ban+dhe dkor dred bag chags 'thug po can: mthu gtad sel gsum nyam zor mnan las mkhan: ming gi lhag mar byed pa'i rngams zas kyis: sha khrag phogs su gtad do tshe srog phrol: lus sems tshogs pa gtor la sri zas mdzod: 'khrul ba sbubs bshig yang dag lam zin par: dkon mchog gsum dang ces rgyan pad+ma mkhyen: cas āḥhūṃ: grangs bsogs gsur gtong dus kyi rgud pa zhi: rten 'brel che phyir nus ldan rdo rjes bris/ sarba maṅga lam/

—10 oṃ āḥsno smon lam log pa'i las ngan nyon mongs pa: rgya 'dre ra mgo can dang chu 'khor can: me dmar bya yi phung po sbrul dug can: chu yi 'dab can mtsho rdzings gling mtha' me: su ru nu ru kha la kha ro yug: hā ri ṣa skyal srin mo khrag dug skyal: ltog nad dgu 'khrugs klu nad khol ba gsum: gnyan nad khrag bshal rgyu mkhal mchin tshad khol: spob ring dgu 'khrugs rgya 'dre 'gong po'i rigs: thams cad ma lus myong grol gsur mchod 'dis: ngoms pa skongs shing re ba 'jo bzhin tu: rang gnas phyir log nad mug mtshon gsum dang: mi 'dod nyes tshogs ming med ka dag mdzod: a āḥhūṃ:du ru ṣa shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: 'di yang nus ldan rdo rjes sbyar ba'o: :: rin chen sgod bzang 'dod yon phyur bur gtams: tshogs drug rgyan shar zhen med rang grol gter: mi zad nam mkha' yangs pa'i mdzod chen po: mthong thos dran rag rnam grol sar bkod pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul ba'i gnas gyur pa: ga ga gnas glo bur lhag pa'i 'byung po'i rigs: nad rims yams bdag shi 'dre gson bdud bgegs: za 'dre phung sri

dme mkhon 'khrug slong sde: god kha chags sgo bkra mi shes par byed: dbul nad mtshon sogs sbyor ngan sna tshogs pa: 'gro kun sdug la sbyor ba'i dam sri rnams: rang grol 'dod yon mchog gis ngoms tshim nas: gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor rtsub mo dang bral te: phan pa byang chub sems la rtag gnas shing: rig pa 'od gsal dbyings su ngal gso bzhin: kun khyab gdod ma'i rgyal sar sangs rgyas re ga: a a li u li ta li haṃ bha li bha ti ya yi swā hā: skyid āḥhūṃ: 'bru gsum la grangs bsogs na don che bar mngon rmi lam 'khrul nyams don ldan yin snyams nas rnal 'byor kun bzang dgyes phyir nus ldan pas so: sarba maṅga lam/

baX dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgud gso gter ston nus ldan rdo rje'i snang nyams gsur mchod bzhugs so:——1) rgya 'dre'i gzengs pa phyogs bzhi'i ldang: sems can blo sems rmong par byed nad yams kha char bu yug dang: nyes pa sna tshogs gzengs langs tshe: 'bru phye sha tshil mar gyi rbag: snying rje'i gter chen gsal bzhin pas gsur rdzas sngags dang phyag rgyas spel: rnga gshang dkrol bzhin 'di skad brjod: rgya 'dre blo sems kyi 'khrugs pa zhi bar mdzad pa'i mgon po mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o: o āḥs: dus ngan snyigs ma lnga yi smag rum 'dir: smon lam log pa'i las dbang gis bskyed pa'i: rgya 'dre chu 'dab can dang chu 'khor rdolaḥ sgrug rdul 'tshubs dang grang lhag khol ba sogs: skye 'gro'i shes rgyud brlag pa'i rgya 'dre rnams: dri gsur myong grol sman mchog 'di spyod cig: ngoms pa skong shing re ba 'jo bzhin du: kha char zu yug 'tshubs rdul mi ston par: nad sna phyir bzlog dmag jag mkhon 'dzing gzhom: bod khams bkra mi shes pa'i nyes tshogs bzlog: khyed cag za kha 'thung kha rang gnas

bsdus: bod skyong dkar phyogs dbu 'phang mi phab par: rang bzhin gshes ngan nag po'i rgya yul dengs: gangs ljongs bod spyi'i bsod nams tshe chos nor skyobs pa'i lha lnga rdzogs dgu'i byin rlabs kyi: gnas skabs mthar thug 'tsho bar mdzad du gsol: skyid āḥ:: du ru ṣa shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: zhes pa'ang bod khams mnar byed rgya 'dre'i 'tshubs ma lang nas sems can gyi bde skyid bcoms nye tshe lhag bsam dkar ba'i blos nus ldan pas gang shar bab bcol du bris pa maṅga lam̐/ —

ge rdo oṃ āḥs: rgya 'dre kha dmar gnam thog rgod po la:sa srin the'u rang mang pos 'khor dang bcas:rā dza zangs mche lcags kyi ral can la:rab snyigs dur khrod mo 'dre mang pos bskor:bsen mo rkan brdeb mi snying rlon 'phrog dmar:bla rkun gnyan rims yams bdag mang pos bskor:byis sri hor gyi pu tra tshe zan la:chung 'dre chung gdon sri rkun mang pos bskor:kun kyang sgyu ma'i dkor nor 'di la spyod:gsur dri 'dod lnga'i phung pos tshim kyis la:ber ke 'brum bu dmar bshal gnyan rims lnga:mkhris pa rtsa rgyug nywa gas thod gas dang:nag po sum 'dril bad nad mi gtong bar:ma mo'i dal yams nad srin sngo dmar bsdu:'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gdung ba kun zhi nas:bde skyid chos bzhin spyod par mdzad du gsol:sa bhisne du ru ṣa sarba dz+wa ra shirnyi ku ru swā hwa:nus ldan pas so:

—1) nyams snang las: rgya 'dre 'byung po'i tshogs la me gsur bsngo ba bzhugs:da(3 na mo gu ru ye: lejagi ོ skyabs sems ni: na re: snyigs 'gro skyabs med yongs kyis skyabs gcig pu: o rgyan rin po che la skyabs su mchi: dus kyis rgud min gdung ba bsal bya'i phyir: rnam dag byang chub mchog du sems bskyed do: lan gsum: me gsur ni: :: stong dang snyeng rje'i rang mdangs zhi ba'i thab: dkar zlum bsregs rdzas 'dod lnga sgyu ma'i 'phrul: bza' bas mi zad btung bas mi skems shing / bgo bas mi nyams spyod pa'i mi dbul ba: dpag bsam lha yis dga' ston lta bu 'di: srid zhi'i mgron la kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul: bdag gzhan nyes ltung dam sdom nyams pa bshags: mgon po yon tan mgron gyur rnams la 'bul: bdag gi chos mthun bsam pa mthar phyin mdzod: stod smad bar gsum yul gzhi'i bdag por 'bul: nad mug 'khrugs rtsod dus kyi rgud pa sol: dge bsnyen 'brong ri bka' blon 'bangs sder 'bul:

gser gru 'dzin la kha 'dzin sdong grogs mdzod rgya 'dre 'byung po dus mtha'i gdon la bsngo: sngon po'i dug tshangs 'byung lnga'i g.yo 'khrugs bzlog: dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro lha ma yin: lha mi bar do'i 'gro ba snying rje'i yul: thams cad ma lus ngoms pa skong phyir 'bul: rang snang sdug bral bde ba mchog ldan shog: the'u 'gong bse rag grong rgyug 'byung por 'bul: mi nad phyugs nad bkra mi shis pa thul: pho 'dre mo 'dre gri gshed yongs la bsngo: ngoms shing tshims nas gnod 'tshe ma byed cig mas mgron thams cad bde ldan sdul bsngal bral: byang chub sems kyis ngang la gnas gyur cig: sa/ āX :: bisne du ru ṣa shirnyi ku ru swā hā bsdu rim bsngo smon ni: he: gsur mgron thams cad mi dmigs ngang la bsdu: don dam bden pas kun rdzob rten 'brel legs dge ba 'khor gsum yongs su dag par bsngo: rlung sems yul gyis mching rgya rang grol re ga: na mo: thub pa'i bstan pa nang rgyud gsang sngags kyi bstan dang bstan 'dzin yar ngos zla ltar 'phel: bshad dang sgrub pas yangs pa'i rgyal khams khyab: bde skyid chos bzhin spyod pa'i bkra

——1) shis de ga: de ltar phul bas 'gro phan 'grub: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya zhes pa'ang sgo spa'i dbon po blo rnams kyis dar bcas bskul ngor nus ldan pas gus phul/das rgya 'dre 'byung po brngan gsur 'dod 'byung dpal 'phel bzhugs so:—1) na mo gu ru yā: zas sna bsregs pas phye mar sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangs bsgyur spel la 'di skad brjod rgo āhūṃ: snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mi srun ma rung ba'i: rgya 'dre srin po'i rigs dang chu 'khor can: mtshon rdzong gling mtha' me 'khor ha ru ṣa dug sbyor khrag rkyal khol dang bdud srin mo: thams cad ma lus phun tshogs dri gsur rol: nad yams kha char mi dge 'khrugs rtsod sogs: rgya 'dre'i gdug rtsub bsam sbyor ngan pa zhi: thams cad 'khrul snang rang sar grol gyur cig: sa ā&: du ru ṣa shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā:zhes snyigs ma'i ru 'dzing nad mtshon mu ge'i rgud pa sel phyir nus ldan rdo rjes spel ba dge legs 'phel/
